text_en: These are the words, which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan , in the plain wilderness , over against the Red Sea , between Pharan and Thophel and Laban and Haseroth, where there is very much gold.
text_la: Hæc sunt verba quæ locutus est Moyses ad omnem Israël trans Jordanem in solitudine campestri, contra mare Rubrum, inter Pharan et Tophel et Laban et Haseroth, ubi auri est plurimum:
text_pt: Estas são as palavras que Moisés falou a todo o Israel além do Jordão, no deserto, na planície defronte do Mar Vermelho, entre Parã e Tôfel, e Labã, e Hazerote, e Di-Zaabe.
text_el: οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι οὓς ἐλάλησεν Μωυσῆς παντὶ Ισραηλ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ πρὸς δυσμαῖς πλησίον τῆς ἐρυθρᾶς ἀνὰ μέσον Φαραν Τοφολ καὶ Λοβον καὶ Αυλων καὶ καταχρύσεα

text_en: Eleven days' journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir to Cadesbarne .
text_la: undecim diebus de Horeb per viam montis Seir usque ad Cadesbarne.
text_pt: Onze jornadas há desde Horebe, caminho do monte Seir, até Cades-Barnéia.
text_el: ἕνδεκα ἡμερῶν ἐν Χωρηβ ὁδὸς ἐπ' ὄρος Σηιρ ἕως Καδης Βαρνη

text_en: In the fortieth year, the eleventh month, the first day of the month, Moses spoke to the children of Israel all that the Lord had commanded him to say to them:
text_la: Quadragesimo anno, undecimo mense, prima die mensis, locutus est Moyses ad filios Israël omnia quæ præceperat illi Dominus, ut diceret eis,
text_pt: E sucedeu que, no ano quadragésimo, no mês undécimo, no primeiro dia do mês, Moisés falou aos filhos de Israel, conforme a tudo o que o Senhor lhe mandara acerca deles.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἐν τῷ τεσσαρακοστῷ ἔτει ἐν τῷ ἑνδεκάτῳ μηνὶ μιᾷ τοῦ μηνὸς ἐλάλησεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς πάντας υἱοὺς Ισραηλ κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐνετείλατο κύριος αὐτῷ πρὸς αὐτούς

text_en: After that he had slain Sehon king of the Amorrhites , who dwelt in Hesebon : and Og king of Basan who abode in Astaroth, and in Edrai,
text_la: postquam percussit Sehon regem Amorrhæorum, qui habitabat in Hesebon, et Og regem Basan, qui mansit in Astaroth, et in Edrai,
text_pt: Depois que feriu a Siom, rei dos amorreus, que habitava em Hesbom, e a Ogue, rei de Basã, que habitava em Astarote, em Edrei.
text_el: μετὰ τὸ πατάξαι Σηων βασιλέα Αμορραίων τὸν κατοικήσαντα ἐν Εσεβων καὶ Ωγ βασιλέα τῆς Βασαν τὸν κατοικήσαντα ἐν Ασταρωθ καὶ ἐν Εδραϊν

text_en: beyond the Jordan in the land of Moab . And Moses began to expound the law , and to say:
text_la: trans Jordanem in terra Moab. Cœpitque Moyses explanare legem, et dicere:
text_pt: Além do Jordão, na terra de Moabe, começou Moisés a declarar esta lei, dizendo:
text_el: ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἐν γῇ Μωαβ ἤρξατο Μωυσῆς διασαφῆσαι τὸν νόμον τοῦτον λέγων

text_en: The Lord our God spoke to us in Horeb , saying: You have stayed long enough in this mountain:
text_la: Dominus Deus noster locutus est ad nos in Horeb, dicens : Sufficit vobis quod in hoc monte mansistis:
text_pt: O Senhor nosso Deus nos falou em Horebe, dizendo: Assaz vos haveis demorado neste monte.
text_el: κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐλάλησεν ἡμῖν ἐν Χωρηβ λέγων ἱκανούσθω ὑμῖν κατοικεῖν ἐν τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ

text_en: Turn you, and come to the mountain of the Amorrhites , and to the other places that are next to it, the plains and the hills and the vales towards the south, and by the sea shore, the land of the Chanaanites , and of Libanus, as far as the great river Euphrates.
text_la: revertimini, et venite ad montem Amorrhæorum, et ad cetera quæ ei proxima sunt campestria atque montana et humiliora loca contra meridiem, et juxta littus maris, terram Chananæorum, et Libani usque ad flumen magnum Euphraten.
text_pt: Voltai-vos, e parti, e ide à montanha dos amorreus, e a todos os seus vizinhos, à planície, e à montanha, e ao vale, e ao sul, e à margem do mar; à terra dos cananeus, e ao Líbano, até ao grande rio, o rio Eufrates.
text_el: ἐπιστράφητε καὶ ἀπάρατε ὑμεῖς καὶ εἰσπορεύεσθε εἰς ὄρος Αμορραίων καὶ πρὸς πάντας τοὺς περιοίκους Αραβα εἰς ὄρος καὶ πεδίον καὶ πρὸς λίβα καὶ παραλίαν γῆν Χαναναίων καὶ Ἀντιλίβανον ἕως τοῦ ποταμοῦ τοῦ μεγάλου Εὐφράτου

text_en: Behold, said he, I have delivered it to you: go in and possess it, concerning which the Lord swore to your fathers Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob , that he would give it to them, and to their seed after them.
text_la: En, inquit, tradidi vobis : ingredimini et possidete eam, super qua juravit Dominus patribus vestris Abraham, Isaac, et Jacob, ut daret illam eis, et semini eorum post eos.
text_pt: Eis que tenho posto esta terra diante de vós; entrai e possuí a terra que o Senhor jurou a vossos pais, Abraão, Isaque e Jacó, que a daria a eles e à sua descendência depois deles.
text_el: ἴδετε παραδέδωκα ἐνώπιον ὑμῶν τὴν γῆν εἰσπορευθέντες κληρονομήσατε τὴν γῆν ἣν ὤμοσα τοῖς πατράσιν ὑμῶν τῷ Αβρααμ καὶ Ισαακ καὶ Ιακωβ δοῦναι αὐτοῖς καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτῶν μετ' αὐτούς

text_en: And I said to you at that time:
text_la: Dixique vobis illo in tempore:
text_pt: E no mesmo tempo eu vos falei, dizendo: Eu sozinho não poderei levar-vos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ λέγων οὐ δυνήσομαι μόνος φέρειν ὑμᾶς

text_en: I alone am not able to bear you: for the Lord your God has multiplied you, and you are this day as the stars of heaven , for multitude.
text_la: Non possum solus sustinere vos : quia Dominus Deus vester multiplicavit vos, et estis hodie sicut stellæ cæli, plurimi.
text_pt: O Senhor vosso Deus já vos tem multiplicado; e eis que em multidão sois hoje como as estrelas do céu.
text_el: κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν ἐπλήθυνεν ὑμᾶς καὶ ἰδού ἐστε σήμερον ὡσεὶ τὰ ἄστρα τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τῷ πλήθει

text_en: (The Lord God of your fathers add to this number many thousands, and bless you as he has spoken.)
text_la: (Dominus Deus patrum vestrorum addat ad hunc numerum multa millia, et benedicat vobis sicut locutus est.)
text_pt: O Senhor Deus de vossos pais vos aumente, ainda mil vezes mais do que sois; e vos abençoe, como vos tem falado.
text_el: κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν προσθείη ὑμῖν ὡς ἐστὲ χιλιοπλασίως καὶ εὐλογήσαι ὑμᾶς καθότι ἐλάλησεν ὑμῖν

text_en: I alone am not able to bear your business, and the charge of you and your differences.
text_la: Non valeo solus negotia vestra sustinere, et pondus ac jurgia.
text_pt: Como suportaria eu sozinho os vossos fardos, e as vossas cargas, e as vossas contendas?
text_el: πῶς δυνήσομαι μόνος φέρειν τὸν κόπον ὑμῶν καὶ τὴν ὑπόστασιν ὑμῶν καὶ τὰς ἀντιλογίας ὑμῶν

text_en: Let me have from among you wise and understanding men , and such whose conversation is approved among your tribes , that I may appoint them your rulers.
text_la: Date ex vobis viros sapientes et gnaros, et quorum conversatio sit probata in tribubus vestris, ut ponam eos vobis principes.
text_pt: Tomai-vos homens sábios e entendidos, experimentados entre as vossas tribos, para que os ponha por chefes sobre vós.
text_el: δότε ἑαυτοῖς ἄνδρας σοφοὺς καὶ ἐπιστήμονας καὶ συνετοὺς εἰς τὰς φυλὰς ὑμῶν καὶ καταστήσω ἐφ' ὑμῶν ἡγουμένους ὑμῶν

text_en: Then you answered me: The thing is good which you mean to do.
text_la: Tunc respondistis mihi : Bona res est, quam vis facere.
text_pt: Então vós me respondestes, e dissestes: Bom é fazer o que tens falado.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθητέ μοι καὶ εἴπατε καλὸν τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ ἐλάλησας ποιῆσαι

text_en: And I took out of your tribes men wise and honourable , and appointed them rulers, tribunes, and centurions , and officers over fifties, and over tens, who might teach you all things.
text_la: Tulique de tribubus vestris viros sapientes et nobiles, et constitui eos principes, tribunos, et centuriones, et quinquagenarios ac decanos, qui docerent vos singula.
text_pt: Tomei, pois, os chefes de vossas tribos, homens sábios e experimentados, e os tenho posto por cabeças sobre vós, por capitães de milhares, e por capitães de cem, e por capitães de cinqüenta, e por capitães de dez, e por governadores das vossas tribos.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβον ἐξ ὑμῶν ἄνδρας σοφοὺς καὶ ἐπιστήμονας καὶ συνετοὺς καὶ κατέστησα αὐτοὺς ἡγεῖσθαι ἐφ' ὑμῶν χιλιάρχους καὶ ἑκατοντάρχους καὶ πεντηκοντάρχους καὶ δεκαδάρχους καὶ γραμματοεισαγωγεῖς τοῖς κριταῖς ὑμῶν

text_en: And I commanded them, saying: Hear them, and judge that which is just : whether he be one of your country, or a stranger.
text_la: Præcepique eis, dicens : Audite illos, et quod justum est judicate : sive civis sit ille, sive peregrinus.
text_pt: E no mesmo tempo mandei a vossos juízes, dizendo: Ouvi a causa entre vossos irmãos, e julgai justamente entre o homem e seu irmão, e entre o estrangeiro que está com ele.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετειλάμην τοῖς κριταῖς ὑμῶν ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ λέγων διακούετε ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ἀδελφῶν ὑμῶν καὶ κρίνατε δικαίως ἀνὰ μέσον ἀνδρὸς καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον ἀδελφοῦ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον προσηλύτου αὐτοῦ

text_en: There shall be no difference of persons, you shall hear the little as well as the great: neither shall you respect any man's person, because it is the judgment of God . And if anything seem hard to you, refer it to me, and I will hear it.
text_la: Nulla erit distantia personarum : ita parvum audietis ut magnum, nec accipietis cujusquam personam, quia Dei judicium est. Quod si difficile vobis visum aliquid fuerit, referte ad me, et ego audiam.
text_pt: Não discriminareis as pessoas em juízo; ouvireis assim o pequeno como o grande; não temereis a face de ninguém, porque o juízo é de Deus; porém a causa que vos for difícil fareis vir a mim, e eu a ouvirei.
text_el: οὐκ ἐπιγνώσῃ πρόσωπον ἐν κρίσει κατὰ τὸν μικρὸν καὶ κατὰ τὸν μέγαν κρινεῖς οὐ μὴ ὑποστείλῃ πρόσωπον ἀνθρώπου ὅτι ἡ κρίσις τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν καὶ τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ ἐὰν σκληρὸν ᾖ ἀφ' ὑμῶν ἀνοίσετε αὐτὸ ἐπ' ἐμέ καὶ ἀκούσομαι αὐτό

text_en: And I commanded you all things that you were to do.
text_la: Præcepique omnia quæ facere deberetis.
text_pt: Assim naquele tempo vos ordenei todas as coisas que havíeis de fazer.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετειλάμην ὑμῖν ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ πάντας τοὺς λόγους οὓς ποιήσετε

text_en: And departing from Horeb , we passed through the terrible and vast wilderness , which you saw, by the way of the mountain of the Amorrhite , as the Lord our God had commanded us. And when we had come into Cadesbarne ,
text_la: Profecti autem de Horeb, transivimus per eremum terribilem et maximam, quam vidistis, per viam montis Amorrhæi, sicut præceperat Dominus Deus noster nobis. Cumque venissemus in Cadesbarne,
text_pt: Então partimos de Horebe, e caminhamos por todo aquele grande e tremendo deserto que vistes, pelo caminho das montanhas dos amorreus, como o Senhor nosso Deus nos ordenara; e chegamos a Cades-Barnéia.
text_el: καὶ ἀπάραντες ἐκ Χωρηβ ἐπορεύθημεν πᾶσαν τὴν ἔρημον τὴν μεγάλην καὶ τὴν φοβερὰν ἐκείνην ἣν εἴδετε ὁδὸν ὄρους τοῦ Αμορραίου καθότι ἐνετείλατο κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ἡμῖν καὶ ἤλθομεν ἕως Καδης Βαρνη

text_en: I said to you: You have come to the mountain of the Amorrhite , which the Lord our God will give to us.
text_la: dixi vobis : Venistis ad montem Amorrhæi, quem Dominus Deus noster daturus est nobis:
text_pt: Então eu vos disse: Chegados sois às montanhas dos amorreus, que o Senhor nosso Deus nos dá.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἤλθατε ἕως τοῦ ὄρους τοῦ Αμορραίου ὃ ὁ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν δίδωσιν ὑμῖν

text_en: See the land which the Lord your God gives you: go up and possess it, as the Lord our God has spoken to your fathers: fear not, nor be any way discouraged.
text_la: vide terram, quam Dominus Deus tuus dat tibi : ascende et posside eam, sicut locutus est Dominus Deus noster patribus tuis : noli timere, nec quidquam paveas.
text_pt: Eis aqui o Senhor teu Deus tem posto esta terra diante de ti; sobe, toma posse dela, como te falou o Senhor Deus de teus pais; não temas, e não te assustes.
text_el: ἴδετε παραδέδωκεν ὑμῖν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν πρὸ προσώπου ὑμῶν τὴν γῆν ἀναβάντες κληρονομήσατε ὃν τρόπον εἶπεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν ὑμῖν μὴ φοβεῖσθε μηδὲ δειλιάσητε

text_en: And you came all to me, and said: Let us send men who may view the land, and bring us word what way we shall go up, and to what cities we shall go.
text_la: Et accessistis ad me omnes, atque dixistis : Mittamus viros qui considerent terram : et renuntient per quod iter debeamus ascendere, et ad quas pergere civitates.
text_pt: Então todos vós chegastes a mim, e dissestes: Mandemos homens adiante de nós, para que nos espiem a terra e, de volta, nos ensinem o caminho pelo qual devemos subir, e as cidades a que devemos ir.
text_el: καὶ προσήλθατέ μοι πάντες καὶ εἴπατε ἀποστείλωμεν ἄνδρας προτέρους ἡμῶν καὶ ἐφοδευσάτωσαν ἡμῖν τὴν γῆν καὶ ἀναγγειλάτωσαν ἡμῖν ἀπόκρισιν τὴν ὁδόν δι' ἧς ἀναβησόμεθα ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ τὰς πόλεις εἰς ἃς εἰσπορευσόμεθα εἰς αὐτάς

text_en: And because the saying pleased me, I sent of you twelve men , one of every tribe :
text_la: Cumque mihi sermo placuisset, misi ex vobis duodecim viros, singulos de tribubus suis.
text_pt: Isto me pareceu bem; de modo que de vós tomei doze homens, de cada tribo um homem.
text_el: καὶ ἤρεσεν ἐναντίον μου τὸ ῥῆμα καὶ ἔλαβον ἐξ ὑμῶν δώδεκα ἄνδρας ἄνδρα ἕνα κατὰ φυλήν

text_en: Who, when they had set forward and had gone up to the mountains, came as far as the valley of the cluster: and having viewed the land,
text_la: Qui cum perrexissent, et ascendissent in montana, venerunt usque ad Vallem botri : et considerata terra,
text_pt: E foram-se, e subiram à montanha, e chegaram até ao vale de Escol, e o espiaram.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιστραφέντες ἀνέβησαν εἰς τὸ ὄρος καὶ ἤλθοσαν ἕως Φάραγγος βότρυος καὶ κατεσκόπευσαν αὐτήν

text_en: taking of the fruits thereof, to show its fertility, they brought them to us, and said: The land is good , which the Lord our God will give us.
text_la: sumentes de fructibus ejus, ut ostenderent ubertatem, attulerunt ad nos, atque dixerunt : Bona est terra, quam Dominus Deus noster daturus est nobis.
text_pt: E tomaram do fruto da terra nas suas mãos, e no-lo trouxeram e nos informaram, dizendo: Boa é a terra que nos dá o Senhor nosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάβοσαν ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τοῦ καρποῦ τῆς γῆς καὶ κατήνεγκαν πρὸς ἡμᾶς καὶ ἔλεγον ἀγαθὴ ἡ γῆ ἣν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν δίδωσιν ἡμῖν

text_en: And you would not go up, but being incredulous to the word of the Lord our God ,
text_la: Et noluistis ascendere, sed increduli ad sermonem Domini Dei nostri,
text_pt: Porém vós não quisestes subir; mas fostes rebeldes ao mandado do Senhor nosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἠθελήσατε ἀναβῆναι καὶ ἠπειθήσατε τῷ ῥήματι κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν

text_en: you murmured in your tents, and said: The Lord hates us, and therefore he has brought us out of the land of Egypt , that he might deliver us into the hand of the Amorrhite , and destroy us.
text_la: murmurastis in tabernaculis vestris, atque dixistis : Odit nos Dominus, et idcirco eduxit nos de terra Ægypti, ut traderet nos in manu Amorrhæi, atque deleret.
text_pt: E murmurastes nas vossas tendas, e dissestes: Porquanto o Senhor nos odeia, nos tirou da terra do Egito para nos entregar nas mãos dos amorreus, para destruir-nos.
text_el: καὶ διεγογγύζετε ἐν ταῖς σκηναῖς ὑμῶν καὶ εἴπατε διὰ τὸ μισεῖν κύριον ἡμᾶς ἐξήγαγεν ἡμᾶς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου παραδοῦναι ἡμᾶς εἰς χεῖρας Αμορραίων ἐξολεθρεῦσαι ἡμᾶς

text_en: Whither shall we go up? The messengers have terrified our hearts, saying: The multitude is very great, and taller than we: the cities are great, and walled up to the sky, we have seen the sons of the Enacims there.
text_la: Quo ascendemus? nuntii terruerunt cor nostrum, dicentes : Maxima multitudo est, et nobis statura procerior; urbes magnæ, et ad cælum usque munitæ : filios Enacim vidimus ibi.
text_pt: Para onde subiremos? Nossos irmãos fizeram com que se derretesse o nosso coração, dizendo: Maior e mais alto é este povo do que nós, as cidades são grandes e fortificadas até aos céus; e também vimos ali filhos dos gigantes.
text_el: ποῦ ἡμεῖς ἀναβαίνομεν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ὑμῶν ἀπέστησαν ὑμῶν τὴν καρδίαν λέγοντες ἔθνος μέγα καὶ πολὺ καὶ δυνατώτερον ἡμῶν καὶ πόλεις μεγάλαι καὶ τετειχισμέναι ἕως τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἀλλὰ καὶ υἱοὺς γιγάντων ἑωράκαμεν ἐκεῖ

text_en: And I said to you: Fear not; neither be afraid of them:
text_la: Et dixi vobis : Nolite metuere, nec timeatis eos:
text_pt: Então eu vos disse: Não vos espanteis, nem os temais.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα πρὸς ὑμᾶς μὴ πτήξητε μηδὲ φοβηθῆτε ἀπ' αὐτῶν

text_en: The Lord God , who is your leader, himself will fight for you, as he did in Egypt in the sight of all.
text_la: Dominus Deus, qui ductor est vester, pro vobis ipse pugnabit, sicut fecit in Ægypto cunctis videntibus.
text_pt: O Senhor vosso Deus que vai adiante de vós, ele pelejará por vós, conforme a tudo o que fez convosco, diante de vossos olhos, no Egito;
text_el: κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν ὁ προπορευόμενος πρὸ προσώπου ὑμῶν αὐτὸς συνεκπολεμήσει αὐτοὺς μεθ' ὑμῶν κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησεν ὑμῖν ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ

text_en: And in the wilderness (as you have seen) the Lord your God has carried you, as a man is wont to carry his little son, all the way that you have come, until you came to this place.
text_la: Et in solitudine (ipse vidisti) portavit te Dominus Deus tuus, ut solet homo gestare parvulum filium suum, in omni via per quam ambulastis, donec veniretis ad locum istum.
text_pt: Como também no deserto, onde vistes que o Senhor vosso Deus nele vos levou, como um homem leva seu filho, por todo o caminho que andastes, até chegardes a este lugar.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ταύτῃ ἣν εἴδετε ὡς ἐτροφοφόρησέν σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου ὡς εἴ τις τροφοφορήσει ἄνθρωπος τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ κατὰ πᾶσαν τὴν ὁδόν ἣν ἐπορεύθητε ἕως ἤλθετε εἰς τὸν τόπον τοῦτον

text_en: And yet for all this you did not believe the Lord your God ,
text_la: Et nec sic quidem credidistis Domino Deo vestro,
text_pt: Mas nem por isso crestes no Senhor vosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ λόγῳ τούτῳ οὐκ ἐνεπιστεύσατε κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ ὑμῶν

text_en: who went before you on the way, and marked out the place, wherein you should pitch your tents, in the night showing you the way by fire, and in the day by the pillar of a cloud .
text_la: qui præcessit vos in via, et metatus est locum in quo tentoria figere deberetis, nocte ostendens vobis iter per ignem, et die per columnam nubis.
text_pt: Que foi adiante de vós por todo o caminho, para vos achar o lugar onde vós deveríeis acampar; de noite no fogo, para vos mostrar o caminho por onde havíeis de andar, e de dia na nuvem.
text_el: ὃς προπορεύεται πρότερος ὑμῶν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ἐκλέγεσθαι ὑμῖν τόπον ὁδηγῶν ὑμᾶς ἐν πυρὶ νυκτὸς δεικνύων ὑμῖν τὴν ὁδόν καθ' ἣν πορεύεσθε ἐπ' αὐτῆς καὶ ἐν νεφέλῃ ἡμέρας

text_en: And when the Lord had heard the voice of your words, he was angry and swore , and said:
text_la: Cumque audisset Dominus vocem sermonum vestrorum, iratus juravit, et ait:
text_pt: Ouvindo, pois, o Senhor a voz das vossas palavras, indignou-se, e jurou, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν κύριος τὴν φωνὴν τῶν λόγων ὑμῶν καὶ παροξυνθεὶς ὤμοσεν λέγων

text_en: Not one of the men of this wicked generation shall see the good land, which I promised with an oath to your fathers:
text_la: Non videbit quispiam de hominibus generationis hujus pessimæ terram bonam, quam sub juramento pollicitus sum patribus vestris,
text_pt: Nenhum dos homens desta maligna geração verá esta boa terra que jurei dar a vossos pais.
text_el: εἰ ὄψεταί τις τῶν ἀνδρῶν τούτων τὴν ἀγαθὴν ταύτην γῆν ἣν ὤμοσα τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν

text_en: Except Caleb the son of Jephone : for he shall see it, and to him I will give the land that he has trodden upon, and to his children, because he has followed the Lord .
text_la: præter Caleb filium Jephone : ipse enim videbit eam, et ipsi dabo terram, quam calcavit, et filiis ejus, quia secutus est Dominum.
text_pt: Salvo Calebe, filho de Jefoné; ele a verá, e a terra que pisou darei a ele e a seus filhos; porquanto perseverou em seguir ao Senhor.
text_el: πλὴν Χαλεβ υἱὸς Ιεφοννη οὗτος ὄψεται αὐτήν καὶ τούτῳ δώσω τὴν γῆν ἐφ' ἣν ἐπέβη καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ διὰ τὸ προσκεῖσθαι αὐτὸν τὰ πρὸς κύριον

text_en: Neither is his indignation against the people to be wondered at, since the Lord was angry with me also on your account, and said: Neither shall you go in thither.
text_la: Nec miranda indignatio in populum, cum mihi quoque iratus Dominus propter vos dixerit : Nec tu ingredieris illuc:
text_pt: Também o Senhor se indignou contra mim por causa de vós, dizendo: Também tu lá não entrarás.
text_el: καὶ ἐμοὶ ἐθυμώθη κύριος δι' ὑμᾶς λέγων οὐδὲ σὺ οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθῃς ἐκεῖ

text_en: But Joshua the son of Nun , your minister, he shall go in for you: exhort and encourage him, and he shall divide the land by lot to Israel .
text_la: sed Josue filius Nun minister tuus, ipse intrabit pro te. Hunc exhortare et robora, et ipse sorte terram dividet Israëli.
text_pt: Josué, filho de Num, que está diante de ti, ele ali entrará; fortalece-o, porque ele a fará herdar a Israel.
text_el: Ἰησοῦς υἱὸς Ναυη ὁ παρεστηκώς σοι οὗτος εἰσελεύσεται ἐκεῖ αὐτὸν κατίσχυσον ὅτι αὐτὸς κατακληρονομήσει αὐτὴν τῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: Your children, of whom you said that they should be led away captives, and your sons who know not this day the difference of good and evil , they shall go in: and to them I will give the land, and they shall possess it.
text_la: Parvuli vestri, de quibus dixistis quod captivi ducerentur, et filii qui hodie boni ac mali ignorant distantiam, ipsi ingredientur : et ipsis dabo terram, et possidebunt eam.
text_pt: E vossos meninos, de quem dissestes: Por presa serão; e vossos filhos, que hoje não conhecem nem o bem nem o mal, eles ali entrarão, e a eles a darei, e eles a possuirão.
text_el: καὶ πᾶν παιδίον νέον ὅστις οὐκ οἶδεν σήμερον ἀγαθὸν ἢ κακόν οὗτοι εἰσελεύσονται ἐκεῖ καὶ τούτοις δώσω αὐτήν καὶ αὐτοὶ κληρονομήσουσιν αὐτήν

text_en: But return you and go into the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea .
text_la: Vos autem revertimini, et abite in solitudinem per viam maris Rubri.
text_pt: Porém vós virai-vos, e parti para o deserto, pelo caminho do Mar Vermelho.
text_el: καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐπιστραφέντες ἐστρατοπεδεύσατε εἰς τὴν ἔρημον ὁδὸν τὴν ἐπὶ τῆς ἐρυθρᾶς θαλάσσης

text_en: And you answered me: We have sinned against the Lord : we will go up and fight, as the Lord our God has commanded. And when you went ready armed unto the mountain,
text_la: Et respondistis mihi : Peccavimus Domino : ascendemus et pugnabimus, sicut præcepit Dominus Deus noster. Cumque instructi armis pergeretis in montem,
text_pt: Então respondestes, e me dissestes: Pecamos contra o Senhor; nós subiremos e pelejaremos, conforme a tudo o que nos ordenou o Senhor nosso Deus. E armastes-vos, cada um de vós, dos seus instrumentos de guerra, e estivestes prestes para subir à montanha.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθητέ μοι καὶ εἴπατε ἡμάρτομεν ἔναντι κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἡμεῖς ἀναβάντες πολεμήσομεν κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐνετείλατο κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ἡμῖν καὶ ἀναλαβόντες ἕκαστος τὰ σκεύη τὰ πολεμικὰ αὐτοῦ καὶ συναθροισθέντες ἀνεβαίνετε εἰς τὸ ὄρος

text_en: the Lord said to me: Say to them: Go not up, and fight not, for I am not with you: lest you fall before your enemies.
text_la: ait mihi Dominus : Dic ad eos : Nolite ascendere, neque pugnetis : non enim sum vobiscum : ne cadatis coram inimicis vestris.
text_pt: E disse-me o Senhor: Dize-lhes: Não subais nem pelejeis, pois não estou no meio de vós; para que não sejais feridos diante de vossos inimigos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με εἰπὸν αὐτοῖς οὐκ ἀναβήσεσθε οὐδὲ μὴ πολεμήσετε οὐ γάρ εἰμι μεθ' ὑμῶν καὶ οὐ μὴ συντριβῆτε ἐνώπιον τῶν ἐχθρῶν ὑμῶν

text_en: I spoke, and you hearkened not: but resisting the commandment of the Lord , and swelling with pride , you went up into the mountain.
text_la: Locutus sum, et non audistis : sed adversantes imperio Domini, et tumentes superbia, ascendistis in montem.
text_pt: Porém, falando-vos eu, não ouvistes; antes fostes rebeldes ao mandado do Senhor, e vos ensoberbecestes, e subistes à montanha.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησα ὑμῖν καὶ οὐκ εἰσηκούσατέ μου καὶ παρέβητε τὸ ῥῆμα κυρίου καὶ παραβιασάμενοι ἀνέβητε εἰς τὸ ὄρος

text_en: And the Amorrhite that dwelt in the mountains coming out, and meeting you, chased you, as bees do: and made slaughter of you from Seir as far as Horma.
text_la: Itaque egressus Amorrhæus, qui habitabat in montibus, et obviam veniens, persecutus est vos, sicut solent apes persequi : et cecidit de Seir usque Horma.
text_pt: E os amorreus, que habitavam naquela montanha, vos saíram ao encontro; e perseguiram-vos como fazem as abelhas e vos derrotaram desde Seir até Hormá.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ Αμορραῖος ὁ κατοικῶν ἐν τῷ ὄρει ἐκείνῳ εἰς συνάντησιν ὑμῖν καὶ κατεδίωξαν ὑμᾶς ὡς εἰ ποιήσαισαν αἱ μέλισσαι καὶ ἐτίτρωσκον ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ Σηιρ ἕως Ερμα

text_en: And when you returned and wept before the Lord , he heard you not, neither would he yield to your voice.
text_la: Cumque reversi ploraretis coram Domino, non audivit vos, nec voci vestræ voluit acquiescere.
text_pt: Tornando, pois, vós, e chorando perante o Senhor, o Senhor não ouviu a vossa voz, nem vos escutou.
text_el: καὶ καθίσαντες ἐκλαίετε ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ οὐκ εἰσήκουσεν κύριος τῆς φωνῆς ὑμῶν οὐδὲ προσέσχεν ὑμῖν

text_en: So you abode in Cadesbarne a long time.
text_la: Sedistis ergo in Cadesbarne multo tempore.
text_pt: Assim permanecestes muitos dias em Cades, pois ali vos demorastes muito.
text_el: καὶ ἐνεκάθησθε ἐν Καδης ἡμέρας πολλάς ὅσας ποτὲ ἡμέρας ἐνεκάθησθε

text_en: And departing from thence we came into the wilderness that leads to the Red Sea , as the Lord had spoken to me: and we compassed mount Seir a long time.
text_la: Profectique inde, venimus in solitudinem, quæ ducit ad mare Rubrum, sicut mihi dixerat Dominus : et circuivimus montem Seir longo tempore.
text_pt: Depois viramo-nos, e caminhamos ao deserto, caminho do Mar Vermelho, como o SENHOR me tinha dito, e muitos dias rodeamos o monte Seir.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιστραφέντες ἀπήραμεν εἰς τὴν ἔρημον ὁδὸν θάλασσαν ἐρυθράν ὃν τρόπον ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρός με καὶ ἐκυκλώσαμεν τὸ ὄρος τὸ Σηιρ ἡμέρας πολλάς

text_en: And the Lord said to me:
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad me:
text_pt: Então o Senhor me falou, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με

text_en: You have compassed this mountain long enough: go toward the north:
text_la: Sufficit vobis circuire montem istum : ite contra aquilonem:
text_pt: Tendes rodeado bastante esta montanha; virai-vos para o norte.
text_el: ἱκανούσθω ὑμῖν κυκλοῦν τὸ ὄρος τοῦτο ἐπιστράφητε οὖν ἐπὶ βορρᾶν

text_en: And command the people, saying: You shall pass by the borders of your brethren the children of Esau , who dwell in Seir, and they will be afraid of you.
text_la: et populo præcipe, dicens : Transibitis per terminos fratrum vestrorum filiorum Esau, qui habitant in Seir, et timebunt vos.
text_pt: E dá ordem ao povo, dizendo: Passareis pelos termos de vossos irmãos, os filhos de Esaú, que habitam em Seir; e eles terão medo de vós; porém guardai-vos bem.
text_el: καὶ τῷ λαῷ ἔντειλαι λέγων ὑμεῖς παραπορεύεσθε διὰ τῶν ὁρίων τῶν ἀδελφῶν ὑμῶν υἱῶν Ησαυ οἳ κατοικοῦσιν ἐν Σηιρ καὶ φοβηθήσονται ὑμᾶς καὶ εὐλαβηθήσονται ὑμᾶς σφόδρα

text_en: Take then good heed that you stir not against them. For I will not give you of their land so much as the step of one foot can tread upon, because I have given mount Seir to Esau , for a possession.
text_la: Videte ergo diligenter ne moveamini contra eos. Neque enim dabo vobis de terra eorum quantum potest unius pedis calcare vestigium, quia in possessionem Esau dedi montem Seir.
text_pt: Não vos envolvais com eles, porque não vos darei da sua terra nem ainda a pisada da planta de um pé; porquanto a Esaú tenho dado o monte Seir por herança.
text_el: μὴ συνάψητε πρὸς αὐτοὺς πόλεμον οὐ γὰρ μὴ δῶ ὑμῖν ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς αὐτῶν οὐδὲ βῆμα ποδός ὅτι ἐν κλήρῳ δέδωκα τοῖς υἱοῖς Ησαυ τὸ ὄρος τὸ Σηιρ

text_en: You shall buy meats of them for money and shall eat: you shall draw waters for money, and shall drink.
text_la: Cibos emetis ab eis pecunia, et comedetis : aquam emptam haurietis, et bibetis.
text_pt: Comprareis deles, por dinheiro, comida para comerdes; e também água para beber deles comprareis por dinheiro.
text_el: βρώματα ἀργυρίου ἀγοράσατε παρ' αὐτῶν καὶ φάγεσθε καὶ ὕδωρ μέτρῳ λήμψεσθε παρ' αὐτῶν ἀργυρίου καὶ πίεσθε

text_en: The Lord your God has blessed you in every work of your hands: the Lord your God dwelling with you, knows your journey, how you have passed through this great wilderness , for forty years, and you have wanted nothing.
text_la: Dominus Deus tuus benedixit tibi in omni opere manuum tuarum : novit iter tuum, quomodo transieris solitudinem hanc magnam, per quadraginta annos habitans tecum Dominus Deus tuus, et nihil tibi defuit.
text_pt: Pois o Senhor teu Deus te abençoou em toda a obra das tuas mãos; ele sabe que andas por este grande deserto; estes quarenta anos o Senhor teu Deus esteve contigo, coisa nenhuma te faltou.
text_el: ὁ γὰρ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν εὐλόγησέν σε ἐν παντὶ ἔργῳ τῶν χειρῶν σου διάγνωθι πῶς διῆλθες τὴν ἔρημον τὴν μεγάλην καὶ τὴν φοβερὰν ἐκείνην ἰδοὺ τεσσαράκοντα ἔτη κύριος ὁ θεός σου μετὰ σοῦ οὐκ ἐπεδεήθης ῥήματος

text_en: And when we had passed by our brethren the children of Esau , that dwelt in Seir, by the way of the plain from Elath and from Asiongaber , we came to the way that leads to the desert of Moab .
text_la: Cumque transissemus fratres nostros filios Esau, qui habitabant in Seir, per viam campestrem de Elath, et de Asiongaber, venimus ad iter quod ducit in desertum Moab.
text_pt: Passando, pois, por nossos irmãos, os filhos de Esaú, que habitavam em Seir, desde o caminho da planície de Elate e de Eziom-Geber, nos viramos e passamos o caminho do deserto de Moabe.
text_el: καὶ παρήλθομεν τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ἡμῶν υἱοὺς Ησαυ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν Σηιρ παρὰ τὴν ὁδὸν τὴν Αραβα ἀπὸ Αιλων καὶ ἀπὸ Γασιωνγαβερ καὶ ἐπιστρέψαντες παρήλθομεν ὁδὸν ἔρημον Μωαβ

text_en: And the Lord said to me: Fight not against the Moabites , neither go to battle against them: for I will not give you any of their land, because I have given Ar to the children of Lot in possession.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad me : Non pugnes contra Moabitas, nec ineas adversus eos prælium : non enim dabo tibi quidquam de terra eorum, quia filiis Loth tradidi Ar in possessionem.
text_pt: Então o Senhor me disse: Não molestes aos de Moabe, e não contendas com eles em peleja, porque não te darei herança da sua terra; porquanto tenho dado a Ar por herança aos filhos de Ló.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με μὴ ἐχθραίνετε τοῖς Μωαβίταις καὶ μὴ συνάψητε πρὸς αὐτοὺς πόλεμον οὐ γὰρ μὴ δῶ ὑμῖν ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς αὐτῶν ἐν κλήρῳ τοῖς γὰρ υἱοῖς Λωτ δέδωκα τὴν Σηιρ κληρονομεῖν

text_en: The Emims first were the inhabitants thereof, a people great, and strong, and so tall, that like the race of the Enacims,
text_la: Emim primi fuerunt habitatores ejus, populus magnus, et validus, et tam excelsus ut de Enacim stirpe,
text_pt: (Os emins dantes habitaram nela; um povo grande e numeroso, e alto como os gigantes.
text_el: οἱ Ομμιν πρότεροι ἐνεκάθηντο ἐπ' αὐτῆς ἔθνος μέγα καὶ πολὺ καὶ ἰσχύοντες ὥσπερ οἱ Ενακιμ

text_en: they were esteemed as giants, and were like the sons of the Enacims. But the Moabites call them Emims.
text_la: quasi gigantes crederentur, et essent similes filiorum Enacim. Denique Moabitæ appellant eos Emim.
text_pt: Também estes foram considerados gigantes como os anaquins; e os moabitas os chamavam emins.
text_el: Ραφαϊν λογισθήσονται καὶ οὗτοι ὥσπερ οἱ Ενακιμ καὶ οἱ Μωαβῖται ἐπονομάζουσιν αὐτοὺς Ομμιν

text_en: The Horrhites also formerly dwelt in Seir: who being driven out and destroyed, the children of Esau dwelt there, as Israel did in the land of his possession, which the Lord gave him.
text_la: In Seir autem prius habitaverunt Horrhæi : quibus expulsis atque deletis, habitaverunt filii Esau, sicut fecit Israël in terra possessionis suæ, quam dedit illi Dominus.
text_pt: Outrora os horeus também habitaram em Seir; porém os filhos de Esaú os lançaram fora, e os destruíram de diante de si, e habitaram no seu lugar, assim como Israel fez à terra da sua herança, que o Senhor lhes tinha dado).
text_el: καὶ ἐν Σηιρ ἐνεκάθητο ὁ Χορραῖος πρότερον καὶ υἱοὶ Ησαυ ἀπώλεσαν αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐξέτριψαν αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν καὶ κατῳκίσθησαν ἀντ' αὐτῶν ὃν τρόπον ἐποίησεν Ισραηλ τὴν γῆν τῆς κληρονομίας αὐτοῦ ἣν δέδωκεν κύριος αὐτοῖς

text_en: Then rising up to pass the torrent Zared, we came to it.
text_la: Surgentes ergo ut transiremus torrentem Zared, venimus ad eum.
text_pt: Levantai-vos agora, e passai o ribeiro de Zerede. Assim passamos o ribeiro de Zerede.
text_el: νῦν οὖν ἀνάστητε καὶ ἀπάρατε ὑμεῖς καὶ παραπορεύεσθε τὴν φάραγγα Ζαρετ καὶ παρήλθομεν τὴν φάραγγα Ζαρετ

text_en: And the time that we journeyed from Cadesbarne till we passed over the torrent Zared, was thirty-eight years: until all the generation of the men that were fit for war was consumed out of the camp, as the Lord had sworn:
text_la: Tempus autem, quo ambulavimus de Cadesbarne usque ad transitum torrentis Zared, triginta et octo annorum fuit : donec consumeretur omnis generatio hominum bellatorum de castris, sicut juraverat Dominus:
text_pt: E os dias que caminhamos, desde Cades-Barnéia até que passamos o ribeiro de Zerede, foram trinta e oito anos, até que toda aquela geração dos homens de guerra se consumiu do meio do arraial, como o Senhor lhes jurara.
text_el: καὶ αἱ ἡμέραι ἃς παρεπορεύθημεν ἀπὸ Καδης Βαρνη ἕως οὗ παρήλθομεν τὴν φάραγγα Ζαρετ τριάκοντα καὶ ὀκτὼ ἔτη ἕως οὗ διέπεσεν πᾶσα γενεὰ ἀνδρῶν πολεμιστῶν ἀποθνῄσκοντες ἐκ τῆς παρεμβολῆς καθότι ὤμοσεν αὐτοῖς ὁ θεός

text_en: For his hand was against them, that they should perish from the midst of the camp.
text_la: cujus manus fuit adversum eos, ut interirent de castrorum medio.
text_pt: Assim também foi contra eles a mão do Senhor, para os destruir do meio do arraial até os haver consumido.
text_el: καὶ ἡ χεὶρ τοῦ θεοῦ ἦν ἐπ' αὐτοῖς ἐξαναλῶσαι αὐτοὺς ἐκ τῆς παρεμβολῆς ἕως οὗ διέπεσαν

text_en: And after all the fighting men were dead,
text_la: Postquam autem universi ceciderunt pugnatores,
text_pt: E sucedeu que, sendo já consumidos todos os homens de guerra, pela morte, do meio do povo,
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἐπεὶ διέπεσαν πάντες οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ πολεμισταὶ ἀποθνῄσκοντες ἐκ μέσου τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: the Lord spoke to me, saying:
text_la: locutus est Dominus ad me, dicens:
text_pt: O Senhor me falou, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρός με λέγων

text_en: You shall pass this day the borders of Moab , the city named Ar:
text_la: Tu transibis hodie terminos Moab, urbem nomine Ar:
text_pt: Hoje passarás a Ar, pelos termos de Moabe;
text_el: σὺ παραπορεύσῃ σήμερον τὰ ὅρια Μωαβ τὴν Σηιρ

text_en: And when you come near the frontiers of the children of Ammon , take heed not to fight against them, nor once move to battle: for I will not give you of the land of the children of Ammon , because I have given it to the children of Lot for a possession.
text_la: et accedens in vicina filiorum Ammon, cave ne pugnes contra eos, nec movearis ad prælium : non enim dabo tibi de terra filiorum Ammon, quia filiis Loth dedi eam in possessionem.
text_pt: E chegando até defronte dos filhos de Amom, não os molestes, e com eles não contendas; porque da terra dos filhos de Amom não te darei herança, porquanto aos filhos de Ló a tenho dado por herança.
text_el: καὶ προσάξετε ἐγγὺς υἱῶν Αμμαν μὴ ἐχθραίνετε αὐτοῖς καὶ μὴ συνάψητε αὐτοῖς εἰς πόλεμον οὐ γὰρ μὴ δῶ ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς υἱῶν Αμμαν σοὶ ἐν κλήρῳ ὅτι τοῖς υἱοῖς Λωτ δέδωκα αὐτὴν ἐν κλήρῳ

text_en: It was accounted a land of giants: and giants formerly dwelt in it, whom the Ammonites call Zomzommims,
text_la: Terra gigantum reputata est : et in ipsa olim habitaverunt gigantes, quos Ammonitæ vocant Zomzommim,
text_pt: (Também essa foi considerada terra de gigantes; antes nela habitavam gigantes, e os amonitas os chamavam zamzumins;
text_el: γῆ Ραφαϊν λογισθήσεται καὶ γὰρ ἐπ' αὐτῆς κατῴκουν οἱ Ραφαϊν τὸ πρότερον καὶ οἱ Αμμανῖται ὀνομάζουσιν αὐτοὺς Ζομζομμιν

text_en: a people great and many, and of tall stature, like the Enacims whom the Lord destroyed before their face: and he made them to dwell in their stead,
text_la: populus magnus, et multus, et proceræ longitudinis, sicut Enacim, quos delevit Dominus a facie eorum : et fecit illos habitare pro eis,
text_pt: Um povo grande, e numeroso, e alto, como os gigantes; e o Senhor os destruiu de diante dos amonitas, e estes os lançaram fora, e habitaram no seu lugar;
text_el: ἔθνος μέγα καὶ πολὺ καὶ δυνατώτερον ὑμῶν ὥσπερ οἱ Ενακιμ καὶ ἀπώλεσεν αὐτοὺς κύριος πρὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν καὶ κατεκληρονόμησαν καὶ κατῳκίσθησαν ἀντ' αὐτῶν ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: as he had done in favour of the children of Esau , that dwell in Seir, destroying the Horrhites, and delivering their land to them, which they possess to this day.
text_la: sicut fecerat filiis Esau, qui habitant in Seir, delens Horrhæos, et terram eorum illis tradens, quam possident usque in præsens.
text_pt: Assim como fez com os filhos de Esaú, que habitavam em Seir, de diante dos quais destruiu os horeus, e eles os lançaram fora, e habitaram no lugar deles até este dia;
text_el: ὥσπερ ἐποίησαν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ησαυ τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν ἐν Σηιρ ὃν τρόπον ἐξέτριψαν τὸν Χορραῖον ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν καὶ κατεκληρονόμησαν καὶ κατῳκίσθησαν ἀντ' αὐτῶν ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: The Hevites also, that dwelt in Haserim as far as Gaza , were expelled by the Cappadocians: who came out of Cappadocia, and destroyed them and dwelt in their stead.
text_la: Hevæos quoque, qui habitabant in Haserim usque Gazan, Cappadoces expulerunt : qui egressi de Cappadocia deleverunt eos, et habitaverunt pro illis.
text_pt: Também os caftorins, que saíram de Caftor, destruíram os aveus, que habitavam em Cazerim até Gaza, e habitaram no lugar deles).
text_el: καὶ οἱ Ευαῖοι οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν ασηρωθ ἕως Γάζης καὶ οἱ Καππάδοκες οἱ ἐξελθόντες ἐκ Καππαδοκίας ἐξέτριψαν αὐτοὺς καὶ κατῳκίσθησαν ἀντ' αὐτῶν

text_en: Arise, and pass the torrent Arnon: Behold I have delivered into your hand Sehon king of Hesebon the Amorrhite , and begin to possess his land and make war against him.
text_la: Surgite, et transite torrentem Arnon : ecce tradidi in manu tua Sehon regem Hesebon Amorrhæum, et terram ejus incipe possidere, et committe adversus eum prælium.
text_pt: Levantai-vos, parti e passai o ribeiro de Arnom; eis aqui na tua mão tenho dado a Siom, amorreu, rei de Hesbom, e a sua terra; começa a possuí-la, e contende com eles em peleja.
text_el: νῦν οὖν ἀνάστητε καὶ ἀπάρατε καὶ παρέλθατε ὑμεῖς τὴν φάραγγα Αρνων ἰδοὺ παραδέδωκα εἰς τὰς χεῖράς σου τὸν Σηων βασιλέα Εσεβων τὸν Αμορραῖον καὶ τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ ἐνάρχου κληρονομεῖν σύναπτε πρὸς αὐτὸν πόλεμον

text_en: This day will I begin to send the dread and fear of you upon the nations that dwell under the whole heaven : that when they hear your name they may fear and tremble, and be in pain like women in travail.
text_la: Hodie incipiam mittere terrorem atque formidinem tuam in populos, qui habitant sub omni cælo : ut audito nomine tuo paveant, et in morem parturientium contremiscant, et dolore teneantur.
text_pt: Neste dia começarei a pôr um terror e um medo de ti diante dos povos que estão debaixo de todo o céu; os que ouvirem a tua fama tremerão diante de ti e se angustiarão.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ ἐνάρχου δοῦναι τὸν τρόμον σου καὶ τὸν φόβον σου ἐπὶ πρόσωπον πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν τῶν ὑποκάτω τοῦ οὐρανοῦ οἵτινες ἀκούσαντες τὸ ὄνομά σου ταραχθήσονται καὶ ὠδῖνας ἕξουσιν ἀπὸ προσώπου σου

text_en: So I sent messengers from the wilderness of Cademoth to Sehon the king of Hesebon with peaceable words, saying:
text_la: Misi ergo nuntios de solitudine Cademoth ad Sehon regem Hesebon verbis pacificis, dicens:
text_pt: Então mandei mensageiros desde o deserto de Quedemote a Siom, rei de Hesbom, com palavras de paz, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλα πρέσβεις ἐκ τῆς ἐρήμου Κεδαμωθ πρὸς Σηων βασιλέα Εσεβων λόγοις εἰρηνικοῖς λέγων

text_en: We will pass through your land, we will go along by the highway: we will not turn aside neither to the right hand nor to the left.
text_la: Transibimus per terram tuam : publica gradiemur via; non declinabimus neque ad dexteram, neque ad sinistram.
text_pt: Deixa-me passar pela tua terra; somente pela estrada irei; não me desviarei para a direita nem para a esquerda.
text_el: παρελεύσομαι διὰ τῆς γῆς σου ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ παρελεύσομαι οὐχὶ ἐκκλινῶ δεξιὰ οὐδὲ ἀριστερά

text_en: Sell us meat for money, that we may eat: give us water for money and so we will drink. We only ask that you will let us pass through,
text_la: Alimenta pretio vende nobis, ut vescamur : aquam pecunia tribue, et sic bibemus. Tantum est ut nobis concedas transitum,
text_pt: A comida, para que eu coma, vender-me-ás por dinheiro, e dar-me-ás por dinheiro a água para que eu beba; tão-somente deixa-me passar a pé;
text_el: βρώματα ἀργυρίου ἀποδώσῃ μοι καὶ φάγομαι καὶ ὕδωρ ἀργυρίου ἀποδώσῃ μοι καὶ πίομαι πλὴν ὅτι παρελεύσομαι τοῖς ποσίν

text_en: as the children of Esau have done, that dwell in Seir, and the Moabites , that abide in Ar: until we come to the Jordan , and pass to the land which the Lord our God will give us.
text_la: sicut fecerunt filii Esau, qui habitant in Seir, et Moabitæ, qui morantur in Ar : donec veniamus ad Jordanem, et transeamus ad terram, quam Dominus Deus noster daturus est nobis.
text_pt: Como fizeram comigo os filhos de Esaú, que habitam em Seir, e os moabitas que habitam em Ar; até que eu passe o Jordão, à terra que o Senhor nosso Deus nos há de dar.
text_el: καθὼς ἐποίησάν μοι οἱ υἱοὶ Ησαυ οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν Σηιρ καὶ οἱ Μωαβῖται οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν Αροηρ ἕως παρέλθω τὸν Ιορδάνην εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν δίδωσιν ἡμῖν

text_en: And Sehon the king of Hesebon would not let us pass: because the Lord your God had hardened his spirit, and fixed his heart, that he might be delivered into your hands, as now you see.
text_la: Noluitque Sehon rex Hesebon dare nobis transitum : quia induraverat Dominus Deus tuus spiritum ejus, et obfirmaverat cor illius, ut traderetur in manus tuas, sicut nunc vides.
text_pt: Mas Siom, rei de Hesbom, não nos quis deixar passar por sua terra, porquanto o Senhor teu Deus endurecera o seu espírito, e fizera obstinado o seu coração para to dar na tua mão, como hoje se vê.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησεν Σηων βασιλεὺς Εσεβων παρελθεῖν ἡμᾶς δι' αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐσκλήρυνεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτοῦ καὶ κατίσχυσεν τὴν καρδίαν αὐτοῦ ἵνα παραδοθῇ εἰς τὰς χεῖράς σου ὡς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ

text_en: And the Lord said to me: Behold I have begun to deliver unto you Sehon and his land, begin to possess it.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad me : Ecce cœpi tibi tradere Sehon, et terram ejus : incipe possidere eam.
text_pt: E o Senhor me disse: Eis aqui, tenho começado a dar-te Siom, e a sua terra; começa, pois, a possuí-la para que herdes a sua terra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με ἰδοὺ ἦργμαι παραδοῦναι πρὸ προσώπου σου τὸν Σηων βασιλέα Εσεβων τὸν Αμορραῖον καὶ τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ ἔναρξαι κληρονομῆσαι τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Sehon came out to meet us with all his people to fight at Jasa.
text_la: Egressusque est Sehon obviam nobis cum omni populo suo ad prælium in Jasa.
text_pt: E Siom saiu-nos ao encontro, ele e todo o seu povo, à peleja, em Jaza;
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Σηων βασιλεὺς Εσεβων εἰς συνάντησιν ἡμῖν αὐτὸς καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς αὐτοῦ εἰς πόλεμον Ιασσα

text_en: And the Lord our God delivered him to us: and we slew him with his sons and all his people.
text_la: Et tradidit eum Dominus Deus noster nobis : percussimusque eum cum filiis suis et omni populo suo.
text_pt: E o Senhor nosso Deus no-lo entregou, e o ferimos a ele, e a seus filhos, e a todo o seu povo.
text_el: καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτὸν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν πρὸ προσώπου ἡμῶν καὶ ἐπατάξαμεν αὐτὸν καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντα τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And we took all his cities at that time, killing the inhabitants of them, men and women and children. We left nothing of them,
text_la: Cunctasque urbes in tempore illo cepimus, interfectis habitatoribus earum, viris ac mulieribus et parvulis : non reliquimus in eis quidquam,
text_pt: E naquele tempo tomamos todas as suas cidades, e cada uma destruímos com os seus homens, mulheres e crianças; não deixamos a ninguém.
text_el: καὶ ἐκρατήσαμεν πασῶν τῶν πόλεων αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ καὶ ἐξωλεθρεύσαμεν πᾶσαν πόλιν ἑξῆς καὶ τὰς γυναῖκας αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν οὐ κατελίπομεν ζωγρείαν

text_en: except the cattle which came to the share of them that took them: and the spoils of the cities, which we took:
text_la: absque jumentis, quæ in partem venere prædantium : et spoliis urbium, quas cepimus
text_pt: Somente tomamos por presa o gado para nós, e o despojo das cidades que tínhamos tomado.
text_el: πλὴν τὰ κτήνη ἐπρονομεύσαμεν καὶ τὰ σκῦλα τῶν πόλεων ἐλάβομεν

text_en: From Aroer, which is upon the bank of the torrent Arnon, a town that is situate in a valley, as far as Galaad. There was not a village or city, that escaped our hands: the Lord our God delivered all unto us:
text_la: ab Aroër, quæ est super ripam torrentis Arnon, oppido quod in valle situm est, usque Galaad. Non fuit vicus et civitas, quæ nostras effugeret manus : omnes tradidit Dominus Deus noster nobis,
text_pt: Desde Aroer, que está à margem do ribeiro de Arnom, e a cidade que está junto ao ribeiro, até Gileade, nenhuma cidade houve que de nós escapasse; tudo isto o Senhor nosso Deus nos entregou.
text_el: ἐξ Αροηρ ἥ ἐστιν παρὰ τὸ χεῖλος χειμάρρου Αρνων καὶ τὴν πόλιν τὴν οὖσαν ἐν τῇ φάραγγι καὶ ἕως ὄρους τοῦ Γαλααδ οὐκ ἐγενήθη πόλις ἥτις διέφυγεν ἡμᾶς τὰς πάσας παρέδωκεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν εἰς τὰς χεῖρας ἡμῶν

text_en: Except the land of the children of Ammon , to which we approached not: and all that border upon the torrent Jeboc, and the cities in the mountains, and all the places which the Lord our God forbade us.
text_la: absque terra filiorum Ammon, ad quam non accessimus : et cunctis quæ adjacent torrenti Jeboc, et urbibus montanis, universisque locis, a quibus nos prohibuit Dominus Deus noster.
text_pt: Somente à terra dos filhos de Amom não chegastes; nem a toda a margem do ribeiro de Jaboque, nem às cidades da montanha, nem a coisa alguma que nos proibira o Senhor nosso Deus.
text_el: πλὴν εἰς γῆν υἱῶν Αμμων οὐ προσήλθομεν πάντα τὰ συγκυροῦντα χειμάρρου Ιαβοκ καὶ τὰς πόλεις τὰς ἐν τῇ ὀρεινῇ καθότι ἐνετείλατο ἡμῖν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν

text_en: Then we turned and went by the way of Basan: and Og the king of Basan came out to meet us with his people to fight in Edrai.
text_la: Itaque conversi ascendimus per iter Basan : egressusque est Og rex Basan in occursum nobis cum populo suo ad bellandum in Edrai.
text_pt: Depois nos viramos e subimos o caminho de Basã; e Ogue, rei de Basã, nos saiu ao encontro, ele e todo o seu povo, à peleja em Edrei.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιστραφέντες ἀνέβημεν ὁδὸν τὴν εἰς Βασαν καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Ωγ βασιλεὺς τῆς Βασαν εἰς συνάντησιν ἡμῖν αὐτὸς καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς αὐτοῦ εἰς πόλεμον εἰς Εδραϊν

text_en: And the Lord said to me: Fear him not: because he is delivered into your hand, with all his people and his land: and you shall do to him as you have done to Sehon king of the Amorrhites , that dwelt in Hesebon .
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad me : Ne timeas eum : quia in manu tua traditus est cum omni populo ac terra sua : faciesque ei sicut fecisti Sehon regi Amorrhæorum, qui habitavit in Hesebon.
text_pt: Então o Senhor me disse: Não o temas, porque a ele e a todo o seu povo, e a sua terra, tenho dado na tua mão; e far-lhe-ás como fizeste a Siom, rei dos amorreus, que habitava em Hesbom.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με μὴ φοβηθῇς αὐτόν ὅτι εἰς τὰς χεῖράς σου παραδέδωκα αὐτὸν καὶ πάντα τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ καὶ ποιήσεις αὐτῷ ὥσπερ ἐποίησας Σηων βασιλεῖ τῶν Αμορραίων ὃς κατῴκει ἐν Εσεβων

text_en: So the Lord our God delivered into our hands, Og also, the king of Basan, and all his people: and we utterly destroyed them,
text_la: Tradidit ergo Dominus Deus noster in manibus nostris etiam Og regem Basan, et universum populum ejus : percussimusque eos usque ad internecionem,
text_pt: E também o Senhor nosso Deus nos deu na nossa mão a Ogue, rei de Basã, e a todo o seu povo; de maneira que o ferimos até que não lhe ficou sobrevivente algum.
text_el: καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτὸν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν εἰς τὰς χεῖρας ἡμῶν καὶ τὸν Ωγ βασιλέα τῆς Βασαν καὶ πάντα τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπατάξαμεν αὐτὸν ἕως τοῦ μὴ καταλιπεῖν αὐτοῦ σπέρμα

text_en: wasting all his cities at one time, there was not a town that escaped us: sixty cities, all the country of Argob the kingdom of Og in Basan.
text_la: vastantes cunctas civitates illius uno tempore. Non fuit oppidum, quod nos effugeret : sexaginta urbes, omnem regionem Argob regni Og in Basan.
text_pt: E naquele tempo tomamos todas as suas cidades; nenhuma cidade houve que lhes não tomássemos; sessenta cidades, toda a região de Argobe, o reino de Ogue em Basã.
text_el: καὶ ἐκρατήσαμεν πασῶν τῶν πόλεων αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ οὐκ ἦν πόλις ἣν οὐκ ἐλάβομεν παρ' αὐτῶν ἑξήκοντα πόλεις πάντα τὰ περίχωρα Αργοβ βασιλείας Ωγ ἐν Βασαν

text_en: All the cities were fenced with very high walls, and with gates and bars, besides innumerable towns that had no walls.
text_la: Cunctæ urbes erant munitæ muris altissimis, portisque et vectibus, absque oppidis innumeris, quæ non habebant muros.
text_pt: Todas estas cidades eram fortificadas com altos muros, portas e ferrolhos; e muitas outras cidades sem muros.
text_el: πᾶσαι πόλεις ὀχυραί τείχη ὑψηλά πύλαι καὶ μοχλοί πλὴν τῶν πόλεων τῶν Φερεζαίων τῶν πολλῶν σφόδρα

text_en: And we utterly destroyed them, as we had done to Sehon the king of Hesebon , destroying every city, men and women and children:
text_la: Et delevimus eos, sicut feceramus Sehon regi Hesebon, disperdentes omnem civitatem, virosque ac mulieres et parvulos:
text_pt: E destruímo-las como fizemos a Siom, rei de Hesbom, destruindo todas as cidades, homens, mulheres e crianças.
text_el: ἐξωλεθρεύσαμεν αὐτούς ὥσπερ ἐποιήσαμεν τὸν Σηων βασιλέα Εσεβων καὶ ἐξωλεθρεύσαμεν πᾶσαν πόλιν ἑξῆς καὶ τὰς γυναῖκας καὶ τὰ παιδία

text_en: But the cattle and the spoils of the cities we took for our prey.
text_la: jumenta autem et spolia urbium diripuimus.
text_pt: Porém todo o gado, e o despojo das cidades, tomamos para nós por presa.
text_el: καὶ πάντα τὰ κτήνη καὶ τὰ σκῦλα τῶν πόλεων ἐπρονομεύσαμεν ἑαυτοῖς

text_en: And we took at that time the land out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorrhites , that were beyond the Jordan : from the torrent Arnon unto the mount Hermon ,
text_la: Tulimusque illo in tempore terram de manu duorum regum Amorrhæorum, qui erant trans Jordanem : a torrente Arnon usque ad montem Hernon,
text_pt: Assim naquele tempo tomamos a terra das mãos daqueles dois reis dos amorreus, que estavam além do Jordão; desde o rio de Arnom, até ao monte de Hermom
text_el: καὶ ἐλάβομεν ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ τὴν γῆν ἐκ χειρῶν δύο βασιλέων τῶν Αμορραίων οἳ ἦσαν πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἀπὸ τοῦ χειμάρρου Αρνων καὶ ἕως Αερμων

text_en: which the Sidonians call Sarion, and the Amorrhites Sanir:
text_la: quem Sidonii Sarion vocant, et Amorrhæi Sanir:
text_pt: (A Hermom os sidônios chamam Siriom; porém os amorreus o chamam Senir);
text_el: οἱ Φοίνικες ἐπονομάζουσιν τὸ Αερμων Σανιωρ καὶ ὁ Αμορραῖος ἐπωνόμασεν αὐτὸ Σανιρ

text_en: All the cities that are situate in the plain, and all the land of Galaad and Basan as far as Selcha and Edrai, cities of the kingdom of Og in Basan.
text_la: omnes civitates, quæ sitæ sunt in planitie, et universam terram Galaad et Basan usque ad Selcha, et Edrai civitates regni Og in Basan.
text_pt: Todas as cidades do planalto, e todo o Gileade, e todo o Basã, até Salcá e Edrei, cidades do reino de Ogue em Basã.
text_el: πᾶσαι πόλεις Μισωρ καὶ πᾶσα Γαλααδ καὶ πᾶσα Βασαν ἕως Σελχα καὶ Εδραϊν πόλεις βασιλείας τοῦ Ωγ ἐν τῇ Βασαν

text_en: For only Og king of Basan remained of the race of the giants. His bed of iron is shown, which is in Rabbath of the children of Ammon , being nine cubits long, and four broad after the measure of the cubit of a man's hand.
text_la: Solus quippe Og rex Basan restiterat de stirpe gigantum. Monstratur lectus ejus ferreus, qui est in Rabbath filiorum Ammon, novem cubitos habens longitudinis, et quatuor latitudinis ad mensuram cubiti virilis manus.
text_pt: Porque só Ogue, o rei de Basã, restou dos gigantes; eis que o seu leito, um leito de ferro, não está porventura em Rabá dos filhos de Amom? De nove côvados, o seu comprimento, e de quatro côvados, a sua largura, pelo côvado comum.
text_el: ὅτι πλὴν Ωγ βασιλεὺς Βασαν κατελείφθη ἀπὸ τῶν Ραφαϊν ἰδοὺ ἡ κλίνη αὐτοῦ κλίνη σιδηρᾶ ἰδοὺ αὕτη ἐν τῇ ἄκρᾳ τῶν υἱῶν Αμμων ἐννέα πηχῶν τὸ μῆκος αὐτῆς καὶ τεσσάρων πηχῶν τὸ εὖρος αὐτῆς ἐν πήχει ἀνδρός

text_en: And we possessed the land at that time from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the torrent Arnon, unto the half of mount Galaad: and I gave the cities thereof to Ruben and Gad .
text_la: Terramque possedimus tempore illo ab Aroër, quæ est super ripam torrentis Arnon, usque ad mediam partem montis Galaad : et civitates illius dedi Ruben et Gad.
text_pt: Tomamos, pois, esta terra em possessão naquele tempo: Desde Aroer, que está junto ao ribeiro de Arnom, e a metade da montanha de Gileade, com as suas cidades, tenho dado aos rubenitas e gaditas.
text_el: καὶ τὴν γῆν ἐκείνην ἐκληρονομήσαμεν ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ἀπὸ Αροηρ ἥ ἐστιν ἐπὶ τοῦ χείλους χειμάρρου Αρνων καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ ὄρους Γαλααδ καὶ τὰς πόλεις αὐτοῦ ἔδωκα τῷ Ρουβην καὶ τῷ Γαδ

text_en: And I delivered the other part of Galaad, and all Basan the kingdom of Og to the half tribe of Manasses , all the country of Argob: and all Basan is called the Land of giants .
text_la: Reliquam autem partem Galaad, et omnem Basan regni Og, tradidi mediæ tribui Manasse, omnem regionem Argob : cunctaque Basan vocatur Terra gigantum.
text_pt: E o restante de Gileade, como também todo o Basã, o reino de Ogue, dei à meia tribo de Manassés; toda aquela região de Argobe, por todo o Basã, se chamava a terra dos gigantes.
text_el: καὶ τὸ κατάλοιπον τοῦ Γαλααδ καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν Βασαν βασιλείαν Ωγ ἔδωκα τῷ ἡμίσει φυλῆς Μανασση καὶ πᾶσαν περίχωρον Αργοβ πᾶσαν τὴν Βασαν ἐκείνην γῆ Ραφαϊν λογισθήσεται

text_en: Jair the son of Manasses possessed all the country of Argob unto the borders of Gessuri, and Machati. And he called Basan by his own name , Havoth Jair, that is to say, the towns of Jair, until this present day.
text_la: Jair filius Manasse possedit omnem regionem Argob usque ad terminos Gessuri et Machati. Vocavitque ex nomine suo Basan, Havoth Jair, id est, Villas Jair, usque in præsentem diem.
text_pt: Jair, filho de Manassés, alcançou toda a região de Argobe, até ao termo dos gesuritas, e maacatitas, e a chamou de seu nome, Havote-Jair até este dia.
text_el: καὶ Ιαϊρ υἱὸς Μανασση ἔλαβεν πᾶσαν τὴν περίχωρον Αργοβ ἕως τῶν ὁρίων Γαργασι καὶ Ομαχαθι ἐπωνόμασεν αὐτὰς ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ τὴν Βασαν Αυωθ Ιαϊρ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: To Machir also I gave Galaad.
text_la: Machir quoque dedi Galaad.
text_pt: E a Maquir dei Gileade.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Μαχιρ ἔδωκα τὴν Γαλααδ

text_en: And to the tribes of Ruben and Gad I gave of the land of Galaad as far as the torrent Arnon, half the torrent, and the confines even unto the torrent Jeboc, which is the border of the children of Ammon :
text_la: Et tribubus Ruben et Gad dedi de terra Galaad usque ad torrentem Arnon medium torrentis, et confinium usque ad torrentem Jeboc, qui est terminus filiorum Ammon:
text_pt: Mas aos rubenitas e gaditas dei desde Gileade até ao ribeiro de Arnom, cujo meio serve de limite; e até ao ribeiro de Jaboque, o termo dos filhos de Amom.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Ρουβην καὶ τῷ Γαδ δέδωκα ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλααδ ἕως χειμάρρου Αρνων μέσον τοῦ χειμάρρου ὅριον καὶ ἕως τοῦ Ιαβοκ ὁ χειμάρρους ὅριον τοῖς υἱοῖς Αμμαν

text_en: And the plain of the wilderness , and the Jordan , and the borders of Cenereth unto the sea of the desert , which is the most salt sea , to the foot of mount Phasga eastward.
text_la: et planitiem solitudinis, atque Jordanem, et terminos Cenereth usque ad mare deserti, quod est salsissimum, ad radices montis Phasga contra orientem.
text_pt: Como também a campina, e o Jordão por termo; desde Quinerete até ao mar da campina, o Mar Salgado, abaixo de Asdote-Pisga para o oriente.
text_el: καὶ ἡ Αραβα καὶ ὁ Ιορδάνης ὅριον Μαχαναρεθ καὶ ἕως θαλάσσης Αραβα θαλάσσης ἁλυκῆς ὑπὸ Ασηδωθ τὴν Φασγα ἀνατολῶν

text_en: And I commanded you at that time, saying: The Lord your God gives you this land for an inheritance, go well appointed before your brethren the children of Israel , all the strong men of you.
text_la: Præcepique vobis in tempore illo, dicens : Dominus Deus vester dat vobis terram hanc in hæreditatem : expediti præcedite fratres vestros filios Israël omnes viri robusti,
text_pt: E no mesmo tempo vos ordenei, dizendo: O Senhor vosso Deus vos deu esta terra, para possuí-la; passai, pois, armados vós, todos os homens valentes, diante de vossos irmãos, os filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετειλάμην ὑμῖν ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ λέγων κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν ἔδωκεν ὑμῖν τὴν γῆν ταύτην ἐν κλήρῳ ἐνοπλισάμενοι προπορεύεσθε πρὸ προσώπου τῶν ἀδελφῶν ὑμῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ πᾶς δυνατός

text_en: Leaving your wives and children and cattle. For I know you have much cattle, and they must remain in the cities, which I have delivered to you.
text_la: absque uxoribus, et parvulis, atque jumentis. Novi enim quod plura habeatis pecora, et in urbibus remanere debebunt, quas tradidi vobis,
text_pt: Tão-somente vossas mulheres, e vossas crianças, e vosso gado (porque eu sei que tendes muito gado), ficarão nas vossas cidades, que já vos tenho dado.
text_el: πλὴν αἱ γυναῖκες ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ κτήνη ὑμῶν οἶδα ὅτι πολλὰ κτήνη ὑμῖν κατοικείτωσαν ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν ὑμῶν αἷς ἔδωκα ὑμῖν

text_en: Until the Lord give rest to your brethren, as he has given to you: and they also possess the land, which he will give them beyond the Jordan : then shall every man return to his possession, which I have given you.
text_la: donec requiem tribuat Dominus fratribus vestris, sicut vobis tribuit : et possideant ipsi etiam terram, quam daturus est eis trans Jordanem : tunc revertetur unusquisque in possessionem suam, quam dedi vobis.
text_pt: Até que o Senhor dê descanso a vossos irmãos como a vós; para que eles herdem também a terra que o Senhor vosso Deus lhes há de dar além do Jordão; então voltareis cada qual à sua herança que já vos tenho dado.
text_el: ἕως ἂν καταπαύσῃ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὑμῶν ὥσπερ καὶ ὑμᾶς καὶ κατακληρονομήσουσιν καὶ οὗτοι τὴν γῆν ἣν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν δίδωσιν αὐτοῖς ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου καὶ ἐπαναστραφήσεσθε ἕκαστος εἰς τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ ἣν ἔδωκα ὑμῖν

text_en: I commanded Joshua also at that time, saying: Your eyes have seen what the Lord your God has done to these two kings: so will he do to all the kingdoms to which you shall pass.
text_la: Josue quoque in tempore illo præcepi, dicens : Oculi tui viderunt quæ fecit Dominus Deus vester duobus his regibus : sic faciet omnibus regnis, ad quæ transiturus es.
text_pt: Também dei ordem a Josué no mesmo tempo, dizendo: Os teus olhos têm visto tudo o que o Senhor vosso Deus tem feito a estes dois reis; assim fará o Senhor a todos os reinos, a que tu passarás.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Ἰησοῖ ἐνετειλάμην ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ λέγων οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ὑμῶν ἑωράκασιν πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν τοῖς δυσὶ βασιλεῦσι τούτοις οὕτως ποιήσει κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν πάσας τὰς βασιλείας ἐφ' ἃς σὺ διαβαίνεις ἐκεῖ

text_en: Fear them not: for the Lord your God will fight for you.
text_la: Ne timeas eos : Dominus enim Deus vester pugnabit pro vobis.
text_pt: Não os temais, porque o Senhor vosso Deus é o que peleja por vós.
text_el: οὐ φοβηθήσεσθε ὅτι κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν αὐτὸς πολεμήσει περὶ ὑμῶν

text_en: And I besought the Lord at that time, saying:
text_la: Precatusque sum Dominum in tempore illo, dicens:
text_pt: Também eu pedi graça ao Senhor no mesmo tempo, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐδεήθην κυρίου ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ λέγων

text_en: Lord God , you have begun to show unto your servant your greatness, and most mighty hand, for there is no other God either in heaven or earth, that is able to do your works, or to be compared to your strength.
text_la: Domine Deus, tu cœpisti ostendere servo tuo magnitudinem tuam, manumque fortissimam : neque enim est alius deus vel in cælo, vel in terra, qui possit facere opera tua, et comparari fortitudini tuæ.
text_pt: Senhor DEUS! já começaste a mostrar ao teu servo a tua grandeza e a tua forte mão; pois, que Deus há nos céus e na terra, que possa fazer segundo as tuas obras, e segundo os teus grandes feitos?
text_el: κύριε κύριε σὺ ἤρξω δεῖξαι τῷ σῷ θεράποντι τὴν ἰσχύν σου καὶ τὴν δύναμίν σου καὶ τὴν χεῖρα τὴν κραταιὰν καὶ τὸν βραχίονα τὸν ὑψηλόν τίς γάρ ἐστιν θεὸς ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ἢ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ὅστις ποιήσει καθὰ σὺ ἐποίησας καὶ κατὰ τὴν ἰσχύν σου

text_en: I will pass over therefore, and will see this excellent land beyond the Jordan , and this goodly mountain, and Libanus.
text_la: Transibo igitur, et videbo terram hanc optimam trans Jordanem, et montem istum egregium, et Libanum.
text_pt: Rogo-te que me deixes passar, para que veja esta boa terra que está além do Jordão; esta boa montanha, e o Líbano!
text_el: διαβὰς οὖν ὄψομαι τὴν γῆν τὴν ἀγαθὴν ταύτην τὴν οὖσαν πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου τὸ ὄρος τοῦτο τὸ ἀγαθὸν καὶ τὸν Ἀντιλίβανον

text_en: And the Lord was angry with me on your account and heard me not, but said to me: It is enough: speak no more to me of this matter.
text_la: Iratusque est Dominus mihi propter vos, nec exaudivit me, sed dixit mihi : Sufficit tibi : nequaquam ultra loquaris de hac re ad me.
text_pt: Porém o Senhor indignou-se muito contra mim por causa de vós, e não me ouviu; antes o Senhor me disse: Basta; não me fales mais deste assunto;
text_el: καὶ ὑπερεῖδεν κύριος ἐμὲ ἕνεκεν ὑμῶν καὶ οὐκ εἰσήκουσέν μου καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με ἱκανούσθω σοι μὴ προσθῇς ἔτι λαλῆσαι τὸν λόγον τοῦτον

text_en: Go up to the top of Phasga , and cast your eyes round about to the west, and to the north, and to the south, and to the east, and behold it, for you shall not pass this Jordan .
text_la: Ascende cacumen Phasgæ, et oculos tuos circumfer ad occidentem, et ad aquilonem, austrumque et orientem, et aspice; nec enim transibis Jordanem istum.
text_pt: Sobe ao cume de Pisga, e levanta os teus olhos ao ocidente, e ao norte, e ao sul, e ao oriente, e vê com os teus olhos; porque não passarás este Jordão.
text_el: ἀνάβηθι ἐπὶ κορυφὴν Λελαξευμένου καὶ ἀναβλέψας τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς κατὰ θάλασσαν καὶ βορρᾶν καὶ λίβα καὶ ἀνατολὰς καὶ ἰδὲ τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς σου ὅτι οὐ διαβήσῃ τὸν Ιορδάνην τοῦτον

text_en: Command Joshua , and encourage and strengthen him: for he shall go before this people, and shall divide unto them the land which you shall see.
text_la: Præcipe Josue, et corrobora eum atque conforta : quia ipse præcedet populum istum, et dividet eis terram quam visurus es.
text_pt: Manda, pois, a Josué, e anima-o, e fortalece-o; porque ele passará adiante deste povo, e o fará possuir a terra que verás.
text_el: καὶ ἔντειλαι Ἰησοῖ καὶ κατίσχυσον αὐτὸν καὶ παρακάλεσον αὐτόν ὅτι οὗτος διαβήσεται πρὸ προσώπου τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου καὶ αὐτὸς κατακληρονομήσει αὐτοῖς τὴν γῆν ἣν ἑώρακας

text_en: And we abode in the valley over against the temple of Phogor.
text_la: Mansimusque in valle contra fanum Phogor.
text_pt: Assim ficamos neste vale, defronte de Bete-Peor.
text_el: καὶ ἐνεκαθήμεθα ἐν νάπῃ σύνεγγυς οἴκου Φογωρ

text_en: And now, O Israel , hear the commandments and judgments which I teach you: that doing them, you may live, and entering in may possess the land which the Lord the God of your fathers will give you.
text_la: Et nunc, Israël, audi præcepta et judicia, quæ ego doceo te : ut faciens ea, vivas, et ingrediens possideas terram, quam Dominus Deus patrum vestrorum daturus est vobis.
text_pt: Agora, pois, ó Israel, ouve os estatutos e os juízos que eu vos ensino, para os cumprirdes; para que vivais, e entreis, e possuais a terra que o SENHOR Deus de vossos pais vos dá.
text_el: καὶ νῦν Ισραηλ ἄκουε τῶν δικαιωμάτων καὶ τῶν κριμάτων ὅσα ἐγὼ διδάσκω ὑμᾶς σήμερον ποιεῖν ἵνα ζῆτε καὶ πολυπλασιασθῆτε καὶ εἰσελθόντες κληρονομήσητε τὴν γῆν ἣν κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν δίδωσιν ὑμῖν

text_en: You shall not add to the word that I speak to you, neither shall you take away from it: keep the commandments of the Lord your God which I command you.
text_la: Non addetis ad verbum, quod vobis loquor, nec auferetis ex eo : custodite mandata Domini Dei vestri, quæ ego præcipio vobis.
text_pt: Não acrescentareis à palavra que vos mando, nem diminuireis dela, para que guardeis os mandamentos do Senhor vosso Deus, que eu vos mando.
text_el: οὐ προσθήσετε πρὸς τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαι ὑμῖν καὶ οὐκ ἀφελεῖτε ἀπ' αὐτοῦ φυλάσσεσθε τὰς ἐντολὰς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν ὅσα ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαι ὑμῖν σήμερον

text_en: Your eyes have seen all that the Lord has done against Beelphegor , how he has destroyed all his worshippers from among you.
text_la: Oculi vestri viderunt omnia quæ fecit Dominus contra Beelphegor, quomodo contriverit omnes cultores ejus de medio vestri.
text_pt: Os vossos olhos têm visto o que o Senhor fez por causa de Baal-Peor; pois a todo o homem que seguiu a Baal-Peor o Senhor teu Deus consumiu do meio de ti.
text_el: οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ὑμῶν ἑωράκασιν πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν τῷ Βεελφεγωρ ὅτι πᾶς ἄνθρωπος ὅστις ἐπορεύθη ὀπίσω Βεελφεγωρ ἐξέτριψεν αὐτὸν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν ἐξ ὑμῶν

text_en: But you that adhere to the Lord your God , are all alive until this present day.
text_la: Vos autem qui adhæretis Domino Deo vestro, vivitis universi usque in præsentem diem.
text_pt: Porém vós, que vos achegastes ao Senhor vosso Deus, hoje todos estais vivos.
text_el: ὑμεῖς δὲ οἱ προσκείμενοι κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ ὑμῶν ζῆτε πάντες ἐν τῇ σήμερον

text_en: You know that I have taught you statutes and justices, as the Lord my God has commanded me: so shall you do them in the land which you shall possess:
text_la: Scitis quod docuerim vos præcepta atque justitias, sicut mandavit mihi Dominus Deus meus : sic facietis ea in terra, quam possessuri estis:
text_pt: Vedes aqui vos tenho ensinado estatutos e juízos, como me mandou o Senhor meu Deus; para que assim façais no meio da terra a qual ides a herdar.
text_el: ἴδετε δέδειχα ὑμῖν δικαιώματα καὶ κρίσεις καθὰ ἐνετείλατό μοι κύριος ποιῆσαι οὕτως ἐν τῇ γῇ εἰς ἣν ὑμεῖς εἰσπορεύεσθε ἐκεῖ κληρονομεῖν αὐτήν

text_en: And you shall observe, and fulfil them in practice. For this is your wisdom, and understanding in the sight of nations , that hearing all these precepts , they may say: Behold a wise and understanding people, a great nation.
text_la: et observabitis et implebitis opere. Hæc est enim vestra sapientia, et intellectus coram populis, ut audientes universa præcepta hæc, dicant : En populus sapiens et intelligens, gens magna.
text_pt: Guardai-os pois, e cumpri-os, porque isso será a vossa sabedoria e o vosso entendimento perante os olhos dos povos, que ouvirão todos estes estatutos, e dirão: Este grande povo é nação sábia e entendida.
text_el: καὶ φυλάξεσθε καὶ ποιήσετε ὅτι αὕτη ἡ σοφία ὑμῶν καὶ ἡ σύνεσις ἐναντίον πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν ὅσοι ἐὰν ἀκούσωσιν πάντα τὰ δικαιώματα ταῦτα καὶ ἐροῦσιν ἰδοὺ λαὸς σοφὸς καὶ ἐπιστήμων τὸ ἔθνος τὸ μέγα τοῦτο

text_en: Neither is there any other nation so great, that has gods so near them, as our God is present to all our petitions.
text_la: Nec est alia natio tam grandis, quæ habeat deos appropinquantes sibi, sicut Deus noster adest cunctis obsecrationibus nostris.
text_pt: Pois, que nação há tão grande, que tenha deuses tão chegados como o Senhor nosso Deus, todas as vezes que o invocamos?
text_el: ὅτι ποῖον ἔθνος μέγα ᾧ ἐστιν αὐτῷ θεὸς ἐγγίζων αὐτοῖς ὡς κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς ἐὰν αὐτὸν ἐπικαλεσώμεθα

text_en: For what other nation is there so renowned that has ceremonies , and just judgments, and all the law , which I will set forth this day before our eyes?
text_la: Quæ est enim alia gens sic inclyta, ut habeat cæremonias, justaque judicia, et universam legem, quam ego proponam hodie ante oculos vestros?
text_pt: E que nação há tão grande, que tenha estatutos e juízos tão justos como toda esta lei que hoje ponho perante vós?
text_el: καὶ ποῖον ἔθνος μέγα ᾧ ἐστιν αὐτῷ δικαιώματα καὶ κρίματα δίκαια κατὰ πάντα τὸν νόμον τοῦτον ὃν ἐγὼ δίδωμι ἐνώπιον ὑμῶν σήμερον

text_en: Keep yourself therefore, and your soul carefully. Forget not the words that your eyes have seen, and let them not go out of your heart all the days of your life. You shall teach them to your sons and to your grandsons,
text_la: Custodi igitur temetipsum, et animam tuam sollicite. Ne obliviscaris verborum, quæ viderunt oculi tui, et ne excidant de corde tuo cunctis diebus vitæ tuæ. Docebis ea filios ac nepotes tuos,
text_pt: Tão-somente guarda-te a ti mesmo, e guarda bem a tua alma, que não te esqueças daquelas coisas que os teus olhos têm visto, e não se apartem do teu coração todos os dias da tua vida; e as farás saber a teus filhos, e aos filhos de teus filhos.
text_el: πρόσεχε σεαυτῷ καὶ φύλαξον τὴν ψυχήν σου σφόδρα μὴ ἐπιλάθῃ πάντας τοὺς λόγους οὓς ἑωράκασιν οἱ ὀφθαλμοί σου καὶ μὴ ἀποστήτωσαν ἀπὸ τῆς καρδίας σου πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς σου καὶ συμβιβάσεις τοὺς υἱούς σου καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν υἱῶν σου

text_en: from the day in which you stood before the Lord your God in Horeb , when the Lord spoke to me, saying: Call together the people unto me, that they may hear my words, and may learn to fear me all the time that they live on the earth, and may teach their children.
text_la: a die in quo stetisti coram Domino Deo tuo in Horeb, quando Dominus locutus est mihi, dicens : Congrega ad me populum, ut audiant sermones meos, et discant timere me omni tempore quo vivunt in terra, doceantque filios suos.
text_pt: O dia em que estiveste perante o Senhor teu Deus em Horebe, quando o Senhor me disse: Ajunta-me este povo, e os farei ouvir as minhas palavras, e aprendê-las-ão, para me temerem todos os dias que na terra viverem, e as ensinarão a seus filhos;
text_el: ἡμέραν ἣν ἔστητε ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν ἐν Χωρηβ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς ἐκκλησίας ὅτε εἶπεν κύριος πρός με ἐκκλησίασον πρός με τὸν λαόν καὶ ἀκουσάτωσαν τὰ ῥήματά μου ὅπως μάθωσιν φοβεῖσθαί με πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ἃς αὐτοὶ ζῶσιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτῶν διδάξωσιν

text_en: And you came to the foot of the mount , which burned even unto heaven : and there was darkness, and a cloud and obscurity in it.
text_la: Et accessistis ad radices montis, qui ardebat usque ad cælum : erantque in eo tenebræ, et nubes, et caligo.
text_pt: E vós vos chegastes, e vos pusestes ao pé do monte; e o monte ardia em fogo até ao meio dos céus, e havia trevas, e nuvens e escuridão;
text_el: καὶ προσήλθετε καὶ ἔστητε ὑπὸ τὸ ὄρος καὶ τὸ ὄρος ἐκαίετο πυρὶ ἕως τοῦ οὐρανοῦ σκότος γνόφος θύελλα φωνὴ μεγάλη

text_en: And the Lord spoke to you from the midst of the fire. You heard the voice of his words, but you saw not any form at all.
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad vos de medio ignis. Vocem verborum ejus audistis, et formam penitus non vidistis.
text_pt: Então o Senhor vos falou do meio do fogo; a voz das palavras ouvistes; porém, além da voz, não vistes figura alguma.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐκ μέσου τοῦ πυρός φωνὴν ῥημάτων ὑμεῖς ἠκούσατε καὶ ὁμοίωμα οὐκ εἴδετε ἀλλ' ἢ φωνήν

text_en: And he showed you his covenant, which he commanded you to do, and the ten words that he wrote in two tables of stone.
text_la: Et ostendit vobis pactum suum, quod præcepit ut faceretis, et decem verba, quæ scripsit in duabus tabulis lapideis.
text_pt: Então vos anunciou ele a sua aliança que vos ordenou cumprir, os dez mandamentos, e os escreveu em duas tábuas de pedra.
text_el: καὶ ἀνήγγειλεν ὑμῖν τὴν διαθήκην αὐτοῦ ἣν ἐνετείλατο ὑμῖν ποιεῖν τὰ δέκα ῥήματα καὶ ἔγραψεν αὐτὰ ἐπὶ δύο πλάκας λιθίνας

text_en: And he commanded me at that time that I should teach you the ceremonies and judgments which you shall do in the land, that you shall possess.
text_la: Mihique mandavit in illo tempore ut docerem vos cæremonias et judicia, quæ facere deberetis in terra, quam possessuri estis.
text_pt: Também o Senhor me ordenou ao mesmo tempo que vos ensinasse estatutos e juízos, para que os cumprísseis na terra a qual passais a possuir.
text_el: καὶ ἐμοὶ ἐνετείλατο κύριος ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ διδάξαι ὑμᾶς δικαιώματα καὶ κρίσεις ποιεῖν αὐτὰ ὑμᾶς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς εἰς ἣν ὑμεῖς εἰσπορεύεσθε ἐκεῖ κληρονομεῖν αὐτήν

text_en: Keep therefore your souls carefully. You saw not any similitude in the day that the Lord God spoke to you in Horeb from the midst of the fire:
text_la: Custodite igitur sollicite animas vestras. Non vidistis aliquam similitudinem in die, qua locutus est vobis Dominus in Horeb de medio ignis:
text_pt: Guardai, pois, com diligência as vossas almas, pois nenhuma figura vistes no dia em que o Senhor, em Horebe, falou convosco do meio do fogo;
text_el: καὶ φυλάξεσθε σφόδρα τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν ὅτι οὐκ εἴδετε ὁμοίωμα ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν Χωρηβ ἐν τῷ ὄρει ἐκ μέσου τοῦ πυρός

text_en: Lest perhaps being deceived you might make you a graven similitude , or image of male or female,
text_la: ne forte decepti faciatis vobis sculptam similitudinem, aut imaginem masculi vel feminæ:
text_pt: Para que não vos corrompais, e vos façais alguma imagem esculpida na forma de qualquer figura, semelhança de homem ou mulher;
text_el: μὴ ἀνομήσητε καὶ ποιήσητε ὑμῖν ἑαυτοῖς γλυπτὸν ὁμοίωμα πᾶσαν εἰκόνα ὁμοίωμα ἀρσενικοῦ ἢ θηλυκοῦ

text_en: the similitude of any beasts, that are upon the earth, or of birds, that fly under heaven ,
text_la: similitudinem omnium jumentorum, quæ sunt super terram, vel avium sub cælo volantium,
text_pt: Figura de algum animal que haja na terra; figura de alguma ave alada que voa pelos céus;
text_el: ὁμοίωμα παντὸς κτήνους τῶν ὄντων ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ὁμοίωμα παντὸς ὀρνέου πτερωτοῦ ὃ πέταται ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανόν

text_en: or of creeping things, that move on the earth, or of fishes, that abide in the waters under the earth:
text_la: atque reptilium, quæ moventur in terra, sive piscium qui sub terra morantur in aquis:
text_pt: Figura de algum animal que se arrasta sobre a terra; figura de algum peixe que esteja nas águas debaixo da terra;
text_el: ὁμοίωμα παντὸς ἑρπετοῦ ὃ ἕρπει ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ὁμοίωμα παντὸς ἰχθύος ὅσα ἐστὶν ἐν τοῖς ὕδασιν ὑποκάτω τῆς γῆς

text_en: Lest perhaps lifting up your eyes to heaven , you see the sun and the moon, and all the stars of heaven , and being deceived by error you adore and serve them, which the Lord your God created for the service of all the nations, that are under heaven .
text_la: ne forte elevatis oculis ad cælum, videas solem et lunam, et omnia astra cæli, et errore deceptus adores ea, et colas quæ creavit Dominus Deus tuus in ministerium cunctis gentibus, quæ sub cælo sunt.
text_pt: Que não levantes os teus olhos aos céus e vejas o sol, e a lua, e as estrelas, todo o exército dos céus; e sejas impelido a que te inclines perante eles, e sirvas àqueles que o Senhor teu Deus repartiu a todos os povos debaixo de todos os céus.
text_el: καὶ μὴ ἀναβλέψας εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ ἰδὼν τὸν ἥλιον καὶ τὴν σελήνην καὶ τοὺς ἀστέρας καὶ πάντα τὸν κόσμον τοῦ οὐρανοῦ πλανηθεὶς προσκυνήσῃς αὐτοῖς καὶ λατρεύσῃς αὐτοῖς ἃ ἀπένειμεν κύριος ὁ θεός σου αὐτὰ πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν τοῖς ὑποκάτω τοῦ οὐρανοῦ

text_en: But the Lord has taken you and brought you out of the iron furnaces of Egypt , to make you his people of inheritance, as it is this present day.
text_la: Vos autem tulit Dominus, et eduxit de fornace ferrea Ægypti, ut haberet populum hæreditarium, sicut est in præsenti die.
text_pt: Mas o Senhor vos tomou, e vos tirou da fornalha de ferro do Egito, para que lhe sejais por povo hereditário, como neste dia se vê.
text_el: ὑμᾶς δὲ ἔλαβεν ὁ θεὸς καὶ ἐξήγαγεν ὑμᾶς ἐκ τῆς καμίνου τῆς σιδηρᾶς ἐξ Αἰγύπτου εἶναι αὐτῷ λαὸν ἔγκληρον ὡς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ

text_en: And the Lord was angry with me for your words, and he swore that I should not pass over the Jordan , nor enter into the excellent land, which he will give you.
text_la: Iratusque est Dominus contra me propter sermones vestros, et juravit ut non transirem Jordanem, nec ingrederer terram optimam, quam daturus est vobis.
text_pt: Também o Senhor se indignou contra mim por causa das vossas palavras, e jurou que eu não passaria o Jordão, e que não entraria na boa terra que o Senhor teu Deus te dará por herança.
text_el: καὶ κύριος ἐθυμώθη μοι περὶ τῶν λεγομένων ὑφ' ὑμῶν καὶ ὤμοσεν ἵνα μὴ διαβῶ τὸν Ιορδάνην τοῦτον καὶ ἵνα μὴ εἰσέλθω εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν κύριος ὁ θεὸς δίδωσίν σοι ἐν κλήρῳ

text_en: Behold I die in this land, I shall not pass over the Jordan : you shall pass, and possess the goodly land.
text_la: Ecce morior in hac humo; non transibo Jordanem : vos transibitis, et possidebitis terram egregiam.
text_pt: Porque eu nesta terra morrerei, não passarei o Jordão; porém vós o passareis, e possuireis aquela boa terra.
text_el: ἐγὼ γὰρ ἀποθνῄσκω ἐν τῇ γῇ ταύτῃ καὶ οὐ διαβαίνω τὸν Ιορδάνην τοῦτον ὑμεῖς δὲ διαβαίνετε καὶ κληρονομήσετε τὴν γῆν τὴν ἀγαθὴν ταύτην

text_en: Beware lest you ever forget the covenant of the Lord your God , which he has made with you: and make to yourself a graven likeness of those things which the Lord has forbid to be made:
text_la: Cave nequando obliviscaris pacti Domini Dei tui, quod pepigit tecum, et facias tibi sculptam similitudinem eorum, quæ fieri Dominus prohibuit:
text_pt: Guardai-vos e não vos esqueçais da aliança do Senhor vosso Deus, que tem feito convosco, e não façais para vós escultura alguma, imagem de alguma coisa que o Senhor vosso Deus vos proibiu.
text_el: προσέχετε ὑμεῖς μὴ ἐπιλάθησθε τὴν διαθήκην κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν ἣν διέθετο πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ ποιήσητε ὑμῖν ἑαυτοῖς γλυπτὸν ὁμοίωμα πάντων ὧν συνέταξεν κύριος ὁ θεός σου

text_en: Because the Lord your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God .
text_la: quia Dominus Deus tuus ignis consumens est, Deus æmulator.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor teu Deus é um fogo que consome, um Deus zeloso.
text_el: ὅτι κύριος ὁ θεός σου πῦρ καταναλίσκον ἐστίν θεὸς ζηλωτής

text_en: If you shall beget sons and grandsons, and abide in the land, and being deceived , make to yourselves any similitude , committing evil before the Lord your God , to provoke him to wrath :
text_la: Si genueritis filios ac nepotes, et morati fueritis in terra, deceptique feceritis vobis aliquam similitudinem, patrantes malum coram Domino Deo vestro, ut eum ad iracundiam provocetis:
text_pt: Quando, pois, gerardes filhos, e filhos de filhos, e vos envelhecerdes na terra, e vos corromperdes, e fizerdes alguma escultura, semelhança de alguma coisa, e fizerdes o que é mau aos olhos do Senhor teu Deus, para o provocar à ira;
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ γεννήσῃς υἱοὺς καὶ υἱοὺς τῶν υἱῶν σου καὶ χρονίσητε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἀνομήσητε καὶ ποιήσητε γλυπτὸν ὁμοίωμα παντὸς καὶ ποιήσητε τὰ πονηρὰ ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν παροργίσαι αὐτόν

text_en: I call this day heaven and earth to witness, that you shall quickly perish out of the land, which, when you have passed over the Jordan , you shall possess. You shall not dwell therein long, but the Lord will destroy you,
text_la: testes invoco hodie cælum et terram, cito perituros vos esse de terra, quam transito Jordane possessuri estis : non habitabitis in ea longo tempore, sed delebit vos Dominus,
text_pt: Hoje tomo por testemunhas contra vós o céu e a terra, que certamente logo perecereis da terra, a qual passais o Jordão para a possuir; não prolongareis os vossos dias nela, antes sereis de todo destruídos.
text_el: διαμαρτύρομαι ὑμῖν σήμερον τόν τε οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν ὅτι ἀπωλείᾳ ἀπολεῖσθε ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς εἰς ἣν ὑμεῖς διαβαίνετε τὸν Ιορδάνην ἐκεῖ κληρονομῆσαι αὐτήν οὐχὶ πολυχρονιεῖτε ἡμέρας ἐπ' αὐτῆς ἀλλ' ἢ ἐκτριβῇ ἐκτριβήσεσθε

text_en: and scatter you among all nations , and you shall remain a few among the nations , to which the Lord shall lead you.
text_la: atque disperget in omnes gentes, et remanebitis pauci in nationibus, ad quas vos ducturus est Dominus.
text_pt: E o Senhor vos espalhará entre os povos, e ficareis poucos em número entre as nações às quais o Senhor vos conduzirá.
text_el: καὶ διασπερεῖ κύριος ὑμᾶς ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ καταλειφθήσεσθε ὀλίγοι ἀριθμῷ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν εἰς οὓς εἰσάξει κύριος ὑμᾶς ἐκεῖ
