text_en: And there you shall serve gods , that were framed with men's hands: wood and stone, that neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
text_la: Ibique servietis diis, qui hominum manu fabricati sunt, ligno et lapidi qui non vident, nec audiunt, nec comedunt, nec odorantur.
text_pt: E ali servireis a deuses que são obra de mãos de homens, madeira e pedra, que não vêem, nem ouvem, nem comem, nem cheiram.
text_el: καὶ λατρεύσετε ἐκεῖ θεοῖς ἑτέροις ἔργοις χειρῶν ἀνθρώπων ξύλοις καὶ λίθοις οἳ οὐκ ὄψονται οὐδὲ μὴ ἀκούσωσιν οὔτε μὴ φάγωσιν οὔτε μὴ ὀσφρανθῶσιν

text_en: And when you shall seek there the Lord your God , you shall find him: yet so, if you seek him with all your heart, and all the affliction of your soul .
text_la: Cumque quæsieris ibi Dominum Deum tuum, invenies eum : si tamen toto corde quæsieris, et tota tribulatione animæ tuæ.
text_pt: Então dali buscarás ao Senhor teu Deus, e o acharás, quando o buscares de todo o teu coração e de toda a tua alma.
text_el: καὶ ζητήσετε ἐκεῖ κύριον τὸν θεὸν ὑμῶν καὶ εὑρήσετε ὅταν ἐκζητήσητε αὐτὸν ἐξ ὅλης τῆς καρδίας σου καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς ψυχῆς σου ἐν τῇ θλίψει σου

text_en: After all the things aforesaid shall find you, in the latter time you shall return to the Lord your God , and shall hear his voice.
text_la: Postquam te invenerint omnia quæ prædicta sunt, novissimo tempore reverteris ad Dominum Deum tuum, et audies vocem ejus.
text_pt: Quando estiverdes em angústia, e todas estas coisas te alcançarem, então nos últimos dias voltarás para o Senhor teu Deus, e ouvirás a sua voz.
text_el: καὶ εὑρήσουσίν σε πάντες οἱ λόγοι οὗτοι ἐπ' ἐσχάτῳ τῶν ἡμερῶν καὶ ἐπιστραφήσῃ πρὸς κύριον τὸν θεόν σου καὶ εἰσακούσῃ τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Because the Lord your God is a merciful God : he will not leave you, nor altogether destroy you, nor forget the covenant, by which he swore to your fathers.
text_la: Quia Deus misericors Dominus Deus tuus est : non dimittet te, nec omnino delebit, neque obliviscetur pacti, in quo juravit patribus tuis.
text_pt: Porquanto o Senhor teu Deus é Deus misericordioso, e não te desamparará, nem te destruirá, nem se esquecerá da aliança que jurou a teus pais.
text_el: ὅτι θεὸς οἰκτίρμων κύριος ὁ θεός σου οὐκ ἐγκαταλείψει σε οὐδὲ μὴ ἐκτρίψει σε οὐκ ἐπιλήσεται τὴν διαθήκην τῶν πατέρων σου ἣν ὤμοσεν αὐτοῖς

text_en: Ask of the days of old, that have been before your time from the day that God created man upon the earth, from one end of heaven to the other end thereof, if ever there was done the like thing, or it has been known at any time,
text_la: Interroga de diebus antiquis, qui fuerunt ante te ex die quo creavit Deus hominem super terram, a summo cælo usque ad summum ejus, si facta est aliquando hujuscemodi res, aut umquam cognitum est,
text_pt: Agora, pois, pergunta aos tempos passados, que te precederam desde o dia em que Deus criou o homem sobre a terra, desde uma extremidade do céu até à outra, se sucedeu jamais coisa tão grande como esta, ou se jamais se ouviu coisa como esta?
text_el: ἐπερωτήσατε ἡμέρας προτέρας τὰς γενομένας προτέρας σου ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας ἧς ἔκτισεν ὁ θεὸς ἄνθρωπον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἕως ἄκρου τοῦ οὐρανοῦ εἰ γέγονεν κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμα τὸ μέγα τοῦτο εἰ ἤκουσται τοιοῦτο

text_en: that a people should hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of fire, as you have heard, and lived:
text_la: ut audiret populus vocem Dei loquentis de medio ignis, sicut tu audisti, et vixisti:
text_pt: Ou se algum povo ouviu a voz de Deus falando do meio do fogo, como tu a ouviste, e ficou vivo?
text_el: εἰ ἀκήκοεν ἔθνος φωνὴν θεοῦ ζῶντος λαλοῦντος ἐκ μέσου τοῦ πυρός ὃν τρόπον ἀκήκοας σὺ καὶ ἔζησας

text_en: If God ever did so as to go, and take to himself a nation out of the midst of nations by temptations, signs, and wonders , by fight, and a strong hand, and stretched out arm, and horrible visions according to all the things that the Lord your God did for you in Egypt , before your eyes.
text_la: si fecit Deus ut ingrederetur, et tolleret sibi gentem de medio nationum, per tentationes, signa atque portenta, per pugnam et robustam manum, extentumque brachium, et horribiles visiones juxta omnia quæ fecit pro vobis Dominus Deus vester in Ægypto, videntibus oculis tuis:
text_pt: Ou se Deus intentou ir tomar para si um povo do meio de outro povo com provas, com sinais, e com milagres, e com peleja, e com mão forte, e com braço estendido, e com grandes espantos, conforme a tudo quanto o Senhor vosso Deus vos fez no Egito aos vossos olhos?
text_el: εἰ ἐπείρασεν ὁ θεὸς εἰσελθὼν λαβεῖν ἑαυτῷ ἔθνος ἐκ μέσου ἔθνους ἐν πειρασμῷ καὶ ἐν σημείοις καὶ ἐν τέρασιν καὶ ἐν πολέμῳ καὶ ἐν χειρὶ κραταιᾷ καὶ ἐν βραχίονι ὑψηλῷ καὶ ἐν ὁράμασιν μεγάλοις κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ ἐνώπιόν σου βλέποντος

text_en: That you might know that the Lord he is God , and there is no other besides him.
text_la: ut scires quoniam Dominus ipse est Deus, et non est alius præter eum.
text_pt: A ti te foi mostrado para que soubesses que o Senhor é Deus; nenhum outro há senão ele.
text_el: ὥστε εἰδῆσαί σε ὅτι κύριος ὁ θεός σου οὗτος θεός ἐστιν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἔτι πλὴν αὐτοῦ

text_en: From heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might teach you. And upon earth he showed you his exceeding great fire, and you heard his words out of the midst of the fire,
text_la: De cælo te fecit audire vocem suam, ut doceret te, et in terra ostendit tibi ignem suum maximum, et audisti verba illius de medio ignis:
text_pt: Desde os céus te fez ouvir a sua voz, para te ensinar, e sobre a terra te mostrou o seu grande fogo, e ouviste as suas palavras do meio do fogo.
text_el: ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἀκουστὴ ἐγένετο ἡ φωνὴ αὐτοῦ παιδεῦσαί σε καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἔδειξέν σοι τὸ πῦρ αὐτοῦ τὸ μέγα καὶ τὰ ῥήματα αὐτοῦ ἤκουσας ἐκ μέσου τοῦ πυρός

text_en: because he loved your fathers, and chose their seed after them. And he brought you out of Egypt , going before you with his great power,
text_la: quia dilexit patres tuos, et elegit semen eorum post eos. Eduxitque te præcedens in virtute sua magna ex Ægypto,
text_pt: E, porquanto amou teus pais, e escolheu a sua descendência depois deles, te tirou do Egito diante de si, com a sua grande força,
text_el: διὰ τὸ ἀγαπῆσαι αὐτὸν τοὺς πατέρας σου καὶ ἐξελέξατο τὸ σπέρμα αὐτῶν μετ' αὐτοὺς ὑμᾶς καὶ ἐξήγαγέν σε αὐτὸς ἐν τῇ ἰσχύι αὐτοῦ τῇ μεγάλῃ ἐξ Αἰγύπτου

text_en: to destroy at your coming very great nations , and stronger than you are, and to bring you in, and give you their land for a possession, as you see at this present day.
text_la: ut deleret nationes maximas et fortiores te in introitu tuo : et introduceret te, daretque tibi terram earum in possessionem, sicut cernis in præsenti die.
text_pt: Para lançar fora de diante de ti nações maiores e mais poderosas do que tu, para te introduzir e te dar a sua terra por herança, como neste dia se vê.
text_el: ἐξολεθρεῦσαι ἔθνη μεγάλα καὶ ἰσχυρότερά σου πρὸ προσώπου σου εἰσαγαγεῖν σε δοῦναί σοι τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν κληρονομεῖν καθὼς ἔχεις σήμερον

text_en: Know therefore this day, and think in your heart that the Lord he is God in heaven above, and in the earth beneath, and there is no other.
text_la: Scito ergo hodie, et cogitato in corde tuo quod Dominus ipse sit Deus in cælo sursum, et in terra deorsum, et non sit alius.
text_pt: Por isso hoje saberás, e refletirás no teu coração, que só o Senhor é Deus, em cima no céu e em baixo na terra; nenhum outro há.
text_el: καὶ γνώσῃ σήμερον καὶ ἐπιστραφήσῃ τῇ διανοίᾳ ὅτι κύριος ὁ θεός σου οὗτος θεὸς ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ἄνω καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς κάτω καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἔτι πλὴν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Keep his precepts and commandments , which I command you: that it may be well with you, and your children after you, and you may remain a long time upon the land, which the Lord your God will give you.
text_la: Custodi præcepta ejus atque mandata, quæ ego præcipio tibi : ut bene sit tibi, et filiis tuis post te, et permaneas multo tempore super terram, quam Dominus Deus tuus daturus est tibi.
text_pt: E guardarás os seus estatutos e os seus mandamentos, que te ordeno hoje para que te vá bem a ti, e a teus filhos depois de ti, e para que prolongues os dias na terra que o Senhor teu Deus te dá para todo o sempre.
text_el: καὶ φυλάξῃ τὰ δικαιώματα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ὅσας ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον ἵνα εὖ σοι γένηται καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς σου μετὰ σέ ὅπως μακροήμεροι γένησθε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἧς κύριος ὁ θεός σου δίδωσίν σοι πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας

text_en: Then Moses set aside three cities beyond the Jordan at the east side,
text_la: Tunc separavit Moyses tres civitates trans Jordanem ad orientalem plagam,
text_pt: Então Moisés separou três cidades além do Jordão, do lado do nascimento do sol;
text_el: τότε ἀφώρισεν Μωυσῆς τρεῖς πόλεις πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν ἡλίου

text_en: that any one might flee to them who should kill his neighbour unwillingly, and was not his enemy a day or two before, and that he might escape to some one of these cities:
text_la: ut confugiat ad eas qui occiderit nolens proximum suum, nec sibi fuerit inimicus ante unum et alterum diem, et ad harum aliquam urbium possit evadere:
text_pt: Para que ali se acolhesse o homicida que involuntariamente matasse o seu próximo a quem dantes não tivesse ódio algum; e se acolhesse a uma destas cidades, e vivesse;
text_el: φυγεῖν ἐκεῖ τὸν φονευτήν ὃς ἂν φονεύσῃ τὸν πλησίον οὐκ εἰδὼς καὶ οὗτος οὐ μισῶν αὐτὸν πρὸ τῆς ἐχθὲς καὶ τρίτης καὶ καταφεύξεται εἰς μίαν τῶν πόλεων τούτων καὶ ζήσεται

text_en: Bosor in the wilderness , which is situate in the plains of the tribe of Ruben : and Ramoth in Galaad, which is in the tribe of Gad : and Golan in Basan, which is in the tribe of Manasses .
text_la: Bosor in solitudine, quæ sita est in terra campestri de tribu Ruben : et Ramoth in Galaad, quæ est in tribu Gad : et Golan in Basan, quæ est in tribu Manasse.
text_pt: A Bezer, no deserto, no planalto, para os rubenitas; e a Ramote, em Gileade, para os gaditas; e a Golã, em Basã, para os manassitas.
text_el: τὴν Βοσορ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἐν τῇ γῇ τῇ πεδινῇ τῷ Ρουβην καὶ τὴν Ραμωθ ἐν Γαλααδ τῷ Γαδδι καὶ τὴν Γαυλων ἐν Βασαν τῷ Μανασση

text_en: This is the law , that Moses set before the children of Israel ,
text_la: Ista est lex, quam proposuit Moyses coram filiis Israël:
text_pt: Esta é, pois, a lei que Moisés propôs aos filhos de Israel.
text_el: οὗτος ὁ νόμος ὃν παρέθετο Μωυσῆς ἐνώπιον υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: and these are the testimonies and ceremonies and judgments, which he spoke to the children of Israel , when they came out of Egypt ,
text_la: et hæc testimonia et cæremoniæ atque judicia, quæ locutus est ad filios Israël, quando egressi sunt de Ægypto,
text_pt: Estes são os testemunhos, e os estatutos, e os juízos, que Moisés falou aos filhos de Israel, havendo saído do Egito;
text_el: ταῦτα τὰ μαρτύρια καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα καὶ τὰ κρίματα ὅσα ἐλάλησεν Μωυσῆς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἐξελθόντων αὐτῶν ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: beyond the Jordan in the valley over against the temple of Phogor, in the land of Sehon king of the Amorrhites , that dwelt in Hesebon , whom Moses slew. And the children of Israel coming out of Egypt ,
text_la: trans Jordanem in valle contra fanum Phogor in terra Sehon regis Amorrhæi, qui habitavit in Hesebon, quem percussit Moyses. Filii quoque Israël egressi ex Ægypto
text_pt: Além do Jordão, no vale defronte de Bete-Peor, na terra de Siom, rei dos amorreus, que habitava em Hesbom, a quem feriu Moisés e os filhos de Israel, havendo eles saído do Egito.
text_el: ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἐν φάραγγι ἐγγὺς οἴκου Φογωρ ἐν γῇ Σηων βασιλέως τῶν Αμορραίων ὃς κατῴκει ἐν Εσεβων οὓς ἐπάταξεν Μωυσῆς καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἐξελθόντων αὐτῶν ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Basan, of the two kings of the Amorrhites , who were beyond the Jordan towards the rising of the sun:
text_la: possederunt terram ejus, et terram Og regis Basan, duorum regum Amorrhæorum, qui erant trans Jordanem ad solis ortum:
text_pt: E tomaram a sua terra em possessão, como também a terra de Ogue, rei de Basã, dois reis dos amorreus, que estavam além do Jordão, do lado do nascimento do sol.
text_el: καὶ ἐκληρονόμησαν τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν γῆν Ωγ βασιλέως τῆς Βασαν δύο βασιλέων τῶν Αμορραίων οἳ ἦσαν πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου κατ' ἀνατολὰς ἡλίου

text_en: From Aroer, which is situate upon the bank of the torrent Arnon, unto mount Sion, which is also called Hermon ,
text_la: ab Aroër, quæ sita est super ripam torrentis Arnon, usque ad montem Sion, qui est et Hermon,
text_pt: Desde Aroer, que está à margem do ribeiro de Arnom, até ao monte Sião, que é Hermom,
text_el: ἀπὸ Αροηρ ἥ ἐστιν ἐπὶ τοῦ χείλους χειμάρρου Αρνων καὶ ἐπὶ τοῦ ὄρους τοῦ Σηων ὅ ἐστιν Αερμων

text_en: all the plain beyond the Jordan at the east side, unto the sea of the wilderness, and unto the foot of mount Phasga .
text_la: omnem planitiem trans Jordanem ad orientalem plagam, usque ad mare solitudinis, et usque ad radices montis Phasga.
text_pt: E toda a campina além do Jordão, do lado do oriente, até ao mar da campina, abaixo de Asdote-Pisga.
text_el: πᾶσαν τὴν Αραβα πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου κατ' ἀνατολὰς ἡλίου ὑπὸ Ασηδωθ τὴν λαξευτήν

text_en: And Moses called all Israel , and said to them: Hear, O Israel , the ceremonies and judgments, which I speak in your ears this day: learn them, and fulfil them in work.
text_la: Vocavitque Moyses omnem Israëlem, et dixit ad eum : Audi, Israël, cæremonias atque judicia, quæ ego loquor in auribus vestris hodie : discite ea, et opere complete.
text_pt: E chamou Moisés a todo o Israel, e disse-lhes: Ouve, ó Israel, os estatutos e juízos que hoje vos falo aos ouvidos; e aprendê-los-eis, e guardá-los-eis, para os cumprir.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Μωυσῆς πάντα Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς ἄκουε Ισραηλ τὰ δικαιώματα καὶ τὰ κρίματα ὅσα ἐγὼ λαλῶ ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶν ὑμῶν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ καὶ μαθήσεσθε αὐτὰ καὶ φυλάξεσθε ποιεῖν αὐτά

text_en: The Lord our God made a covenant with us in Horeb .
text_la: Dominus Deus noster pepigit nobiscum fœdus in Horeb.
text_pt: O Senhor nosso Deus fez conosco aliança em Horebe.
text_el: κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν διέθετο πρὸς ὑμᾶς διαθήκην ἐν Χωρηβ

text_en: He made not the covenant with our fathers, but with us, who are now present and living.
text_la: Non cum patribus nostris iniit pactum, sed nobiscum qui in præsentiarum sumus, et vivimus.
text_pt: Não com nossos pais fez o Senhor esta aliança, mas conosco, todos os que hoje aqui estamos vivos.
text_el: οὐχὶ τοῖς πατράσιν ὑμῶν διέθετο κύριος τὴν διαθήκην ταύτην ἀλλ' ἢ πρὸς ὑμᾶς ὑμεῖς ὧδε πάντες ζῶντες σήμερον

text_en: He spoke to us face to face in the mount out of the midst of fire.
text_la: Facie ad faciem locutus est nobis in monte de medio ignis.
text_pt: Face a face o Senhor falou conosco no monte, do meio do fogo
text_el: πρόσωπον κατὰ πρόσωπον ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν τῷ ὄρει ἐκ μέσου τοῦ πυρός

text_en: I was the mediator and stood between the Lord and you at that time, to show you his words, for you feared the fire, and went not up into the mountain, and he said:
text_la: Ego sequester et medius fui inter Dominum et vos in tempore illo, ut annuntiarem vobis verba ejus : timuistis enim ignem, et non ascendistis in montem. Et ait:
text_pt: (Naquele tempo eu estava em pé entre o Senhor e vós, para vos notificar a palavra do Senhor; porque temestes o fogo e não subistes ao monte), dizendo:
text_el: κἀγὼ εἱστήκειν ἀνὰ μέσον κυρίου καὶ ὑμῶν ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ἀναγγεῖλαι ὑμῖν τὰ ῥήματα κυρίου ὅτι ἐφοβήθητε ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ πυρὸς καὶ οὐκ ἀνέβητε εἰς τὸ ὄρος λέγων

text_en: I am the Lord your God , who brought you out of the land of Egypt , out of the house of bondage .
text_la: Ego Dominus Deus tuus, qui eduxi te de terra Ægypti, de domo servitutis.
text_pt: Eu sou o Senhor teu Deus, que te tirei da terra do Egito, da casa da servidão;
text_el: ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεός σου ὁ ἐξαγαγών σε ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ἐξ οἴκου δουλείας

text_en: You shall not have strange gods in my sight.
text_la: Non habebis deos alienos in conspectu meo.
text_pt: Não terás outros deuses diante de mim;
text_el: οὐκ ἔσονταί σοι θεοὶ ἕτεροι πρὸ προσώπου μου

text_en: You shall not make to your self a graven thing , nor the likeness of any things, that are in heaven above, or that are in the earth beneath, or that abide in the waters under the earth.
text_la: Non facies tibi sculptile, nec similitudinem omnium, quæ in cælo sunt desuper, et quæ in terra deorsum, et quæ versantur in aquis sub terra.
text_pt: Não farás para ti imagem de escultura, nem semelhança alguma do que há em cima no céu, nem em baixo na terra, nem nas águas debaixo da terra;
text_el: οὐ ποιήσεις σεαυτῷ εἴδωλον οὐδὲ παντὸς ὁμοίωμα ὅσα ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ἄνω καὶ ὅσα ἐν τῇ γῇ κάτω καὶ ὅσα ἐν τοῖς ὕδασιν ὑποκάτω τῆς γῆς

text_en: You shall not adore them, and you shall not serve them. For I am the Lord your God , a jealous God , visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon their children unto the third and fourth generation , to them that hate me,
text_la: Non adorabis ea, et non coles. Ego enim sum Dominus Deus tuus : Deus æmulator, reddens iniquitatem patrum super filios in tertiam et quartam generationem his qui oderunt me:
text_pt: Não te encurvarás a elas, nem as servirás; porque eu, o Senhor teu Deus, sou Deus zeloso, que visito a iniqüidade dos pais nos filhos, até a terceira e quarta geração daqueles que me odeiam.
text_el: οὐ προσκυνήσεις αὐτοῖς οὐδὲ μὴ λατρεύσῃς αὐτοῖς ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ὁ θεός σου θεὸς ζηλωτὴς ἀποδιδοὺς ἁμαρτίας πατέρων ἐπὶ τέκνα ἐπὶ τρίτην καὶ τετάρτην γενεὰν τοῖς μισοῦσίν με

text_en: and showing mercy unto many thousands, to them that love me, and keep my commandments .
text_la: et faciens misericordiam in multa millia diligentibus me, et custodientibus præcepta mea.
text_pt: E faço misericórdia a milhares dos que me amam e guardam os meus mandamentos.
text_el: καὶ ποιῶν ἔλεος εἰς χιλιάδας τοῖς ἀγαπῶσίν με καὶ τοῖς φυλάσσουσιν τὰ προστάγματά μου

text_en: You shall not take the name of the Lord your God in vain : for he shall not be unpunished that takes his name upon a vain thing.
text_la: Non usurpabis nomen Domini Dei tui frustra : quia non erit impunitus qui super re vana nomen ejus assumpserit.
text_pt: Não tomarás o nome do Senhor teu Deus em vão; porque o Senhor não terá por inocente ao que tomar o seu nome em vão.
text_el: οὐ λήμψῃ τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου ἐπὶ ματαίῳ οὐ γὰρ μὴ καθαρίσῃ κύριος τὸν λαμβάνοντα τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ ματαίῳ

text_en: Observe the day of the sabbath , to sanctify it, as the Lord your God has commanded you.
text_la: Observa diem sabbati, ut sanctifices eum, sicut præcepit tibi Dominus Deus tuus.
text_pt: Guarda o dia de sábado, para o santificar, como te ordenou o Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: φύλαξαι τὴν ἡμέραν τῶν σαββάτων ἁγιάζειν αὐτήν ὃν τρόπον ἐνετείλατό σοι κύριος ὁ θεός σου

text_en: Six days shall you labour, and shall do all your works.
text_la: Sex diebus operaberis, et facies omnia opera tua.
text_pt: Seis dias trabalharás, e farás todo o teu trabalho.
text_el: ἓξ ἡμέρας ἐργᾷ καὶ ποιήσεις πάντα τὰ ἔργα σου

text_en: The seventh is the day of the sabbath , that is, the rest of the Lord your God . You shall not do any work therein, neither you nor your son nor your daughter, nor your manservant nor your maidservant, nor your ox, nor your ass, nor any of your beasts, nor the stranger that is within your gates: that your manservant and your maidservant may rest, even as yourself.
text_la: Septimus dies sabbati est, id est, requies Domini Dei tui. Non facies in eo quidquam operis tu, et filius tuus, et filia, servus et ancilla, et bos, et asinus, et omne jumentum tuum, et peregrinus qui est intra portas tuas : ut requiescat servus tuus, et ancilla tua, sicut et tu.
text_pt: Mas o sétimo dia é o sábado do Senhor teu Deus; não farás nenhum trabalho nele, nem tu, nem teu filho, nem tua filha, nem o teu servo, nem a tua serva, nem o teu boi, nem o teu jumento, nem animal algum teu, nem o estrangeiro que está dentro de tuas portas; para que o teu servo e a tua serva descansem como tu;
text_el: τῇ δὲ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ σάββατα κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σου οὐ ποιήσεις ἐν αὐτῇ πᾶν ἔργον σὺ καὶ οἱ υἱοί σου καὶ ἡ θυγάτηρ σου ὁ παῖς σου καὶ ἡ παιδίσκη σου ὁ βοῦς σου καὶ τὸ ὑποζύγιόν σου καὶ πᾶν κτῆνός σου καὶ ὁ προσήλυτος ὁ παροικῶν ἐν σοί ἵνα ἀναπαύσηται ὁ παῖς σου καὶ ἡ παιδίσκη σου ὥσπερ καὶ σύ

text_en: Remember that you also served in Egypt , and the Lord your God brought you out from thence with a strong hand, and a stretched out arm. Therefore has he commanded you that you should observe the sabbath day .
text_la: Memento quod et ipse servieris in Ægypto, et eduxerit te inde Dominus Deus tuus in manu forti, et brachio extento. Idcirco præcepit tibi ut observares diem sabbati.
text_pt: Porque te lembrarás que foste servo na terra do Egito, e que o Senhor teu Deus te tirou dali com mão forte e braço estendido; por isso o Senhor teu Deus te ordenou que guardasses o dia de sábado.
text_el: καὶ μνησθήσῃ ὅτι οἰκέτης ἦσθα ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ ἐξήγαγέν σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐκεῖθεν ἐν χειρὶ κραταιᾷ καὶ ἐν βραχίονι ὑψηλῷ διὰ τοῦτο συνέταξέν σοι κύριος ὁ θεός σου ὥστε φυλάσσεσθαι τὴν ἡμέραν τῶν σαββάτων καὶ ἁγιάζειν αὐτήν

text_en: Honour your father and mother , as the Lord your God has commanded you, that you may live a long time, and it may be well with you in the land, which the Lord your God will give you.
text_la: Honora patrem tuum et matrem, sicut præcepit tibi Dominus Deus tuus, ut longo vivas tempore, et bene sit tibi in terra, quam Dominus Deus tuus daturus est tibi.
text_pt: Honra a teu pai e a tua mãe, como o Senhor teu Deus te ordenou, para que se prolonguem os teus dias, e para que te vá bem na terra que te dá o Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: τίμα τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ τὴν μητέρα σου ὃν τρόπον ἐνετείλατό σοι κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἵνα εὖ σοι γένηται καὶ ἵνα μακροχρόνιος γένῃ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἧς κύριος ὁ θεός σου δίδωσίν σοι

text_en: You shall not kill .
text_la: Non occides,
text_pt: Não matarás.
text_el: οὐ μοιχεύσεις

text_en: Neither shall you commit adultery .
text_la: neque mœchaberis,
text_pt: Não adulterarás.
text_el: οὐ φονεύσεις

text_en: And you shall not steal .
text_la: furtumque non facies:
text_pt: Não furtarás.
text_el: οὐ κλέψεις

text_en: Neither shall you bear false witness against your neighbour.
text_la: nec loqueris contra proximum tuum falsum testimonium.
text_pt: Não dirás falso testemunho contra o teu próximo.
text_el: οὐ ψευδομαρτυρήσεις κατὰ τοῦ πλησίον σου μαρτυρίαν ψευδῆ

text_en: You shall not covet your neighbour's wife: nor his house, nor his field, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is his.
text_la: Non concupisces uxorem proximi tui : non domum, non agrum, non servum, non ancillam, non bovem, non asinum, et universa quæ illius sunt.
text_pt: Não cobiçarás a mulher do teu próximo; e não desejarás a casa do teu próximo, nem o seu campo, nem o seu servo, nem a sua serva, nem o seu boi, nem o seu jumento, nem coisa alguma do teu próximo.
text_el: οὐκ ἐπιθυμήσεις τὴν γυναῖκα τοῦ πλησίον σου οὐκ ἐπιθυμήσεις τὴν οἰκίαν τοῦ πλησίον σου οὔτε τὸν ἀγρὸν αὐτοῦ οὔτε τὸν παῖδα αὐτοῦ οὔτε τὴν παιδίσκην αὐτοῦ οὔτε τοῦ βοὸς αὐτοῦ οὔτε τοῦ ὑποζυγίου αὐτοῦ οὔτε παντὸς κτήνους αὐτοῦ οὔτε ὅσα τῷ πλησίον σού ἐστιν

text_en: These words the Lord spoke to all the multitude of you in the mountain , out of the midst of the fire and the cloud, and the darkness, with a loud voice, adding nothing more: and he wrote them in two tables of stone, which he delivered unto me.
text_la: Hæc verba locutus est Dominus ad omnem multitudinem vestram in monte de medio ignis et nubis, et caliginis, voce magna, nihil addens amplius : et scripsit ea in duabus tabulis lapideis, quas tradidit mihi.
text_pt: Estas palavras falou o Senhor a toda a vossa congregação no monte, do meio do fogo, da nuvem e da escuridão, com grande voz, e nada acrescentou; e as escreveu em duas tábuas de pedra, e a mim mas deu.
text_el: τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς πᾶσαν συναγωγὴν ὑμῶν ἐν τῷ ὄρει ἐκ μέσου τοῦ πυρός σκότος γνόφος θύελλα φωνὴ μεγάλη καὶ οὐ προσέθηκεν καὶ ἔγραψεν αὐτὰ ἐπὶ δύο πλάκας λιθίνας καὶ ἔδωκέν μοι

text_en: But you, after you heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, and saw the mountain burn, came to me, all the princes of the tribes and the elders, and you said:
text_la: Vos autem postquam audistis vocem de medio tenebrarum, et montem ardere vidistis, accessistis ad me omnes principes tribuum et majores natu, atque dixistis:
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo a voz do meio das trevas, e vendo o monte ardendo em fogo, vos achegastes a mim, todos os cabeças das vossas tribos, e vossos anciãos;
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἠκούσατε τὴν φωνὴν ἐκ μέσου τοῦ πυρὸς καὶ τὸ ὄρος ἐκαίετο πυρί καὶ προσήλθετε πρός με πάντες οἱ ἡγούμενοι τῶν φυλῶν ὑμῶν καὶ ἡ γερουσία ὑμῶν

text_en: Behold the Lord our God has shown us his majesty and his greatness, we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire, and have proved this day that God speaking with man , man has lived.
text_la: Ecce ostendit nobis Dominus Deus noster majestatem et magnitudinem suam : vocem ejus audivimus de medio ignis, et probavimus hodie, quod loquente Deo cum homine, vixerit homo.
text_pt: E dissestes: Eis aqui o Senhor nosso Deus nos fez ver a sua glória e a sua grandeza, e ouvimos a sua voz do meio do fogo; hoje vimos que Deus fala com o homem, e que este permanece vivo.
text_el: καὶ ἐλέγετε ἰδοὺ ἔδειξεν ἡμῖν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ ἠκούσαμεν ἐκ μέσου τοῦ πυρός ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ εἴδομεν ὅτι λαλήσει ὁ θεὸς πρὸς ἄνθρωπον καὶ ζήσεται

text_en: Why shall we die therefore, and why shall this exceeding great fire consume us: for if we hear the voice of the Lord our God any more, we shall die.
text_la: Cur ergo moriemur, et devorabit nos ignis hic maximus? si enim audierimus ultra vocem Domini Dei nostri, moriemur.
text_pt: Agora, pois, por que morreríamos? Pois este grande fogo nos consumiria; se ainda mais ouvíssemos a voz do Senhor nosso Deus morreríamos.
text_el: καὶ νῦν μὴ ἀποθάνωμεν ὅτι ἐξαναλώσει ἡμᾶς τὸ πῦρ τὸ μέγα τοῦτο ἐὰν προσθώμεθα ἡμεῖς ἀκοῦσαι τὴν φωνὴν κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἔτι καὶ ἀποθανούμεθα

text_en: What is all flesh, that it should hear the voice of the living God , who speaks out of the midst of the fire, as we have heard, and be able to live?
text_la: Quid est omnis caro, ut audiat vocem Dei viventis, qui de medio ignis loquitur sicut nos audivimus, et possit vivere?
text_pt: Porque, quem há de toda a carne, que ouviu a voz do Deus vivente falando do meio do fogo, como nós, e ficou vivo?
text_el: τίς γὰρ σάρξ ἥτις ἤκουσεν φωνὴν θεοῦ ζῶντος λαλοῦντος ἐκ μέσου τοῦ πυρὸς ὡς ἡμεῖς καὶ ζήσεται

text_en: Approach rather: and hear all things that the Lord our God shall say to you, and you shall speak to us, and we will hear and will do them.
text_la: Tu magis accede : et audi cuncta quæ dixerit Dominus Deus noster tibi : loquerisque ad nos, et nos audientes faciemus ea.
text_pt: Chega-te tu, e ouve tudo o que disser o Senhor nosso Deus; e tu nos dirás tudo o que te disser o Senhor nosso Deus, e o ouviremos, e o cumpriremos.
text_el: πρόσελθε σὺ καὶ ἄκουσον ὅσα ἐὰν εἴπῃ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν καὶ σὺ λαλήσεις πρὸς ἡμᾶς πάντα ὅσα ἂν λαλήσῃ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν πρὸς σέ καὶ ἀκουσόμεθα καὶ ποιήσομεν

text_en: And when the Lord had heard this, he said to me: I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they spoke to you: they have spoken all things well.
text_la: Quod cum audisset Dominus, ait ad me : Audivi vocem verborum populi hujus quæ locuti sunt tibi : bene omnia sunt locuti.
text_pt: Ouvindo, pois, o Senhor as vossas palavras, quando me faláveis, o Senhor me disse: Eu ouvi as palavras deste povo, que eles te disseram; em tudo falaram bem.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν κύριος τὴν φωνὴν τῶν λόγων ὑμῶν λαλούντων πρός με καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με ἤκουσα τὴν φωνὴν τῶν λόγων τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου ὅσα ἐλάλησαν πρὸς σέ ὀρθῶς πάντα ὅσα ἐλάλησαν

text_en: Who shall give them to have such a mind , to fear me, and to keep all my commandments at all times, that it may be well with them and with their children for ever?
text_la: Quis det talem eos habere mentem, ut timeant me, et custodiant universa mandata mea in omni tempore, ut bene sit eis et filiis eorum in sempiternum?
text_pt: Quem dera que eles tivessem tal coração que me temessem, e guardassem todos os meus mandamentos todos os dias, para que bem lhes fosse a eles e a seus filhos para sempre.
text_el: τίς δώσει οὕτως εἶναι τὴν καρδίαν αὐτῶν ἐν αὐτοῖς ὥστε φοβεῖσθαί με καὶ φυλάσσεσθαι τὰς ἐντολάς μου πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ἵνα εὖ ᾖ αὐτοῖς καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτῶν δι' αἰῶνος

text_en: Go and say to them: Return into your tents.
text_la: Vade et dic eis : Revertimini in tentoria vestra.
text_pt: Vai, dize-lhes: Tornai-vos às vossas tendas.
text_el: βάδισον εἰπὸν αὐτοῖς ἀποστράφητε ὑμεῖς εἰς τοὺς οἴκους ὑμῶν

text_en: But stand here with me, and I will speak to you all my commandments , and ceremonies and judgments: which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land, which I will give them for a possession.
text_la: Tu vero hic sta mecum, et loquar tibi omnia mandata mea, et cæremonias atque judicia : quæ docebis eos, ut faciant ea in terra, quam dabo illis in possessionem.
text_pt: Tu, porém, fica-te aqui comigo, para que eu a ti te diga todos os mandamentos, e estatutos, e juízos, que tu lhes hás de ensinar, para que cumpram na terra que eu lhes darei para possuí-la.
text_el: σὺ δὲ αὐτοῦ στῆθι μετ' ἐμοῦ καὶ λαλήσω πρὸς σὲ τὰς ἐντολὰς καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα καὶ τὰ κρίματα ὅσα διδάξεις αὐτούς καὶ ποιείτωσαν ἐν τῇ γῇ ἣν ἐγὼ δίδωμι αὐτοῖς ἐν κλήρῳ

text_en: Keep therefore and do the things which the Lord God has commanded you: you shall not go aside neither to the right hand, nor to the left.
text_la: Custodite igitur et facite quæ præcepit Dominus Deus vobis : non declinabitis neque ad dexteram, neque ad sinistram:
text_pt: Olhai, pois, que façais como vos mandou o Senhor vosso Deus; não vos desviareis, nem para a direita nem para a esquerda.
text_el: καὶ φυλάξεσθε ποιεῖν ὃν τρόπον ἐνετείλατό σοι κύριος ὁ θεός σου οὐκ ἐκκλινεῖτε εἰς δεξιὰ οὐδὲ εἰς ἀριστερὰ

text_en: But you shall walk in the way that the Lord your God has commanded, that you may live, and it may be well with you, and your days may be long in the land of your possession.
text_la: sed per viam, quam præcepit Dominus Deus vester, ambulabitis, ut vivatis, et bene sit vobis, et protelentur dies in terra possessionis vestræ.
text_pt: Andareis em todo o caminho que vos manda o Senhor vosso Deus, para que vivais e bem vos suceda, e prolongueis os dias na terra que haveis de possuir.
text_el: κατὰ πᾶσαν τὴν ὁδόν ἣν ἐνετείλατό σοι κύριος ὁ θεός σου πορεύεσθαι ἐν αὐτῇ ὅπως καταπαύσῃ σε καὶ εὖ σοι ᾖ καὶ μακροημερεύσητε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἧς κληρονομήσετε

text_en: These are the precepts , and ceremonies , and judgments, which the Lord your God commanded that I should teach you, and that you should do them in the land into which you pass over to possess it:
text_la: Hæc sunt præcepta, et cæremoniæ, atque judicia, quæ mandavit Dominus Deus vester ut docerem vos, et faciatis ea in terra, ad quam transgredimini possidendam:
text_pt: Estes, pois, são os mandamentos, os estatutos e os juízos que mandou o SENHOR vosso Deus para ensinar-vos, para que os cumprísseis na terra a que passais a possuir;
text_el: καὶ αὗται αἱ ἐντολαὶ καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα καὶ τὰ κρίματα ὅσα ἐνετείλατο κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν διδάξαι ὑμᾶς ποιεῖν οὕτως ἐν τῇ γῇ εἰς ἣν ὑμεῖς εἰσπορεύεσθε ἐκεῖ κληρονομῆσαι αὐτήν

text_en: That you may fear the Lord your God , and keep all his commandments and precepts , which I command you, and your sons, and your grandsons, all the days of your life, that your days may be prolonged.
text_la: ut timeas Dominum Deum tuum, et custodias omnia mandata et præcepta ejus, quæ ego præcipio tibi, et filiis, ac nepotibus tuis, cunctis diebus vitæ tuæ, ut prolongentur dies tui.
text_pt: Para que temas ao Senhor teu Deus, e guardes todos os seus estatutos e mandamentos, que eu te ordeno, tu, e teu filho, e o filho de teu filho, todos os dias da tua vida, e que teus dias sejam prolongados.
text_el: ἵνα φοβῆσθε κύριον τὸν θεὸν ὑμῶν φυλάσσεσθαι πάντα τὰ δικαιώματα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ὅσας ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον σὺ καὶ οἱ υἱοί σου καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν υἱῶν σου πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς σου ἵνα μακροημερεύσητε

text_en: Hear, O Israel , and observe to do the things which the Lord has commanded you, that it may be well with you, and you may be greatly multiplied, as the Lord the God of your fathers has promised you a land flowing with milk and honey.
text_la: Audi, Israël, et observa ut facias quæ præcepit tibi Dominus, et bene sit tibi, et multipliceris amplius, sicut pollicitus est Dominus Deus patrum tuorum tibi terram lacte et melle manantem.
text_pt: Ouve, pois, ó Israel, e atenta em os guardares, para que bem te suceda, e muito te multipliques, como te disse o Senhor Deus de teus pais, na terra que mana leite e mel.
text_el: καὶ ἄκουσον Ισραηλ καὶ φύλαξαι ποιεῖν ὅπως εὖ σοι ᾖ καὶ ἵνα πληθυνθῆτε σφόδρα καθάπερ ἐλάλησεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων σου δοῦναί σοι γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι

text_en: Hear, O Israel , the Lord our God is one Lord .
text_la: Audi, Israël : Dominus Deus noster, Dominus unus est.
text_pt: Ouve, Israel, o Senhor nosso Deus é o único Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ δικαιώματα καὶ τὰ κρίματα ὅσα ἐνετείλατο κύριος τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἐξελθόντων αὐτῶν ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ἄκουε Ισραηλ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν κύριος εἷς ἐστιν

text_en: You shall love the Lord your God with your whole heart, and with your whole soul , and with your whole strength.
text_la: Diliges Dominum Deum tuum ex toto corde tuo, et ex tota anima tua, et ex tota fortitudine tua.
text_pt: Amarás, pois, o Senhor teu Deus de todo o teu coração, e de toda a tua alma, e de todas as tuas forças.
text_el: καὶ ἀγαπήσεις κύριον τὸν θεόν σου ἐξ ὅλης τῆς καρδίας σου καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς ψυχῆς σου καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς δυνάμεώς σου

text_en: And these words which I command you this day, shall be in your heart:
text_la: Eruntque verba hæc, quæ ego præcipio tibi hodie, in corde tuo:
text_pt: E estas palavras, que hoje te ordeno, estarão no teu coração;
text_el: καὶ ἔσται τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα ὅσα ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ σου καὶ ἐν τῇ ψυχῇ σου

text_en: And you shall tell them to your children, and you shall meditate upon them sitting in your house, and walking on your journey, sleeping and rising.
text_la: et narrabis ea filiis tuis, et meditaberis in eis sedens in domo tua, et ambulans in itinere, dormiens atque consurgens.
text_pt: E as ensinarás a teus filhos e delas falarás assentado em tua casa, e andando pelo caminho, e deitando-te e levantando-te.
text_el: καὶ προβιβάσεις αὐτὰ τοὺς υἱούς σου καὶ λαλήσεις ἐν αὐτοῖς καθήμενος ἐν οἴκῳ καὶ πορευόμενος ἐν ὁδῷ καὶ κοιταζόμενος καὶ διανιστάμενος

text_en: And you shall bind them as a sign on your hand, and they shall be and shall move between your eyes.
text_la: Et ligabis ea quasi signum in manu tua, eruntque et movebuntur inter oculos tuos,
text_pt: Também as atarás por sinal na tua mão, e te serão por frontais entre os teus olhos.
text_el: καὶ ἀφάψεις αὐτὰ εἰς σημεῖον ἐπὶ τῆς χειρός σου καὶ ἔσται ἀσάλευτον πρὸ ὀφθαλμῶν σου

text_en: And you shall write them in the entry, and on the doors of your house.
text_la: scribesque ea in limine, et ostiis domus tuæ.
text_pt: E as escreverás nos umbrais de tua casa, e nas tuas portas.
text_el: καὶ γράψετε αὐτὰ ἐπὶ τὰς φλιὰς τῶν οἰκιῶν ὑμῶν καὶ τῶν πυλῶν ὑμῶν

text_en: And when the Lord your God shall have brought you into the land, for which he swore to your fathers Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob : and shall have given you great and goodly cities, which you did not build,
text_la: Cumque introduxerit te Dominus Deus tuus in terram, pro qua juravit patribus tuis Abraham, Isaac, et Jacob, et dederit tibi civitates magnas et optimas, quas non ædificasti,
text_pt: Quando, pois, o Senhor teu Deus te introduzir na terra que jurou a teus pais, Abraão, Isaque e Jacó, que te daria, com grandes e boas cidades, que tu não edificaste,
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὅταν εἰσαγάγῃ σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ὤμοσεν τοῖς πατράσιν σου τῷ Αβρααμ καὶ Ισαακ καὶ Ιακωβ δοῦναί σοι πόλεις μεγάλας καὶ καλάς ἃς οὐκ ᾠκοδόμησας

text_en: houses full of riches, which you did not set up, cisterns which you did not dig, vineyards and oliveyards, which you did not plant,
text_la: domos plenas cunctarum opum, quas non exstruxisti, cisternas, quas non fodisti, vineta et oliveta, quæ non plantasti,
text_pt: E casas cheias de todo o bem, que tu não encheste, e poços cavados, que tu não cavaste, vinhas e olivais, que tu não plantaste, e comeres, e te fartares,
text_el: οἰκίας πλήρεις πάντων ἀγαθῶν ἃς οὐκ ἐνέπλησας λάκκους λελατομημένους οὓς οὐκ ἐξελατόμησας ἀμπελῶνας καὶ ἐλαιῶνας οὓς οὐ κατεφύτευσας καὶ φαγὼν καὶ ἐμπλησθεὶς

text_en: and you shall have eaten and be full:
text_la: et comederis, et saturatus fueris:
text_pt: Guarda-te, que não te esqueças do Senhor, que te tirou da terra do Egito, da casa da servidão.
text_el: πρόσεχε σεαυτῷ μὴ ἐπιλάθῃ κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου τοῦ ἐξαγαγόντος σε ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ἐξ οἴκου δουλείας

text_en: Take heed diligently lest you forget the Lord , who brought you out of the land of Egypt , out of the house of bondage . You shall fear the Lord your God , and shall serve him only, and you shall swear by his name .
text_la: cave diligenter ne obliviscaris Domini, qui eduxit te de terra Ægypti, de domo servitutis. Dominum Deum tuum timebis, et illi soli servies, ac per nomen illius jurabis.
text_pt: O Senhor teu Deus temerás e a ele servirás, e pelo seu nome jurarás.
text_el: κύριον τὸν θεόν σου φοβηθήσῃ καὶ αὐτῷ λατρεύσεις καὶ πρὸς αὐτὸν κολληθήσῃ καὶ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ ὀμῇ

text_en: You shall not go after the strange gods of all the nations , that are round about you:
text_la: Non ibitis post deos alienos cunctarum gentium, quæ in circuitu vestro sunt:
text_pt: Não seguireis outros deuses, os deuses dos povos que houver ao redor de vós;
text_el: οὐ πορεύσεσθε ὀπίσω θεῶν ἑτέρων ἀπὸ τῶν θεῶν τῶν ἐθνῶν τῶν περικύκλῳ ὑμῶν

text_en: Because the Lord your God is a jealous God in the midst of you: lest at any time the wrath of the Lord your God be kindled against you, and take you away from the face of the earth.
text_la: quoniam Deus æmulator Dominus Deus tuus in medio tui : nequando irascatur furor Domini Dei tui contra te, et auferat te de superficie terræ.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor teu Deus é um Deus zeloso no meio de ti, para que a ira do Senhor teu Deus se não acenda contra ti e te destrua de sobre a face da terra.
text_el: ὅτι θεὸς ζηλωτὴς κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐν σοί μὴ ὀργισθεὶς θυμωθῇ κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐν σοὶ καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσῃ σε ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς γῆς

text_en: You shall not tempt the Lord your God , as you tempted him in the place of temptation.
text_la: Non tentabis Dominum Deum tuum, sicut tentasti in loco tentationis.
text_pt: Não tentareis o Senhor vosso Deus, como o tentastes em Massá;
text_el: οὐκ ἐκπειράσεις κύριον τὸν θεόν σου ὃν τρόπον ἐξεπειράσασθε ἐν τῷ Πειρασμῷ

text_en: Keep the precepts of the Lord your God , and the testimonies and ceremonies which he has commanded you.
text_la: Custodi præcepta Domini Dei tui, ac testimonia et cæremonias, quas præcepit tibi:
text_pt: Diligentemente guardareis os mandamentos do Senhor vosso Deus, como também os seus testemunhos, e seus estatutos, que te tem mandado.
text_el: φυλάσσων φυλάξῃ τὰς ἐντολὰς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου τὰ μαρτύρια καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα ὅσα ἐνετείλατό σοι

text_en: And do that which is pleasing and good in the sight of the Lord , that it may be well with you: and going in you may possess the goodly land, concerning which the Lord swore to your fathers,
text_la: et fac quod placitum est et bonum in conspectu Domini, ut bene sit tibi : et ingressus possideas terram optimam, de qua juravit Dominus patribus tuis,
text_pt: E farás o que é reto e bom aos olhos do Senhor, para que bem te suceda, e entres, e possuas a boa terra, a qual o Senhor jurou dar a teus pais.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις τὸ ἀρεστὸν καὶ τὸ καλὸν ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν ἵνα εὖ σοι γένηται καὶ εἰσέλθῃς καὶ κληρονομήσῃς τὴν γῆν τὴν ἀγαθήν ἣν ὤμοσεν κύριος τοῖς πατράσιν ὑμῶν

text_en: that he would destroy all your enemies before you, as he has spoken.
text_la: ut deleret omnes inimicos tuos coram te, sicut locutus est.
text_pt: Para que lance fora a todos os teus inimigos de diante de ti, como o Senhor tem falado.
text_el: ἐκδιῶξαι πάντας τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου πρὸ προσώπου σου καθὰ ἐλάλησεν

text_en: And when your son shall ask you tomorrow, saying: What mean these testimonies, and ceremonies and judgments, which the Lord our God has commanded us?
text_la: Cumque interrogaverit te filius tuus cras, dicens : Quid sibi volunt testimonia hæc, et cæremoniæ, atque judicia, quæ præcepit Dominus Deus noster nobis?
text_pt: Quando teu filho te perguntar no futuro, dizendo: Que significam os testemunhos, e estatutos e juízos que o Senhor nosso Deus vos ordenou?
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὅταν ἐρωτήσῃ σε ὁ υἱός σου αὔριον λέγων τί ἐστιν τὰ μαρτύρια καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα καὶ τὰ κρίματα ὅσα ἐνετείλατο κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ἡμῖν

text_en: You shall say to him: We were bondmen of Pharao in Egypt , and the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a strong hand.
text_la: dices ei : Servi eramus Pharaonis in Ægypto, et eduxit nos Dominus de Ægypto in manu forti:
text_pt: Então dirás a teu filho: Éramos servos de Faraó no Egito; porém o Senhor, com mão forte, nos tirou do Egito;
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς τῷ υἱῷ σου οἰκέται ἦμεν τῷ Φαραω ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ ἐξήγαγεν ἡμᾶς κύριος ἐκεῖθεν ἐν χειρὶ κραταιᾷ καὶ ἐν βραχίονι ὑψηλῷ

text_en: And he wrought signs and wonders great and very grievous in Egypt against Pharao , and all his house, in our sight,
text_la: fecitque signa atque prodigia magna et pessima in Ægypto contra Pharaonem, et omnem domum illius in conspectu nostro,
text_pt: E o Senhor, aos nossos olhos, fez sinais e maravilhas, grandes e terríveis, contra o Egito, contra Faraó e toda sua casa;
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν κύριος σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα μεγάλα καὶ πονηρὰ ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ ἐν Φαραω καὶ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ ἐνώπιον ἡμῶν

text_en: and he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in and give us the land, concerning which he swore to our fathers.
text_la: et eduxit nos inde, ut introductis daret terram, super qua juravit patribus nostris.
text_pt: E dali nos tirou, para nos levar, e nos dar a terra que jurara a nossos pais.
text_el: καὶ ἡμᾶς ἐξήγαγεν ἐκεῖθεν ἵνα εἰσαγάγῃ ἡμᾶς δοῦναι ἡμῖν τὴν γῆν ταύτην ἣν ὤμοσεν δοῦναι τοῖς πατράσιν ἡμῶν

text_en: And the Lord commanded that we should do all these ordinances, and should fear the Lord our God , that it might be well with us all the days of our life, as it is at this day.
text_la: Præcepitque nobis Dominus ut faciamus omnia legitima hæc, et timeamus Dominum Deum nostrum, ut bene sit nobis cunctis diebus vitæ nostræ, sicut est hodie.
text_pt: E o Senhor nos ordenou que cumpríssemos todos estes estatutos, que temêssemos ao Senhor nosso Deus, para o nosso perpétuo bem, para nos guardar em vida, como no dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο ἡμῖν κύριος ποιεῖν πάντα τὰ δικαιώματα ταῦτα φοβεῖσθαι κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν ἵνα εὖ ᾖ ἡμῖν πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ἵνα ζῶμεν ὥσπερ καὶ σήμερον

text_en: And he will be merciful to us, if we keep and do all his precepts before the Lord our God , as he has commanded us.
text_la: Eritque nostri misericors, si custodierimus et fecerimus omnia præcepta ejus coram Domino Deo nostro, sicut mandavit nobis.
text_pt: E será para nós justiça, quando tivermos cuidado de cumprir todos estes mandamentos perante o Senhor nosso Deus, como nos tem ordenado.
text_el: καὶ ἐλεημοσύνη ἔσται ἡμῖν ἐὰν φυλασσώμεθα ποιεῖν πάσας τὰς ἐντολὰς ταύτας ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν καθὰ ἐνετείλατο ἡμῖν κύριος

text_en: When the Lord your God shall have brought you into the land, which you are going in to possess, and shall have destroyed many nations before you, the Hethite , and the Gergezite, and the Amorrhite , and the Chanaanite , and the Pherezite, and the Hevite, and the Jebusite, seven nations much more numerous than you are, and stronger than you:
text_la: Cum introduxerit te Dominus Deus tuus in terram, quam possessurus ingredieris, et deleverit gentes multas coram te, Hethæum, et Gergezæum, et Amorrhæum, Chananæum, et Pherezæum, et Hevæum, et Jebusæum, septem gentes multo majoris numeri quam tu es, et robustiores te:
text_pt: Quando o SENHOR teu Deus te houver introduzido na terra, à qual vais para a possuir, e tiver lançado fora muitas nações de diante de ti, os heteus, e os girgaseus, e os amorreus, e os cananeus, e os perizeus, e os heveus, e os jebuseus, sete nações mais numerosas e mais poderosas do que tu;
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ εἰσαγάγῃ σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου εἰς τὴν γῆν εἰς ἣν εἰσπορεύῃ ἐκεῖ κληρονομῆσαι καὶ ἐξαρεῖ ἔθνη μεγάλα ἀπὸ προσώπου σου τὸν Χετταῖον καὶ Γεργεσαῖον καὶ Αμορραῖον καὶ Χαναναῖον καὶ Φερεζαῖον καὶ Ευαῖον καὶ Ιεβουσαῖον ἑπτὰ ἔθνη πολλὰ καὶ ἰσχυρότερα ὑμῶν

text_en: And the Lord your God shall have delivered them to you, you shall utterly destroy them. You shall make no league with them, nor show mercy to them:
text_la: tradideritque eas Dominus Deus tuus tibi, percuties eas usque ad internecionem. Non inibis cum eis fœdus, nec misereberis earum,
text_pt: E o Senhor teu Deus as tiver dado diante de ti, para as ferir, totalmente as destruirás; não farás com elas aliança, nem terás piedade delas;
text_el: καὶ παραδώσει αὐτοὺς κύριος ὁ θεός σου εἰς τὰς χεῖράς σου καὶ πατάξεις αὐτούς ἀφανισμῷ ἀφανιεῖς αὐτούς οὐ διαθήσῃ πρὸς αὐτοὺς διαθήκην οὐδὲ μὴ ἐλεήσητε αὐτούς

text_en: Neither shall you make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor take his daughter for your son:
text_la: neque sociabis cum eis conjugia. Filiam tuam non dabis filio ejus, nec filiam illius accipies filio tuo:
text_pt: Nem te aparentarás com elas; não darás tuas filhas a seus filhos, e não tomarás suas filhas para teus filhos;
text_el: οὐδὲ μὴ γαμβρεύσητε πρὸς αὐτούς τὴν θυγατέρα σου οὐ δώσεις τῷ υἱῷ αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν θυγατέρα αὐτοῦ οὐ λήμψῃ τῷ υἱῷ σου

text_en: For she will turn away your son from following me, that he may rather serve strange gods , and the wrath of the Lord will be kindled, and will quickly destroy you.
text_la: quia seducet filium tuum, ne sequatur me, et ut magis serviat diis alienis : irasceturque furor Domini, et delebit te cito.
text_pt: Pois fariam desviar teus filhos de mim, para que servissem a outros deuses; e a ira do Senhor se acenderia contra vós, e depressa vos consumiria.
text_el: ἀποστήσει γὰρ τὸν υἱόν σου ἀπ' ἐμοῦ καὶ λατρεύσει θεοῖς ἑτέροις καὶ ὀργισθήσεται θυμῷ κύριος εἰς ὑμᾶς καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσει σε τὸ τάχος

text_en: But thus rather shall you deal with them: Destroy their altars , and break their statues , and cut down their groves, and burn their graven things .
text_la: Quin potius hæc facietis eis : aras eorum subvertite, et confringite statuas, lucosque succidite, et sculptilia comburite:
text_pt: Porém assim lhes fareis: Derrubareis os seus altares, quebrareis as suas estátuas; e cortareis os seus bosques, e queimareis a fogo as suas imagens de escultura.
text_el: ἀλλ' οὕτως ποιήσετε αὐτοῖς τοὺς βωμοὺς αὐτῶν καθελεῖτε καὶ τὰς στήλας αὐτῶν συντρίψετε καὶ τὰ ἄλση αὐτῶν ἐκκόψετε καὶ τὰ γλυπτὰ τῶν θεῶν αὐτῶν κατακαύσετε πυρί

text_en: Because you are a holy people to the Lord your God . The Lord your God has chosen you, to be his peculiar people of all peoples that are upon the earth.
text_la: quia populus sanctus es Domino Deo tuo. Te elegit Dominus Deus tuus, ut sis ei populus peculiaris de cunctis populis, qui sunt super terram.
text_pt: Porque povo santo és ao Senhor teu Deus; o Senhor teu Deus te escolheu, para que lhe fosses o seu povo especial, de todos os povos que há sobre a terra.
text_el: ὅτι λαὸς ἅγιος εἶ κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σου καὶ σὲ προείλατο κύριος ὁ θεός σου εἶναί σε αὐτῷ λαὸν περιούσιον παρὰ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ὅσα ἐπὶ προσώπου τῆς γῆς

text_en: Not because you surpass all nations in number, is the Lord joined unto you, and has chosen you, for you are the fewest of any people:
text_la: Non quia cunctas gentes numero vincebatis, vobis junctus est Dominus, et elegit vos, cum omnibus sitis populis pauciores:
text_pt: O Senhor não tomou prazer em vós, nem vos escolheu, porque a vossa multidão era mais do que a de todos os outros povos, pois vós éreis menos em número do que todos os povos;
text_el: οὐχ ὅτι πολυπληθεῖτε παρὰ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη προείλατο κύριος ὑμᾶς καὶ ἐξελέξατο ὑμᾶς ὑμεῖς γάρ ἐστε ὀλιγοστοὶ παρὰ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη

text_en: But because the Lord has loved you, and has kept his oath , which he swore to your fathers: and has brought you out with a strong hand, and redeemed you from the house of bondage , out of the hand of Pharao the king of Egypt .
text_la: sed quia dilexit vos Dominus, et custodivit juramentum, quod juravit patribus vestris : eduxitque vos in manu forti, et redemit de domo servitutis, de manu Pharaonis regis Ægypti.
text_pt: Mas, porque o Senhor vos amava, e para guardar o juramento que fizera a vossos pais, o Senhor vos tirou com mão forte e vos resgatou da casa da servidão, da mão de Faraó, rei do Egito.
text_el: ἀλλὰ παρὰ τὸ ἀγαπᾶν κύριον ὑμᾶς καὶ διατηρῶν τὸν ὅρκον ὃν ὤμοσεν τοῖς πατράσιν ὑμῶν ἐξήγαγεν κύριος ὑμᾶς ἐν χειρὶ κραταιᾷ καὶ ἐν βραχίονι ὑψηλῷ καὶ ἐλυτρώσατο ἐξ οἴκου δουλείας ἐκ χειρὸς Φαραω βασιλέως Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And you shall know that the Lord your God , he is a strong and faithful God , keeping his covenant and mercy to them that love him, and to them that keep his commandments , unto a thousand generations :
text_la: Et scies, quia Dominus Deus tuus, ipse est Deus fortis et fidelis, custodiens pactum et misericordiam diligentibus se, et his qui custodiunt præcepta ejus in mille generationes:
text_pt: Saberás, pois, que o Senhor teu Deus, ele é Deus, o Deus fiel, que guarda a aliança e a misericórdia até mil gerações aos que o amam e guardam os seus mandamentos.
text_el: καὶ γνώσῃ ὅτι κύριος ὁ θεός σου οὗτος θεός θεὸς πιστός ὁ φυλάσσων διαθήκην καὶ ἔλεος τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν αὐτὸν καὶ τοῖς φυλάσσουσιν τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ εἰς χιλίας γενεὰς

text_en: And repaying forthwith them that hate him, so as to destroy them, without further delay immediately rendering to them what they deserve.
text_la: et reddens odientibus se statim, ita ut disperdat eos, et ultra non differat, protinus eis restituens quod merentur.
text_pt: E retribui no rosto qualquer dos que o odeiam, fazendo-o perecer; não será tardio ao que o odeia; em seu rosto lho pagará.
text_el: καὶ ἀποδιδοὺς τοῖς μισοῦσιν κατὰ πρόσωπον ἐξολεθρεῦσαι αὐτούς καὶ οὐχὶ βραδυνεῖ τοῖς μισοῦσιν κατὰ πρόσωπον ἀποδώσει αὐτοῖς

text_en: Keep therefore the precepts and ceremonies and judgments, which I command you this day to do.
text_la: Custodi ergo præcepta et cæremonias atque judicia, quæ ego mando tibi hodie ut facias.
text_pt: Guarda, pois, os mandamentos e os estatutos e os juízos que hoje te mando cumprir.
text_el: καὶ φυλάξῃ τὰς ἐντολὰς καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα καὶ τὰ κρίματα ταῦτα ὅσα ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον ποιεῖν

text_en: If after you have heard these judgments, you keep and do them, the Lord your God will also keep his covenant to you, and the mercy which he swore to your fathers:
text_la: Si postquam audieris hæc judicia, custodieris ea, et feceris, custodiet et Dominus Deus tuus pactum tibi, et misericordiam quam juravit patribus tuis:
text_pt: Será, pois, que, se ouvindo estes juízos, os guardardes e cumprirdes, o Senhor teu Deus te guardará a aliança e a misericórdia que jurou a teus pais;
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἡνίκα ἂν ἀκούσητε πάντα τὰ δικαιώματα ταῦτα καὶ φυλάξητε καὶ ποιήσητε αὐτά καὶ διαφυλάξει κύριος ὁ θεός σού σοι τὴν διαθήκην καὶ τὸ ἔλεος ὃ ὤμοσεν τοῖς πατράσιν ὑμῶν

text_en: And he will love you and multiply you, and will bless the fruit of your womb, and the fruit of your land, your corn, and your vintage, your oil, and your herds, and the flocks of your sheep upon the land, for which he swore to your fathers that he would give it you.
text_la: et diliget te, ac multiplicabit, benedicetque fructui ventris tui, et fructui terræ tuæ, frumento tuo, atque vindemiæ, oleo, et armentis, gregibus ovium tuarum super terram, pro qua juravit patribus tuis ut daret eam tibi.
text_pt: E amar-te-á, e abençoar-te-á, e te fará multiplicar; abençoará o fruto do teu ventre, e o fruto da tua terra, o teu grão, e o teu mosto, e o teu azeite, e a criação das tuas vacas, e o rebanho do teu gado miúdo, na terra que jurou a teus pais dar-te.
text_el: καὶ ἀγαπήσει σε καὶ εὐλογήσει σε καὶ πληθυνεῖ σε καὶ εὐλογήσει τὰ ἔκγονα τῆς κοιλίας σου καὶ τὸν καρπὸν τῆς γῆς σου τὸν σῖτόν σου καὶ τὸν οἶνόν σου καὶ τὸ ἔλαιόν σου τὰ βουκόλια τῶν βοῶν σου καὶ τὰ ποίμνια τῶν προβάτων σου ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἧς ὤμοσεν κύριος τοῖς πατράσιν σου δοῦναί σοι

text_en: Blessed shall you be among all people. No one shall be barren among you of either sex, neither of men nor cattle.
text_la: Benedictus eris inter omnes populos. Non erit apud te sterilis utriusque sexus, tam in hominibus quam in gregibus tuis.
text_pt: Bendito serás mais do que todos os povos; não haverá estéril entre ti, seja homem, seja mulher, nem entre os teus animais.
text_el: εὐλογητὸς ἔσῃ παρὰ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη οὐκ ἔσται ἐν ὑμῖν ἄγονος οὐδὲ στεῖρα καὶ ἐν τοῖς κτήνεσίν σου

text_en: The Lord will take away from you all sickness: and the grievous infirmities of Egypt , which you know , he will not bring upon you, but upon your enemies.
text_la: Auferet Dominus a te omnem languorem : et infirmitates Ægypti pessimas, quas novisti, non inferet tibi, sed cunctis hostibus tuis.
text_pt: E o Senhor de ti desviará toda a enfermidade; sobre ti não porá nenhuma das más doenças dos egípcios, que bem sabes, antes as porá sobre todos os que te odeiam.
text_el: καὶ περιελεῖ κύριος ἀπὸ σοῦ πᾶσαν μαλακίαν καὶ πάσας νόσους Αἰγύπτου τὰς πονηράς ἃς ἑώρακας καὶ ὅσα ἔγνως οὐκ ἐπιθήσει ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ ἐπιθήσει αὐτὰ ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς μισοῦντάς σε

text_en: You shall consume all the people, which the Lord your God will deliver to you. Your eye shall not spare them, neither shall you serve their gods , lest they be your ruin.
text_la: Devorabis omnes populos, quos Dominus Deus tuus daturus est tibi. Non parcet eis oculus tuus, nec servies diis eorum, ne sint in ruinam tui.
text_pt: Pois consumirás a todos os povos que te der o Senhor teu Deus; os teus olhos não os poupará; e não servirás a seus deuses, pois isto te seria por laço.
text_el: καὶ φάγῃ πάντα τὰ σκῦλα τῶν ἐθνῶν ἃ κύριος ὁ θεός σου δίδωσίν σοι οὐ φείσεται ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου ἐπ' αὐτοῖς καὶ οὐ λατρεύσεις τοῖς θεοῖς αὐτῶν ὅτι σκῶλον τοῦτό ἐστίν σοι

text_en: If you say in your heart: These nations are more than I, how shall I be able to destroy them?
text_la: Si dixeris in corde tuo : Plures sunt gentes istæ quam ego : quomodo potero delere eas?
text_pt: Se disseres no teu coração: Estas nações são mais numerosas do que eu; como as poderei lançar fora?
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ λέγῃς ἐν τῇ διανοίᾳ σου ὅτι πολὺ τὸ ἔθνος τοῦτο ἢ ἐγώ πῶς δυνήσομαι ἐξολεθρεῦσαι αὐτούς

text_en: Fear not, but remember what the Lord your God did to Pharao and to all the Egyptians ,
text_la: noli metuere, sed recordare quæ fecerit Dominus Deus tuus Pharaoni, et cunctis Ægyptiis,
text_pt: Delas não tenhas temor; não deixes de te lembrar do que o Senhor teu Deus fez a Faraó e a todos os egípcios;
text_el: οὐ φοβηθήσῃ αὐτούς μνείᾳ μνησθήσῃ ὅσα ἐποίησεν κύριος ὁ θεός σου τῷ Φαραω καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς Αἰγυπτίοις

text_en: the exceeding great plagues , which your eyes saw, and the signs and wonders , and the strong hand, and the stretched out arm, with which the Lord your God brought you out: so will he do to all the people, whom you fear.
text_la: plagas maximas, quas viderunt oculi tui, et signa atque portenta, manumque robustam, et extentum brachium, ut educeret te Dominus Deus tuus : sic faciet cunctis populis, quos metuis.
text_pt: Das grandes provas que viram os teus olhos, e dos sinais, e maravilhas, e mão forte, e braço estendido, com que o Senhor teu Deus te tirou; assim fará o Senhor teu Deus com todos os povos, diante dos quais tu temes.
text_el: τοὺς πειρασμοὺς τοὺς μεγάλους οὓς εἴδοσαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοί σου τὰ σημεῖα καὶ τὰ τέρατα τὰ μεγάλα ἐκεῖνα τὴν χεῖρα τὴν κραταιὰν καὶ τὸν βραχίονα τὸν ὑψηλόν ὡς ἐξήγαγέν σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου οὕτως ποιήσει κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν οὓς σὺ φοβῇ ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν

text_en: Moreover the Lord your God will send also hornets among them, until he destroy and consume all that have escaped you, and could hide themselves.
text_la: Insuper et crabrones mittet Dominus Deus tuus in eos, donec deleat omnes atque disperdat qui te fugerint, et latere potuerint.
text_pt: E mais, o Senhor teu Deus entre eles mandará vespões, até que pereçam os que ficarem e se esconderem de diante de ti.
text_el: καὶ τὰς σφηκίας ἀποστελεῖ κύριος ὁ θεός σου εἰς αὐτούς ἕως ἂν ἐκτριβῶσιν οἱ καταλελειμμένοι καὶ οἱ κεκρυμμένοι ἀπὸ σοῦ

text_en: You shall not fear them, because the Lord your God is in the midst of you, a God mighty and terrible:
text_la: Non timebis eos, quia Dominus Deus tuus in medio tui est, Deus magnus et terribilis:
text_pt: Não te espantes diante deles; porque o Senhor teu Deus está no meio de ti, Deus grande e terrível.
text_el: οὐ τρωθήσῃ ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν ὅτι κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐν σοί θεὸς μέγας καὶ κραταιός

text_en: He will consume these nations in your sight by little and little and by degrees. You will not be able to destroy them altogether: lest perhaps the beasts of the earth should increase upon you.
text_la: ipse consumet nationes has in conspectu tuo paulatim atque per partes. Non poteris eas delere pariter : ne forte multiplicentur contra te bestiæ terræ.
text_pt: E o Senhor teu Deus lançará fora estas nações pouco a pouco de diante de ti; não poderás destruí-las todas de pronto, para que as feras do campo não se multipliquem contra ti.
text_el: καὶ καταναλώσει κύριος ὁ θεός σου τὰ ἔθνη ταῦτα ἀπὸ προσώπου σου κατὰ μικρὸν μικρόν οὐ δυνήσῃ ἐξαναλῶσαι αὐτοὺς τὸ τάχος ἵνα μὴ γένηται ἡ γῆ ἔρημος καὶ πληθυνθῇ ἐπὶ σὲ τὰ θηρία τὰ ἄγρια

text_en: But the Lord your God shall deliver them in your sight: and shall slay them until they be utterly destroyed.
text_la: Dabitque eos Dominus Deus tuus in conspectu tuo : et interficiet illos, donec penitus deleantur.
text_pt: E o Senhor teu Deus as entregará a ti, e lhes infligirá uma grande confusão até que sejam consumidas.
text_el: καὶ παραδώσει αὐτοὺς κύριος ὁ θεός σου εἰς τὰς χεῖράς σου καὶ ἀπολέσει αὐτοὺς ἀπωλείᾳ μεγάλῃ ἕως ἂν ἐξολεθρεύσῃ αὐτούς

text_en: And he shall deliver their kings into your hands, and you shall destroy their names from under Heaven : no man shall be able to resist you, until you destroy them.
text_la: Tradetque reges eorum in manus tuas, et disperdes nomina eorum sub cælo : nullus poterit resistere tibi, donec conteras eos.
text_pt: Também os seus reis te entregará na mão, para que apagues os seus nomes de debaixo dos céus; nenhum homem resistirá diante de ti, até que os destruas.
text_el: καὶ παραδώσει τοὺς βασιλεῖς αὐτῶν εἰς τὰς χεῖρας ὑμῶν καὶ ἀπολεῖται τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῶν ἐκ τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου οὐκ ἀντιστήσεται οὐδεὶς κατὰ πρόσωπόν σου ἕως ἂν ἐξολεθρεύσῃς αὐτούς

text_en: Their graven things you shall burn with fire: you shall not covet the silver and gold of which they are made, neither shall you take to you anything thereof, lest you offend, because it is an abomination to the Lord your God .
text_la: Sculptilia eorum igne combures : non concupisces argentum et aurum, de quibus facta sunt, neque assumes ex eis tibi quidquam, ne offendas, propterea quia abominatio est Domini tui:
text_pt: As imagens de escultura de seus deuses queimarás a fogo; a prata e o ouro que estão sobre elas não cobiçarás, nem os tomarás para ti, para que não te enlaces neles; pois abominação é ao Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: τὰ γλυπτὰ τῶν θεῶν αὐτῶν κατακαύσετε πυρί οὐκ ἐπιθυμήσεις ἀργύριον οὐδὲ χρυσίον ἀπ' αὐτῶν καὶ οὐ λήμψῃ σεαυτῷ μὴ πταίσῃς δι' αὐτό ὅτι βδέλυγμα κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σού ἐστιν

text_en: Neither shall you bring anything of the idol into your house, lest you become an anathema , like it. You shall detest it as dung, and shall utterly abhor it as uncleanness and filth, because it is an anathema .
text_la: nec inferes quippiam ex idolo in domum tuam, ne fias anathema, sicut et illud est. Quasi spurcitiam detestaberis, et velut inquinamentum ac sordes abominationi habebis, quia anathema est.
text_pt: Não porás, pois, abominação em tua casa, para que não sejas anátema, assim como ela; de todo a detestarás, e de todo a abominarás, porque anátema é.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ εἰσοίσεις βδέλυγμα εἰς τὸν οἶκόν σου καὶ ἔσῃ ἀνάθημα ὥσπερ τοῦτο προσοχθίσματι προσοχθιεῖς καὶ βδελύγματι βδελύξῃ ὅτι ἀνάθημά ἐστιν

text_en: All the commandments , that I command you this day, take great care to observe: that you may live, and be multiplied, and going in may possess the land, for which the Lord swore to your fathers.
text_la: Omne mandatum, quod ego præcipio tibi hodie, cave diligenter ut facias, ut possitis vivere, et multiplicemini, ingressique possideatis terram, pro qua juravit Dominus patribus vestris.
text_pt: Todos os mandamentos que hoje vos ordeno guardareis para os cumprir; para que vivais, e vos multipliqueis, e entreis, e possuais a terra que o SENHOR jurou a vossos pais.
text_el: πάσας τὰς ἐντολάς ἃς ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαι ὑμῖν σήμερον φυλάξεσθε ποιεῖν ἵνα ζῆτε καὶ πολυπλασιασθῆτε καὶ εἰσέλθητε καὶ κληρονομήσητε τὴν γῆν ἣν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν ὤμοσεν τοῖς πατράσιν ὑμῶν

text_en: And you shall remember all the way through which the Lord your God has brought you for forty years through the desert , to afflict you and to prove you, and that the things that were known in your heart might be made known, whether you would keep his commandments or no.
text_la: Et recordaberis cuncti itineris, per quod adduxit te Dominus Deus tuus quadraginta annis per desertum, ut affligeret te, atque tentaret, et nota fierent quæ in tuo animo versabantur, utrum custodires mandata illius, an non.
text_pt: E te lembrarás de todo o caminho, pelo qual o Senhor teu Deus te guiou no deserto estes quarenta anos, para te humilhar, e te provar, para saber o que estava no teu coração, se guardarias os seus mandamentos, ou não.
text_el: καὶ μνησθήσῃ πᾶσαν τὴν ὁδόν ἣν ἤγαγέν σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ὅπως ἂν κακώσῃ σε καὶ ἐκπειράσῃ σε καὶ διαγνωσθῇ τὰ ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ σου εἰ φυλάξῃ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ἢ οὔ

text_en: He afflicted you with want , and gave you manna for your food, which neither you nor your fathers knew : to show that not in bread alone does man live, but in every word that proceeds from the mouth of God .
text_la: Afflixit te penuria, et dedit tibi cibum manna, quod ignorabas tu et patres tui : ut ostenderet tibi quod non in solo pane vivat homo, sed in omni verbo quod egreditur de ore Dei.
text_pt: E te humilhou, e te deixou ter fome, e te sustentou com o maná, que tu não conheceste, nem teus pais o conheceram; para te dar a entender que o homem não viverá só de pão, mas de tudo o que sai da boca do Senhor viverá o homem.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάκωσέν σε καὶ ἐλιμαγχόνησέν σε καὶ ἐψώμισέν σε τὸ μαννα ὃ οὐκ εἴδησαν οἱ πατέρες σου ἵνα ἀναγγείλῃ σοι ὅτι οὐκ ἐπ' ἄρτῳ μόνῳ ζήσεται ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἀλλ' ἐπὶ παντὶ ῥήματι τῷ ἐκπορευομένῳ διὰ στόματος θεοῦ ζήσεται ὁ ἄνθρωπος

text_en: Your raiment, with which you were covered, has not decayed for age, and your foot is not worn, lo this is the fortieth year,
text_la: Vestimentum tuum, quo operiebaris, nequaquam vetustate defecit, et pes tuus non est subtritus, en quadragesimus annus est:
text_pt: Nunca se envelheceu a tua roupa sobre ti, nem se inchou o teu pé nestes quarenta anos.
text_el: τὰ ἱμάτιά σου οὐ κατετρίβη ἀπὸ σοῦ οἱ πόδες σου οὐκ ἐτυλώθησαν ἰδοὺ τεσσαράκοντα ἔτη

text_en: that you may consider in your heart, that as a man trains up his son, so the Lord your God has trained you up.
text_la: ut recogites in corde tuo, quia sicut erudit filium suum homo, sic Dominus Deus tuus erudivit te,
text_pt: Sabes, pois, no teu coração que, como um homem castiga a seu filho, assim te castiga o Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: καὶ γνώσῃ τῇ καρδίᾳ σου ὅτι ὡς εἴ τις παιδεύσαι ἄνθρωπος τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ οὕτως κύριος ὁ θεός σου παιδεύσει σε

text_en: That you should keep the commandments of the Lord your God , and walk in his ways, and fear him.
text_la: ut custodias mandata Domini Dei tui, et ambules in viis ejus, et timeas eum.
text_pt: E guarda os mandamentos do Senhor teu Deus, para andares nos seus caminhos e para o temeres.
text_el: καὶ φυλάξῃ τὰς ἐντολὰς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου πορεύεσθαι ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ φοβεῖσθαι αὐτόν

text_en: For the Lord your God will bring you into a good land, of brooks and of waters, and of fountains: in the plains of which and the hills deep rivers break out:
text_la: Dominus enim Deus tuus introducet te in terram bonam, terram rivorum, aquarumque et fontium, in cujus campis et montibus erumpunt fluviorum abyssi:
text_pt: Porque o Senhor teu Deus te põe numa boa terra, terra de ribeiros de águas, de fontes, e de mananciais, que saem dos vales e das montanhas;
text_el: ὁ γὰρ κύριος ὁ θεός σου εἰσάγει σε εἰς γῆν ἀγαθὴν καὶ πολλήν οὗ χείμαρροι ὑδάτων καὶ πηγαὶ ἀβύσσων ἐκπορευόμεναι διὰ τῶν πεδίων καὶ διὰ τῶν ὀρέων

text_en: A land of wheat, and barley, and vineyards, wherein fig trees and pomegranates, and oliveyards grow: a land of oil and honey.
text_la: terram frumenti, hordei ac vinearum, in qua ficus, et malogranata, et oliveta nascuntur : terram olei ac mellis,
text_pt: Terra de trigo e cevada, e de vides e figueiras, e romeiras; terra de oliveiras, de azeite e mel.
text_el: γῆ πυροῦ καὶ κριθῆς ἄμπελοι συκαῖ ῥόαι γῆ ἐλαίας ἐλαίου καὶ μέλιτος

text_en: Where without any want you shall eat your bread, and enjoy abundance of all things : where the stones are iron, and out of its hills are dug mines of brass:
text_la: ubi absque ulla penuria comedes panem tuum, et rerum omnium abundantia perfrueris : cujus lapides ferrum sunt, et de montibus ejus æris metalla fodiuntur:
text_pt: Terra em que comerás o pão sem escassez, e nada te faltará nela; terra cujas pedras são ferro, e de cujos montes tu cavarás o cobre.
text_el: γῆ ἐφ' ἧς οὐ μετὰ πτωχείας φάγῃ τὸν ἄρτον σου καὶ οὐκ ἐνδεηθήσῃ οὐδὲν ἐπ' αὐτῆς γῆ ἧς οἱ λίθοι σίδηρος καὶ ἐκ τῶν ὀρέων αὐτῆς μεταλλεύσεις χαλκόν

text_en: That when you have eaten, and are full, you may bless the Lord your God for the excellent land which he has given you.
text_la: ut cum comederis, et satiatus fueris, benedicas Domino Deo tuo pro terra optima, quam dedit tibi.
text_pt: Quando, pois, tiveres comido, e fores farto, louvarás ao Senhor teu Deus pela boa terra que te deu.
text_el: καὶ φάγῃ καὶ ἐμπλησθήσῃ καὶ εὐλογήσεις κύριον τὸν θεόν σου ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς τῆς ἀγαθῆς ἧς ἔδωκέν σοι

text_en: Take heed, and beware lest at any time you forget the Lord your God , and neglect his commandments and judgments and ceremonies , which I command you this day:
text_la: Observa, et cave nequando obliviscaris Domini Dei tui, et negligas mandata ejus atque judicia et cæremonias, quas ego præcipio tibi hodie:
text_pt: Guarda-te que não te esqueças do Senhor teu Deus, deixando de guardar os seus mandamentos, e os seus juízos, e os seus estatutos que hoje te ordeno;
text_el: πρόσεχε σεαυτῷ μὴ ἐπιλάθῃ κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου τοῦ μὴ φυλάξαι τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ κρίματα καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα αὐτοῦ ὅσα ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον

text_en: Lest after you have eaten and are filled, have built goodly houses, and dwelt in them,
text_la: ne postquam comederis et satiatus fueris, domos pulchras ædificaveris, et habitaveris in eis,
text_pt: Para não suceder que, havendo tu comido e fores farto, e havendo edificado boas casas, e habitando-as,
text_el: μὴ φαγὼν καὶ ἐμπλησθεὶς καὶ οἰκίας καλὰς οἰκοδομήσας καὶ κατοικήσας ἐν αὐταῖς

text_en: and shall have herds of oxen and flocks of sheep, and plenty of gold and of silver, and of all things ,
text_la: habuerisque armenta boum, et ovium greges, argenti et auri, cunctarumque rerum copiam,
text_pt: E se tiverem aumentado os teus gados e os teus rebanhos, e se acrescentar a prata e o ouro, e se multiplicar tudo quanto tens,
text_el: καὶ τῶν βοῶν σου καὶ τῶν προβάτων σου πληθυνθέντων σοι ἀργυρίου καὶ χρυσίου πληθυνθέντος σοι καὶ πάντων ὅσων σοι ἔσται πληθυνθέντων σοι

text_en: your heart be lifted up, and you remember not the Lord your God , who brought you out of the land of Egypt , out of the house of bondage :
text_la: elevetur cor tuum, et non reminiscaris Domini Dei tui, qui eduxit te de terra Ægypti, de domo servitutis,
text_pt: Se eleve o teu coração e te esqueças do Senhor teu Deus, que te tirou da terra do Egito, da casa da servidão;
text_el: ὑψωθῇς τῇ καρδίᾳ καὶ ἐπιλάθῃ κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου τοῦ ἐξαγαγόντος σε ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ἐξ οἴκου δουλείας

text_en: And was your leader in the great and terrible wilderness , wherein there was the serpent burning with his breath, and the scorpion and the dipsas , and no waters at all: who brought forth streams out of the hardest rock,
text_la: et ductor tuus fuit in solitudine magna atque terribili, in qua erat serpens flatu adurens, et scorpio, ac dipsas, et nullæ omnino aquæ : qui eduxit rivos de petra durissima,
text_pt: Que te guiou por aquele grande e terrível deserto de serpentes ardentes, e de escorpiões, e de terra seca, em que não havia água; e tirou água para ti da rocha pederneira;
text_el: τοῦ ἀγαγόντος σε διὰ τῆς ἐρήμου τῆς μεγάλης καὶ τῆς φοβερᾶς ἐκείνης οὗ ὄφις δάκνων καὶ σκορπίος καὶ δίψα οὗ οὐκ ἦν ὕδωρ τοῦ ἐξαγαγόντος σοι ἐκ πέτρας ἀκροτόμου πηγὴν ὕδατος

text_en: and fed you in the wilderness with manna which your fathers knew not. And after he had afflicted and proved you, at the last he had mercy on you,
text_la: et cibavit te manna in solitudine, quod nescierunt patres tui. Et postquam afflixit ac probavit, ad extremum misertus est tui,
text_pt: Que no deserto te sustentou com maná, que teus pais não conheceram; para te humilhar, e para te provar, para no fim te fazer bem;
text_el: τοῦ ψωμίσαντός σε τὸ μαννα ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ὃ οὐκ εἴδησαν οἱ πατέρες σου ἵνα κακώσῃ σε καὶ ἐκπειράσῃ σε καὶ εὖ σε ποιήσῃ ἐπ' ἐσχάτων τῶν ἡμερῶν σου

text_en: lest you should say in your heart: My own might, and the strength of my own hand have achieved all these things for me.
text_la: ne diceres in corde tuo : Fortitudo mea, et robur manus meæ, hæc mihi omnia præstiterunt:
text_pt: E digas no teu coração: A minha força, e a fortaleza da minha mão, me adquiriu este poder.
text_el: μὴ εἴπῃς ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ σου ἡ ἰσχύς μου καὶ τὸ κράτος τῆς χειρός μου ἐποίησέν μοι τὴν δύναμιν τὴν μεγάλην ταύτην

text_en: But remember the Lord your God , that he has given you strength, that he might fulfil his covenant, concerning which he swore to your fathers, as this present day shows.
text_la: sed recorderis Domini Dei tui, quod ipse vires tibi præbuerit, ut impleret pactum suum, super quo juravit patribus tuis, sicut præsens indicat dies.
text_pt: Antes te lembrarás do Senhor teu Deus, que ele é o que te dá força para adquirires riqueza; para confirmar a sua aliança, que jurou a teus pais, como se vê neste dia.
text_el: καὶ μνησθήσῃ κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου ὅτι αὐτός σοι δίδωσιν ἰσχὺν τοῦ ποιῆσαι δύναμιν καὶ ἵνα στήσῃ τὴν διαθήκην αὐτοῦ ἣν ὤμοσεν κύριος τοῖς πατράσιν σου ὡς σήμερον

text_en: But if you forget the Lord your God , and follow strange gods , and serve and adore them: behold now I foretell you that you shall utterly perish.
text_la: Sin autem oblitus Domini Dei tui, secutus fueris deos alienos, coluerisque illos et adoraveris : ecce nunc prædico tibi quod omnino dispereas.
text_pt: Será, porém, que, se de qualquer modo te esqueceres do Senhor teu Deus, e se ouvires outros deuses, e os servires, e te inclinares perante eles, hoje eu testifico contra vós que certamente perecereis.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν λήθῃ ἐπιλάθῃ κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου καὶ πορευθῇς ὀπίσω θεῶν ἑτέρων καὶ λατρεύσῃς αὐτοῖς καὶ προσκυνήσῃς αὐτοῖς διαμαρτύρομαι ὑμῖν σήμερον τόν τε οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν ὅτι ἀπωλείᾳ ἀπολεῖσθε

text_en: As the nations , which the Lord destroyed at your entrance, so shall you also perish, if you be disobedient to the voice of the Lord your God .
text_la: Sicut gentes, quas delevit Dominus in introitu tuo, ita et vos peribitis, si inobedientes fueritis voci Domini Dei vestri.
text_pt: Como as nações que o Senhor destruiu diante de vós, assim vós perecereis, porquanto não queríeis obedecer à voz do Senhor vosso Deus.
text_el: καθὰ καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ ἔθνη ὅσα κύριος ἀπολλύει πρὸ προσώπου ὑμῶν οὕτως ἀπολεῖσθε ἀνθ' ὧν οὐκ ἠκούσατε τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν

text_en: Hear, O Israel : You shall go over the Jordan this day; to possess nations very great, and stronger than yourself, cities great, and walled up to the sky,
text_la: Audi, Israël : tu transgredieris hodie Jordanem, ut possideas nationes maximas et fortiores te, civitates ingentes, et ad cælum usque muratas,
text_pt: Ouve, ó Israel, hoje passarás o Jordão, para entrares a possuir nações maiores e mais fortes do que tu; cidades grandes, e muradas até aos céus;
text_el: ἄκουε Ισραηλ σὺ διαβαίνεις σήμερον τὸν Ιορδάνην εἰσελθεῖν κληρονομῆσαι ἔθνη μεγάλα καὶ ἰσχυρότερα μᾶλλον ἢ ὑμεῖς πόλεις μεγάλας καὶ τειχήρεις ἕως τοῦ οὐρανοῦ

text_en: a people great and tall, the sons of the Enacims, whom you have seen, and heard of, against whom no man is able to stand.
text_la: populum magnum atque sublimem, filios Enacim, quos ipse vidisti et audisti, quibus nullus potest ex adverso resistere.
text_pt: Um povo grande e alto, filhos de gigantes, que tu conheces, e de que já ouviste. Quem resistiria diante dos filhos dos gigantes?
text_el: λαὸν μέγαν καὶ πολὺν καὶ εὐμήκη υἱοὺς Ενακ οὓς σὺ οἶσθα καὶ σὺ ἀκήκοας τίς ἀντιστήσεται κατὰ πρόσωπον υἱῶν Ενακ

text_en: You shall know therefore this day that the Lord your God himself will pass over before you, a devouring and consuming fire, to destroy and extirpate and bring them to nothing before your face quickly, as he has spoken to you.
text_la: Scies ergo hodie quod Dominus Deus tuus ipse transibit ante te, ignis devorans atque consumens, qui conterat eos, et deleat atque disperdat ante faciem tuam velociter, sicut locutus est tibi:
text_pt: Sabe, pois, hoje que o Senhor teu Deus, que passa adiante de ti, é um fogo consumidor, que os destruirá, e os derrubará de diante de ti; e tu os lançarás fora, e cedo os desfarás, como o Senhor te tem falado.
text_el: καὶ γνώσῃ σήμερον ὅτι κύριος ὁ θεός σου οὗτος προπορεύεται πρὸ προσώπου σου πῦρ καταναλίσκον ἐστίν οὗτος ἐξολεθρεύσει αὐτούς καὶ οὗτος ἀποστρέψει αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ προσώπου σου καὶ ἀπολεῖς αὐτούς καθάπερ εἶπέν σοι κύριος

text_en: Say not in your heart, when the Lord your God shall have destroyed them in your sight: For my justice has the Lord brought me in to possess this land, whereas these nations are destroyed for their wickedness .
text_la: ne dicas in corde tuo, cum deleverit eos Dominus Deus tuus in conspectu tuo : Propter justitiam meam introduxit me Dominus ut terram hanc possiderem, cum propter impietates suas istæ deletæ sint nationes.
text_pt: Quando, pois, o Senhor teu Deus os lançar fora de diante de ti, não fales no teu coração, dizendo: Por causa da minha justiça é que o Senhor me trouxe a esta terra para a possuir; porque pela impiedade destas nações é que o Senhor as lança fora de diante de ti.
text_el: μὴ εἴπῃς ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ σου ἐν τῷ ἐξαναλῶσαι κύριον τὸν θεόν σου τὰ ἔθνη ταῦτα ἀπὸ προσώπου σου λέγων διὰ τὰς δικαιοσύνας μου εἰσήγαγέν με κύριος κληρονομῆσαι τὴν γῆν τὴν ἀγαθὴν ταύτην ἀλλὰ διὰ τὴν ἀσέβειαν τῶν ἐθνῶν τούτων κύριος ἐξολεθρεύσει αὐτοὺς πρὸ προσώπου σου

text_en: For it is not for your justices, and the uprightness of your heart that you shall go in to possess their lands: but because they have done wickedly , they are destroyed at your coming in: and that the Lord might accomplish his word, which he promised by oath to your fathers Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob .
text_la: Neque enim propter justitias tuas, et æquitatem cordis tui ingredieris, ut possideas terras earum : sed quia illæ egerunt impie, introëunte te deletæ sunt : et ut compleret verbum suum Dominus, quod sub juramento pollicitus est patribus tuis, Abraham, Isaac, et Jacob.
text_pt: Não é por causa da tua justiça, nem pela retidão do teu coração que entras a possuir a sua terra, mas pela impiedade destas nações o Senhor teu Deus as lança fora, de diante de ti, e para confirmar a palavra que o Senhor jurou a teus pais, Abraão, Isaque e Jacó.
text_el: οὐχὶ διὰ τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου οὐδὲ διὰ τὴν ὁσιότητα τῆς καρδίας σου σὺ εἰσπορεύῃ κληρονομῆσαι τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν ἀλλὰ διὰ τὴν ἀσέβειαν τῶν ἐθνῶν τούτων κύριος ἐξολεθρεύσει αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ προσώπου σου καὶ ἵνα στήσῃ τὴν διαθήκην αὐτοῦ ἣν ὤμοσεν τοῖς πατράσιν ὑμῶν τῷ Αβρααμ καὶ τῷ Ισαακ καὶ τῷ Ιακωβ

text_en: Know therefore that the Lord your God gives you not this excellent land in possession for your justices, for you are a very stiffnecked people.
text_la: Scito ergo quod non propter justitias tuas Dominus Deus tuus dederit tibi terram hanc optimam in possessionem, cum durissimæ cervicis sis populus.
text_pt: Sabe, pois, que não é por causa da tua justiça que o Senhor teu Deus te dá esta boa terra para possuí-la, pois tu és povo obstinado.
text_el: καὶ γνώσῃ σήμερον ὅτι οὐχὶ διὰ τὰς δικαιοσύνας σου κύριος ὁ θεός σου δίδωσίν σοι τὴν γῆν τὴν ἀγαθὴν ταύτην κληρονομῆσαι ὅτι λαὸς σκληροτράχηλος εἶ

text_en: Remember, and forget not how you provoked the Lord your God to wrath in the wilderness . From the day that you came out of Egypt unto this place, you have always strove against the Lord .
text_la: Memento, et ne obliviscaris, quomodo ad iracundiam provocaveris Dominum Deum tuum in solitudine. Ex eo die, quo egressus es ex Ægypto usque ad locum istum, semper adversum Dominum contendisti.
text_pt: Lembra-te, e não te esqueças, de que muito provocaste à ira ao Senhor teu Deus no deserto; desde o dia em que saístes do Egito, até que chegastes a esse lugar, rebeldes fostes contra o Senhor;
text_el: μνήσθητι μὴ ἐπιλάθῃ ὅσα παρώξυνας κύριον τὸν θεόν σου ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἀφ' ἧς ἡμέρας ἐξήλθετε ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ἕως ἤλθετε εἰς τὸν τόπον τοῦτον ἀπειθοῦντες διετελεῖτε τὰ πρὸς κύριον

text_en: For in Horeb , also you provoked him, and he was angry , and would have destroyed you,
text_la: Nam et in Horeb provocasti eum, et iratus delere te voluit,
text_pt: Pois em Horebe provocastes à ira o Senhor, tanto que o Senhor se indignou contra vós para vos destruir.
text_el: καὶ ἐν Χωρηβ παρωξύνατε κύριον καὶ ἐθυμώθη κύριος ἐφ' ὑμῖν ἐξολεθρεῦσαι ὑμᾶς

text_en: when I went up into the mount to receive the tables of stone , the tables of the covenant which the Lord made with you: and I continued in the mount forty days and nights, neither eating bread, nor drinking water.
text_la: quando ascendi in montem, ut acciperem tabulas lapideas, tabulas pacti quod pepigit vobiscum Dominus : et perseveravi in monte quadraginta diebus ac noctibus, panem non comedens, et aquam non bibens.
text_pt: Subindo eu ao monte a receber as tábuas de pedra, as tábuas da aliança que o Senhor fizera convosco, então fiquei no monte quarenta dias e quarenta noites; pão não comi, e água não bebi;
text_el: ἀναβαίνοντός μου εἰς τὸ ὄρος λαβεῖν τὰς πλάκας τὰς λιθίνας πλάκας διαθήκης ἃς διέθετο κύριος πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ κατεγινόμην ἐν τῷ ὄρει τεσσαράκοντα ἡμέρας καὶ τεσσαράκοντα νύκτας ἄρτον οὐκ ἔφαγον καὶ ὕδωρ οὐκ ἔπιον

text_en: And the Lord gave me two tables of stone written with the finger of God , and containing all the words that he spoke to you in the mount from the midst of the fire, when the people were assembled together.
text_la: Deditque mihi Dominus duas tabulas lapideas scriptas digito Dei, et continentes omnia verba quæ vobis locutus est in monte de medio ignis, quando concio populi congregata est.
text_pt: E o Senhor me deu as duas tábuas de pedra, escritas com o dedo de Deus; e nelas estava escrito conforme a todas aquelas palavras que o Senhor tinha falado convosco no monte, do meio do fogo, no dia da assembléia.
