text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν κύριος ἐμοὶ τὰς δύο πλάκας τὰς λιθίνας γεγραμμένας ἐν τῷ δακτύλῳ τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐπ' αὐταῖς ἐγέγραπτο πάντες οἱ λόγοι οὓς ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν τῷ ὄρει ἡμέρᾳ ἐκκλησίας

text_en: And when forty days were passed, and as many nights, the Lord gave me the two tables of stone , the tables of the covenant,
text_la: Cumque transissent quadraginta dies, et totidem noctes, dedit mihi Dominus duas tabulas lapideas, tabulas fœderis,
text_pt: Sucedeu, pois, que ao fim dos quarenta dias e quarenta noites, o Senhor me deu as duas tábuas de pedra, as tábuas da aliança.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο διὰ τεσσαράκοντα ἡμερῶν καὶ τεσσαράκοντα νυκτῶν ἔδωκεν κύριος ἐμοὶ τὰς δύο πλάκας τὰς λιθίνας πλάκας διαθήκης

text_en: and said to me: Arise, and go down from hence quickly: for your people, which you have brought out of Egypt , have quickly forsaken the way that you have shown them, and have made to themselves a molten idol .
text_la: dixitque mihi : Surge, et descende hinc cito : quia populus tuus, quem eduxisti de Ægypto, deseruerunt velociter viam, quam demonstrasti eis, feceruntque sibi conflatile.
text_pt: E o Senhor me disse: Levanta-te, desce depressa daqui, porque o teu povo, que tiraste do Egito, já se tem corrompido; cedo se desviaram do caminho que eu lhes tinha ordenado; fizeram para si uma imagem de fundição.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με ἀνάστηθι κατάβηθι τὸ τάχος ἐντεῦθεν ὅτι ἠνόμησεν ὁ λαός σου οὓς ἐξήγαγες ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου παρέβησαν ταχὺ ἐκ τῆς ὁδοῦ ἧς ἐνετείλω αὐτοῖς ἐποίησαν ἑαυτοῖς χώνευμα

text_en: And again the Lord said to me: I see that this people is stiffnecked:
text_la: Rursumque ait Dominus ad me : Cerno quod populus iste duræ cervicis sit:
text_pt: Falou-me ainda o Senhor, dizendo: Atentei para este povo, e eis que ele é povo obstinado;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με λελάληκα πρὸς σὲ ἅπαξ καὶ δὶς λέγων ἑώρακα τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον καὶ ἰδοὺ λαὸς σκληροτράχηλός ἐστιν

text_en: Let me alone that I may destroy them, and abolish their name from under heaven , and set you over a nation , that is greater and stronger than this.
text_la: dimitte me ut conteram eum, et deleam nomen ejus de sub cælo, et constituam te super gentem, quæ hac major et fortior sit.
text_pt: Deixa-me que os destrua, e apague o seu nome de debaixo dos céus; e te faça a ti nação mais poderosa e mais numerosa do que esta.
text_el: ἔασόν με ἐξολεθρεῦσαι αὐτούς καὶ ἐξαλείψω τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῶν ὑποκάτωθεν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ποιήσω σὲ εἰς ἔθνος μέγα καὶ ἰσχυρὸν καὶ πολὺ μᾶλλον ἢ τοῦτο

text_en: And when I came down from the burning mount , and held the two tables of the covenant with both hands,
text_la: Cumque de monte ardente descenderem, et duas tabulas fœderis utraque tenerem manu,
text_pt: Então virei-me, e desci do monte; o qual ardia em fogo e as duas tábuas da aliança estavam em ambas as minhas mãos.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιστρέψας κατέβην ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους καὶ τὸ ὄρος ἐκαίετο πυρί καὶ αἱ δύο πλάκες ἐπὶ ταῖς δυσὶ χερσίν μου

text_en: and saw that you had sinned against the Lord your God , and had made to yourselves a molten calf , and had quickly forsaken his way, which he had shown you:
text_la: vidissemque vos peccasse Domino Deo vestro, et fecisse vobis vitulum conflatilem, ac deseruisse velociter viam ejus, quam vobis ostenderat:
text_pt: E olhei, e eis que havíeis pecado contra o Senhor vosso Deus; vós tínheis feito um bezerro de fundição; cedo vos desviastes do caminho que o Senhor vos ordenara.
text_el: καὶ ἰδὼν ὅτι ἡμάρτετε ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν καὶ ἐποιήσατε ὑμῖν ἑαυτοῖς χωνευτὸν καὶ παρέβητε ἀπὸ τῆς ὁδοῦ ἧς ἐνετείλατο ὑμῖν κύριος

text_en: I cast the tables out of my hands, and broke them in your sight.
text_la: projeci tabulas de manibus meis, confregique eas in conspectu vestro.
text_pt: Então peguei das duas tábuas, e as arrojei das minhas mãos, e as quebrei diante dos vossos olhos.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιλαβόμενος τῶν δύο πλακῶν ἔρριψα αὐτὰς ἀπὸ τῶν δύο χειρῶν μου καὶ συνέτριψα ἐναντίον ὑμῶν

text_en: And I fell down before the Lord as before, forty days and nights neither eating bread , nor drinking water, for all your sins , which you had committed against the Lord , and had provoked him to wrath :
text_la: Et procidi ante Dominum sicut prius, quadraginta diebus et noctibus panem non comedens, et aquam non bibens, propter omnia peccata vestra quæ gessistis contra Dominum, et eum ad iracundiam provocastis:
text_pt: E me lancei perante o Senhor, como antes, quarenta dias, e quarenta noites; não comi pão e não bebi água, por causa de todo o vosso pecado que havíeis cometido, fazendo mal aos olhos do Senhor, para o provocar à ira.
text_el: καὶ ἐδεήθην ἐναντίον κυρίου δεύτερον καθάπερ καὶ τὸ πρότερον τεσσαράκοντα ἡμέρας καὶ τεσσαράκοντα νύκτας ἄρτον οὐκ ἔφαγον καὶ ὕδωρ οὐκ ἔπιον περὶ πασῶν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ὑμῶν ὧν ἡμάρτετε ποιῆσαι τὸ πονηρὸν ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν παροξῦναι αὐτόν

text_en: For I feared his indignation and anger , wherewith being moved against you, he would have destroyed you. And the Lord heard me this time also.
text_la: timui enim indignationem et iram illius, qua adversum vos concitatus, delere vos voluit. Et exaudivit me Dominus etiam hac vice.
text_pt: Porque temi por causa da ira e do furor, com que o Senhor tanto estava irado contra vós para vos destruir; porém ainda por esta vez o Senhor me ouviu.
text_el: καὶ ἔκφοβός εἰμι διὰ τὴν ὀργὴν καὶ τὸν θυμόν ὅτι παρωξύνθη κύριος ἐφ' ὑμῖν ἐξολεθρεῦσαι ὑμᾶς καὶ εἰσήκουσεν κύριος ἐμοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ τούτῳ

text_en: And he was exceeding angry against Aaron also, and would have destroyed him, and I prayed in like manner for him.
text_la: Adversum Aaron quoque vehementer iratus, voluit eum conterere, et pro illo similiter deprecatus sum.
text_pt: Também o Senhor se irou muito contra Arão para o destruir; mas também orei por Arão ao mesmo tempo.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ Ααρων ἐθυμώθη κύριος σφόδρα ἐξολεθρεῦσαι αὐτόν καὶ ηὐξάμην καὶ περὶ Ααρων ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ

text_en: And your sin that you had committed, that is, the calf , I took, and burned it with fire, and breaking it into pieces, until it was as small as dust, I threw it into the torrent, which comes down from the mountain.
text_la: Peccatum autem vestrum quod feceratis, id est, vitulum, arripiens, igne combussi, et in frusta comminuens, omninoque in pulverem redigens, projeci in torrentem, qui de monte descendit.
text_pt: Porém eu tomei o vosso pecado, o bezerro que tínheis feito, e o queimei a fogo, e o pisei, moendo-o bem, até que se desfez em pó; e o seu pó lancei no ribeiro que descia do monte.
text_el: καὶ τὴν ἁμαρτίαν ὑμῶν ἣν ἐποιήσατε τὸν μόσχον ἔλαβον αὐτὸν καὶ κατέκαυσα αὐτὸν ἐν πυρὶ καὶ συνέκοψα αὐτὸν καταλέσας σφόδρα ἕως οὗ ἐγένετο λεπτόν καὶ ἐγενήθη ὡσεὶ κονιορτός καὶ ἔρριψα τὸν κονιορτὸν εἰς τὸν χειμάρρουν τὸν καταβαίνοντα ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους

text_en: At the burning also, and at the place of temptation , and at the graves of lust you provoked the Lord :
text_la: In incendio quoque, et in tentatione, et in Sepulchris concupiscentiæ provocastis Dominum:
text_pt: Também em Taberá, e em Massá, e em Quibrote-Hataavá provocastes muito a ira do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ Ἐμπυρισμῷ καὶ ἐν τῷ Πειρασμῷ καὶ ἐν τοῖς Μνήμασιν τῆς ἐπιθυμίας παροξύνοντες ἦτε κύριον τὸν θεὸν ὑμῶν

text_en: And when he sent you from Cadesbarne , saying: Go up, and possess the land that I have given you, and you slighted the commandment of the Lord your God , and did not believe him, neither would you hearken to his voice:
text_la: et quando misit vos de Cadesbarne, dicens : Ascendite, et possidete terram, quam dedi vobis, et contempsistis imperium Domini Dei vestri, et non credidistis ei, neque vocem ejus audire voluistis:
text_pt: Quando também o Senhor vos enviou de Cades-Barnéia, dizendo: Subi, e possuí a terra, que vos tenho dado: rebeldes fostes ao mandado do Senhor vosso Deus, e não o crestes, e não obedecestes à sua voz.
text_el: καὶ ὅτε ἐξαπέστειλεν κύριος ὑμᾶς ἐκ Καδης Βαρνη λέγων ἀνάβητε καὶ κληρονομήσατε τὴν γῆν ἣν δίδωμι ὑμῖν καὶ ἠπειθήσατε τῷ ῥήματι κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν καὶ οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε αὐτῷ καὶ οὐκ εἰσηκούσατε τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: But were always rebellious from the day that I began to know you.
text_la: sed semper fuistis rebelles a die qua nosse vos cœpi.
text_pt: Rebeldes fostes contra o Senhor desde o dia em que vos conheci.
text_el: ἀπειθοῦντες ἦτε τὰ πρὸς κύριον ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας ἧς ἐγνώσθη ὑμῖν

text_en: And I lay prostrate before the Lord forty days and nights, in which I humbly besought him, that he would not destroy you as he had threatened:
text_la: Et jacui coram Domino quadraginta diebus ac noctibus, quibus eum suppliciter deprecabar, ne deleret vos ut fuerat comminatus:
text_pt: E prostrei-me perante o Senhor; aqueles quarenta dias e quarenta noites estive prostrado, porquanto o Senhor dissera que vos queria destruir.
text_el: καὶ ἐδεήθην ἐναντίον κυρίου τεσσαράκοντα ἡμέρας καὶ τεσσαράκοντα νύκτας ὅσας ἐδεήθην εἶπεν γὰρ κύριος ἐξολεθρεῦσαι ὑμᾶς

text_en: And praying , I said: O Lord God , destroy not your people, and your inheritance, which you have redeemed in your greatness, whom you have brought out of Egypt with a strong hand.
text_la: et orans dixi : Domine Deus, ne disperdas populum tuum, et hæreditatem tuam, quam redemisti in magnitudine tua, quos eduxisti de Ægypto in manu forti.
text_pt: E orei ao SENHOR, dizendo: Senhor DEUS, não destruas o teu povo e a tua herança, que resgataste com a tua grandeza, que tiraste do Egito com mão forte.
text_el: καὶ εὐξάμην πρὸς τὸν θεὸν καὶ εἶπα κύριε κύριε βασιλεῦ τῶν θεῶν μὴ ἐξολεθρεύσῃς τὸν λαόν σου καὶ τὴν μερίδα σου ἣν ἐλυτρώσω ἐν τῇ ἰσχύι σου τῇ μεγάλῃ οὓς ἐξήγαγες ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ἐν τῇ ἰσχύι σου τῇ μεγάλῃ καὶ ἐν τῇ χειρί σου τῇ κραταιᾷ καὶ ἐν τῷ βραχίονί σου τῷ ὑψηλῷ

text_en: Remember your servants Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob : look not on the stubbornness of this people, nor on their wickedness and sin :
text_la: Recordare servorum tuorum Abraham, Isaac, et Jacob : ne aspicias duritiam populi hujus, et impietatem atque peccatum:
text_pt: Lembra-te dos teus servos, Abraão, Isaque, e Jacó. Não atentes para a dureza deste povo, nem para a sua impiedade, nem para o seu pecado;
text_el: μνήσθητι Αβρααμ καὶ Ισαακ καὶ Ιακωβ τῶν θεραπόντων σου οἷς ὤμοσας κατὰ σεαυτοῦ μὴ ἐπιβλέψῃς ἐπὶ τὴν σκληρότητα τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου καὶ τὰ ἀσεβήματα καὶ τὰ ἁμαρτήματα αὐτῶν

text_en: Lest perhaps the inhabitants of the land, out of which you have brought us, say: The Lord could not bring them into the land that he promised them, and he hated them: therefore he brought them out, that he might kill them in the wilderness ,
text_la: ne forte dicant habitatores terræ, de qua eduxisti nos : Non poterat Dominus introducere eos in terram, quam pollicitus est eis, et oderat illos : idcirco eduxit, ut interficeret eos in solitudine:
text_pt: Para que o povo da terra donde nos tiraste não diga: Porquanto o Senhor não os pôde introduzir na terra de que lhes tinha falado, e porque os odiava, os tirou para matá-los no deserto;
text_el: μὴ εἴπωσιν οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὴν γῆν ὅθεν ἐξήγαγες ἡμᾶς ἐκεῖθεν λέγοντες παρὰ τὸ μὴ δύνασθαι κύριον εἰσαγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς καὶ παρὰ τὸ μισῆσαι αὐτοὺς ἐξήγαγεν αὐτοὺς ἀποκτεῖναι ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ

text_en: who are your people and your inheritance, whom you have brought out by your great strength, and in your stretched out arm.
text_la: qui sunt populus tuus et hæreditas tua, quos eduxisti in fortitudine tua magna, et in brachio tuo extento.
text_pt: Todavia são eles o teu povo e a tua herança, que tiraste com a tua grande força e com o teu braço estendido.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι λαός σου καὶ κλῆρός σου οὓς ἐξήγαγες ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ἐν τῇ ἰσχύι σου τῇ μεγάλῃ καὶ ἐν τῷ βραχίονί σου τῷ ὑψηλῷ

text_en: At that time the Lord said to me: Hew you two tables of stone like the former, and come up to me into the mount : and you shall make an ark of wood,
text_la: In tempore illo dixit Dominus ad me : Dola tibi duas tabulas lapideas, sicut priores fuerunt, et ascende ad me in montem : faciesque arcam ligneam,
text_pt: Naquele mesmo tempo me disse o SENHOR: Alisa duas tábuas de pedra, como as primeiras, e sobe a mim ao monte, e faze-te uma arca de madeira;
text_el: ἐν ἐκείνῳ τῷ καιρῷ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με λάξευσον σεαυτῷ δύο πλάκας λιθίνας ὥσπερ τὰς πρώτας καὶ ἀνάβηθι πρός με εἰς τὸ ὄρος καὶ ποιήσεις σεαυτῷ κιβωτὸν ξυλίνην

text_en: and I will write on the tables the words that were in them, which you broke before, and you shall put them in the ark .
text_la: et scribam in tabulis verba quæ fuerunt in his qui ante confregisti: ponesque eas in arca.
text_pt: E naquelas tábuas escreverei as palavras que estavam nas primeiras tábuas, que quebraste, e as porás na arca.
text_el: καὶ γράψω ἐπὶ τὰς πλάκας τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἦν ἐν ταῖς πλαξὶν ταῖς πρώταις ἃς συνέτριψας καὶ ἐμβαλεῖς αὐτὰς εἰς τὴν κιβωτόν

text_en: And I made an ark of setim wood . And when I had hewn two tables of stone like the former, I went up into the mount , having them in my hands.
text_la: Feci igitur arcam de lignis setim. Cumque dolassem duas tabulas lapideas instar priorum, ascendi in montem, habens eas in manibus.
text_pt: Assim, fiz uma arca de madeira de acácia, e alisei duas tábuas de pedra, como as primeiras; e subi ao monte com as duas tábuas na minha mão.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησα κιβωτὸν ἐκ ξύλων ἀσήπτων καὶ ἐλάξευσα τὰς δύο πλάκας τὰς λιθίνας ὡς αἱ πρῶται καὶ ἀνέβην εἰς τὸ ὄρος καὶ αἱ δύο πλάκες ἐπὶ ταῖς χερσίν μου

text_en: And he wrote in the tables, according as he had written before, the ten words , which the Lord spoke to you in the mount from the midst of the fire, when the people were assembled: and he gave them to me.
text_la: Scripsitque in tabulis, juxta id quod prius scripserat, verba decem, quæ locutus est Dominus ad vos in monte de medio ignis, quando populus congregatus est : et dedit eas mihi.
text_pt: Então escreveu nas tábuas, conforme à primeira escritura, os dez mandamentos, que o Senhor vos falara no dia da assembléia, no monte, do meio do fogo; e o Senhor mas deu a mim;
text_el: καὶ ἔγραψεν ἐπὶ τὰς πλάκας κατὰ τὴν γραφὴν τὴν πρώτην τοὺς δέκα λόγους οὓς ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν τῷ ὄρει ἐκ μέσου τοῦ πυρός καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὰς κύριος ἐμοί

text_en: And returning from the mount , I came down, and put the tables into the ark , that I had made, and they are there till this present, as the Lord commanded me.
text_la: Reversusque de monte, descendi, et posui tabulas in arcam, quam feceram, quæ hucusque ibi sunt, sicut mihi præcepit Dominus.
text_pt: E virei-me, e desci do monte, e pus as tábuas na arca que fizera; e ali estão, como o Senhor me ordenou.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιστρέψας κατέβην ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους καὶ ἐνέβαλον τὰς πλάκας εἰς τὴν κιβωτόν ἣν ἐποίησα καὶ ἦσαν ἐκεῖ καθὰ ἐνετείλατό μοι κύριος

text_en: And the children of Israel removed their camp from Beroth , of the children of Jacan into Mosera, where Aaron died and was buried, and Eleazar his son succeeded him in the priestly office .
text_la: Filii autem Israël moverunt castra ex Beroth filiorum Jacan in Mosera, ubi Aaron mortuus ac sepultus est, pro quo sacerdotio functus est Eleazar filius ejus.
text_pt: E partiram os filhos de Israel de Beerote-Bene-Jaacã a Moserá; ali faleceu Arão, e ali foi sepultado, e Eleazar, seu filho, administrou o sacerdócio em seu lugar.
text_el: καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Βηρωθ υἱῶν Ιακιμ Μισαδαι ἐκεῖ ἀπέθανεν Ααρων καὶ ἐτάφη ἐκεῖ καὶ ἱεράτευσεν Ελεαζαρ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: From thence they came to Gadgad, from which place they departed, and camped in Jetebatha, in a land of waters and torrents.
text_la: Inde venerunt in Gadgad : de quo loco profecti, castrametati sunt in Jetebatha, in terra aquarum atque torrentium.
text_pt: Dali partiram a Gudgodá, e de Gudgodá a Jotbatá, terra de ribeiros de águas.
text_el: ἐκεῖθεν ἀπῆραν εἰς Γαδγαδ καὶ ἀπὸ Γαδγαδ εἰς Ετεβαθα γῆ χείμαρροι ὑδάτων

text_en: At that time he separated the tribe of Levi , to carry the ark of the covenant of the Lord , and to stand before him in the ministry, and to bless in his name until this present day.
text_la: Eo tempore separavit tribum Levi, ut portaret arcam fœderis Domini, et staret coram eo in ministerio, ac benediceret in nomine illius usque in præsentem diem.
text_pt: No mesmo tempo o Senhor separou a tribo de Levi, para levar a arca da aliança do Senhor, para estar diante do Senhor, para o servir, e para abençoar em seu nome até ao dia de hoje.
text_el: ἐν ἐκείνῳ τῷ καιρῷ διέστειλεν κύριος τὴν φυλὴν τὴν Λευι αἴρειν τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου παρεστάναι ἔναντι κυρίου λειτουργεῖν καὶ ἐπεύχεσθαι ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: Wherefore Levi has no part nor possession with his brethren: because the Lord himself is his possession, as the Lord your God promised him.
text_la: Quam ob rem non habuit Levi partem, neque possessionem cum fratribus suis : quia ipse Dominus possessio ejus est, sicut promisit ei Dominus Deus tuus.
text_pt: Por isso Levi não tem parte nem herança com seus irmãos; o Senhor é a sua herança, como o Senhor teu Deus lhe tem falado.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο οὐκ ἔστιν τοῖς Λευίταις μερὶς καὶ κλῆρος ἐν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτῶν κύριος αὐτὸς κλῆρος αὐτοῦ καθὰ εἶπεν αὐτῷ

text_en: And I stood in the mount , as before, forty days and nights: and the Lord heard me this time also, and would not destroy you.
text_la: Ego autem steti in monte, sicut prius, quadraginta diebus ac noctibus : exaudivitque me Dominus etiam hac vice, et te perdere noluit.
text_pt: E eu estive no monte, como nos primeiros dias, quarenta dias e quarenta noites; e o Senhor me ouviu ainda por esta vez; não quis o Senhor destruir-te.
text_el: κἀγὼ εἱστήκειν ἐν τῷ ὄρει τεσσαράκοντα ἡμέρας καὶ τεσσαράκοντα νύκτας καὶ εἰσήκουσεν κύριος ἐμοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ τούτῳ καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησεν κύριος ἐξολεθρεῦσαι ὑμᾶς

text_en: And he said to me: Go, and walk before the people, that they may enter, and possess the land, which I swore to their fathers that I would give them.
text_la: Dixitque mihi : Vade, et præcede populum, ut ingrediatur, et possideat terram, quam juravi patribus eorum ut traderem eis.
text_pt: Porém o Senhor me disse: Levanta-te, põe-te a caminho adiante do povo, para que entrem, e possuam a terra que jurei dar a seus pais.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με βάδιζε ἄπαρον ἐναντίον τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου καὶ εἰσπορευέσθωσαν καὶ κληρονομείτωσαν τὴν γῆν ἣν ὤμοσα τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν δοῦναι αὐτοῖς

text_en: And now, Israel , what does the Lord your God require of you, but that you fear the Lord your God , and walk in his ways, and love him, and serve the Lord your God , with all your heart, and with all your soul :
text_la: Et nunc Israël, quid Dominus Deus tuus petit a te, nisi ut timeas Dominum Deum tuum, et ambules in viis ejus, et diligas eum, ac servias Domino Deo tuo in toto corde tuo, et in tota anima tua:
text_pt: Agora, pois, ó Israel, que é que o Senhor teu Deus pede de ti, senão que temas o Senhor teu Deus, que andes em todos os seus caminhos, e o ames, e sirvas ao Senhor teu Deus com todo o teu coração e com toda a tua alma,
text_el: καὶ νῦν Ισραηλ τί κύριος ὁ θεός σου αἰτεῖται παρὰ σοῦ ἀλλ' ἢ φοβεῖσθαι κύριον τὸν θεόν σου πορεύεσθαι ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀγαπᾶν αὐτὸν καὶ λατρεύειν κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σου ἐξ ὅλης τῆς καρδίας σου καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς ψυχῆς σου

text_en: And keep the commandments of the Lord , and his ceremonies , which I command you this day, that it may be well with you?
text_la: custodiasque mandata Domini, et cæremonias ejus, quas ego hodie præcipio tibi, ut bene sit tibi?
text_pt: Que guardes os mandamentos do Senhor, e os seus estatutos, que hoje te ordeno, para o teu bem?
text_el: φυλάσσεσθαι τὰς ἐντολὰς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα αὐτοῦ ὅσα ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον ἵνα εὖ σοι ᾖ

text_en: Behold heaven is the Lord's your God , and the heaven of heaven , the earth and all things that are therein.
text_la: En Domini Dei tui cælum est, et cælum cæli, terra, et omnia quæ in ea sunt:
text_pt: Eis que os céus e os céus dos céus são do Senhor teu Deus, a terra e tudo o que nela há.
text_el: ἰδοὺ κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ὁ οὐρανὸς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἡ γῆ καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἐστὶν ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: And yet the Lord has been closely joined to your fathers, and loved them and chose their seed after them, that is to say, you, out of all nations , as this day it is proved.
text_la: et tamen patribus tuis conglutinatus est Dominus, et amavit eos, elegitque semen eorum post eos, id est, vos, de cunctis gentibus, sicut hodie comprobatur.
text_pt: Tão-somente o Senhor se agradou de teus pais para os amar; e a vós, descendência deles, escolheu, depois deles, de todos os povos como neste dia se vê.
text_el: πλὴν τοὺς πατέρας ὑμῶν προείλατο κύριος ἀγαπᾶν αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐξελέξατο τὸ σπέρμα αὐτῶν μετ' αὐτοὺς ὑμᾶς παρὰ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη κατὰ τὴν ἡμέραν ταύτην

text_en: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and stiffen your neck no more.
text_la: Circumcidite igitur præputium cordis vestri, et cervicem vestram ne induretis amplius:
text_pt: Circuncidai, pois, o prepúcio do vosso coração, e não mais endureçais a vossa cerviz.
text_el: καὶ περιτεμεῖσθε τὴν σκληροκαρδίαν ὑμῶν καὶ τὸν τράχηλον ὑμῶν οὐ σκληρυνεῖτε ἔτι

text_en: Because the Lord your God he is the God of gods, and the Lord of lords, a great God and mighty and terrible, who accepts no person nor takes bribes .
text_la: quia Dominus Deus vester ipse est Deus deorum, et Dominus dominantium, Deus magnus, et potens, et terribilis, qui personam non accipit, nec munera.
text_pt: Pois o SENHOR vosso Deus é o Deus dos deuses, e o Senhor dos senhores, o Deus grande, poderoso e terrível, que não faz acepção de pessoas, nem aceita recompensas;
text_el: ὁ γὰρ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν οὗτος θεὸς τῶν θεῶν καὶ κύριος τῶν κυρίων ὁ θεὸς ὁ μέγας καὶ ἰσχυρὸς καὶ ὁ φοβερός ὅστις οὐ θαυμάζει πρόσωπον οὐδ' οὐ μὴ λάβῃ δῶρον

text_en: He does judgment to the fatherless and the widow, loves the stranger, and gives him food and raiment.
text_la: Facit judicium pupillo et viduæ; amat peregrinum, et dat ei victum atque vestitum.
text_pt: Que faz justiça ao órfão e à viúva, e ama o estrangeiro, dando-lhe pão e roupa.
text_el: ποιῶν κρίσιν προσηλύτῳ καὶ ὀρφανῷ καὶ χήρᾳ καὶ ἀγαπᾷ τὸν προσήλυτον δοῦναι αὐτῷ ἄρτον καὶ ἱμάτιον

text_en: And do you therefore love strangers, because you also were strangers in the land of Egypt .
text_la: Et vos ergo amate peregrinos, quia et ipsi fuistis advenæ in terra Ægypti.
text_pt: Por isso amareis o estrangeiro, pois fostes estrangeiros na terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ ἀγαπήσετε τὸν προσήλυτον προσήλυτοι γὰρ ἦτε ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ

text_en: You shall fear the Lord your God , and serve him only: to him you shall adhere, and shall swear by his name .
text_la: Dominum Deum tuum timebis, et ei soli servies : ipsi adhærebis, jurabisque in nomine illius.
text_pt: Ao Senhor teu Deus temerás; a ele servirás, e a ele te chegarás, e pelo seu nome jurarás.
text_el: κύριον τὸν θεόν σου φοβηθήσῃ καὶ αὐτῷ λατρεύσεις καὶ πρὸς αὐτὸν κολληθήσῃ καὶ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ ὀμῇ

text_en: He is your praise, and your God , that has done for you these great and terrible things, which your eyes have seen.
text_la: Ipse est laus tua, et Deus tuus, qui fecit tibi hæc magnalia et terribilia, quæ viderunt oculi tui.
text_pt: Ele é o teu louvor e o teu Deus, que te fez estas grandes e terríveis coisas que os teus olhos têm visto.
text_el: οὗτος καύχημά σου καὶ οὗτος θεός σου ὅστις ἐποίησεν ἐν σοὶ τὰ μεγάλα καὶ τὰ ἔνδοξα ταῦτα ἃ εἴδοσαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοί σου

text_en: In seventy souls your fathers went down into Egypt : and behold now the Lord your God has multiplied you as the stars of heaven .
text_la: In septuaginta animabus descenderunt patres tui in Ægyptum, et ecce nunc multiplicavit te Dominus Deus tuus sicut astra cæli.
text_pt: Com setenta almas teus pais desceram ao Egito; e agora o Senhor teu Deus te pôs como as estrelas dos céus em multidão.
text_el: ἐν ἑβδομήκοντα ψυχαῖς κατέβησαν οἱ πατέρες σου εἰς Αἴγυπτον νυνὶ δὲ ἐποίησέν σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου ὡσεὶ τὰ ἄστρα τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τῷ πλήθει

text_en: Therefore love the Lord your God and observe his precepts and ceremonies , his judgments and commandments at all times.
text_la: Ama itaque Dominum Deum tuum, et observa præcepta ejus et cæremonias, judicia atque mandata, omni tempore.
text_pt: Amarás, pois, ao SENHOR teu Deus, e guardarás as suas ordenanças, e os seus estatutos, e os seus juízos, e os seus mandamentos, todos os dias.
text_el: καὶ ἀγαπήσεις κύριον τὸν θεόν σου καὶ φυλάξῃ τὰ φυλάγματα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰς κρίσεις αὐτοῦ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας

text_en: Know this day the things that your children know not, who saw not the chastisements of the Lord your God , his great doings and strong hand, and stretched out arm,
text_la: Cognoscite hodie quæ ignorant filii vestri, qui non viderunt disciplinam Domini Dei vestri, magnalia ejus et robustam manum, extentumque brachium,
text_pt: E hoje sabereis que falo, não com vossos filhos, que o não sabem, e não viram a instrução do Senhor vosso Deus, a sua grandeza, a sua mão forte, e o seu braço estendido;
text_el: καὶ γνώσεσθε σήμερον ὅτι οὐχὶ τὰ παιδία ὑμῶν ὅσοι οὐκ οἴδασιν οὐδὲ εἴδοσαν τὴν παιδείαν κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου καὶ τὰ μεγαλεῖα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν χεῖρα τὴν κραταιὰν καὶ τὸν βραχίονα τὸν ὑψηλὸν

text_en: the signs and works which he did in the midst of Egypt to King Pharao , and to all his land,
text_la: signa et opera quæ fecit in medio Ægypti Pharaoni regi, et universæ terræ ejus,
text_pt: Nem tampouco os seus sinais, nem os seus feitos, que fez no meio do Egito a Faraó, rei do Egito, e a toda a sua terra;
text_el: καὶ τὰ σημεῖα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ τέρατα αὐτοῦ ὅσα ἐποίησεν ἐν μέσῳ Αἰγύπτου Φαραω βασιλεῖ Αἰγύπτου καὶ πάσῃ τῇ γῇ αὐτοῦ

text_en: and to all the host of the Egyptians , and to their horses and chariots: how the waters of the Red Sea covered them, when they pursued you, and how the Lord destroyed them until this present day:
text_la: omnique exercitui Ægyptiorum, et equis ac curribus : quomodo operuerint eos aquæ maris Rubri, cum vos persequerentur, et deleverit eos Dominus usque in præsentem diem:
text_pt: Nem o que fez ao exército dos egípcios, aos seus cavalos e aos seus carros, fazendo passar sobre eles as águas do Mar Vermelho quando vos perseguiam, e como o Senhor os destruiu, até ao dia de hoje;
text_el: καὶ ὅσα ἐποίησεν τὴν δύναμιν τῶν Αἰγυπτίων τὰ ἅρματα αὐτῶν καὶ τὴν ἵππον αὐτῶν ὡς ἐπέκλυσεν τὸ ὕδωρ τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς ἐρυθρᾶς ἐπὶ προσώπου αὐτῶν καταδιωκόντων αὐτῶν ἐκ τῶν ὀπίσω ὑμῶν καὶ ἀπώλεσεν αὐτοὺς κύριος ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας

text_en: And what he has done to you in the wilderness , till you came to this place:
text_la: vobisque quæ fecerit in solitudine donec veniretis ad hunc locum:
text_pt: Nem o que vos fez no deserto, até que chegastes a este lugar;
text_el: καὶ ὅσα ἐποίησεν ὑμῖν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἕως ἤλθετε εἰς τὸν τόπον τοῦτον

text_en: And to Dathan and Abiron the sons of Eliab, who was the son of Ruben : whom the earth, opening her mouth swallowed up with their households and tents, and all their substance , which they had in the midst of Israel .
text_la: et Dathan atque Abiron filiis Eliab, qui fuit filius Ruben : quos aperto ore suo terra absorbuit, cum domibus et tabernaculis, et universa substantia eorum, quam habebant in medio Israël.
text_pt: E o que fez a Datã e a Abirão, filhos de Eliabe, filho de Rúben; como a terra abriu a sua boca e os tragou com as suas casas e com as suas tendas, como também tudo o que subsistia, e lhes pertencia, no meio de todo o Israel;
text_el: καὶ ὅσα ἐποίησεν τῷ Δαθαν καὶ Αβιρων υἱοῖς Ελιαβ υἱοῦ Ρουβην οὓς ἀνοίξασα ἡ γῆ τὸ στόμα αὐτῆς κατέπιεν αὐτοὺς καὶ τοὺς οἴκους αὐτῶν καὶ τὰς σκηνὰς αὐτῶν καὶ πᾶσαν αὐτῶν τὴν ὑπόστασιν τὴν μετ' αὐτῶν ἐν μέσῳ παντὸς Ισραηλ

text_en: Your eyes have seen all the great works of the Lord , that he has done,
text_la: Oculi vestri viderunt opera Domini magna quæ fecit,
text_pt: Porquanto os vossos olhos são os que viram toda a grande obra que fez o Senhor.
text_el: ὅτι οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ὑμῶν ἑώρακαν πάντα τὰ ἔργα κυρίου τὰ μεγάλα ὅσα ἐποίησεν ὑμῖν σήμερον

text_en: that you may keep all his commandments , which I command you this day, and may go in, and possess the land, to which you are entering,
text_la: ut custodiatis universa mandata illius, quæ ego hodie præcipio vobis, et possitis introire, et possidere terram, ad quam ingredimini,
text_pt: Guardai, pois, todos os mandamentos que eu vos ordeno hoje, para que sejais fortes, e entreis, e ocupeis a terra que passais a possuir;
text_el: καὶ φυλάξεσθε πάσας τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ὅσας ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον ἵνα ζῆτε καὶ πολυπλασιασθῆτε καὶ εἰσελθόντες κληρονομήσητε τὴν γῆν εἰς ἣν ὑμεῖς διαβαίνετε τὸν Ιορδάνην ἐκεῖ κληρονομῆσαι αὐτήν

text_en: and may live in it a long time: which the Lord promised by oath to your fathers, and to their seed, a land which flows with milk and honey.
text_la: multoque in ea vivatis tempore : quam sub juramento pollicitus est Dominus patribus vestris, et semini eorum, lacte et melle manantem.
text_pt: E para que prolongueis os dias na terra que o Senhor jurou dar a vossos pais e à sua descendência, terra que mana leite e mel.
text_el: ἵνα μακροημερεύσητε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἧς ὤμοσεν κύριος τοῖς πατράσιν ὑμῶν δοῦναι αὐτοῖς καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτῶν μετ' αὐτούς γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι

text_en: For the land, which you go to possess, is not like the land of Egypt , from whence you came out, where, when the seed is sown, waters are brought in to water it after the manner of gardens.
text_la: Terra enim, ad quam ingrederis possidendam, non est sicut terra Ægypti, de qua existi, ubi jacto semine in hortorum morem aquæ ducuntur irriguæ:
text_pt: Porque a terra que passas a possuir não é como a terra do Egito, de onde saíste, em que semeavas a tua semente, e a regavas com o teu pé, como a uma horta.
text_el: ἔστιν γὰρ ἡ γῆ εἰς ἣν εἰσπορεύῃ ἐκεῖ κληρονομῆσαι αὐτήν οὐχ ὥσπερ ἡ γῆ Αἰγύπτου ἐστίν ὅθεν ἐκπεπόρευσθε ἐκεῖθεν ὅταν σπείρωσιν τὸν σπόρον καὶ ποτίζωσιν τοῖς ποσὶν ὡσεὶ κῆπον λαχανείας

text_en: But it is a land of hills and plains, expecting rain from heaven .
text_la: sed montuosa est et campestris, de cælo expectans pluvias,
text_pt: Mas a terra que passais a possuir é terra de montes e de vales; da chuva dos céus beberá as águas;
text_el: ἡ δὲ γῆ εἰς ἣν εἰσπορεύῃ ἐκεῖ κληρονομῆσαι αὐτήν γῆ ὀρεινὴ καὶ πεδινή ἐκ τοῦ ὑετοῦ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ πίεται ὕδωρ

text_en: And the Lord your God does always visit it, and his eyes are on it from the beginning of the year unto the end thereof.
text_la: quam Dominus Deus tuus semper invisit, et oculi illius in ea sunt a principio anni usque ad finem ejus.
text_pt: Terra de que o Senhor teu Deus tem cuidado; os olhos do Senhor teu Deus estão sobre ela continuamente, desde o princípio até ao fim do ano.
text_el: γῆ ἣν κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐπισκοπεῖται αὐτήν διὰ παντὸς οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου ἐπ' αὐτῆς ἀπ' ἀρχῆς τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ καὶ ἕως συντελείας τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ

text_en: If then you obey my commandments , which I command you this day, that you love the Lord your God , and serve him with all your heart, and with all your soul :
text_la: Si ergo obedieritis mandatis meis, quæ ego hodie præcipio vobis, ut diligatis Dominum Deum vestrum, et serviatis ei in toto corde vestro, et in tota anima vestra:
text_pt: E será que, se diligentemente obedecerdes a meus mandamentos que hoje vos ordeno, de amar ao Senhor vosso Deus, e de o servir de todo o vosso coração e de toda a vossa alma,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἀκοῇ εἰσακούσητε πάσας τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ὅσας ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον ἀγαπᾶν κύριον τὸν θεόν σου καὶ λατρεύειν αὐτῷ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς καρδίας σου καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς ψυχῆς σου

text_en: He will give to your land the early rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your corn, and your wine, and your oil,
text_la: dabit pluviam terræ vestræ temporaneam et serotinam, ut colligatis frumentum, et vinum, et oleum,
text_pt: Então darei a chuva da vossa terra a seu tempo, a temporã e a serôdia, para que recolhais o vosso grão, e o vosso mosto e o vosso azeite.
text_el: καὶ δώσει τὸν ὑετὸν τῇ γῇ σου καθ' ὥραν πρόιμον καὶ ὄψιμον καὶ εἰσοίσεις τὸν σῖτόν σου καὶ τὸν οἶνόν σου καὶ τὸ ἔλαιόν σου

text_en: and your hay out of the fields to feed your cattle, and that you may eat and be filled.
text_la: fœnumque ex agris ad pascenda jumenta, et ut ipsi comedatis ac saturemini.
text_pt: E darei erva no teu campo aos teus animais, e comerás, e fartar-te-ás.
text_el: καὶ δώσει χορτάσματα ἐν τοῖς ἀγροῖς σου τοῖς κτήνεσίν σου καὶ φαγὼν καὶ ἐμπλησθεὶς

text_en: Beware lest perhaps your heart be deceived , and you depart from the Lord , and serve strange gods , and adore them:
text_la: Cavete ne forte decipiatur cor vestrum, et recedatis a Domino, serviatisque diis alienis, et adoretis eos:
text_pt: Guardai-vos, que o vosso coração não se engane, e vos desvieis, e sirvais a outros deuses, e vos inclineis perante eles;
text_el: πρόσεχε σεαυτῷ μὴ πλατυνθῇ ἡ καρδία σου καὶ παραβῆτε καὶ λατρεύσητε θεοῖς ἑτέροις καὶ προσκυνήσητε αὐτοῖς

text_en: And the Lord being angry shut up heaven , that the rain come not down, nor the earth yield her fruit, and you perish quickly from the excellent land, which the Lord will give you.
text_la: iratusque Dominus claudat cælum, et pluviæ non descendant, nec terra det germen suum, pereatisque velociter de terra optima, quam Dominus daturus est vobis.
text_pt: E a ira do Senhor se acenda contra vós, e feche ele os céus, e não haja água, e a terra não dê o seu fruto, e cedo pereçais da boa terra que o Senhor vos dá.
text_el: καὶ θυμωθεὶς ὀργῇ κύριος ἐφ' ὑμῖν καὶ συσχῇ τὸν οὐρανόν καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὑετός καὶ ἡ γῆ οὐ δώσει τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῆς καὶ ἀπολεῖσθε ἐν τάχει ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς τῆς ἀγαθῆς ἧς ἔδωκεν ὁ κύριος ὑμῖν

text_en: Lay up these words in your hearts and minds, and hang them for a sign on your hands, and place them between your eyes.
text_la: Ponite hæc verba mea in cordibus et in animis vestris, et suspendite ea pro signo in manibus, et inter oculos vestros collocate.
text_pt: Ponde, pois, estas minhas palavras no vosso coração e na vossa alma, e atai-as por sinal na vossa mão, para que estejam por frontais entre os vossos olhos.
text_el: καὶ ἐμβαλεῖτε τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα εἰς τὴν καρδίαν ὑμῶν καὶ εἰς τὴν ψυχὴν ὑμῶν καὶ ἀφάψετε αὐτὰ εἰς σημεῖον ἐπὶ τῆς χειρὸς ὑμῶν καὶ ἔσται ἀσάλευτον πρὸ ὀφθαλμῶν ὑμῶν

text_en: Teach your children that they meditate on them, when you sit in your house, and when you walk on the way, and when you lie down and rise up.
text_la: Docete filios vestros ut illa meditentur : quando sederis in domo tua, et ambulaveris in via, et accubueris atque surrexeris.
text_pt: E ensinai-as a vossos filhos, falando delas assentado em tua casa, e andando pelo caminho, e deitando-te, e levantando-te;
text_el: καὶ διδάξετε αὐτὰ τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν λαλεῖν αὐτὰ καθημένους ἐν οἴκῳ καὶ πορευομένους ἐν ὁδῷ καὶ κοιταζομένους καὶ διανισταμένους

text_en: You shall write them upon the posts and the doors of your house:
text_la: Scribes ea super postes et januas domus tuæ,
text_pt: E escreve-as nos umbrais de tua casa, e nas tuas portas;
text_el: καὶ γράψετε αὐτὰ ἐπὶ τὰς φλιὰς τῶν οἰκιῶν ὑμῶν καὶ τῶν πυλῶν ὑμῶν

text_en: That your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children in the land which the Lord swore to your fathers, that he would give them as long as the heaven hangs over the earth.
text_la: ut multiplicentur dies tui, et filiorum tuorum in terra, quam juravit Dominus patribus tuis, ut daret eis quamdiu cælum imminet terræ.
text_pt: Para que se multipliquem os vossos dias e os dias de vossos filhos na terra que o Senhor jurou a vossos pais dar-lhes, como os dias dos céus sobre a terra.
text_el: ἵνα πολυημερεύσητε καὶ αἱ ἡμέραι τῶν υἱῶν ὑμῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἧς ὤμοσεν κύριος τοῖς πατράσιν ὑμῶν δοῦναι αὐτοῖς καθὼς αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: For if you keep the commandments which I command you, and do them, to love the Lord your God , and walk in all his ways, cleaving unto him,
text_la: Si enim custodieritis mandata quæ ego præcipio vobis, et feceritis ea, ut diligatis Dominum Deum vestrum, et ambuletis in omnibus viis ejus, adhærentes ei,
text_pt: Porque se diligentemente guardardes todos estes mandamentos, que vos ordeno para os guardardes, amando ao Senhor vosso Deus, andando em todos os seus caminhos, e a ele vos achegardes,
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν ἀκοῇ ἀκούσητε πάσας τὰς ἐντολὰς ταύτας ὅσας ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον ποιεῖν ἀγαπᾶν κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν καὶ πορεύεσθαι ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ προσκολλᾶσθαι αὐτῷ

text_en: the Lord will destroy all these nations before your face, and you shall possess them, which are greater and stronger than you.
text_la: disperdet Dominus omnes gentes istas ante faciem vestram, et possidebitis eas, quæ majores et fortiores vobis sunt.
text_pt: Também o Senhor, de diante de vós, lançará fora todas estas nações, e possuireis nações maiores e mais poderosas do que vós.
text_el: καὶ ἐκβαλεῖ κύριος πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ταῦτα ἀπὸ προσώπου ὑμῶν καὶ κληρονομήσετε ἔθνη μεγάλα καὶ ἰσχυρότερα μᾶλλον ἢ ὑμεῖς

text_en: Every place, that your foot shall tread upon, shall be yours. From the desert , and from Libanus, from the great river Euphrates unto the western sea shall be your borders.
text_la: Omnis locus, quem calcaverit pes vester, vester erit. A deserto, et a Libano, a flumine magno Euphrate usque ad mare occidentale erunt termini vestri.
text_pt: Todo o lugar que pisar a planta do vosso pé será vosso; desde o deserto, e desde o Líbano, desde o rio, o rio Eufrates, até ao mar ocidental, será o vosso termo.
text_el: πάντα τὸν τόπον οὗ ἐὰν πατήσῃ τὸ ἴχνος τοῦ ποδὸς ὑμῶν ὑμῖν ἔσται ἀπὸ τῆς ἐρήμου καὶ Ἀντιλιβάνου καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ποταμοῦ τοῦ μεγάλου ποταμοῦ Εὐφράτου καὶ ἕως τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς ἐπὶ δυσμῶν ἔσται τὰ ὅριά σου

text_en: None shall stand against you: the Lord your God shall lay the dread and fear of you upon all the land that you shall tread upon, as he has spoken to you.
text_la: Nullus stabit contra vos : terrorem vestrum et formidinem dabit Dominus Deus vester super omnem terram quam calcaturi estis, sicut locutus est vobis.
text_pt: Ninguém resistirá diante de vós; o Senhor vosso Deus porá sobre toda a terra, que pisardes, o vosso terror e o temor de vós, como já vos tem dito.
text_el: οὐκ ἀντιστήσεται οὐδεὶς κατὰ πρόσωπον ὑμῶν τὸν τρόμον ὑμῶν καὶ τὸν φόβον ὑμῶν ἐπιθήσει κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον πάσης τῆς γῆς ἐφ' ἧς ἐὰν ἐπιβῆτε ἐπ' αὐτῆς ὃν τρόπον ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς ὑμᾶς

text_en: Behold I set forth in your sight this day a blessing and a curse :
text_la: En propono in conspectu vestro hodie benedictionem et maledictionem:
text_pt: Eis que hoje eu ponho diante de vós a bênção e a maldição;
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ δίδωμι ἐνώπιον ὑμῶν σήμερον εὐλογίαν καὶ κατάραν

text_en: A blessing , if you obey the commandments of the Lord your God , which I command you this day:
text_la: benedictionem, si obedieritis mandatis Domini Dei vestri, quæ ego hodie præcipio vobis:
text_pt: A bênção, quando cumprirdes os mandamentos do Senhor vosso Deus, que hoje vos mando;
text_el: τὴν εὐλογίαν ἐὰν ἀκούσητε τὰς ἐντολὰς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν ἃς ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαι ὑμῖν σήμερον

text_en: A curse , if you obey not the commandments of the Lord your God , but revolt from the way which now I show you, and walk after strange gods which you know not.
text_la: maledictionem, si non obedieritis mandatis Domini Dei vestri, sed recesseritis de via, quam ego nunc ostendo vobis, et ambulaveritis post deos alienos, quos ignoratis.
text_pt: Porém a maldição, se não cumprirdes os mandamentos do Senhor vosso Deus, e vos desviardes do caminho que hoje vos ordeno, para seguirdes outros deuses que não conhecestes.
text_el: καὶ τὰς κατάρας ἐὰν μὴ ἀκούσητε τὰς ἐντολὰς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν ὅσας ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαι ὑμῖν σήμερον καὶ πλανηθῆτε ἀπὸ τῆς ὁδοῦ ἧς ἐνετειλάμην ὑμῖν πορευθέντες λατρεύειν θεοῖς ἑτέροις οὓς οὐκ οἴδατε

text_en: And when the Lord your God shall have brought you into the land, whither you go to dwell, you shall put the blessing upon mount Garizim, the curse upon mount Hebal:
text_la: Cum vero introduxerit te Dominus Deus tuus in terram, ad quam pergis habitandam, pones benedictionem super montem Garizim, maledictionem super montem Hebal:
text_pt: E será que, quando o Senhor teu Deus te introduzir na terra, a que vais para possuí-la, então pronunciarás a bênção sobre o monte Gerizim, e a maldição sobre o monte Ebal.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὅταν εἰσαγάγῃ σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου εἰς τὴν γῆν εἰς ἣν διαβαίνεις ἐκεῖ κληρονομῆσαι αὐτήν καὶ δώσεις τὴν εὐλογίαν ἐπ' ὄρος Γαριζιν καὶ τὴν κατάραν ἐπ' ὄρος Γαιβαλ

text_en: Which are beyond the Jordan , behind the way that goes to the setting of the sun, in the land of the Chanaanite who dwells in the plain country over against Galgala, which is near the valley that reaches and enters far.
text_la: qui sunt trans Jordanem, post viam quæ vergit ad solis occubitum in terra Chananæi, qui habitat in campestribus contra Galgalam, quæ est juxta vallem tendentem et intrantem procul.
text_pt: Porventura não estão eles além do Jordão, junto ao caminho do pôr do sol, na terra dos cananeus, que habitam na campina defronte de Gilgal, junto aos carvalhais de Moré?
text_el: οὐκ ἰδοὺ ταῦτα πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου ὀπίσω ὁδὸν δυσμῶν ἡλίου ἐν γῇ Χανααν τὸ κατοικοῦν ἐπὶ δυσμῶν ἐχόμενον τοῦ Γολγολ πλησίον τῆς δρυὸς τῆς ὑψηλῆς

text_en: For you shall pass over the Jordan , to possess the land, which the Lord your God will give you, that you may have it and possess it.
text_la: Vos enim transibitis Jordanem, ut possideatis terram quam Dominus Deus vester daturus est vobis, ut habeatis et possideatis illam.
text_pt: Porque passareis o Jordão para entrardes a possuir a terra, que vos dá o Senhor vosso Deus; e a possuireis, e nela habitareis.
text_el: ὑμεῖς γὰρ διαβαίνετε τὸν Ιορδάνην εἰσελθόντες κληρονομῆσαι τὴν γῆν ἣν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν δίδωσιν ὑμῖν ἐν κλήρῳ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας καὶ κληρονομήσετε αὐτὴν καὶ κατοικήσετε ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: See therefore that you fulfil the ceremonies and judgments, which I shall set this day before you.
text_la: Videte ergo ut impleatis cæremonias atque judicia, quæ ego hodie ponam in conspectu vestro.
text_pt: Tende, pois, cuidado em cumprir todos os estatutos e os juízos, que eu hoje vos proponho.
text_el: καὶ φυλάξεσθε τοῦ ποιεῖν πάντα τὰ προστάγματα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰς κρίσεις ταύτας ὅσας ἐγὼ δίδωμι ἐνώπιον ὑμῶν σήμερον

text_en: These are the precepts and judgments, that you must do in the land, which the Lord the God of your fathers will give you, to possess it all the days that you shall walk upon the earth.
text_la: Hæc sunt præcepta atque judicia, quæ facere debetis in terra, quam Dominus Deus patrum tuorum daturus est tibi, ut possideas eam cunctis diebus, quibus super humum gradieris.
text_pt: Estes são os estatutos e os juízos que tereis cuidado em cumprir na terra que vos deu o SENHOR Deus de vossos pais, para a possuir todos os dias que viverdes sobre a terra.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ προστάγματα καὶ αἱ κρίσεις ἃς φυλάξετε τοῦ ποιεῖν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἧς κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν δίδωσιν ὑμῖν ἐν κλήρῳ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ἃς ὑμεῖς ζῆτε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: Destroy all the places in which the nations , that you shall possess, worshipped their gods upon high mountains, and hills, and under every shady tree:
text_la: Subvertite omnia loca, in quibus coluerunt gentes, quas possessuri estis, deos suos super montes excelsos, et colles, et subter omne lignum frondosum.
text_pt: Totalmente destruireis todos os lugares, onde as nações que possuireis serviram os seus deuses, sobre as altas montanhas, e sobre os outeiros, e debaixo de toda a árvore frondosa;
text_el: ἀπωλείᾳ ἀπολεῖτε πάντας τοὺς τόπους ἐν οἷς ἐλάτρευσαν ἐκεῖ τοῖς θεοῖς αὐτῶν οὓς ὑμεῖς κληρονομεῖτε αὐτούς ἐπὶ τῶν ὀρέων τῶν ὑψηλῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν θινῶν καὶ ὑποκάτω δένδρου δασέος

text_en: Overthrow their altars , and break down their statues , burn their groves with fire, and break their idols in pieces: destroy their names out of those places.
text_la: Dissipate aras eorum, et confringite statuas : lucos igne comburite, et idola comminuite : disperdite nomina eorum de locis illis.
text_pt: E derrubareis os seus altares, e quebrareis as suas estátuas, e os seus bosques queimareis a fogo, e destruireis as imagens esculpidas dos seus deuses, e apagareis o seu nome daquele lugar.
text_el: καὶ κατασκάψετε τοὺς βωμοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ συντρίψετε τὰς στήλας αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ ἄλση αὐτῶν ἐκκόψετε καὶ τὰ γλυπτὰ τῶν θεῶν αὐτῶν κατακαύσετε πυρί καὶ ἀπολεῖται τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῶν ἐκ τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου

text_en: You shall not do so to the Lord your God :
text_la: Non facietis ita Domino Deo vestro:
text_pt: Assim não fareis ao Senhor vosso Deus;
text_el: οὐ ποιήσετε οὕτως κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ ὑμῶν

text_en: But you shall come to the place, which the Lord your God shall choose out of all your tribes , to put his name there, and to dwell in it:
text_la: sed ad locum, quem elegerit Dominus Deus vester de cunctis tribubus vestris, ut ponat nomen suum ibi, et habitet in eo, venietis:
text_pt: Mas o lugar que o Senhor vosso Deus escolher de todas as vossas tribos, para ali pôr o seu nome, buscareis, para sua habitação, e ali vireis.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἢ εἰς τὸν τόπον ὃν ἂν ἐκλέξηται κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν ἐν μιᾷ τῶν φυλῶν ὑμῶν ἐπονομάσαι τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐκεῖ ἐπικληθῆναι καὶ ἐκζητήσετε καὶ εἰσελεύσεσθε ἐκεῖ

text_en: And you shall offer in that place your holocausts and victims, the tithes and firstfruits of your hands and your vows and gifts, the firstborn of your herds and your sheep.
text_la: et offeretis in loco illo holocausta et victimas vestras, decimas et primitias manuum vestrarum, et vota atque donaria, primogenita boum et ovium.
text_pt: E ali trareis os vossos holocaustos, e os vossos sacrifícios, e os vossos dízimos, e a oferta alçada da vossa mão, e os vossos votos, e as vossas ofertas voluntárias, e os primogênitos das vossas vacas e das vossas ovelhas.
text_el: καὶ οἴσετε ἐκεῖ τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματα ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ θυσιάσματα ὑμῶν καὶ τὰς ἀπαρχὰς ὑμῶν καὶ τὰς εὐχὰς ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ ἑκούσια ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ πρωτότοκα τῶν βοῶν ὑμῶν καὶ τῶν προβάτων ὑμῶν

text_en: And you shall eat there in the sight of the Lord your God : and you shall rejoice in all things, whereunto you shall put your hand, you and your houses wherein the Lord your God has blessed you.
text_la: Et comedetis ibi in conspectu Domini Dei vestri : ac lætabimini in cunctis, ad quæ miseritis manum vos et domus vestræ, in quibus benedixerit vobis Dominus Deus vester.
text_pt: E ali comereis perante o Senhor vosso Deus, e vos alegrareis em tudo em que puserdes a vossa mão, vós e as vossas casas, no que abençoar o Senhor vosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ φάγεσθε ἐκεῖ ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν καὶ εὐφρανθήσεσθε ἐπὶ πᾶσιν οὗ ἂν τὴν χεῖρα ἐπιβάλητε ὑμεῖς καὶ οἱ οἶκοι ὑμῶν καθότι εὐλόγησέν σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου

text_en: You shall not do there the things we do here this day, every man that which seems good to himself.
text_la: Non facietis ibi quæ nos hic facimus hodie, singuli quod sibi rectum videtur:
text_pt: Não fareis conforme a tudo o que hoje fazemos aqui, cada qual tudo o que bem parece aos seus olhos.
text_el: οὐ ποιήσετε πάντα ἃ ἡμεῖς ποιοῦμεν ὧδε σήμερον ἕκαστος τὸ ἀρεστὸν ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ

text_en: For until this present time you are not come to rest, and to the possession, which the Lord your God will give you.
text_la: neque enim usque in præsens tempus venistis ad requiem, et possessionem, quam Dominus Deus vester daturus est vobis.
text_pt: Porque até agora não entrastes no descanso e na herança que vos dá o Senhor vosso Deus.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ ἥκατε ἕως τοῦ νῦν εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσιν καὶ εἰς τὴν κληρονομίαν ἣν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν δίδωσιν ὑμῖν

text_en: You shall pass over the Jordan , and shall dwell in the land which the Lord your God will give you, that you may have rest from all enemies round about: and may dwell without any fear,
text_la: Transibitis Jordanem, et habitabitis in terra, quam Dominus Deus vester daturus est vobis, ut requiescatis a cunctis hostibus per circuitum : et absque ullo timore habitetis
text_pt: Mas passareis o Jordão, e habitareis na terra que vos fará herdar o Senhor vosso Deus; e vos dará repouso de todos os vossos inimigos em redor, e morareis seguros.
text_el: καὶ διαβήσεσθε τὸν Ιορδάνην καὶ κατοικήσετε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἧς κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν κατακληρονομεῖ ὑμῖν καὶ καταπαύσει ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐχθρῶν ὑμῶν τῶν κύκλῳ καὶ κατοικήσετε μετὰ ἀσφαλείας

text_en: in the place, which the Lord your God shall choose, that his name may be therein. Thither shall you bring all the things that I command you, holocausts , and victims, and tithes , and the firstfruits of your hands: and whatsoever is the choicest in the gifts which you shall vow to the Lord .
text_la: in loco, quem elegerit Dominus Deus vester, ut sit nomen ejus in eo : illuc omnia, quæ præcipio, conferetis, holocausta, et hostias, ac decimas, et primitias manuum vestrarum : et quidquid præcipuum est in muneribus, quæ vovebitis Domino.
text_pt: Então haverá um lugar que escolherá o Senhor vosso Deus para ali fazer habitar o seu nome; ali trareis tudo o que vos ordeno; os vossos holocaustos, e os vossos sacrifícios, e os vossos dízimos, e a oferta alçada da vossa mão, e toda a escolha dos vossos votos que fizerdes ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὁ τόπος ὃν ἂν ἐκλέξηται κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν ἐπικληθῆναι τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐκεῖ ἐκεῖ οἴσετε πάντα ὅσα ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαι ὑμῖν σήμερον τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματα ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ θυσιάσματα ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ ἐπιδέκατα ὑμῶν καὶ τὰς ἀπαρχὰς τῶν χειρῶν ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ δόματα ὑμῶν καὶ πᾶν ἐκλεκτὸν τῶν δώρων ὑμῶν ὅσα ἐὰν εὔξησθε τῷ θεῷ ὑμῶν

text_en: There shall you feast before the Lord your God , you and your sons and your daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite that dwells in your cities. For he has no other part and possession among you.
text_la: Ibi epulabimini coram Domino Deo vestro, vos et filii ac filiæ vestræ, famuli et famulæ, atque Levites qui in urbibus vestris commoratur : neque enim habet aliam partem et possessionem inter vos.
text_pt: E vos alegrareis perante o Senhor vosso Deus, vós, e vossos filhos, e vossas filhas, e os vossos servos, e as vossas servas, e o levita que está dentro das vossas portas; pois convosco não tem parte nem herança.
text_el: καὶ εὐφρανθήσεσθε ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν ὑμεῖς καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες ὑμῶν οἱ παῖδες ὑμῶν καὶ αἱ παιδίσκαι ὑμῶν καὶ ὁ Λευίτης ὁ ἐπὶ τῶν πυλῶν ὑμῶν ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτῷ μερὶς οὐδὲ κλῆρος μεθ' ὑμῶν

text_en: Beware lest you offer your holocausts in every place that you shall see:
text_la: Cave ne offeras holocausta tua in omni loco, quem videris:
text_pt: Guarda-te, que não ofereças os teus holocaustos em todo o lugar que vires;
text_el: πρόσεχε σεαυτῷ μὴ ἀνενέγκῃς τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματά σου ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ οὗ ἐὰν ἴδῃς

text_en: But in the place which the Lord shall choose in one of your tribes shall you offer sacrifices , and shall do all that I command you.
text_la: sed in eo, quem elegerit Dominus, in una tribuum tuarum offeres hostias, et facies quæcumque præcipio tibi.
text_pt: Mas no lugar que o Senhor escolher numa das tuas tribos ali oferecerás os teus holocaustos, e ali farás tudo o que te ordeno.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἢ εἰς τὸν τόπον ὃν ἂν ἐκλέξηται κύριος ὁ θεός σου αὐτὸν ἐν μιᾷ τῶν φυλῶν σου ἐκεῖ ἀνοίσεις τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματά σου καὶ ἐκεῖ ποιήσεις πάντα ὅσα ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον

text_en: But if you desire to eat, and the eating of flesh delight you, kill, and eat according to the blessing of the Lord your God , which he has given you, in your cities: whether it be unclean , that is to say, having blemish or defect: or clean , that is to say, sound and without blemish, such as may be offered, as the roe, and the hart, shall you eat it:
text_la: Sin autem comedere volueris, et te esus carnium delectaverit, occide, comede juxta benedictionem Domini Dei tui, quam dedit tibi in urbibus tuis : sive immundum fuerit, hoc est, maculatum et debile : sive mundum, hoc est, integrum et sine macula, quod offerri licet, sicut capream et cervum, comedes:
text_pt: Porém, conforme a todo o desejo da tua alma, matarás e comerás carne, dentro das tuas portas, segundo a bênção do Senhor teu Deus, que te dá em todas as tuas portas; o imundo e o limpo dela comerá, como do corço e do veado;
text_el: ἀλλ' ἢ ἐν πάσῃ ἐπιθυμίᾳ σου θύσεις καὶ φάγῃ κρέα κατὰ τὴν εὐλογίαν κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου ἣν ἔδωκέν σοι ἐν πάσῃ πόλει ὁ ἀκάθαρτος ἐν σοὶ καὶ ὁ καθαρὸς ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ φάγεται αὐτὸ ὡς δορκάδα ἢ ἔλαφον

text_en: Only the blood you shall not eat, but you shall pour it out upon the earth as water.
text_la: absque esu dumtaxat sanguinis, quem super terram quasi aquam effundes.
text_pt: Tão-somente o sangue não comereis; sobre a terra o derramareis como água.
text_el: πλὴν τὸ αἷμα οὐ φάγεσθε ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἐκχεεῖτε αὐτὸ ὡς ὕδωρ

text_en: You may not eat in your towns the tithes of your corn, and your wine, and your oil, the firstborn of your herds and your cattle, nor anything that you vow , and that you will offer voluntarily, and the firstfruits of your hands:
text_la: Non poteris comedere in oppidis tuis decimam frumenti, et vini, et olei tui, primogenita armentorum et pecorum, et omnia quæ voveris, et sponte offerre volueris, et primitias manuum tuarum:
text_pt: Dentro das tuas portas não poderás comer o dízimo do teu grão, nem do teu mosto, nem do teu azeite, nem os primogênitos das tuas vacas, nem das tuas ovelhas; nem nenhum dos teus votos, que houveres prometido, nem as tuas ofertas voluntárias, nem a oferta alçada da tua mão.
text_el: οὐ δυνήσῃ φαγεῖν ἐν ταῖς πόλεσίν σου τὸ ἐπιδέκατον τοῦ σίτου σου καὶ τοῦ οἴνου σου καὶ τοῦ ἐλαίου σου τὰ πρωτότοκα τῶν βοῶν σου καὶ τῶν προβάτων σου καὶ πάσας εὐχάς ὅσας ἂν εὔξησθε καὶ τὰς ὁμολογίας ὑμῶν καὶ τὰς ἀπαρχὰς τῶν χειρῶν ὑμῶν

text_en: But you shall eat them before the Lord your God in the place which the Lord your God shall choose, you and your son and your daughter, and your manservant, and maidservant, and the Levite that dwells in your cities: and you shall rejoice and be refreshed before the Lord your God in all things, whereunto you shall put your hand.
text_la: sed coram Domino Deo tuo comedes ea in loco, quem elegerit Dominus Deus tuus, tu et filius tuus, et filia tua, et servus et famula, atque Levites qui manet in urbibus tuis : et lætaberis et reficieris coram Domino Deo tuo in cunctis ad quæ extenderis manum tuam.
text_pt: Mas os comerás perante o Senhor teu Deus, no lugar que escolher o Senhor teu Deus, tu, e teu filho, e a tua filha, e o teu servo, e a tua serva, e o levita que está dentro das tuas portas; e perante o Senhor teu Deus te alegrarás em tudo em que puseres a tua mão.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἢ ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου φάγῃ αὐτὰ ἐν τῷ τόπῳ ᾧ ἂν ἐκλέξηται κύριος ὁ θεός σου αὐτῷ σὺ καὶ ὁ υἱός σου καὶ ἡ θυγάτηρ σου ὁ παῖς σου καὶ ἡ παιδίσκη σου καὶ ὁ προσήλυτος ὁ ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν ὑμῶν καὶ εὐφρανθήσῃ ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου ἐπὶ πάντα οὗ ἂν ἐπιβάλῃς τὴν χεῖρά σου

text_en: Take heed not to forsake the Levite all the time that you live in the land.
text_la: Cave ne derelinquas Levitem in omni tempore quo versaris in terra.
text_pt: Guarda-te, que não desampares ao levita todos os teus dias na terra.
text_el: πρόσεχε σεαυτῷ μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃς τὸν Λευίτην πάντα τὸν χρόνον ὅσον ἐὰν ζῇς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: When the Lord your God shall have enlarged your borders, as he has spoken to you, and you will eat the flesh that your soul desires:
text_la: Quando dilataverit Dominus Deus tuus terminos tuos, sicut locutus est tibi, et volueris vesci carnibus, quas desiderat anima tua:
text_pt: Quando o Senhor teu Deus dilatar os teus termos, como te disse, e disseres: Comerei carne; porquanto a tua alma tem desejo de comer carne; conforme a todo o desejo da tua alma, comerás carne.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐμπλατύνῃ κύριος ὁ θεός σου τὰ ὅριά σου καθάπερ ἐλάλησέν σοι καὶ ἐρεῖς φάγομαι κρέα ἐὰν ἐπιθυμήσῃ ἡ ψυχή σου ὥστε φαγεῖν κρέα ἐν πάσῃ ἐπιθυμίᾳ τῆς ψυχῆς σου φάγῃ κρέα

text_en: And if the place which the Lord your God shall choose, that his name should be there, be far off, you shall kill of your herds and of your flocks, as I have commanded you, and shall eat in your towns, as it pleases you.
text_la: locus autem, quem elegerit Dominus Deus tuus ut sit nomen ejus ibi, si procul fuerit, occides de armentis et pecoribus, quæ habueris, sicut præcepi tibi, et comedes in oppidis tuis, ut tibi placet.
text_pt: Se estiver longe de ti o lugar que o Senhor teu Deus escolher, para ali pôr o seu nome, então matarás das tuas vacas e das tuas ovelhas, que o Senhor te tiver dado, como te tenho ordenado; e comerás dentro das tuas portas, conforme a todo o desejo da tua alma.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μακρότερον ἀπέχῃ σου ὁ τόπος ὃν ἂν ἐκλέξηται κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐπικληθῆναι τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐκεῖ καὶ θύσεις ἀπὸ τῶν βοῶν σου καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν προβάτων σου ὧν ἂν δῷ ὁ θεός σοι ὃν τρόπον ἐνετειλάμην σοι καὶ φάγῃ ἐν ταῖς πόλεσίν σου κατὰ τὴν ἐπιθυμίαν τῆς ψυχῆς σου

text_en: Even as the roe and the hart is eaten, so shall you eat them: both the clean and unclean shall eat of them alike.
text_la: Sicut comeditur caprea et cervus, ita vesceris eis : et mundus et immundus in commune vescentur.
text_pt: Porém, como se come o corço e o veado, assim comerás; o imundo e o limpo também comerão deles.
text_el: ὡς ἔσθεται ἡ δορκὰς καὶ ἡ ἔλαφος οὕτως φάγῃ αὐτό ὁ ἀκάθαρτος ἐν σοὶ καὶ ὁ καθαρὸς ὡσαύτως ἔδεται

text_en: Only beware of this, that you eat not the blood, for the blood is for the soul : and therefore you must not eat the soul with the flesh:
text_la: Hoc solum cave, ne sanguinem comedas : sanguis enim eorum pro anima est, et idcirco non debes animam comedere cum carnibus:
text_pt: Somente esforça-te para que não comas o sangue; pois o sangue é vida; pelo que não comerás a vida com a carne;
text_el: πρόσεχε ἰσχυρῶς τοῦ μὴ φαγεῖν αἷμα ὅτι τὸ αἷμα αὐτοῦ ψυχή οὐ βρωθήσεται ἡ ψυχὴ μετὰ τῶν κρεῶν

text_en: But you shall pour it upon the earth as water,
text_la: sed super terram fundes quasi aquam,
text_pt: Não o comerás; na terra o derramarás como água.
text_el: οὐ φάγεσθε ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἐκχεεῖτε αὐτὸ ὡς ὕδωρ

text_en: that it may be well with you and your children after you, when you shall do that which is pleasing in the sight of the Lord .
text_la: ut bene sit tibi et filiis tuis post te, cum feceris quod placet in conspectu Domini.
text_pt: Não o comerás; para que bem te suceda a ti, e a teus filhos, depois de ti, quando fizeres o que for reto aos olhos do Senhor.
text_el: οὐ φάγῃ αὐτό ἵνα εὖ σοι γένηται καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς σου μετὰ σέ ἐὰν ποιήσῃς τὸ καλὸν καὶ τὸ ἀρεστὸν ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου

text_en: But the things which you have sanctified and vowed to the Lord , you shall take, and shall come to the place which the Lord shall choose:
text_la: Quæ autem sanctificaveris, et voveris Domino, tolles, et venies ad locum, quem elegerit Dominus:
text_pt: Porém, as coisas santas que tiveres, e os teus votos tomarás, e virás ao lugar que o Senhor escolher.
text_el: πλὴν τὰ ἅγιά σου ἐὰν γένηταί σοι καὶ τὰς εὐχάς σου λαβὼν ἥξεις εἰς τὸν τόπον ὃν ἂν ἐκλέξηται κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐπικληθῆναι τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐκεῖ

text_en: And shall offer your oblations , the flesh and the blood upon the altar of the Lord your God : the blood of your victims you shall pour on the altar : and the flesh you yourself shall eat.
text_la: et offeres oblationes tuas carnem et sanguinem super altare Domini Dei tui : sanguinem hostiarum fundes in altari; carnibus autem ipse vesceris.
text_pt: E oferecerás os teus holocaustos, a carne e o sangue sobre o altar do Senhor teu Deus; e o sangue dos teus sacrifícios se derramará sobre o altar do Senhor teu Deus; porém a carne comerás.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματά σου τὰ κρέα ἀνοίσεις ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου τὸ δὲ αἷμα τῶν θυσιῶν σου προσχεεῖς πρὸς τὴν βάσιν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου τὰ δὲ κρέα φάγῃ

text_en: Observe and hear all the things that I command you, that it may be well with you and your children after you for ever, when you shall do what is good and pleasing in the sight of the Lord your God .
text_la: Observa et audi omnia quæ ego præcipio tibi, ut bene sit tibi et filiis tuis post te in sempiternum, cum feceris quod bonum est et placitum in conspectu Domini Dei tui.
text_pt: Guarda e ouve todas estas palavras que te ordeno, para que bem te suceda a ti e a teus filhos depois de ti para sempre, quando fizeres o que for bom e reto aos olhos do Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: φυλάσσου καὶ ἄκουε καὶ ποιήσεις πάντας τοὺς λόγους οὓς ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι ἵνα εὖ σοι γένηται καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς σου δι' αἰῶνος ἐὰν ποιήσῃς τὸ καλὸν καὶ τὸ ἀρεστὸν ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου

text_en: When the Lord your God shall have destroyed before your face the nations , which you shall go in to possess, and when you shall possess them, and dwell in their land:
text_la: Quando disperdiderit Dominus Deus tuus ante faciem tuam gentes, ad quas ingredieris possidendas, et possederis eas, atque habitaveris in terra earum:
text_pt: Quando o Senhor teu Deus desarraigar de diante de ti as nações, aonde vais a possuí-las, e as possuíres e habitares na sua terra,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐξολεθρεύσῃ κύριος ὁ θεός σου τὰ ἔθνη εἰς οὓς σὺ εἰσπορεύῃ ἐκεῖ κληρονομῆσαι τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν ἀπὸ προσώπου σου καὶ κατακληρονομήσῃς αὐτοὺς καὶ κατοικήσῃς ἐν τῇ γῇ αὐτῶν

text_en: Beware lest you imitate them, after they are destroyed at your coming in, and lest you seek after their ceremonies , saying: As these nations have worshipped their gods , so will I also worship .
text_la: cave ne imiteris eas, postquam te fuerint introëunte subversæ, et requiras cæremonias earum, dicens : Sicut coluerunt gentes istæ deos suos, ita et ego colam.
text_pt: Guarda-te, que não te enlaces seguindo-as, depois que forem destruídas diante de ti; e que não perguntes acerca dos seus deuses, dizendo: Assim como serviram estas nações os seus deuses, do mesmo modo também farei eu.
text_el: πρόσεχε σεαυτῷ μὴ ἐκζητήσῃς ἐπακολουθῆσαι αὐτοῖς μετὰ τὸ ἐξολεθρευθῆναι αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ προσώπου σου οὐ μὴ ἐκζητήσῃς τοὺς θεοὺς αὐτῶν λέγων πῶς ποιοῦσιν τὰ ἔθνη ταῦτα τοῖς θεοῖς αὐτῶν ποιήσω κἀγώ

text_en: You shall not do in like manner to the Lord your God . For they have done to their gods all the abominations which the Lord abhors, offering their sons and daughters, and burning them with fire.
text_la: Non facies similiter Domino Deo tuo. Omnes enim abominationes, quas aversatur Dominus, fecerunt diis suis, offerentes filios et filias, et comburentes igni.
text_pt: Assim não farás ao Senhor teu Deus; porque tudo o que é abominável ao Senhor, e que ele odeia, fizeram eles a seus deuses; pois até seus filhos e suas filhas queimaram no fogo aos seus deuses.
text_el: οὐ ποιήσεις οὕτως κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σου τὰ γὰρ βδελύγματα ἃ κύριος ἐμίσησεν ἐποίησαν τοῖς θεοῖς αὐτῶν ὅτι τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῶν κατακαίουσιν ἐν πυρὶ τοῖς θεοῖς αὐτῶν

text_en: What I command you, that only do to the Lord : neither add anything, nor diminish.
text_la: Quod præcipio tibi, hoc tantum facito Domino : nec addas quidquam, nec minuas.
text_pt: Quando profeta ou sonhador de sonhos se levantar no meio de ti, e te der um sinal ou prodígio,
text_el: πᾶν ῥῆμα ὃ ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον τοῦτο φυλάξῃ ποιεῖν οὐ προσθήσεις ἐπ' αὐτὸ οὐδὲ ἀφελεῖς ἀπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: If there rise in the midst of you a prophet or one that says he has dreamed a dream , and he foretell a sign and a wonder ,
text_la: Si surrexerit in medio tui prophetes, aut qui somnium vidisse se dicat, et prædixerit signum atque portentum,
text_pt: E suceder o tal sinal ou prodígio, de que te houver falado, dizendo: Vamos após outros deuses, que não conheceste, e sirvamo-los;
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἀναστῇ ἐν σοὶ προφήτης ἢ ἐνυπνιαζόμενος ἐνύπνιον καὶ δῷ σοι σημεῖον ἢ τέρας

text_en: and that come to pass which he spoke, and he say to you: Let us go and follow strange gods , which you know not, and let us serve them:
text_la: et evenerit quod locutus est, et dixerit tibi : Eamus, et sequamur deos alienos quos ignoras, et serviamus eis:
text_pt: Não ouvirás as palavras daquele profeta ou sonhador de sonhos; porquanto o Senhor vosso Deus vos prova, para saber se amais o Senhor vosso Deus com todo o vosso coração, e com toda a vossa alma.
text_el: καὶ ἔλθῃ τὸ σημεῖον ἢ τὸ τέρας ὃ ἐλάλησεν πρὸς σὲ λέγων πορευθῶμεν καὶ λατρεύσωμεν θεοῖς ἑτέροις οὓς οὐκ οἴδατε

text_en: You shall not hear the words of that prophet or dreamer: for the Lord your God tries you, that it may appear whether you love him with all your heart, and with all your soul , or not.
text_la: non audies verba prophetæ illius aut somniatoris : quia tentat vos Dominus Deus vester, ut palam fiat utrum diligatis eum an non, in toto corde, et in tota anima vestra.
text_pt: Após o Senhor vosso Deus andareis, e a ele temereis, e os seus mandamentos guardareis, e a sua voz ouvireis, e a ele servireis, e a ele vos achegareis.
text_el: οὐκ ἀκούσεσθε τῶν λόγων τοῦ προφήτου ἐκείνου ἢ τοῦ ἐνυπνιαζομένου τὸ ἐνύπνιον ἐκεῖνο ὅτι πειράζει κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμᾶς εἰδέναι εἰ ἀγαπᾶτε κύριον τὸν θεὸν ὑμῶν ἐξ ὅλης τῆς καρδίας ὑμῶν καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς ψυχῆς ὑμῶν

text_en: Follow the Lord your God , and fear him, and keep his commandments , and hear his voice: him you shall serve, and to him you shall cleave.
text_la: Dominum Deum vestrum sequimini, et ipsum timete, et mandata illius custodite, et audite vocem ejus : ipsi servietis, et ipsi adhærebitis.
text_pt: E aquele profeta ou sonhador de sonhos morrerá, pois falou rebeldia contra o Senhor vosso Deus, que vos tirou da terra do Egito, e vos resgatou da casa da servidão, para te apartar do caminho que te ordenou o Senhor teu Deus, para andares nele: assim tirarás o mal do meio de ti.
text_el: ὀπίσω κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν πορεύεσθε καὶ αὐτὸν φοβηθήσεσθε καὶ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ φυλάξεσθε καὶ τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσεσθε καὶ αὐτῷ προστεθήσεσθε

text_en: And that prophet or forger of dreams shall be slain: because he spoke to draw you away from the Lord your God , who brought you out of the land of Egypt , and redeemed you from the house of bondage : to make you go out of the way, which the Lord your God commanded you: and you shall take away the evil out of the midst of you.
text_la: Propheta autem ille aut fictor somniorum interficietur : quia locutus est ut vos averteret a Domino Deo vestro, qui eduxit vos de terra Ægypti, et redemit vos de domo servitutis : ut errare te faceret de via, quam tibi præcepit Dominus Deus tuus : et auferes malum de medio tui.
text_pt: Quando te incitar teu irmão, filho da tua mãe, ou teu filho, ou tua filha, ou a mulher do teu seio, ou teu amigo, que te é como a tua alma, dizendo-te em segredo: Vamos, e sirvamos a outros deuses que não conheceste, nem tu nem teus pais;
text_el: καὶ ὁ προφήτης ἐκεῖνος ἢ ὁ τὸ ἐνύπνιον ἐνυπνιαζόμενος ἐκεῖνος ἀποθανεῖται ἐλάλησεν γὰρ πλανῆσαί σε ἀπὸ κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου τοῦ ἐξαγαγόντος σε ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου τοῦ λυτρωσαμένου σε ἐκ τῆς δουλείας ἐξῶσαί σε ἐκ τῆς ὁδοῦ ἧς ἐνετείλατό σοι κύριος ὁ θεός σου πορεύεσθαι ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ ἀφανιεῖς τὸν πονηρὸν ἐξ ὑμῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: If your brother the son of your mother, or your son, or daughter, or your wife that is in your bosom, or your friend, whom you love as your own soul , would persuade you secretly, saying: Let us go, and serve strange gods , which you know not, nor your fathers,
text_la: Si tibi voluerit persuadere frater tuus filius matris tuæ, aut filius tuus vel filia, sive uxor quæ est in sinu tuo, aut amicus, quem diligis ut animam tuam, clam dicens : Eamus, et serviamus diis alienis, quos ignoras tu, et patres tui,
text_pt: Dentre os deuses dos povos que estão em redor de vós, perto ou longe de ti, desde uma extremidade da terra até à outra extremidade;
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ παρακαλέσῃ σε ὁ ἀδελφός σου ἐκ πατρός σου ἢ ἐκ μητρός σου ἢ ὁ υἱός σου ἢ ἡ θυγάτηρ σου ἢ ἡ γυνὴ ἡ ἐν κόλπῳ σου ἢ ὁ φίλος ὁ ἴσος τῆς ψυχῆς σου λάθρᾳ λέγων βαδίσωμεν καὶ λατρεύσωμεν θεοῖς ἑτέροις οὓς οὐκ ᾔδεις σὺ καὶ οἱ πατέρες σου

text_en: of all the nations round about, that are near or afar off, from one end of the earth to the other,
text_la: cunctarum in circuitu gentium, quæ juxta vel procul sunt, ab initio usque ad finem terræ,
text_pt: Não consentirás com ele, nem o ouvirás; nem o teu olho o poupará, nem terás piedade dele, nem o esconderás;
text_el: ἀπὸ τῶν θεῶν τῶν ἐθνῶν τῶν περικύκλῳ ὑμῶν τῶν ἐγγιζόντων σοι ἢ τῶν μακρὰν ἀπὸ σοῦ ἀπ' ἄκρου τῆς γῆς ἕως ἄκρου τῆς γῆς

text_en: consent not to him, hear him not, neither let your eye spare him to pity and conceal him,
text_la: non acquiescas ei, nec audias, neque parcat ei oculus tuus ut miserearis et occultes eum,
text_pt: Mas certamente o matarás; a tua mão será a primeira contra ele, para o matar; e depois a mão de todo o povo.
text_el: οὐ συνθελήσεις αὐτῷ καὶ οὐκ εἰσακούσῃ αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐ φείσεται ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου ἐπ' αὐτῷ οὐκ ἐπιποθήσεις ἐπ' αὐτῷ οὐδ' οὐ μὴ σκεπάσῃς αὐτόν

text_en: but you shall presently put him to death . Let your hand be first upon him, and afterwards the hands of all the people.
text_la: sed statim interficies : sit primum manus tua super eum, et postea omnis populus mittat manum.
text_pt: E o apedrejarás, até que morra, pois te procurou apartar do Senhor teu Deus, que te tirou da terra do Egito, da casa da servidão;
text_el: ἀναγγέλλων ἀναγγελεῖς περὶ αὐτοῦ αἱ χεῖρές σου ἔσονται ἐπ' αὐτὸν ἐν πρώτοις ἀποκτεῖναι αὐτόν καὶ αἱ χεῖρες παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ ἐπ' ἐσχάτῳ

text_en: With stones shall he be stoned to death : because he would have withdrawn you from the Lord your God , who brought you out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage :
text_la: Lapidibus obrutus necabitur : quia voluit te abstrahere a Domino Deo tuo, qui eduxit te de terra Ægypti, de domo servitutis:
text_pt: Para que todo o Israel o ouça e o tema, e não torne a fazer semelhante maldade no meio de ti.
text_el: καὶ λιθοβολήσουσιν αὐτὸν ἐν λίθοις καὶ ἀποθανεῖται ὅτι ἐζήτησεν ἀποστῆσαί σε ἀπὸ κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου τοῦ ἐξαγαγόντος σε ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ἐξ οἴκου δουλείας

text_en: That all Israel hearing may fear, and may do no more anything like this.
text_la: ut omnis Israël audiens timeat, et nequaquam ultra faciat quippiam hujus rei simile.
text_pt: Quando ouvires dizer, de alguma das tuas cidades que o Senhor teu Deus te dá para ali habitar:
text_el: καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ ἀκούσας φοβηθήσεται καὶ οὐ προσθήσουσιν ἔτι ποιῆσαι κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμα τὸ πονηρὸν τοῦτο ἐν ὑμῖν

text_en: If in one of your cities, which the Lord your God shall give you to dwell in, you hear some say:
text_la: Si audieris in una urbium tuarum, quas Dominus Deus tuus dabit tibi ad habitandum, dicentes aliquos:
text_pt: Uns homens, filhos de Belial, que saíram do meio de ti, incitaram os moradores da sua cidade, dizendo: Vamos, e sirvamos a outros deuses que não conhecestes;
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἀκούσῃς ἐν μιᾷ τῶν πόλεών σου ὧν κύριος ὁ θεός σου δίδωσίν σοι κατοικεῖν σε ἐκεῖ λεγόντων

text_en: Children of Belial have gone out of the midst of you, and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city, and have said: Let us go, and serve strange gods which you know not:
text_la: Egressi sunt filii Belial de medio tui, et averterunt habitatores urbis suæ, atque dixerunt : Eamus, et serviamus diis alienis quos ignoratis:
text_pt: Então inquirirás e investigarás, e com diligência perguntarás; e eis que, sendo verdade, e certo que se fez tal abominação no meio de ti;
text_el: ἐξήλθοσαν ἄνδρες παράνομοι ἐξ ὑμῶν καὶ ἀπέστησαν πάντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν πόλιν αὐτῶν λέγοντες πορευθῶμεν καὶ λατρεύσωμεν θεοῖς ἑτέροις οὓς οὐκ ᾔδειτε

text_en: Inquire carefully and diligently, the truth of the thing by looking well into it, and if you find that which is said to be certain, and that this abomination has been really committed,
text_la: quare sollicite et diligenter, rei veritate perspecta, si inveneris certum esse quod dicitur, et abominationem hanc opere perpetratam,
text_pt: Certamente ferirás, ao fio da espada, os moradores daquela cidade, destruindo a ela e a tudo o que nela houver, até os animais.
text_el: καὶ ἐρωτήσεις καὶ ἐραυνήσεις σφόδρα καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀληθὴς σαφῶς ὁ λόγος γεγένηται τὸ βδέλυγμα τοῦτο ἐν ὑμῖν

text_en: you shall forthwith kill the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, and shall destroy it and all things that are in it, even the cattle.
text_la: statim percuties habitatores urbis illius in ore gladii, et delebis eam ac omnia quæ in illa sunt, usque ad pecora.
text_pt: E ajuntarás todo o seu despojo no meio da sua praça; e a cidade e todo o seu despojo queimarás totalmente para o Senhor teu Deus, e será montão perpétuo, nunca mais se edificará.
text_el: ἀναιρῶν ἀνελεῖς πάντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν τῇ πόλει ἐκείνῃ ἐν φόνῳ μαχαίρας ἀναθέματι ἀναθεματιεῖτε αὐτὴν καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: And all the household goods that are there, you shall gather together in the midst of the streets thereof, and shall burn them with the city itself, so as to consume all for the Lord your God , and that it be a heap for ever: it shall be built no more.
text_la: Quidquid etiam supellectilis fuerit, congregabis in medio platearum ejus, et cum ipsa civitate succendes, ita ut universa consumas Domino Deo tuo, et sit tumulus sempiternus. Non ædificabitur amplius,
text_pt: Também não se pegará à tua mão nada do anátema, para que o Senhor se aparte do ardor da sua ira, e te faça misericórdia, e tenha piedade de ti, e te multiplique, como jurou a teus pais;
text_el: καὶ πάντα τὰ σκῦλα αὐτῆς συνάξεις εἰς τὰς διόδους αὐτῆς καὶ ἐμπρήσεις τὴν πόλιν ἐν πυρὶ καὶ πάντα τὰ σκῦλα αὐτῆς πανδημεὶ ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου καὶ ἔσται ἀοίκητος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα οὐκ ἀνοικοδομηθήσεται ἔτι

text_en: And there shall nothing of that anathema stick to your hand: that the Lord may turn from the wrath of his fury, and may have mercy on you, and multiply you as he swore to your fathers,
text_la: et non adhærebit de illo anathemate quidquam in manu tua : ut avertatur Dominus ab ira furoris sui, et misereatur tui, multiplicetque te sicut juravit patribus tuis,
text_pt: Quando ouvires a voz do Senhor teu Deus, para guardares todos os seus mandamentos que hoje te ordeno; para fazeres o que for reto aos olhos do Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: οὐ προσκολληθήσεται ἐν τῇ χειρί σου οὐδὲν ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀναθέματος ἵνα ἀποστραφῇ κύριος ἀπὸ θυμοῦ τῆς ὀργῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ δώσει σοι ἔλεος καὶ ἐλεήσει σε καὶ πληθυνεῖ σε ὃν τρόπον ὤμοσεν κύριος τοῖς πατράσιν σου

text_en: when you shall hear the voice of the Lord your God , keeping all his precepts , which I command you this day, that you may do what is pleasing in the sight of the Lord your God .
text_la: quando audieris vocem Domini Dei tui custodiens omnia præcepta ejus, quæ ego præcipio tibi hodie, ut facias quod placitum est in conspectu Domini Dei tui.
text_el: ἐὰν ἀκούσῃς τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου φυλάσσειν πάσας τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ὅσας ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον ποιεῖν τὸ καλὸν καὶ τὸ ἀρεστὸν ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου

text_en: Be children of the Lord your God : you shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness for the dead;
text_la: Filii estote Domini Dei vestri : non vos incidetis, nec facietis calvitium super mortuo:
text_pt: Filhos sois do SENHOR vosso Deus; não vos dareis golpes, nem fareis calva entre vossos olhos por causa de algum morto.
text_el: υἱοί ἐστε κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν οὐ φοιβήσετε οὐκ ἐπιθήσετε φαλάκρωμα ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν ὑμῶν ἐπὶ νεκρῷ

text_en: because you are a holy people to the Lord your God : and he chose you to be his peculiar people of all nations that are upon the earth.
text_la: quoniam populus sanctus es Domino Deo tuo, et te elegit ut sis ei in populum peculiarem de cunctis gentibus, quæ sunt super terram.
text_pt: Porque és povo santo ao Senhor teu Deus; e o Senhor te escolheu, de todos os povos que há sobre a face da terra, para lhe seres o seu próprio povo.
text_el: ὅτι λαὸς ἅγιος εἶ κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σου καὶ σὲ ἐξελέξατο κύριος ὁ θεός σου γενέσθαι σε αὐτῷ λαὸν περιούσιον ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν τῶν ἐπὶ προσώπου τῆς γῆς

text_en: Eat not the things that are unclean .
text_la: Ne comedatis quæ immunda sunt.
text_pt: Nenhuma coisa abominável comereis.
text_el: οὐ φάγεσθε πᾶν βδέλυγμα

text_en: These are the beasts that you shall eat, the ox, and the sheep, and the goat,
text_la: Hoc est animal quod comedere debetis : bovem, et ovem, et capram,
text_pt: Estes são os animais que comereis: o boi, a ovelha, e a cabra.
text_el: ταῦτα τὰ κτήνη ἃ φάγεσθε μόσχον ἐκ βοῶν καὶ ἀμνὸν ἐκ προβάτων καὶ χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν

text_en: the hart and the roe, the buffle, the chamois, the pygarg, the wild goat, the camelopardalus.
text_la: cervum et capream, bubalum, tragelaphum, pygargum, orygem, camelopardalum.
text_pt: O veado e a corça, e o búfalo, e a cabra montês, e o texugo, e a camurça, e o gamo.
text_el: ἔλαφον καὶ δορκάδα καὶ βούβαλον καὶ τραγέλαφον καὶ πύγαργον ὄρυγα καὶ καμηλοπάρδαλιν

text_en: Every beast that divides the hoof in two parts, and chews the cud, you shall eat.
text_la: Omne animal, quod in duas partes findit ungulam, et ruminat, comedetis.
text_pt: Todo o animal que tem unhas fendidas, divididas em duas, que rumina, entre os animais, aquilo comereis.
text_el: πᾶν κτῆνος διχηλοῦν ὁπλὴν καὶ ὀνυχιστῆρας ὀνυχίζον δύο χηλῶν καὶ ἀνάγον μηρυκισμὸν ἐν τοῖς κτήνεσιν ταῦτα φάγεσθε

text_en: But of them that chew the cud, but divide not the hoof, you shall not eat, such as the camel, the hare, and the cherogril: because they chew the cud, but divide not the hoof, they shall be unclean to you.
text_la: De his autem, quæ ruminant, et ungulam non findunt, comedere non debetis, ut camelum, leporem, chœrogryllum : hæc, quia ruminant et non dividunt ungulam, immunda erunt vobis.
text_pt: Porém estes não comereis, dos que somente ruminam, ou que têm a unha fendida: o camelo, e a lebre, e o coelho, porque ruminam mas não têm a unha fendida; imundos vos serão.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα οὐ φάγεσθε ἀπὸ τῶν ἀναγόντων μηρυκισμὸν καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν διχηλούντων τὰς ὁπλὰς καὶ ὀνυχιζόντων ὀνυχιστῆρας τὸν κάμηλον καὶ δασύποδα καὶ χοιρογρύλλιον ὅτι ἀνάγουσιν μηρυκισμὸν καὶ ὁπλὴν οὐ διχηλοῦσιν ἀκάθαρτα ταῦτα ὑμῖν ἐστιν

text_en: The swine also, because it divides the hoof, but chews not the cud, shall be unclean , their flesh you shall not eat, and their carcasses you shall not touch.
text_la: Sus quoque, quoniam dividat ungulam et non ruminat, immunda erit. Carnibus eorum non vescemini, et cadavera non tangetis.
text_pt: Nem o porco, porque tem unha fendida, mas não rumina; imundo vos será; não comereis da carne destes, e não tocareis nos seus cadáveres.
text_el: καὶ τὸν ὗν ὅτι διχηλεῖ ὁπλὴν τοῦτο καὶ ὀνυχίζει ὄνυχας ὁπλῆς καὶ τοῦτο μηρυκισμὸν οὐ μαρυκᾶται ἀκάθαρτον τοῦτο ὑμῖν ἀπὸ τῶν κρεῶν αὐτῶν οὐ φάγεσθε καὶ τῶν θνησιμαίων αὐτῶν οὐχ ἅψεσθε

text_en: These shall you eat of all that abide in the waters: All that have fins and scales, you shall eat.
text_la: Hæc comedetis ex omnibus quæ morantur in aquis : quæ habent pinnulas et squamas, comedite:
text_pt: Isto comereis de tudo o que há nas águas; tudo o que tem barbatanas e escamas comereis.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα φάγεσθε ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐν τοῖς ὕδασιν πάντα ὅσα ἐστὶν ἐν αὐτοῖς πτερύγια καὶ λεπίδες φάγεσθε

text_en: Such as are without fins and scales, you shall not eat, because they are unclean .
text_la: quæ absque pinnulis et squamis sunt, ne comedatis, quia immunda sunt.
text_pt: Mas tudo o que não tiver barbatanas nem escamas não o comereis; imundo vos será.
text_el: καὶ πάντα ὅσα οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτοῖς πτερύγια καὶ λεπίδες οὐ φάγεσθε ἀκάθαρτα ὑμῖν ἐστιν

text_en: All birds that are clean you shall eat.
text_la: Omnes aves mundas comedite.
text_pt: Toda a ave limpa comereis.
text_el: πᾶν ὄρνεον καθαρὸν φάγεσθε

text_en: The unclean eat not: to wit, the eagle, and the grype, and the osprey,
text_la: Immundas ne comedatis : aquilam scilicet, et gryphem, et haliæetum,
text_pt: Porém estas são as que não comereis: a águia, e o quebrantosso, e o xofrango,
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα οὐ φάγεσθε ἀπ' αὐτῶν τὸν ἀετὸν καὶ τὸν γρύπα καὶ τὸν ἁλιαίετον

text_en: the ringtail, and the vulture, and the kite according to their kind:
text_la: ixion et vulturem ac milvum juxta genus suum:
text_pt: E o abutre, e o falcão, e o milhafre, segundo a sua espécie.
text_el: καὶ τὸν γύπα καὶ τὸν ἰκτῖνα καὶ τὰ ὅμοια αὐτῷ

text_en: And all of the raven's kind:
