text_en: If they receive it, and open the gates to you, all the people that are therein, shall be saved, and shall serve you paying tribute.
text_la: Si receperit, et aperuerit tibi portas, cunctus populus, qui in ea est, salvabitur, et serviet tibi sub tributo.
text_pt: E será que, se te responder em paz, e te abrir as portas, todo o povo que se achar nela te será tributário e te servirá.
text_el: ἐὰν μὲν εἰρηνικὰ ἀποκριθῶσίν σοι καὶ ἀνοίξωσίν σοι ἔσται πᾶς ὁ λαὸς οἱ εὑρεθέντες ἐν αὐτῇ ἔσονταί σοι φορολόγητοι καὶ ὑπήκοοί σου

text_en: But if they will not make peace, and shall begin war against you, you shall besiege it.
text_la: Sin autem fœdus inire noluerit, et cœperit contra te bellum, oppugnabis eam.
text_pt: Porém, se ela não fizer paz contigo, mas antes te fizer guerra, então a sitiarás.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ὑπακούσωσίν σοι καὶ ποιήσωσιν πρὸς σὲ πόλεμον περικαθιεῖς αὐτήν

text_en: And when the Lord your God shall deliver it into your hands, you shall slay all that are therein of the male sex, with the edge of the sword,
text_la: Cumque tradiderit Dominus Deus tuus illam in manu tua, percuties omne quod in ea generis masculini est, in ore gladii,
text_pt: E o Senhor teu Deus a dará na tua mão; e todo o homem que houver nela passarás ao fio da espada.
text_el: καὶ παραδώσει αὐτὴν κύριος ὁ θεός σου εἰς τὰς χεῖράς σου καὶ πατάξεις πᾶν ἀρσενικὸν αὐτῆς ἐν φόνῳ μαχαίρας

text_en: excepting women and children, cattle and other things, that are in the city. And you shall divide all the prey to the army, and you shall eat the spoils of your enemies, which the Lord your God shall give you.
text_la: absque mulieribus et infantibus, jumentis et ceteris quæ in civitate sunt. Omnem prædam exercitui divides, et comedes de spoliis hostium tuorum, quæ Dominus Deus tuus dederit tibi.
text_pt: Porém, as mulheres, e as crianças, e os animais; e tudo o que houver na cidade, todo o seu despojo, tomarás para ti; e comerás o despojo dos teus inimigos, que te deu o Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: πλὴν τῶν γυναικῶν καὶ τῆς ἀποσκευῆς καὶ πάντα τὰ κτήνη καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἂν ὑπάρχῃ ἐν τῇ πόλει καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν ἀπαρτίαν προνομεύσεις σεαυτῷ καὶ φάγῃ πᾶσαν τὴν προνομὴν τῶν ἐχθρῶν σου ὧν κύριος ὁ θεός σου δίδωσίν σοι

text_en: So shall you do to all cities that are at a great distance from you, and are not of these cities which you shall receive in possession.
text_la: Sic facies cunctis civitatibus, quæ a te procul valde sunt, et non sunt de his urbibus, quas in possessionem accepturus es.
text_pt: Assim farás a todas as cidades que estiverem mui longe de ti, que não forem das cidades destas nações.
text_el: οὕτως ποιήσεις πάσας τὰς πόλεις τὰς μακρὰν οὔσας ἀπὸ σοῦ σφόδρα αἳ οὐχὶ ἐκ τῶν πόλεων τῶν ἐθνῶν τούτων

text_en: But of those cities that shall be given you, you shall allow none at all to live:
text_la: De his autem civitatibus, quæ dabuntur tibi, nullum omnino permittes vivere:
text_pt: Porém, das cidades destas nações, que o Senhor teu Deus te dá em herança, nenhuma coisa que tem fôlego deixarás com vida.
text_el: ἰδοὺ δὲ ἀπὸ τῶν πόλεων τῶν ἐθνῶν τούτων ὧν κύριος ὁ θεός σου δίδωσίν σοι κληρονομεῖν τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν οὐ ζωγρήσετε ἀπ' αὐτῶν πᾶν ἐμπνέον

text_en: But shall kill them with the edge of the sword, to wit, the Hethite , and the Amorrhite , and the Chanaanite , the Pherezite, and the Hevite, and the Jebusite, as the Lord your God has commanded you:
text_la: sed interficies in ore gladii, Hethæum videlicet, et Amorrhæum, et Chananæum, Pherezæum, et Hevæum, et Jebusæum, sicut præcepit tibi Dominus Deus tuus:
text_pt: Antes destruí-las-ás totalmente: aos heteus, e aos amorreus, e aos cananeus, e aos perizeus, e aos heveus, e aos jebuseus, como te ordenou o Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἢ ἀναθέματι ἀναθεματιεῖτε αὐτούς τὸν Χετταῖον καὶ Αμορραῖον καὶ Χαναναῖον καὶ Φερεζαῖον καὶ Ευαῖον καὶ Ιεβουσαῖον καὶ Γεργεσαῖον ὃν τρόπον ἐνετείλατό σοι κύριος ὁ θεός σου

text_en: Lest they teach you to do all the abominations which they have done to their gods : and you should sin against the Lord your God .
text_la: ne forte doceant vos facere cunctas abominationes, quas ipsi operati sunt diis suis, et peccetis in Dominum Deum vestrum.
text_pt: Para que não vos ensinem a fazer conforme a todas as suas abominações, que fizeram a seus deuses, e pequeis contra o Senhor vosso Deus.
text_el: ἵνα μὴ διδάξωσιν ὑμᾶς ποιεῖν πάντα τὰ βδελύγματα αὐτῶν ὅσα ἐποίησαν τοῖς θεοῖς αὐτῶν καὶ ἁμαρτήσεσθε ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν

text_en: When you have besieged a city a long time, and has compassed it with bulwarks, to take it, you shall not cut down the trees that may be eaten of, neither shall you spoil the country round about with axes: for it is a tree, and not a man , neither can it increase the number of them that fight against you.
text_la: Quando obsederis civitatem multo tempore, et munitionibus circumdederis ut expugnes eam, non succides arbores, de quibus vesci potest, nec securibus per circuitum debes vastare regionem : quoniam lignum est, et non homo, nec potest bellantium contra te augere numerum.
text_pt: Quando sitiares uma cidade por muitos dias, pelejando contra ela para a tomar, não destruirás o seu arvoredo, colocando nele o machado, porque dele comerás; pois que não o cortarás (pois o arvoredo do campo é mantimento para o homem), para empregar no cerco.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ περικαθίσῃς περὶ πόλιν ἡμέρας πλείους ἐκπολεμῆσαι αὐτὴν εἰς κατάλημψιν αὐτῆς οὐχὶ ἐξολεθρεύσεις τὰ δένδρα αὐτῆς ἐπιβαλεῖν ἐπ' αὐτὰ σίδηρον ἀλλ' ἢ ἀπ' αὐτοῦ φάγῃ αὐτὸ δὲ οὐκ ἐκκόψεις μὴ ἄνθρωπος τὸ ξύλον τὸ ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ εἰσελθεῖν ἀπὸ προσώπου σου εἰς τὸν χάρακα

text_en: But if there be any trees that are not fruitful, but wild, and fit for other uses, cut them down, and make engines, until you take the city, which fights against you.
text_la: Si qua autem ligna non sunt pomifera, sed agrestia, et in ceteros apta usus, succide, et instrue machinas, donec capias civitatem, quæ contra te dimicat.
text_pt: Mas as árvores que souberes que não são árvores de alimento, destruí-las-ás e cortá-las-ás; e contra a cidade que guerrear contra ti edificarás baluartes, até que esta seja vencida.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ξύλον ὃ ἐπίστασαι ὅτι οὐ καρπόβρωτόν ἐστιν τοῦτο ἐξολεθρεύσεις καὶ ἐκκόψεις καὶ οἰκοδομήσεις χαράκωσιν ἐπὶ τὴν πόλιν ἥτις ποιεῖ πρὸς σὲ τὸν πόλεμον ἕως ἂν παραδοθῇ

text_en: When there shall be found in the land, which the Lord your God will give you, the corpse of a man slain, and it is not known who is guilty of the murder ,
text_la: Quando inventum fuerit in terra, quam Dominus Deus tuus daturus est tibi, hominis cadaver occisi, et ignorabitur cædis reus,
text_pt: Quando na terra que te der o SENHOR teu Deus, para possuí-la, se achar um morto, caído no campo, sem que se saiba quem o matou,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ εὑρεθῇ τραυματίας ἐν τῇ γῇ ᾗ κύριος ὁ θεός σου δίδωσίν σοι κληρονομῆσαι πεπτωκὼς ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ καὶ οὐκ οἴδασιν τὸν πατάξαντα

text_en: your ancients and judges shall go out, and shall measure from the place where the body lies the distance of every city round about:
text_la: egredientur majores natu, et judices tui, et metientur a loco cadaveris singularum per circuitum spatia civitatum:
text_pt: Então sairão os teus anciãos e os teus juízes, e medirão a distância até as cidades que estiverem em redor do morto;
text_el: ἐξελεύσεται ἡ γερουσία σου καὶ οἱ κριταί σου καὶ ἐκμετρήσουσιν ἐπὶ τὰς πόλεις τὰς κύκλῳ τοῦ τραυματίου

text_en: And the ancients of that city which they shall perceive to be nearer than the rest, shall take a heifer of the herd, that has not drawn in the yoke, nor ploughed the ground,
text_la: et quam viciniorem ceteris esse perspexerint, seniores civitatis illius tollent vitulam de armento, quæ non traxit jugum, nec terram scidit vomere,
text_pt: E, na cidade mais próxima ao morto, os anciãos da mesma cidade tomarão uma novilha da manada, que não tenha trabalhado nem tenha puxado com o jugo;
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἡ πόλις ἡ ἐγγίζουσα τῷ τραυματίᾳ καὶ λήμψεται ἡ γερουσία τῆς πόλεως ἐκείνης δάμαλιν ἐκ βοῶν ἥτις οὐκ εἴργασται καὶ ἥτις οὐχ εἵλκυσεν ζυγόν

text_en: and they shall bring her into a rough and stony valley, that never was ploughed, nor sown: and there they shall strike off the head of the heifer:
text_la: et ducent eam ad vallem asperam atque saxosam, quæ numquam arata est, nec sementem recepit : et cædent in ea cervices vitulæ:
text_pt: E os anciãos daquela cidade trarão a novilha a um vale áspero, que nunca foi lavrado nem semeado; e ali, naquele vale, degolarão a novilha;
text_el: καὶ καταβιβάσουσιν ἡ γερουσία τῆς πόλεως ἐκείνης τὴν δάμαλιν εἰς φάραγγα τραχεῖαν ἥτις οὐκ εἴργασται οὐδὲ σπείρεται καὶ νευροκοπήσουσιν τὴν δάμαλιν ἐν τῇ φάραγγι

text_en: And the priests the sons of Levi shall come, whom the Lord your God has chosen to minister to him, and to bless in his name , and that by their word every matter should be decided, and whatsoever is clean or unclean should be judged.
text_la: accedentque sacerdotes filii Levi, quos elegerit Dominus Deus tuus ut ministrent ei, et benedicant in nomine ejus, et ad verbum eorum omne negotium, et quidquid mundum, vel immundum est, judicetur.
text_pt: Então se achegarão os sacerdotes, filhos de Levi; pois o Senhor teu Deus os escolheu para o servirem, e para abençoarem em nome do Senhor; e pela sua palavra se decidirá toda a demanda e todo o ferimento;
text_el: καὶ προσελεύσονται οἱ ἱερεῖς οἱ Λευῖται ὅτι αὐτοὺς ἐπέλεξεν κύριος ὁ θεός σου παρεστηκέναι αὐτῷ καὶ εὐλογεῖν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν ἔσται πᾶσα ἀντιλογία καὶ πᾶσα ἁφή

text_en: And the ancients of that city shall come to the person slain , and shall wash their hands over the heifer that was killed in the valley,
text_la: Et venient majores natu civitatis illius ad interfectum, lavabuntque manus suas super vitulam, quæ in valle percussa est,
text_pt: E todos os anciãos da mesma cidade, mais próxima ao morto, lavarão as suas mãos sobre a novilha degolada no vale;
text_el: καὶ πᾶσα ἡ γερουσία τῆς πόλεως ἐκείνης οἱ ἐγγίζοντες τῷ τραυματίᾳ νίψονται τὰς χεῖρας ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν τῆς δαμάλεως τῆς νενευροκοπημένης ἐν τῇ φάραγγι

text_en: and shall say: Our hands did not shed this blood, nor did our eyes see it.
text_la: et dicent : Manus nostræ non effuderunt sanguinem hunc, nec oculi viderunt:
text_pt: E protestarão, e dirão: As nossas mãos não derramaram este sangue, e os nossos olhos o não viram.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθέντες ἐροῦσιν αἱ χεῖρες ἡμῶν οὐκ ἐξέχεαν τὸ αἷμα τοῦτο καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἡμῶν οὐχ ἑωράκασιν

text_en: Be merciful to your people Israel , whom you have redeemed , O Lord , and lay not innocent blood to their charge, in the midst of your people Israel . And the guilt of blood shall be taken from them:
text_la: propitius esto populo tuo Israël, quem redemisti, Domine, et ne reputes sanguinem innocentem in medio populi tui Israël. Et auferetur ab eis reatus sanguinis:
text_pt: Sê propício ao teu povo Israel, que tu, ó Senhor, resgataste, e não ponhas o sangue inocente no meio do teu povo Israel. E aquele sangue lhes será expiado.
text_el: ἵλεως γενοῦ τῷ λαῷ σου Ισραηλ οὓς ἐλυτρώσω κύριε ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ἵνα μὴ γένηται αἷμα ἀναίτιον ἐν τῷ λαῷ σου Ισραηλ καὶ ἐξιλασθήσεται αὐτοῖς τὸ αἷμα

text_en: And you shall be free from the innocent's blood, that was shed, when you shall have done what the Lord has commanded you.
text_la: tu autem alienus eris ab innocentis cruore, qui fusus est, cum feceris quod præcepit Dominus.
text_pt: Assim tirarás o sangue inocente do meio de ti; pois farás o que é reto aos olhos do Senhor.
text_el: σὺ δὲ ἐξαρεῖς τὸ αἷμα τὸ ἀναίτιον ἐξ ὑμῶν αὐτῶν ἐὰν ποιήσῃς τὸ καλὸν καὶ τὸ ἀρεστὸν ἔναντι κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου

text_en: If you go out to fight against your enemies, and the Lord your God deliver them into your hand, and you lead them away captives,
text_la: Si egressus fueris ad pugnam contra inimicos tuos, et tradiderit eos Dominus Deus tuus in manu tua, captivosque duxeris,
text_pt: Quando saíres à peleja contra os teus inimigos, e o Senhor teu Deus os entregar nas tuas mãos, e tu deles levares prisioneiros,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐξελθὼν εἰς πόλεμον ἐπὶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου καὶ παραδῷ σοι κύριος ὁ θεός σου εἰς τὰς χεῖράς σου καὶ προνομεύσεις τὴν προνομὴν αὐτῶν

text_en: and see in the number of the captives a beautiful woman , and love her, and will have her to wife ,
text_la: et videris in numero captivorum mulierem pulchram, et adamaveris eam, voluerisque habere uxorem,
text_pt: E tu entre os presos vires uma mulher formosa à vista, e a cobiçares, e a tomares por mulher,
text_el: καὶ ἴδῃς ἐν τῇ προνομῇ γυναῖκα καλὴν τῷ εἴδει καὶ ἐνθυμηθῇς αὐτῆς καὶ λάβῃς αὐτὴν σαυτῷ γυναῖκα

text_en: you shall bring her into your house: and she shall shave her hair, and pare her nails,
text_la: introduces eam in domum tuam : quæ radet cæsariem, et circumcidet ungues,
text_pt: Então a trarás para a tua casa; e ela rapará a cabeça e cortará as suas unhas.
text_el: καὶ εἰσάξεις αὐτὴν ἔνδον εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν σου καὶ ξυρήσεις τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτῆς καὶ περιονυχιεῖς αὐτὴν

text_en: and shall put off the raiment, wherein she was taken: and shall remain in your house, and mourn for her father and mother one month: and after that you shall go in unto her, and shall sleep with her, and she shall be your wife.
text_la: et deponet vestem, in qua capta est : sedensque in domo tua, flebit patrem et matrem suam uno mense : et postea intrabis ad eam, dormiesque cum illa, et erit uxor tua.
text_pt: E despirá o vestido do seu cativeiro, e se assentará na tua casa, e chorará a seu pai e a sua mãe um mês inteiro; e depois chegarás a ela, e tu serás seu marido e ela tua mulher.
text_el: καὶ περιελεῖς τὰ ἱμάτια τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας αὐτῆς ἀπ' αὐτῆς καὶ καθίεται ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ σου καὶ κλαύσεται τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα μηνὸς ἡμέρας καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα εἰσελεύσῃ πρὸς αὐτὴν καὶ συνοικισθήσῃ αὐτῇ καὶ ἔσται σου γυνή

text_en: But if afterwards she please you not, you shall let her go free, but you may not sell her for money nor oppress her by might because you have humbled her.
text_la: Si autem postea non sederit animo tuo, dimittes eam liberam, nec vendere poteris pecunia, nec opprimere per potentiam : quia humiliasti eam.
text_pt: E será que, se te não contentares dela, a deixarás ir à sua vontade; mas de modo algum a venderás por dinheiro, nem a tratarás como escrava, pois a tens humilhado.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν μὴ θέλῃς αὐτήν ἐξαποστελεῖς αὐτὴν ἐλευθέραν καὶ πράσει οὐ πραθήσεται ἀργυρίου οὐκ ἀθετήσεις αὐτήν διότι ἐταπείνωσας αὐτήν

text_en: If a man have two wives, one beloved , and the other hated , and they have had children by him, and the son of the hated be the firstborn ,
text_la: Si habuerit homo uxores duas, unam dilectam, et alteram odiosam, genuerintque ex eo liberos, et fuerit filius odiosæ primogenitus,
text_pt: Quando um homem tiver duas mulheres, uma a quem ama e outra a quem despreza, e a amada e a desprezada lhe derem filhos, e o filho primogênito for da desprezada,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ γένωνται ἀνθρώπῳ δύο γυναῖκες μία αὐτῶν ἠγαπημένη καὶ μία αὐτῶν μισουμένη καὶ τέκωσιν αὐτῷ ἡ ἠγαπημένη καὶ ἡ μισουμένη καὶ γένηται υἱὸς πρωτότοκος τῆς μισουμένης

text_en: and he means to divide his substance among his sons: he may not make the son of the beloved the firstborn , and prefer him before the son of the hated .
text_la: volueritque substantiam inter filios suos dividere, non poterit filium dilectæ facere primogenitum, et præferre filio odiosæ:
text_pt: Será que, no dia em que fizer herdar a seus filhos o que tiver, não poderá dar a primogenitura ao filho da amada, preferindo-o ao filho da desprezada, que é o primogênito.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ κατακληροδοτῇ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτοῦ οὐ δυνήσεται πρωτοτοκεῦσαι τῷ υἱῷ τῆς ἠγαπημένης ὑπεριδὼν τὸν υἱὸν τῆς μισουμένης τὸν πρωτότοκον

text_en: But he shall acknowledge the son of the hated for the firstborn , and shall give him a double portion of all he has: for this is the first of his children, and to him are due the first birthrights.
text_la: sed filium odiosæ agnoscet primogenitum, dabitque ei de his quæ habuerit cuncta duplicia : iste est enim principium liberorum ejus, et huic debentur primogenita.
text_pt: Mas ao filho da desprezada reconhecerá por primogênito, dando-lhe dobrada porção de tudo quanto tiver; porquanto aquele é o princípio da sua força, o direito da primogenitura é dele.
text_el: ἀλλὰ τὸν πρωτότοκον υἱὸν τῆς μισουμένης ἐπιγνώσεται δοῦναι αὐτῷ διπλᾶ ἀπὸ πάντων ὧν ἂν εὑρεθῇ αὐτῷ ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ἀρχὴ τέκνων αὐτοῦ καὶ τούτῳ καθήκει τὰ πρωτοτόκια

text_en: If a man have a stubborn and unruly son, who will not hear the commandments of his father or mother , and being corrected, slights obedience :
text_la: Si genuerit homo filium contumacem et protervum, qui non audiat patris aut matris imperium, et coërcitus obedire contempserit:
text_pt: Quando alguém tiver um filho contumaz e rebelde, que não obedecer à voz de seu pai e à voz de sua mãe, e, castigando-o eles, lhes não der ouvidos,
text_el: ἐὰν δέ τινι ᾖ υἱὸς ἀπειθὴς καὶ ἐρεθιστὴς οὐχ ὑπακούων φωνὴν πατρὸς καὶ φωνὴν μητρὸς καὶ παιδεύσωσιν αὐτὸν καὶ μὴ εἰσακούῃ αὐτῶν

text_en: They shall take him and bring him to the ancients of the city, and to the gate of judgment,
text_la: apprehendent eum, et ducent ad seniores civitatis illius, et ad portam judicii,
text_pt: Então seu pai e sua mãe pegarão nele, e o levarão aos anciãos da sua cidade, e à porta do seu lugar;
text_el: καὶ συλλαβόντες αὐτὸν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξάξουσιν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὴν γερουσίαν τῆς πόλεως αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν πύλην τοῦ τόπου αὐτοῦ

text_en: and shall say to them: This our son is rebellious and stubborn, he slights hearing our admonitions, he gives himself to revelling, and to debauchery and banquetings:
text_la: dicentque ad eos : Filius noster iste protervus et contumax est : monita nostra audire contemnit, comessationibus vacat, et luxuriæ atque conviviis:
text_pt: E dirão aos anciãos da cidade: Este nosso filho é rebelde e contumaz, não dá ouvidos à nossa voz; é um comilão e um beberrão.
text_el: καὶ ἐροῦσιν τοῖς ἀνδράσιν τῆς πόλεως αὐτῶν ὁ υἱὸς ἡμῶν οὗτος ἀπειθεῖ καὶ ἐρεθίζει οὐχ ὑπακούει τῆς φωνῆς ἡμῶν συμβολοκοπῶν οἰνοφλυγεῖ

text_en: The people of the city shall stone him: and he shall die, that you may take away the evil out of the midst of you, and all Israel hearing it may be afraid.
text_la: lapidibus eum obruet populus civitatis, et morietur, ut auferatis malum de medio vestri, et universus Israël audiens pertimescat.
text_pt: Então todos os homens da sua cidade o apedrejarão, até que morra; e tirarás o mal do meio de ti, e todo o Israel ouvirá e temerá.
text_el: καὶ λιθοβολήσουσιν αὐτὸν οἱ ἄνδρες τῆς πόλεως αὐτοῦ ἐν λίθοις καὶ ἀποθανεῖται καὶ ἐξαρεῖς τὸν πονηρὸν ἐξ ὑμῶν αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ ἐπίλοιποι ἀκούσαντες φοβηθήσονται

text_en: When a man has committed a crime for which he is to be punished with death , and being condemned to die is hanged on a gibbet:
text_la: Quando peccaverit homo quod morte plectendum est, et adjudicatus morti appensus fuerit in patibulo:
text_pt: Quando também em alguém houver pecado, digno do juízo de morte, e for morto, e o pendurares num madeiro,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ γένηται ἔν τινι ἁμαρτία κρίμα θανάτου καὶ ἀποθάνῃ καὶ κρεμάσητε αὐτὸν ἐπὶ ξύλου

text_en: His body shall not remain upon the tree, but shall be buried the same day: for he is accursed of God that hangs on a tree: and you shall not defile your land, which the Lord your God shall give you in possession.
text_la: non permanebit cadaver ejus in ligno, sed in eadem die sepelietur : quia maledictus a Deo est qui pendet in ligno : et nequaquam contaminabis terram tuam, quam Dominus Deus tuus dederit tibi in possessionem.
text_pt: O seu cadáver não permanecerá no madeiro, mas certamente o enterrarás no mesmo dia; porquanto o pendurado é maldito de Deus; assim não contaminarás a tua terra, que o Senhor teu Deus te dá em herança.
text_el: οὐκ ἐπικοιμηθήσεται τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τοῦ ξύλου ἀλλὰ ταφῇ θάψετε αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ὅτι κεκατηραμένος ὑπὸ θεοῦ πᾶς κρεμάμενος ἐπὶ ξύλου καὶ οὐ μιανεῖτε τὴν γῆν ἣν κύριος ὁ θεός σου δίδωσίν σοι ἐν κλήρῳ

text_en: You shall not pass by if you see your brother's ox, or his sheep go astray: but you shall bring them back to your brother.
text_la: Non videbis bovem fratris tui, aut ovem errantem, et præteribis : sed reduces fratri tuo,
text_pt: Vendo extraviado o boi ou ovelha de teu irmão, não te desviarás deles; restituí-los-ás sem falta a teu irmão.
text_el: μὴ ἰδὼν τὸν μόσχον τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου ἢ τὸ πρόβατον αὐτοῦ πλανώμενα ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ὑπερίδῃς αὐτά ἀποστροφῇ ἀποστρέψεις αὐτὰ τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου καὶ ἀποδώσεις αὐτῷ

text_en: And if your brother be not near, or you know him not: you shall bring them to your house, and they shall be with you until your brother seek them, and receive them.
text_la: etiamsi non est propinquus frater tuus, nec nosti eum : duces in domum tuam, et erunt apud te quamdiu quærat ea frater tuus, et recipiat.
text_pt: E se teu irmão não estiver perto de ti, ou não o conheceres, recolhê-los-ás na tua casa, para que fiquem contigo, até que teu irmão os busque, e tu lhos restituirás.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ἐγγίζῃ ὁ ἀδελφός σου πρὸς σὲ μηδὲ ἐπίστῃ αὐτόν συνάξεις αὐτὰ ἔνδον εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν σου καὶ ἔσται μετὰ σοῦ ἕως ἂν ζητήσῃ αὐτὰ ὁ ἀδελφός σου καὶ ἀποδώσεις αὐτῷ

text_en: You shall do in like manner with his ass, and with his raiment, and with everything that is your brother's, which is lost: if you find it, neglect it not as pertaining to another.
text_la: Similiter facies de asino, et de vestimento, et de omni re fratris tui, quæ perierit : si inveneris eam, ne negligas quasi alienam.
text_pt: Assim também farás com o seu jumento, e assim farás com as suas roupas; assim farás também com toda a coisa perdida, que se perder de teu irmão, e tu a achares; não te poderás omitir.
text_el: οὕτως ποιήσεις τὸν ὄνον αὐτοῦ καὶ οὕτως ποιήσεις τὸ ἱμάτιον αὐτοῦ καὶ οὕτως ποιήσεις κατὰ πᾶσαν ἀπώλειαν τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου ὅσα ἐὰν ἀπόληται παρ' αὐτοῦ καὶ εὕρῃς οὐ δυνήσῃ ὑπεριδεῖν

text_en: If you see your brother's ass or his ox to be fallen down in the way, you shall not slight it, but shall lift it up with him.
text_la: Si videris asinum fratris tui aut bovem cecidisse in via, non despicies, sed sublevabis cum eo.
text_pt: Se vires o jumento que é de teu irmão, ou o seu boi, caídos no caminho, não te desviarás deles; sem falta o ajudarás a levantá-los.
text_el: οὐκ ὄψῃ τὸν ὄνον τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου ἢ τὸν μόσχον αὐτοῦ πεπτωκότας ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ μὴ ὑπερίδῃς αὐτούς ἀνιστῶν ἀναστήσεις μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: A woman shall not be clothed with man's apparel, neither shall a man use woman's apparel: for he that does these things is abominable before God .
text_la: Non induetur mulier veste virili, nec vir utetur veste feminea : abominabilis enim apud Deum est qui facit hæc.
text_pt: Não haverá traje de homem na mulher, e nem vestirá o homem roupa de mulher; porque, qualquer que faz isto, abominação é ao Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: οὐκ ἔσται σκεύη ἀνδρὸς ἐπὶ γυναικί οὐδὲ μὴ ἐνδύσηται ἀνὴρ στολὴν γυναικείαν ὅτι βδέλυγμα κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σού ἐστιν πᾶς ποιῶν ταῦτα

text_en: If you find as you walk by the way, a bird's nest in a tree, or on the ground, and the dam sitting upon the young or upon the eggs: you shall not take her with her young:
text_la: Si ambulans per viam, in arbore vel in terra nidum avis inveneris, et matrem pullis vel ovis desuper incubantem : non tenebis eam cum filiis,
text_pt: Quando encontrares pelo caminho um ninho de ave numa árvore, ou no chão, com passarinhos, ou ovos, e a mãe posta sobre os passarinhos, ou sobre os ovos, não tomarás a mãe com os filhotes;
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ συναντήσῃς νοσσιᾷ ὀρνέων πρὸ προσώπου σου ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ἢ ἐπὶ παντὶ δένδρει ἢ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς νεοσσοῖς ἢ ᾠοῖς καὶ ἡ μήτηρ θάλπῃ ἐπὶ τῶν νεοσσῶν ἢ ἐπὶ τῶν ᾠῶν οὐ λήμψῃ τὴν μητέρα μετὰ τῶν τέκνων

text_en: But shall let her go, keeping the young which you have caught: that it may be well with you, and you may live a long time.
text_la: sed abire patieris, captos tenens filios : ut bene sit tibi, et longo vivas tempore.
text_pt: Deixarás ir livremente a mãe, e os filhotes tomarás para ti; para que te vá bem e para que prolongues os teus dias.
text_el: ἀποστολῇ ἀποστελεῖς τὴν μητέρα τὰ δὲ παιδία λήμψῃ σεαυτῷ ἵνα εὖ σοι γένηται καὶ πολυήμερος ἔσῃ

text_en: When you build a new house, you shall make a battlement to the roof round about: lest blood be shed in your house, and you be guilty, if any one slip, and fall down headlong.
text_la: Cum ædificaveris domum novam, facies murum tecti per circuitum : ne effundatur sanguis in domo tua, et sis reus labente alio, et in præceps ruente.
text_pt: Quando edificares uma casa nova, farás um parapeito, no eirado, para que não ponhas culpa de sangue na tua casa, se alguém de algum modo cair dela.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ οἰκοδομήσῃς οἰκίαν καινήν καὶ ποιήσεις στεφάνην τῷ δώματί σου καὶ οὐ ποιήσεις φόνον ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ σου ἐὰν πέσῃ ὁ πεσὼν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: You shall not sow your vineyard with divers seeds: lest both the seed which you have sown, and the fruit of the vineyard, be sanctified together.
text_la: Non seres vineam tuam altero semine : ne et sementis quam sevisti, et quæ nascuntur ex vinea, pariter sanctificentur.
text_pt: Não semearás a tua vinha com diferentes espécies de semente, para que não se degenere o fruto da semente que semeares, e a novidade da vinha.
text_el: οὐ κατασπερεῖς τὸν ἀμπελῶνά σου διάφορον ἵνα μὴ ἁγιασθῇ τὸ γένημα καὶ τὸ σπέρμα ὃ ἐὰν σπείρῃς μετὰ τοῦ γενήματος τοῦ ἀμπελῶνός σου

text_en: You shall not plough with an ox and an ass together.
text_la: Non arabis in bove simul et asino.
text_pt: Com boi e com jumento não lavrarás juntamente.
text_el: οὐκ ἀροτριάσεις ἐν μόσχῳ καὶ ὄνῳ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό

text_en: You shall not wear a garment that is woven of woollen and linen together.
text_la: Non indueris vestimento, quod ex lana linoque contextum est.
text_pt: Não te vestirás de diversos estofos de lã e linho juntamente.
text_el: οὐκ ἐνδύσῃ κίβδηλον ἔρια καὶ λίνον ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ

text_en: You shall make strings in the hem at the four corners of your cloak, wherewith you shall be covered.
text_la: Funiculos in fimbriis facies per quatuor angulos pallii tui, quo operieris.
text_pt: Franjas porás nas quatro bordas da tua manta, com que te cobrires.
text_el: στρεπτὰ ποιήσεις σεαυτῷ ἐπὶ τῶν τεσσάρων κρασπέδων τῶν περιβολαίων σου ἃ ἐὰν περιβάλῃ ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: If a man marry a wife, and afterwards hate her,
text_la: Si duxerit vir uxorem, et postea odio habuerit eam,
text_pt: Quando um homem tomar mulher e, depois de coabitar com ela, a desprezar,
text_el: ἐὰν δέ τις λάβῃ γυναῖκα καὶ συνοικήσῃ αὐτῇ καὶ μισήσῃ αὐτὴν

text_en: and seek occasions to put her away , laying to her charge a very ill name , and say: I took this woman to wife, and going in to her, I found her not a virgin :
text_la: quæsieritque occasiones quibus dimittat eam, objiciens ei nomen pessimum, et dixerit : Uxorem hanc accepi, et ingressus ad eam non inveni virginem:
text_pt: E lhe imputar coisas escandalosas, e contra ela divulgar má fama, dizendo: Tomei esta mulher, e me cheguei a ela, porém não a achei virgem;
text_el: καὶ ἐπιθῇ αὐτῇ προφασιστικοὺς λόγους καὶ κατενέγκῃ αὐτῆς ὄνομα πονηρὸν καὶ λέγῃ τὴν γυναῖκα ταύτην εἴληφα καὶ προσελθὼν αὐτῇ οὐχ εὕρηκα αὐτῆς παρθένια

text_en: Her father and mother shall take her, and shall bring with them the tokens of her virginity to the ancients of the city that are in the gate:
text_la: tollent eam pater et mater ejus, et ferent secum signa virginitatis ejus ad seniores urbis qui in porta sunt:
text_pt: Então o pai da moça e sua mãe tomarão os sinais da virgindade da moça, e levá-los-ão aos anciãos da cidade, à porta;
text_el: καὶ λαβὼν ὁ πατὴρ τῆς παιδὸς καὶ ἡ μήτηρ ἐξοίσουσιν τὰ παρθένια τῆς παιδὸς πρὸς τὴν γερουσίαν ἐπὶ τὴν πύλην

text_en: And the father shall say: I gave my daughter unto this man to wife: and because he hates her,
text_la: et dicet pater : Filiam meam dedi huic uxorem : quam quia odit,
text_pt: E o pai da moça dirá aos anciãos: Eu dei minha filha por mulher a este homem, porém ele a despreza;
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖ ὁ πατὴρ τῆς παιδὸς τῇ γερουσίᾳ τὴν θυγατέρα μου ταύτην δέδωκα τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τούτῳ γυναῖκα καὶ μισήσας αὐτὴν

text_en: he lays to her charge a very ill name , so as to say: I found not your daughter a virgin : and behold these are the tokens of my daughter's virginity . And they shall spread the cloth before the ancients of the city:
text_la: imponit ei nomen pessimum, ut dicat : Non inveni filiam tuam virginem : et ecce hæc sunt signa virginitatis filiæ meæ. Expandent vestimentum coram senioribus civitatis:
text_pt: E eis que lhe imputou coisas escandalosas, dizendo: Não achei virgem a tua filha; porém eis aqui os sinais da virgindade de minha filha. E estenderão a roupa diante dos anciãos da cidade.
text_el: αὐτὸς νῦν ἐπιτίθησιν αὐτῇ προφασιστικοὺς λόγους λέγων οὐχ εὕρηκα τῇ θυγατρί σου παρθένια καὶ ταῦτα τὰ παρθένια τῆς θυγατρός μου καὶ ἀναπτύξουσιν τὸ ἱμάτιον ἐναντίον τῆς γερουσίας τῆς πόλεως

text_en: And the ancients of that city shall take that man , and beat him,
text_la: apprehendentque senes urbis illius virum, et verberabunt illum,
text_pt: Então os anciãos da mesma cidade tomarão aquele homem, e o castigarão.
text_el: καὶ λήμψεται ἡ γερουσία τῆς πόλεως ἐκείνης τὸν ἄνθρωπον ἐκεῖνον καὶ παιδεύσουσιν αὐτὸν

text_en: condemning him besides in a hundred sicles of silver, which he shall give to the damsel's father, because he has defamed by a very ill name a virgin of Israel : and he shall have her to wife , and may not put her away all the days of his life.
text_la: condemnantes insuper centum siclis argenti, quos dabit patri puellæ, quoniam diffamavit nomen pessimum super virginem Israël : habebitque eam uxorem, et non poterit dimittere eam omnibus diebus vitæ suæ.
text_pt: E o multarão em cem siclos de prata, e os darão ao pai da moça; porquanto divulgou má fama sobre uma virgem de Israel. E lhe será por mulher, em todos os seus dias não a poderá despedir.
text_el: καὶ ζημιώσουσιν αὐτὸν ἑκατὸν σίκλους καὶ δώσουσιν τῷ πατρὶ τῆς νεάνιδος ὅτι ἐξήνεγκεν ὄνομα πονηρὸν ἐπὶ παρθένον Ισραηλῖτιν καὶ αὐτοῦ ἔσται γυνή οὐ δυνήσεται ἐξαποστεῖλαι αὐτὴν τὸν ἅπαντα χρόνον

text_en: But if what he charged her with be true , and virginity be not found in the damsel:
text_la: Quod si verum est quod objicit, et non est in puella inventa virginitas,
text_pt: Porém se isto for verdadeiro, isto é, que a virgindade não se achou na moça,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐπ' ἀληθείας γένηται ὁ λόγος οὗτος καὶ μὴ εὑρεθῇ παρθένια τῇ νεάνιδι

text_en: They shall cast her out of the doors of her father's house, and the men of the city shall stone her to death , and she shall die: because she has done a wicked thing in Israel , to play the whore in her father's house: and you shall take away the evil out of the midst of you.
text_la: ejicient eam extra fores domus patris sui, et lapidibus obruent viri civitatis illius, et morietur : quoniam fecit nefas in Israël, ut fornicaretur in domo patris sui : et auferes malum de medio tui.
text_pt: Então levarão a moça à porta da casa de seu pai, e os homens da sua cidade a apedrejarão, até que morra; pois fez loucura em Israel, prostituindo-se na casa de seu pai; assim tirarás o mal do meio de ti.
text_el: καὶ ἐξάξουσιν τὴν νεᾶνιν ἐπὶ τὰς θύρας οἴκου πατρὸς αὐτῆς καὶ λιθοβολήσουσιν αὐτὴν οἱ ἄνδρες τῆς πόλεως αὐτῆς ἐν λίθοις καὶ ἀποθανεῖται ὅτι ἐποίησεν ἀφροσύνην ἐν υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ἐκπορνεῦσαι τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῆς καὶ ἐξαρεῖς τὸν πονηρὸν ἐξ ὑμῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: If a man lie with another man's wife , they shall both die, that is to say, the adulterer and the adulteress: and you shall take away the evil out of Israel .
text_la: Si dormierit vir cum uxore alterius, uterque morietur, id est, adulter et adultera : et auferes malum de Israël.
text_pt: Quando um homem for achado deitado com mulher que tenha marido, então ambos morrerão, o homem que se deitou com a mulher, e a mulher; assim tirarás o mal de Israel.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ εὑρεθῇ ἄνθρωπος κοιμώμενος μετὰ γυναικὸς συνῳκισμένης ἀνδρί ἀποκτενεῖτε ἀμφοτέρους τὸν ἄνδρα τὸν κοιμώμενον μετὰ τῆς γυναικὸς καὶ τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ ἐξαρεῖς τὸν πονηρὸν ἐξ Ισραηλ

text_en: If a man have espoused a damsel that is a virgin , and some one find her in the city, and lie with her,
text_la: Si puellam virginem desponderit vir, et invenerit eam aliquis in civitate, et concubuerit cum ea,
text_pt: Quando houver moça virgem, desposada, e um homem a achar na cidade, e se deitar com ela,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ γένηται παῖς παρθένος μεμνηστευμένη ἀνδρὶ καὶ εὑρὼν αὐτὴν ἄνθρωπος ἐν πόλει κοιμηθῇ μετ' αὐτῆς

text_en: you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city, and they shall be stoned : the damsel, because she cried not out, being in the city: the man, because he has humbled his neighbour's wife . And you shall take away the evil from the midst of you.
text_la: educes utrumque ad portam civitatis illius, et lapidibus obruentur : puella, quia non clamavit, cum esset in civitate : vir, quia humiliavit uxorem proximi sui : et auferes malum de medio tui.
text_pt: Então trareis ambos à porta daquela cidade, e os apedrejareis, até que morram; a moça, porquanto não gritou na cidade, e o homem, porquanto humilhou a mulher do seu próximo; assim tirarás o mal do meio de ti.
text_el: ἐξάξετε ἀμφοτέρους ἐπὶ τὴν πύλην τῆς πόλεως αὐτῶν καὶ λιθοβοληθήσονται ἐν λίθοις καὶ ἀποθανοῦνται τὴν νεᾶνιν ὅτι οὐκ ἐβόησεν ἐν τῇ πόλει καὶ τὸν ἄνθρωπον ὅτι ἐταπείνωσεν τὴν γυναῖκα τοῦ πλησίον καὶ ἐξαρεῖς τὸν πονηρὸν ἐξ ὑμῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: But if a man find a damsel that is betrothed , in the field, and taking hold of her, lie with her, he alone shall die:
text_la: Sin autem in agro repererit vir puellam, quæ desponsata est, et apprehendens concubuerit cum ea, ipse morietur solus:
text_pt: E se algum homem no campo achar uma moça desposada, e o homem a forçar, e se deitar com ela, então morrerá só o homem que se deitou com ela;
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐν πεδίῳ εὕρῃ ἄνθρωπος τὴν παῖδα τὴν μεμνηστευμένην καὶ βιασάμενος κοιμηθῇ μετ' αὐτῆς ἀποκτενεῖτε τὸν ἄνθρωπον τὸν κοιμώμενον μετ' αὐτῆς μόνον

text_en: The damsel shall suffer nothing, neither is she guilty of death: for as a robber rises against his brother, and takes away his life , so also did the damsel suffer:
text_la: puella nihil patietur, nec est rea mortis : quoniam sicut latro consurgit contra fratrem suum, et occidit animam ejus, ita et puella perpessa est.
text_pt: Porém à moça não farás nada. A moça não tem culpa de morte; porque, como o homem que se levanta contra o seu próximo, e lhe tira a vida, assim é este caso.
text_el: καὶ τῇ νεάνιδι οὐ ποιήσετε οὐδέν οὐκ ἔστιν τῇ νεάνιδι ἁμάρτημα θανάτου ὅτι ὡς εἴ τις ἐπαναστῇ ἄνθρωπος ἐπὶ τὸν πλησίον καὶ φονεύσῃ αὐτοῦ ψυχήν οὕτως τὸ πρᾶγμα τοῦτο

text_en: She was alone in the field: she cried, and there was no man to help her.
text_la: Sola erat in agro : clamavit, et nullus affuit qui liberaret eam.
text_pt: Pois a achou no campo; a moça desposada gritou, e não houve quem a livrasse.
text_el: ὅτι ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ εὗρεν αὐτήν ἐβόησεν ἡ νεᾶνις ἡ μεμνηστευμένη καὶ ὁ βοηθήσων οὐκ ἦν αὐτῇ

text_en: If a man find a damsel that is a virgin , who is not espoused , and taking her, lie with her, and the matter come to judgment:
text_la: Si invenerit vir puellam virginem, quæ non habet sponsum, et apprehendens concubuerit cum illa, et res ad judicium venerit:
text_pt: Quando um homem achar uma moça virgem, que não for desposada, e pegar nela, e se deitar com ela, e forem apanhados,
text_el: ἐὰν δέ τις εὕρῃ τὴν παῖδα τὴν παρθένον ἥτις οὐ μεμνήστευται καὶ βιασάμενος κοιμηθῇ μετ' αὐτῆς καὶ εὑρεθῇ

text_en: He that lay with her shall give to the father of the maid fifty sicles of silver, and shall have her to wife , because he has humbled her: he may not put her away all the days of his life.
text_la: dabit qui dormivit cum ea, patri puellæ quinquaginta siclos argenti, et habebit eam uxorem, quia humiliavit illam : non poterit dimittere eam cunctis diebus vitæ suæ.
text_pt: Então o homem que se deitou com ela dará ao pai da moça cinqüenta siclos de prata; e porquanto a humilhou, lhe será por mulher; não a poderá despedir em todos os seus dias.
text_el: δώσει ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ κοιμηθεὶς μετ' αὐτῆς τῷ πατρὶ τῆς νεάνιδος πεντήκοντα δίδραχμα ἀργυρίου καὶ αὐτοῦ ἔσται γυνή ἀνθ' ὧν ἐταπείνωσεν αὐτήν οὐ δυνήσεται ἐξαποστεῖλαι αὐτὴν τὸν ἅπαντα χρόνον

text_en: No man shall take his father's wife, nor remove his covering.
text_la: Non accipiet homo uxorem patris sui, nec revelabit operimentum ejus.
text_pt: Nenhum homem tomará a mulher de seu pai, nem descobrirá a nudez de seu pai.
text_el: οὐ λήμψεται ἄνθρωπος τὴν γυναῖκα τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἀποκαλύψει συγκάλυμμα τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: An eunuch, whose testicles are broken or cut away, or yard cut off, shall not enter into the church of the Lord .
text_la: Non intravit eunuchus, attritis vel amputatis testiculis et abscisso veretro, ecclesiam Domini.
text_pt: Aquele a quem forem trilhados os testículos, ou cortado o membro viril, não entrará na congregação do SENHOR.
text_el: οὐκ εἰσελεύσεται θλαδίας καὶ ἀποκεκομμένος εἰς ἐκκλησίαν κυρίου

text_en: A mamzer, that is to say, one born of a prostitute, shall not enter into the church of the Lord , until the tenth generation .
text_la: Non ingredietur mamzer, hoc est, de scorto natus, in ecclesiam Domini, usque ad decimam generationem.
text_pt: Nenhum bastardo entrará na congregação do Senhor; nem ainda a sua décima geração entrará na congregação do Senhor.
text_el: οὐκ εἰσελεύσεται ἐκ πόρνης εἰς ἐκκλησίαν κυρίου

text_en: The Ammonite and the Moabite , even after the tenth generation shall not enter into the church of the Lord for ever:
text_la: Ammonites et Moabites etiam post decimam generationem non intrabunt ecclesiam Domini in æternum:
text_pt: Nenhum amonita nem moabita entrará na congregação do Senhor; nem ainda a sua décima geração entrará na congregação do Senhor eternamente.
text_el: οὐκ εἰσελεύσεται Αμμανίτης καὶ Μωαβίτης εἰς ἐκκλησίαν κυρίου καὶ ἕως δεκάτης γενεᾶς οὐκ εἰσελεύσεται εἰς ἐκκλησίαν κυρίου καὶ ἕως εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: Because they would not meet you with bread and water in the way, when you came out of Egypt : and because they hired against you Balaam, the son of Beor , from Mesopotamia in Syria , to curse you.
text_la: quia noluerunt vobis occurrere cum pane et aqua in via quando egressi estis de Ægypto : et quia conduxerunt contra te Balaam filium Beor de Mesopotamia Syriæ, ut malediceret tibi:
text_pt: Porquanto não saíram com pão e água, a receber-vos no caminho, quando saíeis do Egito; e porquanto alugaram contra ti a Balaão, filho de Beor, de Petor, de mesopotâmia, para te amaldiçoar.
text_el: παρὰ τὸ μὴ συναντῆσαι αὐτοὺς ὑμῖν μετὰ ἄρτων καὶ ὕδατος ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ἐκπορευομένων ὑμῶν ἐξ Αἰγύπτου καὶ ὅτι ἐμισθώσαντο ἐπὶ σὲ τὸν Βαλααμ υἱὸν Βεωρ ἐκ τῆς Μεσοποταμίας καταράσασθαί σε

text_en: And the Lord your God would not hear Balaam , and he turned his cursing into your blessing , because he loved you.
text_la: et noluit Dominus Deus tuus audire Balaam, vertitque maledictionem ejus in benedictionem tuam, eo quod diligeret te.
text_pt: Porém o Senhor teu Deus não quis ouvir Balaão; antes o Senhor teu Deus trocou em bênção a maldição; porquanto o Senhor teu Deus te amava.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησεν κύριος ὁ θεός σου εἰσακοῦσαι τοῦ Βαλααμ καὶ μετέστρεψεν κύριος ὁ θεός σου τὰς κατάρας εἰς εὐλογίαν ὅτι ἠγάπησέν σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου

text_en: You shall not make peace with them, neither shall you seek their prosperity all the days of your life for ever.
text_la: Non facies cum eis pacem, nec quæras eis bona cunctis diebus vitæ tuæ in sempiternum.
text_pt: Não lhes procurarás nem paz nem bem em todos os teus dias para sempre.
text_el: οὐ προσαγορεύσεις εἰρηνικὰ αὐτοῖς καὶ συμφέροντα αὐτοῖς πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: You shall not abhor the Edomite , because he is your brother: nor the Egyptian , because you were a stranger in his land.
text_la: Non abominaberis Idumæum, quia frater tuus est : nec Ægyptium, quia advena fuisti in terra ejus.
text_pt: Não abominarás o edomeu, pois é teu irmão; nem abominarás o egípcio, pois estrangeiro foste na sua terra.
text_el: οὐ βδελύξῃ Ιδουμαῖον ὅτι ἀδελφός σού ἐστιν οὐ βδελύξῃ Αἰγύπτιον ὅτι πάροικος ἐγένου ἐν τῇ γῇ αὐτοῦ

text_en: They that are born of them, in the third generation shall enter into the church of the Lord .
text_la: Qui nati fuerint ex eis, tertia generatione intrabunt in ecclesiam Domini.
text_pt: Os filhos que lhes nascerem na terceira geração, cada um deles entrará na congregação do Senhor.
text_el: υἱοὶ ἐὰν γενηθῶσιν αὐτοῖς γενεὰ τρίτη εἰσελεύσονται εἰς ἐκκλησίαν κυρίου

text_en: When you go out to war against your enemies, you shall keep yourself from every evil thing.
text_la: Quando egressus fueris adversus hostes tuos in pugnam, custodies te ab omni re mala.
text_pt: Quando o exército sair contra os teus inimigos, então te guardarás de toda a coisa má.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐξέλθῃς παρεμβαλεῖν ἐπὶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου καὶ φυλάξῃ ἀπὸ παντὸς ῥήματος πονηροῦ

text_en: If there be among you any man, that is defiled in a dream by night, he shall go forth out of the camp,
text_la: Si fuerit inter vos homo, qui nocturno pollutus sit somnio, egredietur extra castra,
text_pt: Quando entre ti houver alguém que, por algum acidente noturno, não estiver limpo, sairá fora do arraial; não entrará no meio dele.
text_el: ἐὰν ᾖ ἐν σοὶ ἄνθρωπος ὃς οὐκ ἔσται καθαρὸς ἐκ ῥύσεως αὐτοῦ νυκτός καὶ ἐξελεύσεται ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς καὶ οὐκ εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὴν παρεμβολήν

text_en: and shall not return, before he be washed with water in the evening: and after sunset he shall return into the camp.
text_la: et non revertetur, priusquam ad vesperam lavetur aqua : et post solis occasum regredietur in castra.
text_pt: Porém será que, declinando a tarde, se lavará em água; e, em se pondo o sol, entrará no meio do arraial.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται τὸ πρὸς ἑσπέραν λούσεται τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ ὕδατι καὶ δεδυκότος ἡλίου εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὴν παρεμβολήν

text_en: You shall have a place without the camp, to which you may go for the necessities of nature,
text_la: Habebis locum extra castra, ad quem egrediaris ad requisita naturæ,
text_pt: Também terás um lugar fora do arraial, para onde sairás.
text_el: καὶ τόπος ἔσται σοι ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς καὶ ἐξελεύσῃ ἐκεῖ ἔξω

text_en: carrying a paddle at your girdle. And when you sit down, you shall dig round about, and with the earth that is dug up you shall cover
text_la: gerens paxillum in balteo : cumque sederis, fodies per circuitum, et egesta humo operies
text_pt: E entre as tuas armas terás uma pá; e será que, quando estiveres assentado, fora, então com ela cavarás e, virando-te, cobrirás o que defecaste.
text_el: καὶ πάσσαλος ἔσται σοι ἐπὶ τῆς ζώνης σου καὶ ἔσται ὅταν διακαθιζάνῃς ἔξω καὶ ὀρύξεις ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐπαγαγὼν καλύψεις τὴν ἀσχημοσύνην σου ἐν αὐτῷ

text_en: that which you are eased of: (for the Lord your God walks in the midst of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies to you): and let your camp be holy , and let no uncleanness appear therein, lest he go away from you.
text_la: quo revelatus es : Dominus enim Deus tuus ambulat in medio castrorum, ut eruat te, et tradat tibi inimicos tuos : et sint castra tua sancta, et nihil in eis appareat fœditatis, ne derelinquat te.
text_pt: Porquanto o Senhor teu Deus anda no meio de teu arraial, para te livrar, e entregar a ti os teus inimigos; pelo que o teu arraial será santo, para que ele não veja coisa feia em ti, e se aparte de ti.
text_el: ὅτι κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐμπεριπατεῖ ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ σου ἐξελέσθαι σε καὶ παραδοῦναι τὸν ἐχθρόν σου πρὸ προσώπου σου καὶ ἔσται ἡ παρεμβολή σου ἁγία καὶ οὐκ ὀφθήσεται ἐν σοὶ ἀσχημοσύνη πράγματος καὶ ἀποστρέψει ἀπὸ σοῦ

text_en: You shall not deliver to his master the servant that is fled to you.
text_la: Non trades servum domino suo, qui ad te confugerit.
text_pt: Não entregarás a seu senhor o servo que, tendo fugido dele, se acolher a ti;
text_el: οὐ παραδώσεις παῖδα τῷ κυρίῳ αὐτοῦ ὃς προστέθειταί σοι παρὰ τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ

text_en: He shall dwell with you in the place that shall please him, and shall rest in one of your cities: give him no trouble.
text_la: Habitabit tecum in loco, qui ei placuerit, et in una urbium tuarum requiescet : ne contristes eum.
text_pt: Contigo ficará, no meio de ti, no lugar que escolher em alguma das tuas portas, onde lhe agradar; não o oprimirás.
text_el: μετὰ σοῦ κατοικήσει ἐν ὑμῖν κατοικήσει ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ οὗ ἐὰν ἀρέσῃ αὐτῷ οὐ θλίψεις αὐτόν

text_en: There shall be no whore among the daughters of Israel , nor whoremonger among the sons of Israel .
text_la: Non erit meretrix de filiabus Israël, nec scortator de filiis Israël.
text_pt: Não haverá prostituta dentre as filhas de Israel; nem haverá sodomita dentre os filhos de Israel.
text_el: οὐκ ἔσται πόρνη ἀπὸ θυγατέρων Ισραηλ καὶ οὐκ ἔσται πορνεύων ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ισραηλ οὐκ ἔσται τελεσφόρος ἀπὸ θυγατέρων Ισραηλ καὶ οὐκ ἔσται τελισκόμενος ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: You shall not offer the hire of a strumpet, nor the price of a dog, in the house of the Lord your God , whatsoever it be that you have vowed : because both these are an abomination to the Lord your God .
text_la: Non offeres mercedem prostibuli, nec pretium canis in domo Domini Dei tui, quidquid illud est quod voveris : quia abominatio est utrumque apud Dominum Deum tuum.
text_pt: Não trarás o salário da prostituta nem preço de um sodomita à casa do Senhor teu Deus por qualquer voto; porque ambos são igualmente abominação ao Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: οὐ προσοίσεις μίσθωμα πόρνης οὐδὲ ἄλλαγμα κυνὸς εἰς τὸν οἶκον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου πρὸς πᾶσαν εὐχήν ὅτι βδέλυγμα κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σού ἐστιν καὶ ἀμφότερα

text_en: You shall not lend to your brother money to usury , nor corn, nor any other thing:
text_la: Non fœnerabis fratri tuo ad usuram pecuniam, nec fruges, nec quamlibet aliam rem:
text_pt: A teu irmão não emprestarás com juros, nem dinheiro, nem comida, nem qualquer coisa que se empreste com juros.
text_el: οὐκ ἐκτοκιεῖς τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου τόκον ἀργυρίου καὶ τόκον βρωμάτων καὶ τόκον παντὸς πράγματος οὗ ἂν ἐκδανείσῃς

text_en: But to the stranger. To your brother you shall lend that which he wants, without usury : that the Lord your God may bless you in all your works in the land, which you shall go in to possess.
text_la: sed alieno. Fratri autem tuo absque usura id quo indiget, commodabis : ut benedicat tibi Dominus Deus tuus in omni opere tuo in terra, ad quam ingredieris possidendam.
text_pt: Ao estranho emprestarás com juros, porém a teu irmão não emprestarás com juros; para que o Senhor teu Deus te abençoe em tudo que puseres a tua mão, na terra a qual vais a possuir.
text_el: τῷ ἀλλοτρίῳ ἐκτοκιεῖς τῷ δὲ ἀδελφῷ σου οὐκ ἐκτοκιεῖς ἵνα εὐλογήσῃ σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ἔργοις σου ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς εἰς ἣν εἰσπορεύῃ ἐκεῖ κληρονομῆσαι αὐτήν

text_en: When you have made a vow to the Lord your God , you shall not delay to pay it: because the Lord your God will require it. And if you delay, it shall be imputed to you for a sin .
text_la: Cum votum voveris Domino Deo tuo, non tardabis reddere : quia requiret illud Dominus Deus tuus, et si moratus fueris, reputabitur tibi in peccatum.
text_pt: Quando fizeres algum voto ao Senhor teu Deus, não tardarás em cumpri-lo; porque o Senhor teu Deus certamente o requererá de ti, e em ti haverá pecado.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ εὔξῃ εὐχὴν κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σου οὐ χρονιεῖς ἀποδοῦναι αὐτήν ὅτι ἐκζητῶν ἐκζητήσει κύριος ὁ θεός σου παρὰ σοῦ καὶ ἔσται ἐν σοὶ ἁμαρία

text_en: If you will not promise, that shall be without sin .
text_la: Si nolueris polliceri, absque peccato eris.
text_pt: Porém, abstendo-te de votar, não haverá pecado em ti.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ θέλῃς εὔξασθαι οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν σοὶ ἁμαρτία

text_en: But that which is once gone out of your lips, you shall observe, and shall do as you have promised to the Lord your God , and have spoken with your own will and with your own mouth.
text_la: Quod autem semel egressum est de labiis tuis, observabis, et facies sicut promisisti Domino Deo tuo, et propria voluntate et ore tuo locutus es.
text_pt: O que saiu dos teus lábios guardarás, e cumprirás, tal como voluntariamente votaste ao Senhor teu Deus, declarando-o pela tua boca.
text_el: τὰ ἐκπορευόμενα διὰ τῶν χειλέων σου φυλάξῃ καὶ ποιήσεις ὃν τρόπον εὔξω κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σου δόμα ὃ ἐλάλησας τῷ στόματί σου

text_en: Going into your neighbour's vineyard, you may eat as many grapes as you please: but must carry none out with you:
text_la: Ingressus vineam proximi tui, comede uvas, quantum tibi placuerit : foras autem ne efferas tecum.
text_pt: Quando entrares na vinha do teu próximo, comerás uvas conforme ao teu desejo até te fartares, porém não as porás no teu cesto.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ εἰσέλθῃς εἰς ἀμητὸν τοῦ πλησίον σου καὶ συλλέξεις ἐν ταῖς χερσίν σου στάχυς καὶ δρέπανον οὐ μὴ ἐπιβάλῃς ἐπὶ τὸν ἀμητὸν τοῦ πλησίον σου

text_en: If you go into your friend's corn, you may break the ears, and rub them in your hand: but not reap them with a sickle.
text_la: Si intraveris in segetem amici tui, franges spicas, et manu conteres : falce autem non metes.
text_pt: Quando entrares na seara do teu próximo, com a tua mão arrancarás as espigas; porém não porás a foice na seara do teu próximo.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ εἰσέλθῃς εἰς τὸν ἀμπελῶνα τοῦ πλησίον σου φάγῃ σταφυλὴν ὅσον ψυχήν σου ἐμπλησθῆναι εἰς δὲ ἄγγος οὐκ ἐμβαλεῖς

text_en: If a man take a wife , and have her, and she find not favour in his eyes, for some uncleanness : he shall write a bill of divorce , and shall give it in her hand, and send her out of his house.
text_la: Si acceperit homo uxorem, et habuerit eam, et non invenerit gratiam ante oculos ejus propter aliquam fœditatem : scribet libellum repudii, et dabit in manu illius, et dimittet eam de domo sua.
text_pt: Quando um homem tomar uma mulher e se casar com ela, então será que, se não achar graça em seus olhos, por nela encontrar coisa indecente, far-lhe-á uma carta de repúdio, e lha dará na sua mão, e a despedirá da sua casa.
text_el: ἐὰν δέ τις λάβῃ γυναῖκα καὶ συνοικήσῃ αὐτῇ καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν μὴ εὕρῃ χάριν ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ ὅτι εὗρεν ἐν αὐτῇ ἄσχημον πρᾶγμα καὶ γράψει αὐτῇ βιβλίον ἀποστασίου καὶ δώσει εἰς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῆς καὶ ἐξαποστελεῖ αὐτὴν ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας αὐτοῦ

text_en: And when she is departed, and marries another husband,
text_la: Cumque egressa alterum maritum duxerit,
text_pt: Se ela, pois, saindo da sua casa, for e se casar com outro homem,
text_el: καὶ ἀπελθοῦσα γένηται ἀνδρὶ ἑτέρῳ

text_en: and he also hates her, and has given her a bill of divorce , and has sent her out of his house or is dead:
text_la: et ille quoque oderit eam, dederitque ei libellum repudii, et dimiserit de domo sua, vel certe mortuus fuerit:
text_pt: E este também a desprezar, e lhe fizer carta de repúdio, e lha der na sua mão, e a despedir da sua casa, ou se este último homem, que a tomou para si por mulher, vier a morrer,
text_el: καὶ μισήσῃ αὐτὴν ὁ ἀνὴρ ὁ ἔσχατος καὶ γράψει αὐτῇ βιβλίον ἀποστασίου καὶ δώσει εἰς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῆς καὶ ἐξαποστελεῖ αὐτὴν ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας αὐτοῦ ἢ ἀποθάνῃ ὁ ἀνὴρ ὁ ἔσχατος ὃς ἔλαβεν αὐτὴν ἑαυτῷ γυναῖκα

text_en: The former husband cannot take her again to wife : because she is defiled, and has become abominable before the Lord : lest you cause your land to sin , which the Lord your God shall give you to possess.
text_la: non poterit prior maritus recipere eam in uxorem : quia polluta est, et abominabilis facta est coram Domino : ne peccare facias terram tuam, quam Dominus Deus tuus tradiderit tibi possidendam.
text_pt: Então seu primeiro marido, que a despediu, não poderá tornar a tomá-la, para que seja sua mulher, depois que foi contaminada; pois é abominação perante o Senhor; assim não farás pecar a terra que o Senhor teu Deus te dá por herança.
text_el: οὐ δυνήσεται ὁ ἀνὴρ ὁ πρότερος ὁ ἐξαποστείλας αὐτὴν ἐπαναστρέψας λαβεῖν αὐτὴν ἑαυτῷ γυναῖκα μετὰ τὸ μιανθῆναι αὐτήν ὅτι βδέλυγμά ἐστιν ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου καὶ οὐ μιανεῖτε τὴν γῆν ἣν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν δίδωσιν ὑμῖν ἐν κλήρῳ

text_en: When a man has lately taken a wife , he shall not go out to war , neither shall any public business be enjoined him, but he shall be free at home without fault, that for one year he may rejoice with his wife.
text_la: Cum acceperit homo nuper uxorem, non procedet ad bellum, nec ei quippiam necessitatis injungetur publicæ, sed vacabit absque culpa domi suæ, ut uno anno lætetur cum uxore sua.
text_pt: Quando um homem for recém-casado não sairá à guerra, nem se lhe imporá encargo algum; por um ano inteiro ficará livre na sua casa para alegrar a mulher, que tomou.
text_el: ἐὰν δέ τις λάβῃ γυναῖκα προσφάτως οὐκ ἐξελεύσεται εἰς τὸν πόλεμον καὶ οὐκ ἐπιβληθήσεται αὐτῷ οὐδὲν πρᾶγμα ἀθῷος ἔσται ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ αὐτοῦ ἐνιαυτὸν ἕνα εὐφρανεῖ τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ ἣν ἔλαβεν

text_en: You shall not take the nether, nor the upper millstone to pledge: for he has pledged his life to you.
text_la: Non accipies loco pignoris inferiorem, et superiorem molam : quia animam suam opposuit tibi.
text_pt: Não se tomará em penhor ambas as mós, nem a mó de cima nem a de baixo; pois se penhoraria assim a vida.
text_el: οὐκ ἐνεχυράσεις μύλον οὐδὲ ἐπιμύλιον ὅτι ψυχὴν οὗτος ἐνεχυράζει

text_en: If any man be found soliciting his brother of the children of Israel , and selling him shall take a price, he shall be put to death , and you shall take away the evil from the midst of you.
text_la: Si deprehensus fuerit homo sollicitans fratrem suum de filiis Israël, et vendito eo acceperit pretium, interficietur, et auferes malum de medio tui.
text_pt: Quando se achar alguém que tiver furtado um dentre os seus irmãos, dos filhos de Israel, e escravizá-lo, ou vendê-lo, esse ladrão morrerá, e tirarás o mal do meio de ti.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἁλῷ ἄνθρωπος κλέπτων ψυχὴν τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ καταδυναστεύσας αὐτὸν ἀποδῶται ἀποθανεῖται ὁ κλέπτης ἐκεῖνος καὶ ἐξαρεῖς τὸν πονηρὸν ἐξ ὑμῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: Observe diligently that you incur not the stroke of the leprosy , but you shall do whatsoever the priests of the Levitical race shall teach you, according to what I have commanded them, and fulfil it carefully.
text_la: Observa diligenter ne incurras plagam lepræ, sed facies quæcumque docuerint te sacerdotes Levitici generis, juxta id quod præcepi eis, et imple sollicite.
text_pt: Guarda-te da praga da lepra, e tenhas grande cuidado de fazer conforme a tudo o que te ensinarem os sacerdotes levitas; como lhes tenho ordenado, terás cuidado de o fazer.
text_el: πρόσεχε σεαυτῷ ἐν τῇ ἁφῇ τῆς λέπρας φυλάξῃ σφόδρα ποιεῖν κατὰ πάντα τὸν νόμον ὃν ἐὰν ἀναγγείλωσιν ὑμῖν οἱ ἱερεῖς οἱ Λευῖται ὃν τρόπον ἐνετειλάμην ὑμῖν φυλάξασθε ποιεῖν

text_en: Remember what the Lord your God did to Mary, in the way when you came out of Egypt .
text_la: Mementote quæ fecerit Dominus Deus vester Mariæ in via cum egrederemini de Ægypto.
text_pt: Lembra-te do que o Senhor teu Deus fez a Miriã no caminho, quando saíste do Egito.
text_el: μνήσθητι ὅσα ἐποίησεν κύριος ὁ θεός σου τῇ Μαριαμ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ἐκπορευομένων ὑμῶν ἐξ Αἰγύπτου

text_en: When you shall demand of your neighbour anything that he owes you, you shall not go into his house to take away a pledge:
text_la: Cum repetes a proximo tuo rem aliquam, quam debet tibi, non ingredieris domum ejus ut pignus auferas:
text_pt: Quando emprestares alguma coisa ao teu próximo, não entrarás em sua casa, para lhe tirar o penhor.
text_el: ἐὰν ὀφείλημα ᾖ ἐν τῷ πλησίον σου ὀφείλημα ὁτιοῦν οὐκ εἰσελεύσῃ εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν αὐτοῦ ἐνεχυράσαι τὸ ἐνέχυρον

text_en: But you shall stand without, and he shall bring out to you what he has.
text_la: sed stabis foris, et ille tibi proferet quod habuerit.
text_pt: Fora ficarás; e o homem, a quem emprestaste, te trará fora o penhor.
text_el: ἔξω στήσῃ καὶ ὁ ἄνθρωπος οὗ τὸ δάνειόν σού ἐστιν ἐν αὐτῷ ἐξοίσει σοι τὸ ἐνέχυρον ἔξω

text_en: But if he be poor , the pledge shall not lodge with you that night,
text_la: Sin autem pauper est, non pernoctabit apud te pignus,
text_pt: Porém, se for homem pobre, não te deitarás com o seu penhor.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ὁ ἄνθρωπος πένηται οὐ κοιμηθήσῃ ἐν τῷ ἐνεχύρῳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: but you shall restore it to him presently before the going down of the sun: that he may sleep in his own raiment and bless you, and you may have justice before the Lord your God .
text_la: sed statim reddes ei ante solis occasum : ut dormiens in vestimento suo, benedicat tibi, et habeas justitiam coram Domino Deo tuo.
text_pt: Em se pondo o sol, sem falta lhe restituirás o penhor; para que durma na sua roupa, e te abençoe; e isto te será justiça diante do Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: ἀποδόσει ἀποδώσεις τὸ ἐνέχυρον αὐτοῦ περὶ δυσμὰς ἡλίου καὶ κοιμηθήσεται ἐν τῷ ἱματίῳ αὐτοῦ καὶ εὐλογήσει σε καὶ ἔσται σοι ἐλεημοσύνη ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου

text_en: You shall not refuse the hire of the needy , and the poor , whether he be your brother, or a stranger that dwells with you in the land, and is within your gates:
text_la: Non negabis mercedem indigentis, et pauperis fratris tui, sive advenæ, qui tecum moratur in terra, et intra portas tuas est:
text_pt: Não oprimirás o diarista pobre e necessitado de teus irmãos, ou de teus estrangeiros, que está na tua terra e nas tuas portas.
text_el: οὐκ ἀπαδικήσεις μισθὸν πένητος καὶ ἐνδεοῦς ἐκ τῶν ἀδελφῶν σου ἢ ἐκ τῶν προσηλύτων τῶν ἐν ταῖς πόλεσίν σου

text_en: But you shall pay him the price of his labour the same day, before the going down of the sun, because he is poor , and with it maintains his life: lest he cry against you to the Lord , and it be reputed to you for a sin .
text_la: sed eadem die reddes ei pretium laboris sui ante solis occasum, quia pauper est, et ex eo sustentat animam suam : ne clamet contra te ad Dominum, et reputetur tibi in peccatum.
text_pt: No seu dia lhe pagarás a sua diária, e o sol não se porá sobre isso; porquanto pobre é, e sua vida depende disso; para que não clame contra ti ao Senhor, e haja em ti pecado.
text_el: αὐθημερὸν ἀποδώσεις τὸν μισθὸν αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐπιδύσεται ὁ ἥλιος ἐπ' αὐτῷ ὅτι πένης ἐστὶν καὶ ἐν αὐτῷ ἔχει τὴν ἐλπίδα καὶ οὐ καταβοήσεται κατὰ σοῦ πρὸς κύριον καὶ ἔσται ἐν σοὶ ἁμαρτία

text_en: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children for the fathers , but every one shall die for his own sin ,
text_la: Non occidentur patres pro filiis, nec filii pro patribus, sed unusquisque pro peccato suo morietur.
text_pt: Os pais não morrerão pelos filhos, nem os filhos pelos pais; cada um morrerá pelo seu pecado.
text_el: οὐκ ἀποθανοῦνται πατέρες ὑπὲρ τέκνων καὶ υἱοὶ οὐκ ἀποθανοῦνται ὑπὲρ πατέρων ἕκαστος τῇ ἑαυτοῦ ἁμαρτίᾳ ἀποθανεῖται

text_en: you shall not pervert the judgment of the stranger nor of the fatherless , neither shall you take away the widow's raiment for a pledge.
text_la: Non pervertes judicium advenæ et pupilli, nec auferes pignoris loco viduæ vestimentum.
text_pt: Não perverterás o direito do estrangeiro e do órfão; nem tomarás em penhor a roupa da viúva.
text_el: οὐκ ἐκκλινεῖς κρίσιν προσηλύτου καὶ ὀρφανοῦ καὶ χήρας καὶ οὐκ ἐνεχυράσεις ἱμάτιον χήρας

text_en: Remember that you were a slave in Egypt , and the Lord your God delivered you from thence. Therefore I command you to do this thing.
text_la: Memento quod servieris in Ægypto, et eruerit te Dominus Deus tuus inde. Idcirco præcipio tibi ut facias hanc rem.
text_pt: Mas lembrar-te-ás de que foste servo no Egito, e de que o Senhor teu Deus te livrou dali; pelo que te ordeno que faças isso.
text_el: καὶ μνησθήσῃ ὅτι οἰκέτης ἦσθα ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ ἐλυτρώσατό σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐκεῖθεν διὰ τοῦτο ἐγώ σοι ἐντέλλομαι ποιεῖν τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο

text_en: When you have reaped the corn in your field, and have forgot and left a sheaf, you shall not return to take it away: but you shall allow the stranger, and the fatherless and the widow to take it away: that the Lord your God may bless you in all the works of your hands.
text_la: Quando messueris segetem in agro tuo, et oblitus manipulum reliqueris, non reverteris, ut tollas illum : sed advenam, et pupillum, et viduam auferre patieris, ut benedicat tibi Dominus Deus tuus in omni opere manuum tuarum.
text_pt: Quando no teu campo colheres a tua colheita, e esqueceres um molho no campo, não tornarás a tomá-lo; para o estrangeiro, para o órfão, e para a viúva será; para que o Senhor teu Deus te abençoe em toda a obra das tuas mãos,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἀμήσῃς ἀμητὸν ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ σου καὶ ἐπιλάθῃ δράγμα ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ σου οὐκ ἐπαναστραφήσῃ λαβεῖν αὐτό τῷ πτωχῷ καὶ τῷ προσηλύτῳ καὶ τῷ ὀρφανῷ καὶ τῇ χήρᾳ ἔσται ἵνα εὐλογήσῃ σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ἔργοις τῶν χειρῶν σου

text_en: If you have gathered the fruit of your olive trees, you shall not return to gather whatsoever remains on the trees: but shall leave it for the stranger, for the fatherless , and the widow .
text_la: Si fruges collegeris olivarum, quidquid remanserit in arboribus, non reverteris ut colligas : sed relinques advenæ, pupillo, ac viduæ.
text_pt: Quando sacudires a tua oliveira, não voltarás para colher o fruto dos ramos; para o estrangeiro, para o órfão, e para a viúva será.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐλαιαλογήσῃς οὐκ ἐπαναστρέψεις καλαμήσασθαι τὰ ὀπίσω σου τῷ προσηλύτῳ καὶ τῷ ὀρφανῷ καὶ τῇ χήρᾳ ἔσται καὶ μνησθήσῃ ὅτι οἰκέτης ἦσθα ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ διὰ τοῦτο ἐγώ σοι ἐντέλλομαι ποιεῖν τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο

text_en: If you make the vintage of your vineyard, you shall not gather the clusters that remain, but they shall be for the stranger, the fatherless , and the widow .
text_la: Si vindemiaveris vineam tuam, non colliges remanentes racemos : sed cedent in usus advenæ, pupilli, ac viduæ.
text_pt: Quando vindimares a tua vinha, não voltarás para rebuscá-la; para o estrangeiro, para o órfão, e para a viúva será.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ τρυγήσῃς τὸν ἀμπελῶνά σου οὐκ ἐπανατρυγήσεις αὐτὸν τὰ ὀπίσω σου τῷ προσηλύτῳ καὶ τῷ ὀρφανῷ καὶ τῇ χήρᾳ ἔσται

text_en: Remember that you also were a bondman in Egypt , and therefore I command you to do this thing.
text_la: Memento quod et tu servieris in Ægypto, et idcirco præcipio tibi ut facias hanc rem.
text_pt: E lembrar-te-ás de que foste servo na terra do Egito; portanto te ordeno que faças isso.
text_el: καὶ μνησθήσῃ ὅτι οἰκέτης ἦσθα ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ διὰ τοῦτο ἐγώ σοι ἐντέλλομαι ποιεῖν τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο

text_en: If there be a controversy between men , and they call upon the judges: they shall give the prize of justice to him whom they perceive to be just : and him whom they find to be wicked , they shall condemn of wickedness .
text_la: Si fuerit causa inter aliquos, et interpellaverint judices : quem justum esse perspexerint, illi justitiæ palmam dabunt : quem impium, condemnabunt impietatis.
text_pt: Quando houver contenda entre alguns, e vierem a juízo, para que os julguem, ao justo justificarão, e ao injusto condenarão.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ γένηται ἀντιλογία ἀνὰ μέσον ἀνθρώπων καὶ προσέλθωσιν εἰς κρίσιν καὶ κρίνωσιν καὶ δικαιώσωσιν τὸν δίκαιον καὶ καταγνῶσιν τοῦ ἀσεβοῦς

text_en: And if they see that the offender be worthy of stripes: they shall lay him down, and shall cause him to be beaten before them. According to the measure of the sin shall the measure also of the stripes be:
text_la: Sin autem eum, qui peccavit, dignum viderint plagis : prosternent, et coram se facient verberari. Pro mensura peccati erit et plagarum modus:
text_pt: E será que, se o injusto merecer açoites, o juiz o fará deitar-se, para que seja açoitado diante de si; segundo a sua culpa, será o número de açoites.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν ἄξιος ᾖ πληγῶν ὁ ἀσεβῶν καὶ καθιεῖς αὐτὸν ἔναντι τῶν κριτῶν καὶ μαστιγώσουσιν αὐτὸν ἐναντίον αὐτῶν κατὰ τὴν ἀσέβειαν αὐτοῦ ἀριθμῷ

text_en: Yet so, that they exceed not the number of forty: lest your brother depart shamefully torn before your eyes.
text_la: ita dumtaxat, ut quadragenarium numerum non excedant : ne fœde laceratus ante oculos tuos abeat frater tuus.
text_pt: Quarenta açoites lhe fará dar, não mais; para que, porventura, se lhe fizer dar mais açoites do que estes, teu irmão não fique envilecido aos teus olhos.
text_el: τεσσαράκοντα μαστιγώσουσιν αὐτόν οὐ προσθήσουσιν ἐὰν δὲ προσθῶσιν μαστιγῶσαι αὐτὸν ὑπὲρ ταύτας τὰς πληγὰς πλείους ἀσχημονήσει ὁ ἀδελφός σου ἐναντίον σου

text_en: You shall not muzzle the ox that treads out your corn on the floor.
text_la: Non ligabis os bovis terentis in area fruges tuas.
text_pt: Não atarás a boca ao boi, quando trilhar.
text_el: οὐ φιμώσεις βοῦν ἀλοῶντα

text_en: When brethren dwell together, and one of them dies without children, the wife of the deceased shall not marry to another: but his brother shall take her, and raise up seed for his brother:
text_la: Quando habitaverint fratres simul, et unus ex eis absque liberis mortuus fuerit, uxor defuncti non nubet alteri : sed accipiet eam frater ejus, et suscitabit semen fratris sui:
text_pt: Quando irmãos morarem juntos, e um deles morrer, e não tiver filho, então a mulher do falecido não se casará com homem estranho, de fora; seu cunhado estará com ela, e a receberá por mulher, e fará a obrigação de cunhado para com ela.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ κατοικῶσιν ἀδελφοὶ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ καὶ ἀποθάνῃ εἷς ἐξ αὐτῶν σπέρμα δὲ μὴ ᾖ αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔσται ἡ γυνὴ τοῦ τεθνηκότος ἔξω ἀνδρὶ μὴ ἐγγίζοντι ὁ ἀδελφὸς τοῦ ἀνδρὸς αὐτῆς εἰσελεύσεται πρὸς αὐτὴν καὶ λήμψεται αὐτὴν ἑαυτῷ γυναῖκα καὶ συνοικήσει αὐτῇ

text_en: And the first son he shall have of her he shall call by his name , that his name be not abolished out of Israel .
text_la: et primogenitum ex ea filium nomine illius appellabit, ut non deleatur nomen ejus ex Israël.
text_pt: E o primogênito que ela lhe der será sucessor do nome do seu irmão falecido, para que o seu nome não se apague em Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται τὸ παιδίον ὃ ἐὰν τέκῃ κατασταθήσεται ἐκ τοῦ ὀνόματος τοῦ τετελευτηκότος καὶ οὐκ ἐξαλειφθήσεται τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐξ Ισραηλ

text_en: But if he will not take his brother's wife, who by law belongs to him, the woman shall go to the gate of the city, and call upon the ancients, and say: My husband's brother refuses to raise up his brother's name in Israel : and will not take me to wife .
text_la: Sin autem noluerit accipere uxorem fratris sui, quæ ei lege debetur, perget mulier ad portam civitatis, et interpellabit majores natu, dicetque : Non vult frater viri mei suscitare nomen fratris sui in Israël, nec me in conjugem sumere.
text_pt: Porém, se o homem não quiser tomar sua cunhada, esta subirá à porta dos anciãos, e dirá: Meu cunhado recusa suscitar a seu irmão nome em Israel; não quer cumprir para comigo o dever de cunhado.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ βούληται ὁ ἄνθρωπος λαβεῖν τὴν γυναῖκα τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀναβήσεται ἡ γυνὴ ἐπὶ τὴν πύλην ἐπὶ τὴν γερουσίαν καὶ ἐρεῖ οὐ θέλει ὁ ἀδελφὸς τοῦ ἀνδρός μου ἀναστῆσαι τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ ἐν Ισραηλ οὐκ ἠθέλησεν ὁ ἀδελφὸς τοῦ ἀνδρός μου

text_en: And they shall cause him to be sent for forthwith, and shall ask him. If he answer: I will not take her to wife :
text_la: Statimque accersiri eum facient, et interrogabunt. Si responderit : Nolo eam uxorem accipere:
text_pt: Então os anciãos da sua cidade o chamarão, e com ele falarão; e, se ele persistir, e disser: Não quero tomá-la;
text_el: καὶ καλέσουσιν αὐτὸν ἡ γερουσία τῆς πόλεως αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐροῦσιν αὐτῷ καὶ στὰς εἴπῃ οὐ βούλομαι λαβεῖν αὐτήν

text_en: The woman shall come to him before the ancients, and shall take off his shoe from his foot, and spit in his face, and say: So shall it be done to the man that will not build up his brother's house:
text_la: accedet mulier ad eum coram senioribus, et tollet calceamentum de pede ejus, spuetque in faciem illius, et dicet : Sic fiet homini, qui non ædificat domum fratris sui.
text_pt: Então sua cunhada se chegará a ele na presença dos anciãos, e lhe descalçará o sapato do pé, e lhe cuspirá no rosto, e protestará, e dirá: Assim se fará ao homem que não edificar a casa de seu irmão;
text_el: καὶ προσελθοῦσα ἡ γυνὴ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ ἔναντι τῆς γερουσίας καὶ ὑπολύσει τὸ ὑπόδημα αὐτοῦ τὸ ἓν ἀπὸ τοῦ ποδὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐμπτύσεται εἰς τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀποκριθεῖσα ἐρεῖ οὕτως ποιήσουσιν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ ὃς οὐκ οἰκοδομήσει τὸν οἶκον τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And his name shall be called in Israel , the house of the unshod .
text_la: Et vocabitur nomen illius in Israël, Domus discalceati.
text_pt: E o seu nome se chamará em Israel: A casa do descalçado.
text_el: καὶ κληθήσεται τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐν Ισραηλ οἶκος τοῦ ὑπολυθέντος τὸ ὑπόδημα

text_en: If two men have words together, and one begin to fight against the other, and the other's wife willing to deliver her husband out of the hand of the stronger, shall put forth her hand, and take him by the secrets,
text_la: Si habuerint inter se jurgium viri duo, et unus contra alterum rixari cœperit, volensque uxor alterius eruere virum suum de manu fortioris, miseritque manum, et apprehenderit verenda ejus:
text_pt: Quando pelejarem dois homens, um contra o outro, e a mulher de um chegar para livrar a seu marido da mão do que o fere, e ela estender a sua mão, e lhe pegar pelas suas vergonhas,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μάχωνται ἄνθρωποι ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό ἄνθρωπος μετὰ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ προσέλθῃ γυνὴ ἑνὸς αὐτῶν ἐξελέσθαι τὸν ἄνδρα αὐτῆς ἐκ χειρὸς τοῦ τύπτοντος αὐτὸν καὶ ἐκτείνασα τὴν χεῖρα ἐπιλάβηται τῶν διδύμων αὐτοῦ

text_en: you shall cut off her hand, neither shall you be moved with any pity in her regard.
text_la: abscides manum illius, nec flecteris super eam ulla misericordia.
text_pt: Então cortar-lhe-ás a mão; não a poupará o teu olho.
text_el: ἀποκόψεις τὴν χεῖρα αὐτῆς οὐ φείσεται ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου ἐπ' αὐτῇ

text_en: You shall not have divers weights in your bag, a greater and a less:
text_la: Non habebis in sacculo diversa pondera, majus et minus:
text_pt: Na tua bolsa não terás pesos diversos, um grande e um pequeno.
text_el: οὐκ ἔσται ἐν τῷ μαρσίππῳ σου στάθμιον καὶ στάθμιον μέγα ἢ μικρόν

text_en: Neither shall there be in your house a greater bushel and a less.
text_la: nec erit in domo tua modius major, et minor.
text_pt: Na tua casa não terás dois tipos de efa, um grande e um pequeno.
text_el: οὐκ ἔσται ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ σου μέτρον καὶ μέτρον μέγα ἢ μικρόν

text_en: You shall have a just and a true weight, and your bushel shall be equal and true : that you may live a long time upon the land which the Lord your God shall give you.
text_la: Pondus habebis justum et verum, et modius æqualis et verus erit tibi : ut multo vivas tempore super terram, quam Dominus Deus tuus dederit tibi.
text_pt: Peso inteiro e justo terás; efa inteiro e justo terás; para que se prolonguem os teus dias na terra que te dará o Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: στάθμιον ἀληθινὸν καὶ δίκαιον ἔσται σοι καὶ μέτρον ἀληθινὸν καὶ δίκαιον ἔσται σοι ἵνα πολυήμερος γένῃ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἧς κύριος ὁ θεός σου δίδωσίν σοι ἐν κλήρῳ

text_en: For the Lord your God abhors him that does these things, and he hates all injustice .
text_la: Abominatur enim Dominus tuus eum qui facit hæc, et aversatur omnem injustitiam.
text_pt: Porque abominação é ao Senhor teu Deus todo aquele que faz isto, todo aquele que fizer injustiça.
text_el: ὅτι βδέλυγμα κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σου πᾶς ποιῶν ταῦτα πᾶς ποιῶν ἄδικον

text_en: Remember what Amalec did to you in the way when you came out of Egypt :
text_la: Memento quæ fecerit tibi Amalec in via quando egrediebaris ex Ægypto:
text_pt: Lembra-te do que te fez Amaleque no caminho, quando saías do Egito;
text_el: μνήσθητι ὅσα ἐποίησέν σοι Αμαληκ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ἐκπορευομένου σου ἐξ Αἰγύπτου

text_en: How he met you: and slew the hindmost of the army, who sat down, being weary, when you were spent with hunger and labour, and he feared not God .
text_la: quomodo occurrerit tibi, et extremos agminis tui, qui lassi residebant, ceciderit, quando tu eras fame et labore confectus : et non timuerit Deum.
text_pt: Como te saiu ao encontro no caminho, e feriu na tua retaguarda todos os fracos que iam atrás de ti, estando tu cansado e afadigado; e não temeu a Deus.
text_el: πῶς ἀντέστη σοι ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ καὶ ἔκοψέν σου τὴν οὐραγίαν τοὺς κοπιῶντας ὀπίσω σου σὺ δὲ ἐπείνας καὶ ἐκοπίας καὶ οὐκ ἐφοβήθη τὸν θεόν

text_en: Therefore when the Lord your God shall give you rest, and shall have subdued all the nations round about in the land which he has promised you: you shall blot out his name from under heaven . See that you forget it not.
text_la: Cum ergo Dominus Deus tuus dederit tibi requiem, et subjecerit cunctas per circuitum nationes in terra, quam tibi pollicitus est : delebis nomen ejus sub cælo. Cave ne obliviscaris.
text_pt: Será, pois, que, quando o Senhor teu Deus te tiver dado repouso de todos os teus inimigos em redor, na terra que o Senhor teu Deus te dá por herança, para possuí-la, então apagarás a memória de Amaleque de debaixo do céu; não te esqueças.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἡνίκα ἐὰν καταπαύσῃ σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐχθρῶν σου τῶν κύκλῳ σου ἐν τῇ γῇ ᾗ κύριος ὁ θεός σου δίδωσίν σοι ἐν κλήρῳ κατακληρονομῆσαι ἐξαλείψεις τὸ ὄνομα Αμαληκ ἐκ τῆς ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐπιλάθῃ

text_en: And when you have come into the land which the Lord your God will give you to possess, and have conquered it, and dwell in it:
text_la: Cumque intraveris terram, quam Dominus Deus tuus tibi daturus est possidendam, et obtinueris eam, atque habitaveris in ea:
text_pt: E será que, quando entrares na terra que o SENHOR teu Deus te der por herança, e a possuíres, e nela habitares,
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν εἰσέλθῃς εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν κύριος ὁ θεός σου δίδωσίν σοι ἐν κλήρῳ καὶ κατακληρονομήσῃς αὐτὴν καὶ κατοικήσῃς ἐπ' αὐτῆς

text_en: You shall take the first of all your fruits , and put them in a basket, and shall go to the place which the Lord your God shall choose, that his name may be invocated there:
text_la: tolles de cunctis frugibus tuis primitias, et pones in cartallo, pergesque ad locum quem Dominus Deus tuus elegerit, ut ibi invocetur nomen ejus:
text_pt: Então tomarás das primícias de todos os frutos do solo, que recolheres da terra, que te dá o Senhor teu Deus, e as porás num cesto, e irás ao lugar que escolher o Senhor teu Deus, para ali fazer habitar o seu nome.
text_el: καὶ λήμψῃ ἀπὸ τῆς ἀπαρχῆς τῶν καρπῶν τῆς γῆς σου ἧς κύριος ὁ θεός σου δίδωσίν σοι καὶ ἐμβαλεῖς εἰς κάρταλλον καὶ πορεύσῃ εἰς τὸν τόπον ὃν ἂν ἐκλέξηται κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐπικληθῆναι τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐκεῖ

text_en: And you shall go to the priest that shall be in those days, and say to him: I profess this day before the Lord your God , that I have come into the land, for which he swore to our fathers, that he would give it us.
text_la: accedesque ad sacerdotem, qui fuerit in diebus illis, et dices ad eum : Profiteor hodie coram Domino Deo tuo, quod ingressus sum in terram, pro qua juravit patribus nostris, ut daret eam nobis.
text_pt: E irás ao sacerdote, que houver naqueles dias, e dir-lhe-ás: Hoje declaro perante o Senhor teu Deus que entrei na terra que o Senhor jurou a nossos pais dar-nos.
text_el: καὶ ἐλεύσῃ πρὸς τὸν ἱερέα ὃς ἐὰν ᾖ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτόν ἀναγγέλλω σήμερον κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ μου ὅτι εἰσελήλυθα εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ὤμοσεν κύριος τοῖς πατράσιν ἡμῶν δοῦναι ἡμῖν

text_en: And the priest taking the basket at your hand, shall set it before the altar of the Lord your God :
text_la: Suscipiensque sacerdos cartallum de manu tua, ponet ante altare Domini Dei tui:
text_pt: E o sacerdote tomará o cesto da tua mão, e o porá diante do altar do Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: καὶ λήμψεται ὁ ἱερεὺς τὸν κάρταλλον ἐκ τῶν χειρῶν σου καὶ θήσει αὐτὸν ἀπέναντι τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου

text_en: And you shall speak thus in the sight of the Lord your God : The Syrian pursued my father, who went down into Egypt , and sojourned there in a very small number, and grew into a nation great and strong and of an infinite multitude.
text_la: et loqueris in conspectu Domini Dei tui : Syrus persequebatur patrem meum, qui descendit in Ægyptum, et ibi peregrinatus est in paucissimo numero : crevitque in gentem magnam ac robustam et infinitæ multitudinis.
text_pt: Então testificarás perante o Senhor teu Deus, e dirás: Arameu, prestes a perecer, foi meu pai, e desceu ao Egito, e ali peregrinou com pouca gente, porém ali cresceu até vir a ser nação grande, poderosa, e numerosa.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθήσῃ καὶ ἐρεῖς ἔναντι κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου Συρίαν ἀπέβαλεν ὁ πατήρ μου καὶ κατέβη εἰς Αἴγυπτον καὶ παρῴκησεν ἐκεῖ ἐν ἀριθμῷ βραχεῖ καὶ ἐγένετο ἐκεῖ εἰς ἔθνος μέγα καὶ πλῆθος πολὺ καὶ μέγα

text_en: And the Egyptians afflicted us, and persecuted us, laying on us most grievous burdens:
text_la: Afflixeruntque nos Ægyptii, et persecuti sunt, imponentes onera gravissima:
text_pt: Mas os egípcios nos maltrataram e nos afligiram, e sobre nós impuseram uma dura servidão.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάκωσαν ἡμᾶς οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι καὶ ἐταπείνωσαν ἡμᾶς καὶ ἐπέθηκαν ἡμῖν ἔργα σκληρά

text_en: And we cried to the Lord God of our fathers: who heard us, and looked down upon our affliction, and labour, and distress:
text_la: et clamavimus ad Dominum Deum patrum nostrorum : qui exaudivit nos, et respexit humilitatem nostram, et laborem, atque angustiam:
text_pt: Então clamamos ao Senhor Deus de nossos pais; e o Senhor ouviu a nossa voz, e atentou para a nossa miséria, e para o nosso trabalho, e para a nossa opressão.
text_el: καὶ ἀνεβοήσαμεν πρὸς κύριον τὸν θεὸν τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν καὶ εἰσήκουσεν κύριος τῆς φωνῆς ἡμῶν καὶ εἶδεν τὴν ταπείνωσιν ἡμῶν καὶ τὸν μόχθον ἡμῶν καὶ τὸν θλιμμὸν ἡμῶν

text_en: And brought us out of Egypt with a strong hand, and a stretched out arm, with great terror, with signs and wonders :
text_la: et eduxit nos de Ægypto in manu forti, et brachio extento, in ingenti pavore, in signis atque portentis:
text_pt: E o Senhor nos tirou do Egito com mão forte, e com braço estendido, e com grande espanto, e com sinais, e com milagres;
text_el: καὶ ἐξήγαγεν ἡμᾶς κύριος ἐξ Αἰγύπτου αὐτὸς ἐν ἰσχύι μεγάλῃ καὶ ἐν χειρὶ κραταιᾷ καὶ ἐν βραχίονι αὐτοῦ τῷ ὑψηλῷ καὶ ἐν ὁράμασιν μεγάλοις καὶ ἐν σημείοις καὶ ἐν τέρασιν

text_en: And brought us into this place, and gave us this land flowing with milk and honey.
text_la: et introduxit ad locum istum, et tradidit nobis terram lacte et melle manantem.
text_pt: E nos trouxe a este lugar, e nos deu esta terra, terra que mana leite e mel.
text_el: καὶ εἰσήγαγεν ἡμᾶς εἰς τὸν τόπον τοῦτον καὶ ἔδωκεν ἡμῖν τὴν γῆν ταύτην γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι

text_en: And therefore now I offer the firstfruits of the land which the Lord has given me. And you shall leave them in the sight of the Lord your God , adoring the Lord your God .
text_la: Et idcirco nunc offero primitias frugum terræ, quam Dominus dedit mihi. Et dimittes eas in conspectu Domini Dei tui, et adorato Domino Deo tuo.
text_pt: E eis que agora eu trouxe as primícias dos frutos da terra que tu, ó Senhor, me deste. Então as porás perante o Senhor teu Deus, e te inclinarás perante o Senhor teu Deus,
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἰδοὺ ἐνήνοχα τὴν ἀπαρχὴν τῶν γενημάτων τῆς γῆς ἧς ἔδωκάς μοι κύριε γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι καὶ ἀφήσεις αὐτὰ ἀπέναντι κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου καὶ προσκυνήσεις ἐκεῖ ἔναντι κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου

text_en: And you shall feast in all the good things which the Lord your God has given you, and your house, you and the Levite , and the stranger that is with you.
text_la: Et epulaberis in omnibus bonis, quæ Dominus Deus tuus dederit tibi et domui tuæ, tu et Levites, et advena qui tecum est.
text_pt: E te alegrarás por todo o bem que o Senhor teu Deus te tem dado a ti e à tua casa, tu e o levita, e o estrangeiro que está no meio de ti.
text_el: καὶ εὐφρανθήσῃ ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς οἷς ἔδωκέν σοι κύριος ὁ θεός σου καὶ τῇ οἰκίᾳ σου σὺ καὶ ὁ Λευίτης καὶ ὁ προσήλυτος ὁ ἐν σοί

text_en: When you have made an end of tithing all your fruits , in the third year of tithes you shall give it to the Levite , and to the stranger, and to the fatherless , and to the widow , that they may eat within your gates, and be filled:
text_la: Quando compleveris decimam cunctarum frugum tuarum, anno decimarum tertio, dabis Levitæ, et advenæ, et pupillo et viduæ, ut comedant intra portas tuas, et saturentur:
text_pt: Quando acabares de separar todos os dízimos da tua colheita no ano terceiro, que é o ano dos dízimos, então os darás ao levita, ao estrangeiro, ao órfão e à viúva, para que comam dentro das tuas portas, e se fartem;
