text_el: ἐὰν δὲ συντελέσῃς ἀποδεκατῶσαι πᾶν τὸ ἐπιδέκατον τῶν γενημάτων τῆς γῆς σου ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ τρίτῳ τὸ δεύτερον ἐπιδέκατον δώσεις τῷ Λευίτῃ καὶ τῷ προσηλύτῳ καὶ τῷ ὀρφανῷ καὶ τῇ χήρᾳ καὶ φάγονται ἐν ταῖς πόλεσίν σου καὶ ἐμπλησθήσονται

text_en: And you shall speak thus in the sight of the Lord your God : I have taken that which was sanctified out of my house, and I have given it to the Levite , and to the stranger, and to the fatherless , and to the widow , as you have commanded me: I have not transgressed your commandments nor forgotten your precepts .
text_la: loquerisque in conspectu Domini Deo tui : Abstuli quod sanctificatum est de domo mea, et dedi illud Levitæ et advenæ, et pupillo ac viduæ, sicut jussisti mihi : non præterivi mandata tua, nec sum oblitus imperii tui.
text_pt: E dirás perante o Senhor teu Deus: Tirei da minha casa as coisas consagradas e as dei também ao levita, e ao estrangeiro, e ao órfão e à viúva, conforme a todos os teus mandamentos que me tens ordenado; não transgredi os teus mandamentos, nem deles me esqueci;
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου ἐξεκάθαρα τὰ ἅγια ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας μου καὶ ἔδωκα αὐτὰ τῷ Λευίτῃ καὶ τῷ προσηλύτῳ καὶ τῷ ὀρφανῷ καὶ τῇ χήρᾳ κατὰ πάσας τὰς ἐντολάς ἃς ἐνετείλω μοι οὐ παρῆλθον τὴν ἐντολήν σου καὶ οὐκ ἐπελαθόμην

text_en: I have not eaten of them in my mourning, nor separated them for any uncleanness , nor spent anything of them in funerals. I have obeyed the voice of the Lord my God , and have done all things as you have commanded me.
text_la: Non comedi ex eis in luctu meo, nec separavi ea in qualibet immunditia, nec expendi ex his quidquam in re funebri. Obedivi voci Domini Dei mei, et feci omnia sicut præcepisti mihi.
text_pt: Delas não comi no meu luto, nem delas nada tirei quando imundo, nem delas dei para os mortos; obedeci à voz do Senhor meu Deus; conforme a tudo o que me ordenaste, tenho feito.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἔφαγον ἐν ὀδύνῃ μου ἀπ' αὐτῶν οὐκ ἐκάρπωσα ἀπ' αὐτῶν εἰς ἀκάθαρτον οὐκ ἔδωκα ἀπ' αὐτῶν τῷ τεθνηκότι ὑπήκουσα τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ μου ἐποίησα καθὰ ἐνετείλω μοι

text_en: Look from your sanctuary, and your high habitation of heaven , and bless your people Israel , and the land which you have given us, as swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.
text_la: Respice de sanctuario tuo, et de excelso cælorum habitaculo, et benedic populo tuo Israël, et terræ, quam dedisti nobis, sicut jurasti patribus nostris, terræ lacte et melle mananti.
text_pt: Olha desde a tua santa habitação, desde o céu, e abençoa o teu povo, a Israel, e a terra que nos deste, como juraste a nossos pais, terra que mana leite e mel.
text_el: κάτιδε ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ ἁγίου σου ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ εὐλόγησον τὸν λαόν σου τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ τὴν γῆν ἣν ἔδωκας αὐτοῖς καθὰ ὤμοσας τοῖς πατράσιν ἡμῶν δοῦναι ἡμῖν γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι

text_en: This day the Lord your God has commanded you to do these commandments and judgments: and to keep and fulfil them with all your heart, and with all your soul .
text_la: Hodie Dominus Deus tuus præcepit tibi ut facias mandata hæc atque judicia : et custodias et impleas ex toto corde tuo, et ex tota anima tua.
text_pt: Neste dia, o Senhor teu Deus te manda cumprir estes estatutos e juízos; guarda-os pois, e cumpre-os com todo o teu coração e com toda a tua alma.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐνετείλατό σοι ποιῆσαι πάντα τὰ δικαιώματα ταῦτα καὶ τὰ κρίματα καὶ φυλάξεσθε καὶ ποιήσετε αὐτὰ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς καρδίας ὑμῶν καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς ψυχῆς ὑμῶν

text_en: You have chosen the Lord this day to be your God , and to walk in his ways and keep his ceremonies , and precepts , and judgments, and obey his command.
text_la: Dominum elegisti hodie, ut sit tibi Deus, et ambules in viis ejus, et custodias cæremonias illius, et mandata atque judicia, et obedias ejus imperio.
text_pt: Hoje declaraste ao Senhor que ele te será por Deus, e que andarás nos seus caminhos, e guardarás os seus estatutos, e os seus mandamentos, e os seus juízos, e darás ouvidos à sua voz.
text_el: τὸν θεὸν εἵλου σήμερον εἶναί σου θεὸν καὶ πορεύεσθαι ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ φυλάσσεσθαι τὰ δικαιώματα καὶ τὰ κρίματα αὐτοῦ καὶ ὑπακούειν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the Lord has chosen you this day, to be his peculiar people, as he has spoken to you, and to keep all his commandments :
text_la: Et Dominus elegit te hodie ut sis ei populus peculiaris, sicut locutus est tibi, et custodias omnia præcepta illius:
text_pt: E o Senhor hoje te declarou que tu lhe serás por seu próprio povo, como te tem dito, e que guardarás todos os seus mandamentos.
text_el: καὶ κύριος εἵλατό σε σήμερον γενέσθαι σε αὐτῷ λαὸν περιούσιον καθάπερ εἶπέν σοι φυλάσσειν πάσας τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And to make you higher than all nations which he has created, to his own praise, and name , and glory : that you may be a holy people of the Lord your God , as he has spoken.
text_la: et faciat te excelsiorem cunctis gentibus quas creavit, in laudem, et nomen, et gloriam suam : ut sis populus sanctus Domini Dei tui, sicut locutus est.
text_pt: Para assim te exaltar sobre todas as nações que criou, para louvor, e para fama, e para glória, e para que sejas um povo santo ao Senhor teu Deus, como tem falado.
text_el: καὶ εἶναί σε ὑπεράνω πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν ὡς ἐποίησέν σε ὀνομαστὸν καὶ καύχημα καὶ δόξαστόν εἶναί σε λαὸν ἅγιον κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σου καθὼς ἐλάλησεν

text_en: And Moses with the ancients of Israel commanded the people, saying: Keep every commandment that I command you this day.
text_la: Præcepit autem Moyses et seniores Israël populo, dicentes : Custodite omne mandatum quod præcipio vobis hodie.
text_pt: E deram ordem, Moisés e os anciãos, ao povo de Israel, dizendo: Guardai todos estes mandamentos que hoje vos ordeno;
text_el: καὶ προσέταξεν Μωυσῆς καὶ ἡ γερουσία Ισραηλ λέγων φυλάσσεσθε πάσας τὰς ἐντολὰς ταύτας ὅσας ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαι ὑμῖν σήμερον

text_en: And when you are passed over the Jordan into the land which the Lord your God will give you, you shall set up great stones, and shall plaster them over with plaster,
text_la: Cumque transieritis Jordanem in terram, quam Dominus Deus tuus dabit tibi, eriges ingentes lapides, et calce lævigabis eos,
text_pt: Será, pois, que, no dia em que passares o Jordão à terra que te der o Senhor teu Deus, levantar-te-ás umas pedras grandes, e as caiarás.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ διαβῆτε τὸν Ιορδάνην εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν κύριος ὁ θεός σου δίδωσίν σοι καὶ στήσεις σεαυτῷ λίθους μεγάλους καὶ κονιάσεις αὐτοὺς κονίᾳ

text_en: that you may write on them all the words of this law , when you are passed over the Jordan : that you may enter into the land which the Lord your God will give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as he swore to your fathers.
text_la: ut possis in eis scribere omnia verba legis hujus, Jordane transmisso : ut introëas terram, quam Dominus Deus tuus dabit tibi, terram lacte et melle manantem, sicut juravit patribus tuis.
text_pt: E, havendo-o passado, escreverás nelas todas as palavras desta lei, para entrares na terra que te der o Senhor teu Deus, terra que mana leite e mel, como te falou o Senhor Deus de teus pais.
text_el: καὶ γράψεις ἐπὶ τῶν λίθων πάντας τοὺς λόγους τοῦ νόμου τούτου ὡς ἂν διαβῆτε τὸν Ιορδάνην ἡνίκα ἐὰν εἰσέλθητε εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων σου δίδωσίν σοι γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι ὃν τρόπον εἶπεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων σού σοι

text_en: Therefore when you are passed over the Jordan , set up the stones which I command you this day, in mount Hebal, and you shall plaster them with plaster:
text_la: Quando ergo transieritis Jordanem, erigite lapides, quos ego hodie præcipio vobis in monte Hebal, et lævigabis eos calce:
text_pt: Será, pois, que, quando houveres passado o Jordão, levantareis estas pedras, que hoje vos ordeno, no monte Ebal, e as caiarás.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὡς ἂν διαβῆτε τὸν Ιορδάνην στήσετε τοὺς λίθους τούτους οὓς ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον ἐν ὄρει Γαιβαλ καὶ κονιάσεις αὐτοὺς κονίᾳ

text_en: And you shall build there an altar to the Lord your God , of stones which iron has not touched,
text_la: et ædificabis ibi altare Domino Deo tuo de lapidibus, quos ferrum non tetigit,
text_pt: E ali edificarás um altar ao Senhor teu Deus, um altar de pedras; não alçarás instrumento de ferro sobre elas.
text_el: καὶ οἰκοδομήσεις ἐκεῖ θυσιαστήριον κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σου θυσιαστήριον ἐκ λίθων οὐκ ἐπιβαλεῖς ἐπ' αὐτοὺς σίδηρον

text_en: and of stones not fashioned nor polished: and you shall offer upon it holocausts to the Lord your God :
text_la: et de saxis informibus et impolitis : et offeres super eo holocausta Domino Deo tuo,
text_pt: De pedras brutas edificarás o altar do Senhor teu Deus; e sobre ele oferecerás holocaustos ao Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: λίθους ὁλοκλήρους οἰκοδομήσεις θυσιαστήριον κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σου καὶ ἀνοίσεις ἐπ' αὐτὸ ὁλοκαυτώματα κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σου

text_en: And shall immolate peace victims, and eat there, and feast before the Lord your God .
text_la: et immolabis hostias pacificas, comedesque ibi, et epulaberis coram Domino Deo tuo.
text_pt: Também sacrificarás ofertas pacíficas, e ali comerás perante o Senhor teu Deus, e te alegrarás.
text_el: καὶ θύσεις ἐκεῖ θυσίαν σωτηρίου κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σου καὶ φάγῃ καὶ ἐμπλησθήσῃ καὶ εὐφρανθήσῃ ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου

text_en: And you shall write upon the stones all the words of this law plainly and clearly.
text_la: Et scribes super lapides omnia verba legis hujus plane et lucide.
text_pt: E naquelas pedras escreverás todas as palavras desta lei, exprimindo-as nitidamente.
text_el: καὶ γράψεις ἐπὶ τῶν λίθων πάντα τὸν νόμον τοῦτον σαφῶς σφόδρα

text_en: And Moses and the priests of the race of Levi said to all Israel : Attend, and hear, O Israel : This day you are made the people of the Lord your God :
text_la: Dixeruntque Moyses et sacerdotes Levitici generis ad omnem Israëlem : Attende, et audi, Israël : hodie factus es populus Domini Dei tui:
text_pt: Falou mais Moisés, juntamente com os sacerdotes levitas, a todo o Israel, dizendo: Guarda silêncio e ouve, ó Israel! Hoje vieste a ser povo do Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Μωυσῆς καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς οἱ Λευῖται παντὶ Ισραηλ λέγοντες σιώπα καὶ ἄκουε Ισραηλ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ γέγονας εἰς λαὸν κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σου

text_en: You shall hear his voice, and do the commandments and justices which I command you.
text_la: audies vocem ejus, et facies mandata atque justitias, quas ego præcipio tibi.
text_pt: Portanto obedecerás à voz do Senhor teu Deus, e cumprirás os seus mandamentos e os seus estatutos que hoje te ordeno.
text_el: καὶ εἰσακούσῃ τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου καὶ ποιήσεις πάσας τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα αὐτοῦ ὅσα ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον

text_en: And Moses commanded the people in that day, saying:
text_la: Præcepitque Moyses populo in die illo, dicens:
text_pt: E Moisés deu ordem naquele dia ao povo, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο Μωυσῆς τῷ λαῷ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ λέγων

text_en: These shall stand upon mount Garizim to bless the people, when you are passed the Jordan : Simeon , Levi , Juda , Issachar , Joseph , and Benjamin .
text_la: Hi stabunt ad benedicendum populo super montem Garizim, Jordane transmisso : Simeon, Levi, Judas, Issachar, Joseph, et Benjamin.
text_pt: Quando houverdes passado o Jordão, estes estarão sobre o monte Gerizim, para abençoarem o povo: Simeão, e Levi, e Judá, e Issacar, e José, e Benjamim;
text_el: οὗτοι στήσονται εὐλογεῖν τὸν λαὸν ἐν ὄρει Γαριζιν διαβάντες τὸν Ιορδάνην Συμεων Λευι Ιουδας Ισσαχαρ Ιωσηφ καὶ Βενιαμιν

text_en: And over against them shall stand on mount Hebal to curse : Ruben , Gad , and Aser , and Zabulon , Dan , and Nephtali .
text_la: Et e regione isti stabunt ad maledicendum in monte Hebal : Ruben, Gad, et Aser, et Zabulon, Dan, et Nephthali.
text_pt: E estes estarão sobre o monte Ebal para amaldiçoar: Rúben, Gade, e Aser, e Zebulom, Dã e Naftali.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι στήσονται ἐπὶ τῆς κατάρας ἐν ὄρει Γαιβαλ Ρουβην Γαδ καὶ Ασηρ Ζαβουλων Δαν καὶ Νεφθαλι

text_en: And the Levites shall pronounce, and say to all the men of Israel with a loud voice:
text_la: Et pronuntiabunt Levitæ, dicentque ad omnes viros Israël excelsa voce:
text_pt: E os levitas testificarão a todo o povo de Israel em alta voz, e dirão:
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθέντες οἱ Λευῖται ἐροῦσιν παντὶ Ισραηλ φωνῇ μεγάλῃ

text_en: Cursed be the man that makes a graven and molten thing , the abomination of the Lord , the work of the hands of artificers, and shall put it in a secret place: and all the people shall answer and say: Amen .
text_la: Maledictus homo qui facit sculptile et conflatile, abominationem Domini, opus manuum artificum, ponetque illud in abscondito : et respondebit omnis populus, et dicet : Amen.
text_pt: Maldito o homem que fizer imagem de escultura, ou de fundição, abominação ao Senhor, obra da mão do artífice, e a puser em um lugar escondido. E todo o povo, respondendo, dirá: Amém.
text_el: ἐπικατάρατος ἄνθρωπος ὅστις ποιήσει γλυπτὸν καὶ χωνευτόν βδέλυγμα κυρίῳ ἔργον χειρῶν τεχνίτου καὶ θήσει αὐτὸ ἐν ἀποκρύφῳ καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἐροῦσιν γένοιτο

text_en: Cursed be he that honours not his father and mother : and all the people shall say: Amen .
text_la: Maledictus qui non honorat patrem suum, et matrem : et dicet omnis populus : Amen.
text_pt: Maldito aquele que desprezar a seu pai ou a sua mãe. E todo o povo dirá: Amém.
text_el: ἐπικατάρατος ὁ ἀτιμάζων πατέρα αὐτοῦ ἢ μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐροῦσιν πᾶς ὁ λαός γένοιτο

text_en: Cursed be he that removes his neighbour's landmarks: and all the people shall say: Amen .
text_la: Maledictus qui transfert terminos proximi sui : et dicet omnis populus : Amen.
text_pt: Maldito aquele que remover os limites do seu próximo. E todo o povo dirá: Amém.
text_el: ἐπικατάρατος ὁ μετατιθεὶς ὅρια τοῦ πλησίον καὶ ἐροῦσιν πᾶς ὁ λαός γένοιτο

text_en: Cursed be he that makes the blind to wander out of his way: and all the people shall say: Amen .
text_la: Maledictus qui errare facit cæcum in itinere : et dicet omnis populus : Amen.
text_pt: Maldito aquele que fizer que o cego erre de caminho. E todo o povo dirá: Amém.
text_el: ἐπικατάρατος ὁ πλανῶν τυφλὸν ἐν ὁδῷ καὶ ἐροῦσιν πᾶς ὁ λαός γένοιτο

text_en: Cursed be he that perverts the judgment of the stranger, of the fatherless and the widow : and all the people shall say: Amen .
text_la: Maledictus qui pervertit judicium advenæ, pupilli et viduæ : et dicet omnis populus : Amen.
text_pt: Maldito aquele que perverter o direito do estrangeiro, do órfão e da viúva. E todo o povo dirá: Amém.
text_el: ἐπικατάρατος ὃς ἂν ἐκκλίνῃ κρίσιν προσηλύτου καὶ ὀρφανοῦ καὶ χήρας καὶ ἐροῦσιν πᾶς ὁ λαός γένοιτο

text_en: Cursed be he that lies with his father's wife , and uncovers his bed: and all the people shall say: Amen .
text_la: Maledictus qui dormit cum uxore patris sui, et revelat operimentum lectuli ejus : et dicet omnis populus : Amen.
text_pt: Maldito aquele que se deitar com a mulher de seu pai, porquanto descobriu a nudez de seu pai. E todo o povo dirá: Amém.
text_el: ἐπικατάρατος ὁ κοιμώμενος μετὰ γυναικὸς τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἀπεκάλυψεν συγκάλυμμα τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐροῦσιν πᾶς ὁ λαός γένοιτο

text_en: Cursed be he that lies with any beast: and all the people shall say: Amen .
text_la: Maledictus qui dormit cum omni jumento : et dicet omnis populus : Amen.
text_pt: Maldito aquele que se deitar com algum animal. E todo o povo dirá: Amém.
text_el: ἐπικατάρατος ὁ κοιμώμενος μετὰ παντὸς κτήνους καὶ ἐροῦσιν πᾶς ὁ λαός γένοιτο

text_en: Cursed be he that lies with his sister , the daughter of his father, or of his mother: and all the people shall say: Amen .
text_la: Maledictus qui dormit cum sorore sua, filia patris sui, vel matris suæ : et dicet omnis populus : Amen.
text_pt: Maldito aquele que se deitar com sua irmã, filha de seu pai, ou filha de sua mãe. E todo o povo dirá: Amém.
text_el: ἐπικατάρατος ὁ κοιμώμενος μετὰ ἀδελφῆς ἐκ πατρὸς ἢ ἐκ μητρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐροῦσιν πᾶς ὁ λαός γένοιτο

text_en: Cursed be he that lies with his mother-in-law : and all the people shall say: Amen .
text_la: Maledictus qui dormit cum socru sua : et dicet omnis populus : Amen.
text_pt: Maldito aquele que se deitar com sua sogra. E todo o povo dirá: Amém.
text_el: ἐπικατάρατος ὁ κοιμώμενος μετὰ πενθερᾶς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐροῦσιν πᾶς ὁ λαός γένοιτο ἐπικατάρατος ὁ κοιμώμενος μετὰ ἀδελφῆς γυναικὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐροῦσιν πᾶς ὁ λαός γένοιτο

text_en: Cursed be he that secretly kills his neighbour: and all the people shall say: Amen .
text_la: Maledictus qui clam percusserit proximum suum : et dicet omnis populus : Amen.
text_pt: Maldito aquele que ferir ao seu próximo em oculto. E todo o povo dirá: Amém.
text_el: ἐπικατάρατος ὁ τύπτων τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ δόλῳ καὶ ἐροῦσιν πᾶς ὁ λαός γένοιτο

text_en: Cursed be he that takes gifts, to slay an innocent person: and all the people shall say: Amen .
text_la: Maledictus qui accipit munera, ut percutiat animam sanguinis innocentis : et dicet omnis populus : Amen.
text_pt: Maldito aquele que aceitar suborno para ferir uma pessoa inocente. E todo o povo dirá: Amém.
text_el: ἐπικατάρατος ὃς ἂν λάβῃ δῶρα πατάξαι ψυχὴν αἵματος ἀθῴου καὶ ἐροῦσιν πᾶς ὁ λαός γένοιτο

text_en: Cursed be he that abides not in the words of this law , and fulfils them not in work: and all the people shall say: Amen .
text_la: Maledictus qui non permanet in sermonibus legis hujus, nec eos opere perficit : et dicet omnis populus : Amen.
text_pt: Maldito aquele que não confirmar as palavras desta lei, não as cumprindo. E todo o povo dirá: Amém.
text_el: ἐπικατάρατος πᾶς ἄνθρωπος ὃς οὐκ ἐμμενεῖ ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς λόγοις τοῦ νόμου τούτου τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτούς καὶ ἐροῦσιν πᾶς ὁ λαός γένοιτο

text_en: Now if you will hear the voice of all his commandments , which I command you this day, the Lord your God will make you higher than all the nations that are on the earth.
text_la: Si autem audieris vocem Domini Dei tui, ut facias atque custodias omnia mandata ejus, quæ ego præcipio tibi hodie, faciet te Dominus Deus tuus excelsiorem cunctis gentibus, quæ versantur in terra.
text_pt: E será que, se ouvires a voz do SENHOR teu Deus, tendo cuidado de guardar todos os seus mandamentos que eu hoje te ordeno, o SENHOR teu Deus te exaltará sobre todas as nações da terra.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὡς ἂν διαβῆτε τὸν Ιορδάνην εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν δίδωσιν ὑμῖν ἐὰν ἀκοῇ εἰσακούσητε τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν φυλάσσειν καὶ ποιεῖν πάσας τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ἃς ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον καὶ δώσει σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου ὑπεράνω πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν τῆς γῆς

text_en: And all these blessings shall come upon you and overtake you: yet so if you hear his precepts .
text_la: Venientque super te universæ benedictiones istæ, et apprehendent te : si tamen præcepta ejus audieris.
text_pt: E todas estas bênçãos virão sobre ti e te alcançarão, quando ouvires a voz do Senhor teu Deus:
text_el: καὶ ἥξουσιν ἐπὶ σὲ πᾶσαι αἱ εὐλογίαι αὗται καὶ εὑρήσουσίν σε ἐὰν ἀκοῇ ἀκούσῃς τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου

text_en: Blessed shall you be in the city, and blessed in the field.
text_la: Benedictus tu in civitate, et benedictus in agro.
text_pt: Bendito serás na cidade, e bendito serás no campo.
text_el: εὐλογημένος σὺ ἐν πόλει καὶ εὐλογημένος σὺ ἐν ἀγρῷ

text_en: Blessed shall be the fruit of your womb, and the fruit of your ground, and the fruit of your cattle, the droves of your herds, and the folds of your sheep.
text_la: Benedictus fructus ventris tui, et fructus terræ tuæ, fructusque jumentorum tuorum, greges armentorum tuorum, et caulæ ovium tuarum.
text_pt: Bendito o fruto do teu ventre, e o fruto da tua terra, e o fruto dos teus animais; e as crias das tuas vacas e das tuas ovelhas.
text_el: εὐλογημένα τὰ ἔκγονα τῆς κοιλίας σου καὶ τὰ γενήματα τῆς γῆς σου τὰ βουκόλια τῶν βοῶν σου καὶ τὰ ποίμνια τῶν προβάτων σου

text_en: Blessed shall be your barns and blessed your stores.
text_la: Benedicta horrea tua, et benedictæ reliquiæ tuæ.
text_pt: Bendito o teu cesto e a tua amassadeira.
text_el: εὐλογημέναι αἱ ἀποθῆκαί σου καὶ τὰ ἐγκαταλείμματά σου

text_en: Blessed shall you be coming in and going out.
text_la: Benedictus eris tu ingrediens et egrediens.
text_pt: Bendito serás ao entrares, e bendito serás ao saíres.
text_el: εὐλογημένος σὺ ἐν τῷ εἰσπορεύεσθαί σε καὶ εὐλογημένος σὺ ἐν τῷ ἐκπορεύεσθαί σε

text_en: The Lord shall cause your enemies, that rise up against you, to fall down before your face: one way shall they come out against you, and seven ways shall they flee before you.
text_la: Dabit Dominus inimicos tuos, qui consurgunt adversum te, corruentes in conspectu tuo : per unam viam venient contra te, et per septem fugient a facie tua.
text_pt: O Senhor entregará, feridos diante de ti, os teus inimigos, que se levantarem contra ti; por um caminho sairão contra ti, mas por sete caminhos fugirão da tua presença.
text_el: παραδῷ κύριος ὁ θεός σου τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου τοὺς ἀνθεστηκότας σοι συντετριμμένους πρὸ προσώπου σου ὁδῷ μιᾷ ἐξελεύσονται πρὸς σὲ καὶ ἐν ἑπτὰ ὁδοῖς φεύξονται ἀπὸ προσώπου σου

text_en: The Lord will send forth a blessing upon your storehouses, and upon all the works of your hands: and will bless you in the land that you shall receive.
text_la: Emittet Dominus benedictionem super cellaria tua, et super omnia opera manuum tuarum : benedicetque tibi in terra, quam acceperis.
text_pt: O Senhor mandará que a bênção esteja contigo nos teus celeiros, e em tudo o que puseres a tua mão; e te abençoará na terra que te der o Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: ἀποστείλαι κύριος ἐπὶ σὲ τὴν εὐλογίαν ἐν τοῖς ταμιείοις σου καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν οὗ ἂν ἐπιβάλῃς τὴν χεῖρά σου ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἧς κύριος ὁ θεός σου δίδωσίν σοι

text_en: The Lord will raise you up to be a holy people to himself, as he swore to you: if you keep the commandments of the Lord your God , and walk in his ways.
text_la: Suscitabit te Dominus sibi in populum sanctum, sicut juravit tibi : si custodieris mandata Domini Dei tui, et ambulaveris in viis ejus.
text_pt: O Senhor te confirmará para si como povo santo, como te tem jurado, quando guardares os mandamentos do Senhor teu Deus, e andares nos seus caminhos.
text_el: ἀναστήσαι σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἑαυτῷ λαὸν ἅγιον ὃν τρόπον ὤμοσεν τοῖς πατράσιν σου ἐὰν εἰσακούσῃς τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου καὶ πορευθῇς ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And all the people of the earth shall see that the name of the Lord is invocated upon you, and they shall fear you.
text_la: Videbuntque omnes terrarum populi quod nomen Domini invocatum sit super te, et timebunt te.
text_pt: E todos os povos da terra verão que é invocado sobre ti o nome do Senhor, e terão temor de ti.
text_el: καὶ ὄψονταί σε πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τῆς γῆς ὅτι τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου ἐπικέκληταί σοι καὶ φοβηθήσονταί σε

text_en: The Lord will make you abound with all goods, with the fruit of your womb, and the fruit of your cattle, with the fruit of your land, which the Lord swore to your fathers that he would give you.
text_la: Abundare te faciet Dominus omnibus bonis, fructu uteri tui, et fructu jumentorum tuorum, fructu terræ tuæ, quam juravit Dominus patribus tuis ut daret tibi.
text_pt: E o Senhor te dará abundância de bens no fruto do teu ventre, e no fruto dos teus animais, e no fruto do teu solo, sobre a terra que o Senhor jurou a teus pais te dar.
text_el: καὶ πληθυνεῖ σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου εἰς ἀγαθὰ ἐπὶ τοῖς ἐκγόνοις τῆς κοιλίας σου καὶ ἐπὶ τοῖς γενήμασιν τῆς γῆς σου καὶ ἐπὶ τοῖς ἐκγόνοις τῶν κτηνῶν σου ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἧς ὤμοσεν κύριος τοῖς πατράσιν σου δοῦναί σοι

text_en: The Lord will open his excellent treasure, the heaven , that it may give rain in due season: and he will bless all the works of your hands. And you shall lend to many nations , and shall not borrow of any one.
text_la: Aperiet Dominus thesaurum suum optimum, cælum, ut tribuat pluviam terræ tuæ in tempore suo : benedicetque cunctis operibus manuum tuarum. Et fœnerabis gentibus multis, et ipse a nullo fœnus accipies.
text_pt: O Senhor te abrirá o seu bom tesouro, o céu, para dar chuva à tua terra no seu tempo, e para abençoar toda a obra das tuas mãos; e emprestarás a muitas nações, porém tu não tomarás emprestado.
text_el: ἀνοίξαι σοι κύριος τὸν θησαυρὸν αὐτοῦ τὸν ἀγαθόν τὸν οὐρανόν δοῦναι τὸν ὑετὸν τῇ γῇ σου ἐπὶ καιροῦ αὐτοῦ εὐλογῆσαι πάντα τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν σου καὶ δανιεῖς ἔθνεσιν πολλοῖς σὺ δὲ οὐ δανιῇ καὶ ἄρξεις σὺ ἐθνῶν πολλῶν σοῦ δὲ οὐκ ἄρξουσιν

text_en: And the Lord shall make you the head and not the tail: and you shall be always above, and not beneath: yet so if you will hear the commandments of the Lord your God which I command you this day, and keep and do them,
text_la: Constituet te Dominus in caput, et non in caudam : et eris semper supra, et non subter : si tamen audieris mandata Domini Dei tui quæ ego præcipio tibi hodie, et custodieris et feceris,
text_pt: E o Senhor te porá por cabeça, e não por cauda; e só estarás em cima, e não debaixo, se obedeceres aos mandamentos do Senhor teu Deus, que hoje te ordeno, para os guardar e cumprir.
text_el: καταστήσαι σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου εἰς κεφαλὴν καὶ μὴ εἰς οὐράν καὶ ἔσῃ τότε ἐπάνω καὶ οὐκ ἔσῃ ὑποκάτω ἐὰν ἀκούσῃς τῶν ἐντολῶν κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου ὅσα ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον φυλάσσειν καὶ ποιεῖν

text_en: and turn not away from them neither to the right hand, nor to the left, nor follow strange gods , nor worship them.
text_la: ac non declinaveris ab eis nec ad dexteram, nec ad sinistram, nec secutus fueris deos alienos, neque colueris eos.
text_pt: E não te desviarás de todas as palavras que hoje te ordeno, nem para a direita nem para a esquerda, andando após outros deuses, para os servires.
text_el: οὐ παραβήσῃ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν λόγων ὧν ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον δεξιὰ οὐδὲ ἀριστερὰ πορεύεσθαι ὀπίσω θεῶν ἑτέρων λατρεύειν αὐτοῖς

text_en: But if you will not hear the voice of the Lord your God , to keep and to do all his commandments and ceremonies , which I command you this day, all these curses shall come upon you, and overtake you.
text_la: Quod si audire nolueris vocem Domini Dei tui, ut custodias, et facias omnia mandata ejus et cæremonias, quas ego præcipio tibi hodie, venient super te omnes maledictiones istæ, et apprehendent te.
text_pt: Será, porém, que, se não deres ouvidos à voz do Senhor teu Deus, para não cuidares em cumprir todos os seus mandamentos e os seus estatutos, que hoje te ordeno, então virão sobre ti todas estas maldições, e te alcançarão:
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν μὴ εἰσακούσῃς τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου φυλάσσειν καὶ ποιεῖν πάσας τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ὅσας ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον καὶ ἐλεύσονται ἐπὶ σὲ πᾶσαι αἱ κατάραι αὗται καὶ καταλήμψονταί σε

text_en: Cursed shall you be in the city, cursed in the field.
text_la: Maledictus eris in civitate, maledictus in agro.
text_pt: Maldito serás tu na cidade, e maldito serás no campo.
text_el: ἐπικατάρατος σὺ ἐν πόλει καὶ ἐπικατάρατος σὺ ἐν ἀγρῷ

text_en: Cursed shall be your barn, and cursed your stores.
text_la: Maledictum horreum tuum, et maledictæ reliquiæ tuæ.
text_pt: Maldito o teu cesto e a tua amassadeira.
text_el: ἐπικατάρατοι αἱ ἀποθῆκαί σου καὶ τὰ ἐγκαταλείμματά σου

text_en: Cursed shall be the fruit of your womb, and the fruit of your ground, the herds of your oxen, and the flocks of your sheep.
text_la: Maledictus fructus ventris tui, et fructus terræ tuæ, armenta boum tuorum, et greges ovium tuarum.
text_pt: Maldito o fruto do teu ventre, e o fruto da tua terra, e as crias das tuas vacas, e das tuas ovelhas.
text_el: ἐπικατάρατα τὰ ἔκγονα τῆς κοιλίας σου καὶ τὰ γενήματα τῆς γῆς σου τὰ βουκόλια τῶν βοῶν σου καὶ τὰ ποίμνια τῶν προβάτων σου

text_en: Cursed shall you be coming in, and cursed going out.
text_la: Maledictus eris ingrediens, et maledictus egrediens.
text_pt: Maldito serás ao entrares, e maldito serás ao saíres.
text_el: ἐπικατάρατος σὺ ἐν τῷ ἐκπορεύεσθαί σε καὶ ἐπικατάρατος σὺ ἐν τῷ εἰσπορεύεσθαί σε

text_en: The Lord shall send upon you famine and hunger, and a rebuke upon all the works which you shall do: until he consume and destroy you quickly, for your most wicked inventions, by which you have forsaken me.
text_la: Mittet Dominus super te famem et esuriem, et increpationem in omnia opera tua, quæ tu facies : donec conterat te, et perdat velociter, propter adinventiones tuas pessimas in quibus reliquisti me.
text_pt: O Senhor mandará sobre ti a maldição; a confusão e a derrota em tudo em que puseres a mão para fazer; até que sejas destruído, e até que repentinamente pereças, por causa da maldade das tuas obras, pelas quais me deixaste.
text_el: ἐξαποστείλαι κύριός σοι τὴν ἔνδειαν καὶ τὴν ἐκλιμίαν καὶ τὴν ἀνάλωσιν ἐπὶ πάντα οὗ ἂν ἐπιβάλῃς τὴν χεῖρά σου ὅσα ἐὰν ποιήσῃς ἕως ἂν ἐξολεθρεύσῃ σε καὶ ἕως ἂν ἀπολέσῃ σε ἐν τάχει διὰ τὰ πονηρὰ ἐπιτηδεύματά σου διότι ἐγκατέλιπές με

text_en: May the Lord set the pestilence upon you, until he consume you out of the land, which you shall go in to possess.
text_la: Adjungat tibi Dominus pestilentiam, donec consumat te de terra ad quam ingredieris possidendam.
text_pt: O Senhor fará pegar em ti a pestilência, até que te consuma da terra a que passas a possuir.
text_el: προσκολλήσαι κύριος εἰς σὲ τὸν θάνατον ἕως ἂν ἐξαναλώσῃ σε ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς εἰς ἣν σὺ εἰσπορεύῃ ἐκεῖ κληρονομῆσαι αὐτήν

text_en: May the Lord afflict you with miserable want , with the fever and with cold, with burning and with heat, and with corrupted air and with blasting, and pursue you till you perish.
text_la: Percutiat te Dominus egestate, febri et frigore, ardore et æstu, et aëre corrupto ac rubigine, et persequatur donec pereas.
text_pt: O Senhor te ferirá com a tísica e com a febre, e com a inflamação, e com o calor ardente, e com a secura, e com crestamento e com ferrugem; e te perseguirão até que pereças.
text_el: πατάξαι σε κύριος ἀπορίᾳ καὶ πυρετῷ καὶ ῥίγει καὶ ἐρεθισμῷ καὶ φόνῳ καὶ ἀνεμοφθορίᾳ καὶ τῇ ὤχρᾳ καὶ καταδιώξονταί σε ἕως ἂν ἀπολέσωσίν σε

text_en: Be the heaven , that is over you, of brass: and the ground you tread on, of iron.
text_la: Sit cælum, quod supra te est, æneum : et terra, quam calcas, ferrea.
text_pt: E os teus céus, que estão sobre a cabeça, serão de bronze; e a terra que está debaixo de ti, será de ferro.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται σοι ὁ οὐρανὸς ὁ ὑπὲρ κεφαλῆς σου χαλκοῦς καὶ ἡ γῆ ἡ ὑποκάτω σου σιδηρᾶ

text_en: The Lord give you dust for rain upon your land, and let ashes come down from heaven upon you, till you be consumed.
text_la: Det Dominus imbrem terræ tuæ pulverem, et de cælo descendat super te cinis, donec conteraris.
text_pt: O Senhor dará por chuva sobre a tua terra, pó e poeira; dos céus descerá sobre ti, até que pereças.
text_el: δῴη κύριος τὸν ὑετὸν τῇ γῇ σου κονιορτόν καὶ χοῦς ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβήσεται ἐπὶ σέ ἕως ἂν ἐκτρίψῃ σε καὶ ἕως ἂν ἀπολέσῃ σε

text_en: The Lord make you to fall down before your enemies, one way may you go out against them, and flee seven ways, and be scattered throughout all the kingdoms of the earth.
text_la: Tradat te Dominus corruentem ante hostes tuos : per unam viam egrediaris contra eos, et per septem fugias, et dispergaris per omnia regna terræ,
text_pt: O Senhor te fará cair diante dos teus inimigos; por um caminho sairás contra eles, e por sete caminhos fugirás de diante deles, e serás espalhado por todos os reinos da terra.
text_el: δῴη σε κύριος ἐπικοπὴν ἐναντίον τῶν ἐχθρῶν σου ἐν ὁδῷ μιᾷ ἐξελεύσῃ πρὸς αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐν ἑπτὰ ὁδοῖς φεύξῃ ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν καὶ ἔσῃ ἐν διασπορᾷ ἐν πάσαις ταῖς βασιλείαις τῆς γῆς

text_en: And be your carcass meat for all the fowls of the air, and the beasts of the earth, and be there none to drive them away.
text_la: sitque cadaver tuum in escam cunctis volatilibus cæli, et bestiis terræ, et non sit qui abigat.
text_pt: E o teu cadáver servirá de comida a todas as aves dos céus, e aos animais da terra; e ninguém os espantará.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται οἱ νεκροὶ ὑμῶν κατάβρωμα τοῖς πετεινοῖς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τοῖς θηρίοις τῆς γῆς καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ ἀποσοβῶν

text_en: The Lord strike you with the ulcer of Egypt , and the part of your body, by which the dung is cast out, with the scab and with the itch: so that you can not be healed.
text_la: Percutiat te Dominus ulcere Ægypti, et partem corporis, per quam stercora egeruntur, scabie quoque et prurigine : ita ut curari nequeas.
text_pt: O Senhor te ferirá com as úlceras do Egito, com tumores, e com sarna, e com coceira, de que não possas curar-te;
text_el: πατάξαι σε κύριος ἐν ἕλκει Αἰγυπτίῳ ἐν ταῖς ἕδραις καὶ ψώρᾳ ἀγρίᾳ καὶ κνήφῃ ὥστε μὴ δύνασθαί σε ἰαθῆναι

text_en: The Lord strike you with madness and blindness and fury of mind.
text_la: Percutiat te Dominus amentia et cæcitate ac furore mentis,
text_pt: O Senhor te ferirá com loucura, e com cegueira, e com pasmo de coração;
text_el: πατάξαι σε κύριος παραπληξίᾳ καὶ ἀορασίᾳ καὶ ἐκστάσει διανοίας

text_en: And may you grope at midday as the blind is wont to grope in the dark, and not make straight your ways. And may you at all times suffer wrong , and be oppressed with violence , and may you have no one to deliver you.
text_la: et palpes in meridie sicut palpare solet cæcus in tenebris, et non dirigas vias tuas. Omnique tempore calumniam sustineas, et opprimaris violentia, nec habeas qui liberet te.
text_pt: E apalparás ao meio-dia, como o cego apalpa na escuridão, e não prosperarás nos teus caminhos; porém somente serás oprimido e roubado todos os dias, e não haverá quem te salve.
text_el: καὶ ἔσῃ ψηλαφῶν μεσημβρίας ὡσεὶ ψηλαφήσαι ὁ τυφλὸς ἐν τῷ σκότει καὶ οὐκ εὐοδώσει τὰς ὁδούς σου καὶ ἔσῃ τότε ἀδικούμενος καὶ διαρπαζόμενος πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας καὶ οὐκ ἔσται σοι ὁ βοηθῶν

text_en: May you take a wife , and another sleep with her . May you build a house, and not dwell therein. May you plant a vineyard and not gather the vintage thereof.
text_la: Uxorem accipias, et alius dormiat cum ea. Domum ædifices, et non habites in ea. Plantes vineam, et non vindemies eam.
text_pt: Desposar-te-ás com uma mulher, porém outro homem dormirá com ela; edificarás uma casa, porém não morarás nela; plantarás uma vinha, porém não aproveitarás o seu fruto.
text_el: γυναῖκα λήμψῃ καὶ ἀνὴρ ἕτερος ἕξει αὐτήν οἰκίαν οἰκοδομήσεις καὶ οὐκ οἰκήσεις ἐν αὐτῇ ἀμπελῶνα φυτεύσεις καὶ οὐ τρυγήσεις αὐτόν

text_en: May your ox be slain before you, and you not eat thereof. May your ass be taken away in your sight, and not restored to you. May your sheep be given to your enemies, and may there be none to help you.
text_la: Bos tuus immoletur coram te, et non comedas ex eo. Asinus tuus rapiatur in conspectu tuo, et non reddatur tibi. Oves tuæ dentur inimicis tuis, et non sit qui te adjuvet.
text_pt: O teu boi será morto aos teus olhos, porém dele não comerás; o teu jumento será roubado diante de ti, e não voltará a ti; as tuas ovelhas serão dadas aos teus inimigos, e não haverá quem te salve.
text_el: ὁ μόσχος σου ἐσφαγμένος ἐναντίον σου καὶ οὐ φάγῃ ἐξ αὐτοῦ ὁ ὄνος σου ἡρπασμένος ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἀποδοθήσεταί σοι τὰ πρόβατά σου δεδομένα τοῖς ἐχθροῖς σου καὶ οὐκ ἔσται σοι ὁ βοηθῶν

text_en: May your sons and your daughters be given to another people, your eyes looking on, and languishing at the sight of them all the day, and may there be no strength in your hand.
text_la: Filii tui et filiæ tuæ tradantur alteri populo, videntibus oculis tuis, et deficientibus ad conspectum eorum tota die, et non sit fortitudo in manu tua.
text_pt: Teus filhos e tuas filhas serão dados a outro povo, os teus olhos o verão, e por eles desfalecerão todo o dia; porém não haverá poder na tua mão.
text_el: οἱ υἱοί σου καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες σου δεδομέναι ἔθνει ἑτέρῳ καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοί σου βλέψονται σφακελίζοντες εἰς αὐτά καὶ οὐκ ἰσχύσει ἡ χείρ σου

text_en: May a people which you know not, eat the fruits of your land, and all your labours: and may you always suffer oppression, and be crushed at all times.
text_la: Fructus terræ tuæ, et omnes labores tuos, comedat populus quem ignoras : et sis semper calumniam sustinens, et oppressus cunctis diebus,
text_pt: O fruto da tua terra e todo o teu trabalho, comerá um povo que nunca conheceste; e tu serás oprimido e quebrantado todos os dias.
text_el: τὰ ἐκφόρια τῆς γῆς σου καὶ πάντας τοὺς πόνους σου φάγεται ἔθνος ὃ οὐκ ἐπίστασαι καὶ ἔσῃ ἀδικούμενος καὶ τεθραυσμένος πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας

text_en: And be astonished at the terror of those things which your eyes shall see:
text_la: et stupens ad terrorem eorum quæ videbunt oculi tui.
text_pt: E enlouquecerás com o que vires com os teus olhos.
text_el: καὶ ἔσῃ παράπληκτος διὰ τὰ ὁράματα τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν σου ἃ βλέψῃ

text_en: May the Lord strike you with a very sore ulcer in the knees and in the legs, and be thou incurable from the sole of the foot to the top of the head.
text_la: Percutiat te Dominus ulcere pessimo in genibus et in suris, sanarique non possis a planta pedis usque ad verticem tuum.
text_pt: O Senhor te ferirá com úlceras malignas nos joelhos e nas pernas, de que não possas sarar, desde a planta do teu pé até ao alto da cabeça.
text_el: πατάξαι σε κύριος ἐν ἕλκει πονηρῷ ἐπὶ τὰ γόνατα καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς κνήμας ὥστε μὴ δύνασθαί σε ἰαθῆναι ἀπὸ ἴχνους τῶν ποδῶν σου ἕως τῆς κορυφῆς σου

text_en: The Lord shall bring you, and your king, whom you shall have appointed over you, into a nation which you and your fathers know not: and there you shall serve strange gods , wood and stone.
text_la: Ducet te Dominus, et regem tuum, quem constitueris super te, in gentem, quam ignoras tu et patres tui : et servies ibi diis alienis, ligno et lapidi.
text_pt: O Senhor te levará a ti e a teu rei, que tiveres posto sobre ti, a uma nação que não conheceste, nem tu nem teus pais; e ali servirás a outros deuses, ao pau e à pedra.
text_el: ἀπαγάγοι κύριός σε καὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντάς σου οὓς ἐὰν καταστήσῃς ἐπὶ σεαυτόν εἰς ἔθνος ὃ οὐκ ἐπίστασαι σὺ καὶ οἱ πατέρες σου καὶ λατρεύσεις ἐκεῖ θεοῖς ἑτέροις ξύλοις καὶ λίθοις

text_en: And you shall be lost, as a proverb and a byword to all people, among whom the Lord shall bring you in.
text_la: Et eris perditus in proverbium ac fabulam omnibus populis, ad quos te introduxerit Dominus.
text_pt: E serás por pasmo, por ditado, e por fábula, entre todos os povos a que o Senhor te levará.
text_el: καὶ ἔσῃ ἐκεῖ ἐν αἰνίγματι καὶ παραβολῇ καὶ διηγήματι ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν εἰς οὓς ἂν ἀπαγάγῃ σε κύριος ἐκεῖ

text_en: You shall cast much seed into the ground, and gather little: because the locusts shall consume all.
text_la: Sementem multam jacies in terram, et modicum congregabis : quia locustæ devorabunt omnia.
text_pt: Lançarás muita semente ao campo; porém colherás pouco, porque o gafanhoto a consumirá.
text_el: σπέρμα πολὺ ἐξοίσεις εἰς τὸ πεδίον καὶ ὀλίγα εἰσοίσεις ὅτι κατέδεται αὐτὰ ἡ ἀκρίς

text_en: You shall plant a vineyard, and dig it, and shall not drink the wine, nor gather anything thereof: because it shall be wasted with worms.
text_la: Vineam plantabis, et fodies : et vinum non bibes, nec colliges ex ea quippiam : quoniam vastabitur vermibus.
text_pt: Plantarás vinhas, e cultivarás; porém não beberás vinho, nem colherás as uvas; porque o bicho as colherá.
text_el: ἀμπελῶνα φυτεύσεις καὶ κατεργᾷ καὶ οἶνον οὐ πίεσαι οὐδὲ εὐφρανθήσῃ ἐξ αὐτοῦ ὅτι καταφάγεται αὐτὰ ὁ σκώληξ

text_en: You shall have olive trees in all your borders, and shall not be anointed with the oil: for the olives shall fall off and perish.
text_la: Olivas habebis in omnibus terminis tuis, et non ungeris oleo : quia defluent, et peribunt.
text_pt: Em todos os termos terás oliveiras; porém não te ungirás com azeite; porque a azeitona cairá da tua oliveira.
text_el: ἐλαῖαι ἔσονταί σοι ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ὁρίοις σου καὶ ἔλαιον οὐ χρίσῃ ὅτι ἐκρυήσεται ἡ ἐλαία σου

text_en: You shall beget sons and daughters, and shall not enjoy them: because they shall be led into captivity .
text_la: Filios generabis et filias, et non frueris eis : quoniam ducentur in captivitatem.
text_pt: Filhos e filhas gerarás; porém não serão para ti; porque irão em cativeiro.
text_el: υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας γεννήσεις καὶ οὐκ ἔσονταί σοι ἀπελεύσονται γὰρ ἐν αἰχμαλωσίᾳ

text_en: The blast shall consume all the trees and the fruits of your ground.
text_la: Omnes arbores tuas et fruges terræ tuæ rubigo consumet.
text_pt: Todo o teu arvoredo e o fruto da tua terra consumirá a lagarta.
text_el: πάντα τὰ ξύλινά σου καὶ τὰ γενήματα τῆς γῆς σου ἐξαναλώσει ἡ ἐρυσίβη

text_en: The stranger that lives with you in the land, shall rise up over you, and shall be higher: and you shall go down, and be lower.
text_la: Advena, qui tecum versatur in terra, ascendet super te, eritque sublimior : tu autem descendes, et eris inferior.
text_pt: O estrangeiro, que está no meio de ti, se elevará muito sobre ti, e tu mais baixo descerás;
text_el: ὁ προσήλυτος ὅς ἐστιν ἐν σοί ἀναβήσεται ἐπὶ σὲ ἄνω ἄνω σὺ δὲ καταβήσῃ κάτω κάτω

text_en: He shall lend to you, and you shall not lend to him. He shall be as the head, and you shall be the tail.
text_la: Ipse fœnerabit tibi, et tu non fœnerabis ei. Ipse erit in caput, et tu eris in caudam.
text_pt: Ele te emprestará a ti, porém tu não emprestarás a ele; ele será por cabeça, e tu serás por cauda.
text_el: οὗτος δανιεῖ σοι σὺ δὲ τούτῳ οὐ δανιεῖς οὗτος ἔσται κεφαλή σὺ δὲ ἔσῃ οὐρά

text_en: And all these curses shall come upon you, and shall pursue and overtake you, till you perish: because you heard not the voice of the Lord your God , and did not keep his commandments and ceremonies which he commanded you.
text_la: Et venient super te omnes maledictiones istæ, et persequentes apprehendent te, donec intereas : quia non audisti vocem Domini Dei tui, nec servasti mandata ejus et cæremonias, quas præcepit tibi.
text_pt: E todas estas maldições virão sobre ti, e te perseguirão, e te alcançarão, até que sejas destruído; porquanto não ouviste à voz do Senhor teu Deus, para guardares os seus mandamentos, e os seus estatutos, que te tem ordenado;
text_el: καὶ ἐλεύσονται ἐπὶ σὲ πᾶσαι αἱ κατάραι αὗται καὶ καταδιώξονταί σε καὶ καταλήμψονταί σε ἕως ἂν ἐξολεθρεύσῃ σε καὶ ἕως ἂν ἀπολέσῃ σε ὅτι οὐκ εἰσήκουσας τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου φυλάξαι τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα αὐτοῦ ὅσα ἐνετείλατό σοι

text_en: And they shall be as signs and wonders on you, and on your seed for ever.
text_la: Et erunt in te signa atque prodigia, et in semine tuo usque in sempiternum:
text_pt: E serão entre ti por sinal e por maravilha, como também entre a tua descendência para sempre.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν σοὶ σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα καὶ ἐν τῷ σπέρματί σου ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: Because you did not serve the Lord your God with joy and gladness of heart , for the abundance of all things:
text_la: eo quod non servieris Domino Deo tuo in gaudio, cordisque lætitia, propter rerum omnium abundantiam.
text_pt: Porquanto não serviste ao Senhor teu Deus com alegria e bondade de coração, pela abundância de tudo.
text_el: ἀνθ' ὧν οὐκ ἐλάτρευσας κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σου ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ καὶ ἀγαθῇ καρδίᾳ διὰ τὸ πλῆθος πάντων

text_en: You shall serve your enemy, whom the Lord will send upon you, in hunger, and thirst, and nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put an iron yoke upon your neck, till he consume you.
text_la: Servies inimico tuo, quem immittet tibi Dominus, in fame, et siti, et nuditate, et omni penuria : et ponet jugum ferreum super cervicem tuam, donec te conterat.
text_pt: Assim servirás aos teus inimigos, que o Senhor enviará contra ti, com fome e com sede, e com nudez, e com falta de tudo; e sobre o teu pescoço porá um jugo de ferro, até que te tenha destruído.
text_el: καὶ λατρεύσεις τοῖς ἐχθροῖς σου οὓς ἐπαποστελεῖ κύριος ἐπὶ σέ ἐν λιμῷ καὶ ἐν δίψει καὶ ἐν γυμνότητι καὶ ἐν ἐκλείψει πάντων καὶ ἐπιθήσει κλοιὸν σιδηροῦν ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλόν σου ἕως ἂν ἐξολεθρεύσῃ σε

text_en: The Lord will bring upon you a nation from afar, and from the uttermost ends of the earth, like an eagle that flies swiftly, whose tongue you can not understand,
text_la: Adducet Dominus super te gentem de longinquo, et de extremis terræ finibus in similitudinem aquilæ volantis cum impetu, cujus linguam intelligere non possis:
text_pt: O Senhor levantará contra ti uma nação de longe, da extremidade da terra, que voa como a águia, nação cuja língua não entenderás;
text_el: ἐπάξει κύριος ἐπὶ σὲ ἔθνος μακρόθεν ἀπ' ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς ὡσεὶ ὅρμημα ἀετοῦ ἔθνος ὃ οὐκ ἀκούσῃ τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: a most insolent nation , that will show no regard to the ancients, nor have pity on the infant,
text_la: gentem procacissimam, quæ non deferat seni, nec misereatur parvuli,
text_pt: Nação feroz de rosto, que não respeitará o rosto do velho, nem se apiedará do moço;
text_el: ἔθνος ἀναιδὲς προσώπῳ ὅστις οὐ θαυμάσει πρόσωπον πρεσβύτου καὶ νέον οὐκ ἐλεήσει

text_en: and will devour the fruit of your cattle, and the fruits of your land: until you be destroyed, and will leave you no wheat, nor wine, nor oil, nor herds of oxen, nor flocks of sheep: until he destroy you.
text_la: et devoret fructum jumentorum tuorum, ac fruges terræ tuæ : donec intereas, et non relinquat tibi triticum, vinum, et oleum, armenta boum, et greges ovium : donec te disperdat,
text_pt: E comerá o fruto dos teus animais, e o fruto da tua terra, até que sejas destruído; e não te deixará grão, mosto, nem azeite, nem crias das tuas vacas, nem das tuas ovelhas, até que te haja consumido;
text_el: καὶ κατέδεται τὰ ἔκγονα τῶν κτηνῶν σου καὶ τὰ γενήματα τῆς γῆς σου ὥστε μὴ καταλιπεῖν σοι σῖτον οἶνον ἔλαιον τὰ βουκόλια τῶν βοῶν σου καὶ τὰ ποίμνια τῶν προβάτων σου ἕως ἂν ἀπολέσῃ σε

text_en: And consume you in all your cities, and your strong and high wall be brought down, wherein you trusted in all your land. You shall be besieged within your gates in all your land which the Lord your God will give you:
text_la: et conterat in cunctis urbibus tuis, et destruantur muri tui firmi atque sublimes, in quibus habebas fiduciam in omni terra tua. Obsideberis intra portas tuas in omni terra tua, quam dabit tibi Dominus Deus tuus:
text_pt: E sitiar-te-á em todas as tuas portas, até que venham a cair os teus altos e fortes muros, em que confiavas em toda a tua terra; e te sitiará em todas as tuas portas, em toda a tua terra que te tem dado o Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐκτρίψῃ σε ἐν πάσαις ταῖς πόλεσίν σου ἕως ἂν καθαιρεθῶσιν τὰ τείχη σου τὰ ὑψηλὰ καὶ τὰ ὀχυρά ἐφ' οἷς σὺ πέποιθας ἐπ' αὐτοῖς ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ σου καὶ θλίψει σε ἐν πάσαις ταῖς πόλεσίν σου αἷς ἔδωκέν σοι κύριος ὁ θεός σου

text_en: And you shall eat the fruit of your womb, and the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, which the Lord your God shall give you, in the distress and extremity wherewith your enemy shall oppress you.
text_la: et comedes fructum uteri tui, et carnes filiorum tuorum et filiarum tuarum, quas dederit tibi Dominus Deus tuus, in angustia et vastitate qua opprimet te hostis tuus.
text_pt: E comerás o fruto do teu ventre, a carne de teus filhos e de tuas filhas, que te der o Senhor teu Deus, no cerco e no aperto com que os teus inimigos te apertarão.
text_el: καὶ φάγῃ τὰ ἔκγονα τῆς κοιλίας σου κρέα υἱῶν σου καὶ θυγατέρων σου ὅσα ἔδωκέν σοι κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐν τῇ στενοχωρίᾳ σου καὶ ἐν τῇ θλίψει σου ᾗ θλίψει σε ὁ ἐχθρός σου

text_en: The man that is nice among you, and very delicate, shall envy his own brother, and his wife, that lies in his bosom,
text_la: Homo delicatus in te, et luxuriosus valde, invidebit fratri suo, et uxori, quæ cubat in sinu suo,
text_pt: Quanto ao homem mais mimoso e delicado no meio de ti, o seu olho será maligno para com o seu irmão, e para com a mulher do seu regaço, e para com os demais de seus filhos que ainda lhe ficarem;
text_el: ὁ ἁπαλὸς ἐν σοὶ καὶ ὁ τρυφερὸς σφόδρα βασκανεῖ τῷ ὀφθαλμῷ τὸν ἀδελφὸν καὶ τὴν γυναῖκα τὴν ἐν τῷ κόλπῳ αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ καταλελειμμένα τέκνα ἃ ἂν καταλειφθῇ

text_en: so that he will not give them of the flesh of his children, which he shall eat: because he has nothing else in the siege and the want, wherewith your enemies shall distress you within all your gates.
text_la: ne det eis de carnibus filiorum suorum, quas comedet : eo quod nihil aliud habeat in obsidione et penuria, qua vastaverint te inimici tui intra omnes portas tuas.
text_pt: De sorte que não dará a nenhum deles da carne de seus filhos, que ele comer; porquanto nada lhe ficou de resto no cerco e no aperto, com que o teu inimigo te apertará em todas as tuas portas.
text_el: ὥστε δοῦναι ἑνὶ αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῶν σαρκῶν τῶν τέκνων αὐτοῦ ὧν ἂν κατέσθῃ διὰ τὸ μὴ καταλειφθῆναι αὐτῷ μηθὲν ἐν τῇ στενοχωρίᾳ σου καὶ ἐν τῇ θλίψει σου ᾗ ἂν θλίψωσίν σε οἱ ἐχθροί σου ἐν πάσαις ταῖς πόλεσίν σου

text_en: The tender and delicate woman , that could not go upon the ground, nor set down her foot for over much niceness and tenderness, will envy her husband who lies in her bosom, the flesh of her son, and of her daughter,
text_la: Tenera mulier et delicata, quæ super terram ingredi non valebat, nec pedis vestigium figere, propter mollitiem et teneritudinem nimiam, invidebit viro suo, qui cubat in sinu ejus, super filii et filiæ carnibus,
text_pt: E quanto à mulher mais mimosa e delicada no meio de ti, que de mimo e delicadeza nunca tentou pôr a planta de seu pé sobre a terra, será maligno o seu olho contra o homem de seu regaço, e contra seu filho, e contra sua filha;
text_el: καὶ ἡ ἁπαλὴ ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ ἡ τρυφερὰ σφόδρα ἧς οὐχὶ πεῖραν ἔλαβεν ὁ ποὺς αὐτῆς βαίνειν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς διὰ τὴν τρυφερότητα καὶ διὰ τὴν ἁπαλότητα βασκανεῖ τῷ ὀφθαλμῷ αὐτῆς τὸν ἄνδρα αὐτῆς τὸν ἐν τῷ κόλπῳ αὐτῆς καὶ τὸν υἱὸν καὶ τὴν θυγατέρα αὐτῆς

text_en: and the filth of the afterbirths, that come forth from between her thighs, and the children that are born the same hour. For they shall eat them secretly for the want of all things, in the siege and distress, wherewith your enemy shall oppress you within your gates.
text_la: et illuvie secundarum, quæ egrediuntur de medio feminum ejus, et super liberis qui eadem hora nati sunt. Comedent enim eos clam propter rerum omnium penuriam in obsidione et vastitate, qua opprimet te inimicus tuus intra portas tuas.
text_pt: E isto por causa de suas páreas, que saírem dentre os seus pés, e para com os seus filhos que tiver, porque os comerá às escondidas pela falta de tudo, no cerco e no aperto, com que o teu inimigo te apertará nas tuas portas.
text_el: καὶ τὸ χόριον αὐτῆς τὸ ἐξελθὸν διὰ τῶν μηρῶν αὐτῆς καὶ τὸ τέκνον ὃ ἂν τέκῃ καταφάγεται γὰρ αὐτὰ διὰ τὴν ἔνδειαν πάντων κρυφῇ ἐν τῇ στενοχωρίᾳ σου καὶ ἐν τῇ θλίψει σου ᾗ θλίψει σε ὁ ἐχθρός σου ἐν πάσαις ταῖς πόλεσίν σου

text_en: If you will not keep, and fulfil all the words of this law , that are written in this volume, and fear his glorious and terrible name : that is, The Lord your God :
text_la: Nisi custodieris et feceris omnia verba legis hujus, quæ scripta sunt in hoc volumine, et timueris nomen ejus gloriosum et terribile, hoc est, Dominum Deum tuum:
text_pt: Se não tiveres cuidado de guardar todas as palavras desta lei, que estão escritas neste livro, para temeres este nome glorioso e temível, o SENHOR TEU DEUS,
text_el: ἐὰν μὴ εἰσακούσητε ποιεῖν πάντα τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ νόμου τούτου τὰ γεγραμμένα ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τούτῳ φοβεῖσθαι τὸ ὄνομα τὸ ἔντιμον καὶ τὸ θαυμαστὸν τοῦτο κύριον τὸν θεόν σου

text_en: The Lord shall increase your plagues, and the plagues of your seed, plagues great and lasting, infirmities grievous and perpetual.
text_la: augebit Dominus plagas tuas, et plagas seminis tui, plagas magnas et perseverantes, infirmitates pessimas et perpetuas:
text_pt: Então o Senhor fará espantosas as tuas pragas, e as pragas de tua descendência, grandes e permanentes pragas, e enfermidades malignas e duradouras;
text_el: καὶ παραδοξάσει κύριος τὰς πληγάς σου καὶ τὰς πληγὰς τοῦ σπέρματός σου πληγὰς μεγάλας καὶ θαυμαστάς καὶ νόσους πονηρὰς καὶ πιστὰς

text_en: And he shall bring back on you all the afflictions of Egypt , which you were afraid of, and they shall stick fast to you.
text_la: et convertet in te omnes afflictiones Ægypti, quas timuisti, et adhærebunt tibi.
text_pt: E fará tornar sobre ti todos os males do Egito, de que tu tiveste temor, e se apegarão a ti.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιστρέψει ἐπὶ σὲ πᾶσαν τὴν ὀδύνην Αἰγύπτου τὴν πονηράν ἣν διευλαβοῦ ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν καὶ κολληθήσονται ἐν σοί

text_en: Moreover the Lord will bring upon you all the diseases, and plagues, that are not written in the volume of this law till he consume you:
text_la: Insuper et universos languores, et plagas, quæ non sunt scriptæ in volumine legis hujus, inducet Dominus super te, donec te conterat:
text_pt: Também o Senhor fará vir sobre ti toda a enfermidade e toda a praga, que não está escrita no livro desta lei, até que sejas destruído.
text_el: καὶ πᾶσαν μαλακίαν καὶ πᾶσαν πληγὴν τὴν μὴ γεγραμμένην ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τοῦ νόμου τούτου ἐπάξει κύριος ἐπὶ σέ ἕως ἂν ἐξολεθρεύσῃ σε

text_en: And you shall remain few in number, who before were as the stars of heaven for multitude, because you heard not the voice of the Lord your God .
text_la: et remanebitis pauci numero, qui prius eratis sicut astra cæli præ multitudine, quoniam non audisti vocem Domini Dei tui.
text_pt: E ficareis poucos em número, em lugar de haverem sido como as estrelas dos céus em multidão; porquanto não destes ouvidos à voz do Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: καὶ καταλειφθήσεσθε ἐν ἀριθμῷ βραχεῖ ἀνθ' ὧν ὅτι ἦτε ὡσεὶ τὰ ἄστρα τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τῷ πλήθει ὅτι οὐκ εἰσηκούσατε τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν

text_en: And as the Lord rejoiced upon you before doing good to you, and multiplying you: so he shall rejoice destroying and bringing you to nought, so that you shall be taken away from the land which you shall go in to possess.
text_la: Et sicut ante lætatus est Dominus super vos, bene vobis faciens, vosque multiplicans : sic lætabitur disperdens vos atque subvertens, ut auferamini de terra, ad quam ingredieris possidendam.
text_pt: E será que, assim como o Senhor se deleitava em vós, em fazer-vos bem e multiplicar-vos, assim o Senhor se deleitará em destruir-vos e consumir-vos; e desarraigados sereis da terra a qual passais a possuir.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὃν τρόπον εὐφράνθη κύριος ἐφ' ὑμῖν εὖ ποιῆσαι ὑμᾶς καὶ πληθῦναι ὑμᾶς οὕτως εὐφρανθήσεται κύριος ἐφ' ὑμῖν ἐξολεθρεῦσαι ὑμᾶς καὶ ἐξαρθήσεσθε ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς εἰς ἣν ὑμεῖς εἰσπορεύεσθε ἐκεῖ κληρονομῆσαι αὐτήν

text_en: The Lord shall scatter you among all people, from the farthest parts of the earth to the ends thereof: and there you shall serve strange gods , which both you are ignorant of and your fathers, wood and stone.
text_la: Disperget te Dominus in omnes populos, a summitate terræ usque ad terminos ejus : et servies ibi diis alienis, quos et tu ignoras et patres tui, lignis et lapidibus.
text_pt: E o Senhor vos espalhará entre todos os povos, desde uma extremidade da terra até à outra; e ali servireis a outros deuses que não conheceste, nem tu nem teus pais; ao pau e à pedra.
text_el: καὶ διασπερεῖ σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἀπ' ἄκρου τῆς γῆς ἕως ἄκρου τῆς γῆς καὶ δουλεύσεις ἐκεῖ θεοῖς ἑτέροις ξύλοις καὶ λίθοις οὓς οὐκ ἠπίστω σὺ καὶ οἱ πατέρες σου

text_en: Neither shall you be quiet, even in those nations , nor shall there be any rest for the sole of your foot. For the Lord will give you a fearful heart, and languishing eyes, and a soul consumed with pensiveness:
text_la: In gentibus quoque illis non quiesces, neque erit requies vestigio pedis tui. Dabit enim tibi Dominus ibi cor pavidum, et deficientes oculos, et animam consumptam mœrore:
text_pt: E nem ainda entre estas nações descansarás, nem a planta de teu pé terá repouso; porquanto o Senhor ali te dará coração agitado, e desfalecimento de olhos, e desmaio da alma.
text_el: ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἐκείνοις οὐκ ἀναπαύσει σε οὐδ' οὐ μὴ γένηται στάσις τῷ ἴχνει τοῦ ποδός σου καὶ δώσει σοι κύριος ἐκεῖ καρδίαν ἀθυμοῦσαν καὶ ἐκλείποντας ὀφθαλμοὺς καὶ τηκομένην ψυχήν

text_en: And your life shall be as it were hanging before you. You shall fear night and day, neither shall you trust your life.
text_la: et erit vita tua quasi pendens ante te. Timebis nocte et die, et non credes vitæ tuæ.
text_pt: E a tua vida, como em suspenso, estará diante de ti; e estremecerás de noite e de dia, e não crerás na tua própria vida.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἡ ζωή σου κρεμαμένη ἀπέναντι τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν σου καὶ φοβηθήσῃ ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς καὶ οὐ πιστεύσεις τῇ ζωῇ σου

text_en: In the morning you shall say: Who will grant me evening? And at evening: Who will grant me morning? For the fearfulness of your heart, wherewith you shall be terrified, and for those things which you shall see with your eyes.
text_la: Mane dices : Quis mihi det vesperum? et vespere : Quis mihi det mane? propter cordis tui formidinem, qua terreberis, et propter ea, quæ tuis videbis oculis.
text_pt: Pela manhã dirás: Ah! quem me dera ver a noite! E à tarde dirás: ah! quem me dera ver a manhã! pelo pasmo de teu coração, que sentirás, e pelo que verás com os teus olhos.
text_el: τὸ πρωὶ ἐρεῖς πῶς ἂν γένοιτο ἑσπέρα καὶ τὸ ἑσπέρας ἐρεῖς πῶς ἂν γένοιτο πρωί ἀπὸ τοῦ φόβου τῆς καρδίας σου ἃ φοβηθήσῃ καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ὁραμάτων τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν σου ὧν ὄψῃ

text_en: The Lord shall bring you again with ships into Egypt , by the way whereof he said to you that you should see it no more. There shall you be set to sale to your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen , and no man shall buy you.
text_la: Reducet te Dominus classibus in Ægyptum per viam de qua dixit tibi ut eam amplius non videres. Ibi venderis inimicis tuis in servos et ancillas, et non erit qui emat.
text_pt: E o Senhor te fará voltar ao Egito em navios, pelo caminho de que te tenho dito; nunca jamais o verás; e ali sereis vendidos como escravos e escravas aos vossos inimigos; mas não haverá quem vos compre.
text_el: καὶ ἀποστρέψει σε κύριος εἰς Αἴγυπτον ἐν πλοίοις καὶ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ᾗ εἶπα οὐ προσθήσεσθε ἔτι ἰδεῖν αὐτήν καὶ πραθήσεσθε ἐκεῖ τοῖς ἐχθροῖς ὑμῶν εἰς παῖδας καὶ παιδίσκας καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ κτώμενος

text_en: These are the words of the covenant which the Lord commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab : beside that covenant which he made with them in Horeb .
text_la: Hæc sunt verba fœderis quod præcepit Dominus Moysi ut feriret cum filiis Israël in terra Moab : præter illud fœdus, quod cum eis pepigit in Horeb.
text_pt: Estas são as palavras da aliança que o SENHOR ordenou a Moisés que fizesse com os filhos de Israel, na terra de Moabe, além da aliança que fizera com eles em Horebe.
text_el: οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι τῆς διαθήκης οὓς ἐνετείλατο κύριος Μωυσῇ στῆσαι τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ἐν γῇ Μωαβ πλὴν τῆς διαθήκης ἧς διέθετο αὐτοῖς ἐν Χωρηβ

text_en: And Moses called all Israel , and said to them: You have seen all the things that the Lord did before you in the land of Egypt to Pharao , and to all his servants, and to his whole land.
text_la: Vocavitque Moyses omnem Israël, et dixit ad eos : Vos vidistis universa, quæ fecit Dominus coram vobis in terra Ægypti Pharaoni, et omnibus servis ejus, universæque terræ illius,
text_pt: E chamou Moisés a todo o Israel, e disse-lhes: Tendes visto tudo quanto o Senhor fez perante vossos olhos, na terra do Egito, a Faraó, e a todos os seus servos, e a toda a sua terra;
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Μωυσῆς πάντας τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς ὑμεῖς ἑωράκατε πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησεν κύριος ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ ἐνώπιον ὑμῶν Φαραω καὶ τοῖς θεράπουσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ πάσῃ τῇ γῇ αὐτοῦ

text_en: The great temptations, which your eyes have seen, those mighty signs and wonders ,
text_la: tentationes magnas, quas viderunt oculi tui, signa illa, portentaque ingentia,
text_pt: As grandes provas que os teus olhos têm visto, aqueles sinais e grandes maravilhas;
text_el: τοὺς πειρασμοὺς τοὺς μεγάλους οὓς ἑωράκασιν οἱ ὀφθαλμοί σου τὰ σημεῖα καὶ τὰ τέρατα τὰ μεγάλα ἐκεῖνα

text_en: and the Lord has not given you a heart to understand, and eyes to see, and ears that may hear, unto this present day.
text_la: et non dedit vobis Dominus cor intelligens, et oculos videntes, et aures quæ possunt audire, usque in præsentem diem.
text_pt: Porém não vos tem dado o Senhor um coração para entender, nem olhos para ver, nem ouvidos para ouvir, até ao dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἔδωκεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῖν καρδίαν εἰδέναι καὶ ὀφθαλμοὺς βλέπειν καὶ ὦτα ἀκούειν ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: He has brought you forty years through the desert : your garments are not worn out, neither are the shoes of your feet consumed with age.
text_la: Adduxit vos quadraginta annis per desertum : non sunt attrita vestimenta vestra, nec calceamenta pedum vestrorum vetustate consumpta sunt.
text_pt: E quarenta anos vos fiz andar pelo deserto; não se envelheceram sobre vós as vossas vestes, e nem se envelheceu o vosso sapato no vosso pé.
text_el: καὶ ἤγαγεν ὑμᾶς τεσσαράκοντα ἔτη ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ οὐκ ἐπαλαιώθη τὰ ἱμάτια ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ ὑποδήματα ὑμῶν οὐ κατετρίβη ἀπὸ τῶν ποδῶν ὑμῶν

text_en: You have not eaten bread, nor have you drunk wine or strong drink: that you might know that I am the Lord your God .
text_la: Panem non comedistis, vinum et siceram non bibistis : ut sciretis quia ego sum Dominus Deus vester.
text_pt: Pão não comestes, e vinho e bebida forte não bebestes; para que soubésseis que eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus.
text_el: ἄρτον οὐκ ἐφάγετε οἶνον καὶ σικερα οὐκ ἐπίετε ἵνα γνῶτε ὅτι οὗτος κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν

text_en: And you came to this place: and Sehon king of Hesebon , and Og king of Basan, came out against us to fight. And we slew them.
text_la: Et venistis ad hunc locum : egressusque est Sehon rex Hesebon, et Og rex Basan, occurrentes nobis ad pugnam. Et percussimus eos,
text_pt: Vindo vós, pois, a este lugar, Siom, rei de Hesbom, e Ogue, rei de Basã, nos saíram ao encontro, à peleja, e nós os ferimos;
text_el: καὶ ἤλθετε ἕως τοῦ τόπου τούτου καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Σηων βασιλεὺς Εσεβων καὶ Ωγ βασιλεὺς τῆς Βασαν εἰς συνάντησιν ἡμῖν ἐν πολέμῳ καὶ ἐπατάξαμεν αὐτοὺς

text_en: And took their land, and delivered it for a possession to Ruben and Gad , and the half tribe of Manasses .
text_la: et tulimus terram eorum, ac tradidimus possidendam Ruben et Gad, et dimidiæ tribui Manasse.
text_pt: E tomamos a sua terra e a demos por herança aos rubenitas, e aos gaditas, e à meia tribo dos manassitas.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάβομεν τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν καὶ ἔδωκα αὐτὴν ἐν κλήρῳ τῷ Ρουβην καὶ τῷ Γαδδι καὶ τῷ ἡμίσει φυλῆς Μανασση

text_en: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and fulfil them: that you may understand all that you do.
text_la: Custodite ergo verba pacti hujus, et implete ea : ut intelligatis universa quæ facitis.
text_pt: Guardai, pois, as palavras desta aliança, e cumpri-as, para que prospereis em tudo quanto fizerdes.
text_el: καὶ φυλάξεσθε ποιεῖν πάντας τοὺς λόγους τῆς διαθήκης ταύτης ἵνα συνῆτε πάντα ὅσα ποιήσετε

text_en: You all stand this day before the Lord your God , your princes, and tribes , and ancients, and doctors, all the people of Israel ,
text_la: Vos statis hodie cuncti coram Domino Deo vestro, principes vestri, et tribus, ac majores natu, atque doctores, omnis populus Israël,
text_pt: Vós todos estais hoje perante o Senhor vosso Deus; os capitães de vossas tribos, vossos anciãos, e os vossos oficiais, todos os homens de Israel;
text_el: ὑμεῖς ἑστήκατε πάντες σήμερον ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν οἱ ἀρχίφυλοι ὑμῶν καὶ ἡ γερουσία ὑμῶν καὶ οἱ κριταὶ ὑμῶν καὶ οἱ γραμματοεισαγωγεῖς ὑμῶν πᾶς ἀνὴρ Ισραηλ

text_en: your children and your wives, and the stranger that abides with you in the camp, besides the hewers of wood, and them that bring water:
text_la: liberi et uxores vestræ, et advena qui tecum moratur in castris, exceptis lignorum cæsoribus, et his qui comportant aquas:
text_pt: Os vossos meninos, as vossas mulheres, e o estrangeiro que está no meio do vosso arraial; desde o rachador da vossa lenha até ao tirador da vossa água;
text_el: αἱ γυναῖκες ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ ἔκγονα ὑμῶν καὶ ὁ προσήλυτος ὁ ἐν μέσῳ τῆς παρεμβολῆς ὑμῶν ἀπὸ ξυλοκόπου ὑμῶν καὶ ἕως ὑδροφόρου ὑμῶν

text_en: That you may pass in the covenant of the Lord your God , and in the oath which this day the Lord your God makes with you.
text_la: ut transeas in fœdere Domini Dei tui, et in jurejurando quod hodie Dominus Deus tuus percutit tecum:
text_pt: Para entrardes na aliança do Senhor teu Deus, e no seu juramento que o Senhor teu Deus hoje faz convosco;
text_el: παρελθεῖν ἐν τῇ διαθήκῃ κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἀραῖς αὐτοῦ ὅσα κύριος ὁ θεός σου διατίθεται πρὸς σὲ σήμερον

text_en: That he may raise you up a people to himself, and he may be your God as he has spoken to you, and as he swore to your fathers Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob .
text_la: ut suscitet te sibi in populum, et ipse sit Deus tuus sicut locutus est tibi, et sicut juravit patribus tuis, Abraham, Isaac, et Jacob.
text_pt: Para que hoje te confirme por seu povo, e ele te seja por Deus, como te tem dito, e como jurou a teus pais, Abraão, Isaque e Jacó.
text_el: ἵνα στήσῃ σε αὐτῷ εἰς λαόν καὶ αὐτὸς ἔσται σου θεός ὃν τρόπον εἶπέν σοι καὶ ὃν τρόπον ὤμοσεν τοῖς πατράσιν σου Αβρααμ καὶ Ισαακ καὶ Ιακωβ

text_en: Neither with you only do I make this covenant, and confirm these oaths ,
text_la: Nec vobis solis ego hoc fœdus ferio, et hæc juramenta confirmo,
text_pt: E não somente convosco faço esta aliança e este juramento;
text_el: καὶ οὐχ ὑμῖν μόνοις ἐγὼ διατίθεμαι τὴν διαθήκην ταύτην καὶ τὴν ἀρὰν ταύτην

text_en: but with all that are present and that are absent.
text_la: sed cunctis præsentibus et absentibus.
text_pt: Mas com aquele que hoje está aqui em pé conosco perante o Senhor nosso Deus, e com aquele que hoje não está aqui conosco.
text_el: ἀλλὰ καὶ τοῖς ὧδε οὖσι μεθ' ἡμῶν σήμερον ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν καὶ τοῖς μὴ οὖσιν μεθ' ἡμῶν ὧδε σήμερον

text_en: For you know how we dwelt in the land of Egypt , and how we have passed through the midst of nations , and passing through them,
text_la: Vos enim nostis quomodo habitaverimus in terra Ægypti, et quomodo transierimus per medium nationum, quas transeuntes
text_pt: Porque vós sabeis como habitamos na terra do Egito, e como passamos pelo meio das nações pelas quais passastes;
text_el: ὅτι ὑμεῖς οἴδατε ὡς κατῳκήσαμεν ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ παρήλθομεν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἐθνῶν οὓς παρήλθετε

text_en: you have seen their abominations and filth, that is to say, their idols , wood and stone, silver and gold, which they worshipped .
text_la: vidistis abominationes et sordes, id est, idola eorum, lignum et lapidem, argentum et aurum, quæ colebant.
text_pt: E vistes as suas abominações, e os seus ídolos, o pau e a pedra, a prata e o ouro que havia entre eles,
text_el: καὶ εἴδετε τὰ βδελύγματα αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ εἴδωλα αὐτῶν ξύλον καὶ λίθον ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον ἅ ἐστιν παρ' αὐτοῖς

text_en: Lest perhaps there should be among you a man or a woman , a family or a tribe , whose heart is turned away this day from the Lord our God , to go and serve the gods of those nations : and there should be among you a root bringing forth gall and bitterness.
text_la: Ne forte sit inter vos vir aut mulier, familia aut tribus, cujus cor aversum est hodie a Domino Deo nostro, ut vadat et serviat diis illarum gentium : et sit inter vos radix germinans fel et amaritudinem.
text_pt: Para que entre vós não haja homem, nem mulher, nem família, nem tribo, cujo coração hoje se desvie do Senhor nosso Deus, para que vá servir aos deuses destas nações; para que entre vós não haja raiz que dê veneno e fel;
text_el: μή τίς ἐστιν ἐν ὑμῖν ἀνὴρ ἢ γυνὴ ἢ πατριὰ ἢ φυλή τίνος ἡ διάνοια ἐξέκλινεν ἀπὸ κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν πορεύεσθαι λατρεύειν τοῖς θεοῖς τῶν ἐθνῶν ἐκείνων μή τίς ἐστιν ἐν ὑμῖν ῥίζα ἄνω φύουσα ἐν χολῇ καὶ πικρίᾳ

text_en: And when he shall hear the words of this oath , he should bless himself in his heart saying: I shall have peace, and will walk on in the naughtiness of my heart: and the drunken may consume the thirsty,
text_la: Cumque audierit verba juramenti hujus, benedicat sibi in corde suo, dicens : Pax erit mihi, et ambulabo in pravitate cordis mei : et absumat ebria sitientem,
text_pt: E aconteça que, alguém ouvindo as palavras desta maldição, se abençoe no seu coração, dizendo: Terei paz, ainda que ande conforme o parecer do meu coração; para acrescentar à sede a bebedeira.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν ἀκούσῃ τὰ ῥήματα τῆς ἀρᾶς ταύτης καὶ ἐπιφημίσηται ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ λέγων ὅσιά μοι γένοιτο ὅτι ἐν τῇ ἀποπλανήσει τῆς καρδίας μου πορεύσομαι ἵνα μὴ συναπολέσῃ ὁ ἁμαρτωλὸς τὸν ἀναμάρτητον

text_en: and the Lord should not forgive him: but his wrath and jealousy against that man should be exceedingly enkindled at that time, and all the curses that are written in this volume should light upon him: and the Lord should blot out his name from under heaven ,
text_la: et Dominus non ignoscat ei : sed tunc quam maxime furor ejus fumet, et zelus contra hominem illum, et sedeant super eum omnia maledicta, quæ scripta sunt in hoc volumine : et deleat Dominus nomen ejus sub cælo,
text_pt: O Senhor não lhe quererá perdoar; mas fumegará a ira do Senhor e o seu zelo contra esse homem, e toda a maldição escrita neste livro pousará sobre ele; e o Senhor apagará o seu nome de debaixo do céu.
text_el: οὐ μὴ θελήσῃ ὁ θεὸς εὐιλατεῦσαι αὐτῷ ἀλλ' ἢ τότε ἐκκαυθήσεται ὀργὴ κυρίου καὶ ὁ ζῆλος αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ ἐκείνῳ καὶ κολληθήσονται ἐν αὐτῷ πᾶσαι αἱ ἀραὶ τῆς διαθήκης ταύτης αἱ γεγραμμέναι ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τοῦ νόμου τούτου καὶ ἐξαλείψει κύριος τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῆς ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανόν

text_en: and utterly destroy him out of all the tribes of Israel , according to the curses that are contained in the book of this law and covenant:
text_la: et consumat eum in perditionem ex omnibus tribubus Israël, juxta maledictiones, quæ in libro legis hujus ac fœderis continentur.
text_pt: E o Senhor o separará para mal, de todas as tribos de Israel, conforme a todas as maldições da aliança escrita no livro desta lei.
text_el: καὶ διαστελεῖ αὐτὸν κύριος εἰς κακὰ ἐκ πάντων τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ κατὰ πάσας τὰς ἀρὰς τῆς διαθήκης τὰς γεγραμμένας ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τοῦ νόμου τούτου

text_en: And the following generation shall say, and the children that shall be born hereafter, and the strangers that shall come from afar, seeing the plagues of that land and the evils wherewith the Lord has afflicted it,
text_la: Dicetque sequens generatio, et filii qui nascentur deinceps, et peregrini qui de longe venerint, videntes plagas terræ illius, et infirmitates, quibus eam afflixerit Dominus,
text_pt: Então dirá à geração vindoura, os vossos filhos, que se levantarem depois de vós, e o estrangeiro que virá de terras remotas, vendo as pragas desta terra, e as suas doenças, com que o Senhor a terá afligido;
text_el: καὶ ἐροῦσιν ἡ γενεὰ ἡ ἑτέρα οἱ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν οἳ ἀναστήσονται μεθ' ὑμᾶς καὶ ὁ ἀλλότριος ὃς ἂν ἔλθῃ ἐκ γῆς μακρόθεν καὶ ὄψονται τὰς πληγὰς τῆς γῆς ἐκείνης καὶ τὰς νόσους αὐτῆς ἃς ἀπέστειλεν κύριος ἐπ' αὐτήν

text_en: burning it with brimstone, and the heat of salt , so that it cannot be sown any more, nor any green thing grow therein, after the example of the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrha , Adama and Seboim, which the Lord destroyed in his wrath and indignation:
text_la: sulphure, et salis ardore comburens, ita ut ultra non seratur, nec virens quippiam germinet, in exemplum subversionis Sodomæ et Gomorrhæ, Adamæ et Seboim, quas subvertit Dominus in ira et furore suo.
text_pt: E toda a sua terra abrasada com enxofre, e sal, de sorte que não será semeada, e nada produzirá, nem nela crescerá erva alguma; assim como foi a destruição de Sodoma e de Gomorra, de Admá e de Zeboim, que o Senhor destruiu na sua ira e no seu furor.
text_el: θεῖον καὶ ἅλα κατακεκαυμένον πᾶσα ἡ γῆ αὐτῆς οὐ σπαρήσεται οὐδὲ ἀνατελεῖ οὐδὲ μὴ ἀναβῇ ἐπ' αὐτὴν πᾶν χλωρόν ὥσπερ κατεστράφη Σοδομα καὶ Γομορρα Αδαμα καὶ Σεβωιμ ἃς κατέστρεψεν κύριος ἐν θυμῷ καὶ ὀργῇ

text_en: And all the nations shall say: Why has the Lord done thus to this land? What means this exceeding great heat of his wrath ?
text_la: Et dicent omnes gentes : Quare sic fecit Dominus terræ huic? quæ est hæc ira furoris ejus immensa?
text_pt: E todas as nações dirão: Por que fez o Senhor assim com esta terra? Qual foi a causa do furor desta tão grande ira?
text_el: καὶ ἐροῦσιν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη διὰ τί ἐποίησεν κύριος οὕτως τῇ γῇ ταύτῃ τίς ὁ θυμὸς τῆς ὀργῆς ὁ μέγας οὗτος

text_en: And they shall answer: Because they forsook the covenant of the Lord , which he made with their fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt :
text_la: Et respondebunt : Quia dereliquerunt pactum Domini, quod pepigit cum patribus eorum, quando eduxit eos de terra Ægypti:
text_pt: Então se dirá: Porquanto deixaram a aliança do Senhor Deus de seus pais, que com eles tinha feito, quando os tirou do Egito;
text_el: καὶ ἐροῦσιν ὅτι κατελίποσαν τὴν διαθήκην κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν ἃ διέθετο τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν ὅτε ἐξήγαγεν αὐτοὺς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And they have served strange gods , and adored them, whom they knew not, and for whom they had not been assigned:
text_la: et servierunt diis alienis, et adoraverunt eos, quos nesciebant, et quibus non fuerant attributi:
text_pt: E foram, e serviram a outros deuses, e se inclinaram diante deles; deuses que eles não conheceram, e nenhum dos quais lhes tinha sido dado.
text_el: καὶ πορευθέντες ἐλάτρευσαν θεοῖς ἑτέροις καὶ προσεκύνησαν αὐτοῖς οἷς οὐκ ἠπίσταντο οὐδὲ διένειμεν αὐτοῖς

text_en: Therefore the wrath of the Lord was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this volume:
text_la: idcirco iratus est furor Domini contra terram istam, ut induceret super eam omnia maledicta, quæ in hoc volumine scripta sunt:
text_pt: Por isso a ira do Senhor se acendeu contra esta terra, para trazer sobre ela toda a maldição que está escrita neste livro.
text_el: καὶ ὠργίσθη θυμῷ κύριος ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἐκείνην ἐπαγαγεῖν ἐπ' αὐτὴν κατὰ πάσας τὰς κατάρας τὰς γεγραμμένας ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τοῦ νόμου τούτου

text_en: And he has cast them out of their land, in anger and in wrath , and in very great indignation, and has thrown them into a strange land, as it is seen this day.
text_la: et ejecit eos de terra sua in ira et in furore, et in indignatione maxima, projecitque in terram alienam, sicut hodie comprobatur.
text_pt: E o Senhor os arrancou da sua terra com ira, e com indignação, e com grande furor, e os lançou em outra terra como neste dia se vê.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆρεν αὐτοὺς κύριος ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς αὐτῶν ἐν θυμῷ καὶ ὀργῇ καὶ παροξυσμῷ μεγάλῳ σφόδρα καὶ ἐξέβαλεν αὐτοὺς εἰς γῆν ἑτέραν ὡσεὶ νῦν

text_en: Secret things to the Lord our God : things that are manifest, to us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law .
text_la: Abscondita, Domino Deo nostro; quæ manifesta sunt, nobis et filiis nostris usque in sempiternum, ut faciamus universa verba legis hujus.
text_pt: As coisas encobertas pertencem ao Senhor nosso Deus, porém as reveladas nos pertencem a nós e a nossos filhos para sempre, para que cumpramos todas as palavras desta lei.
text_el: τὰ κρυπτὰ κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν τὰ δὲ φανερὰ ἡμῖν καὶ τοῖς τέκνοις ἡμῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ποιεῖν πάντα τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ νόμου τούτου

text_en: Now when all these things shall be come upon you, the blessing or the curse , which I have set forth before you, and you shall be touched with repentance of your heart among all the nations, into which the Lord your God shall have scattered you,
text_la: Cum ergo venerint super te omnes sermones isti, benedictio sive maledictio, quam proposui in conspectu tuo : et ductus pœnitudine cordis tui in universis gentibus, in quas disperserit te Dominus Deus tuus,
text_pt: E será que, sobrevindo-te todas estas coisas, a bênção ou a maldição, que tenho posto diante de ti, e te recordares delas entre todas as nações, para onde te lançar o SENHOR teu Deus,
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὡς ἂν ἔλθωσιν ἐπὶ σὲ πάντα τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα ἡ εὐλογία καὶ ἡ κατάρα ἣν ἔδωκα πρὸ προσώπου σου καὶ δέξῃ εἰς τὴν καρδίαν σου ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν οὗ ἐάν σε διασκορπίσῃ κύριος ἐκεῖ

text_en: and shall return to him, and obey his commandments , as I command you this day, you and your children, with all your heart, and with all your soul :
text_la: et reversus fueris ad eum, et obedieris ejus imperiis, sicut ego hodie præcipio tibi, cum filiis tuis, in toto corde tuo, et in tota anima tua:
text_pt: E te converteres ao Senhor teu Deus, e deres ouvidos à sua voz, conforme a tudo o que eu te ordeno hoje, tu e teus filhos, com todo o teu coração, e com toda a tua alma,
text_el: καὶ ἐπιστραφήσῃ ἐπὶ κύριον τὸν θεόν σου καὶ ὑπακούσῃ τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον ἐξ ὅλης τῆς καρδίας σου καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς ψυχῆς σου

text_en: The Lord your God will bring back again your captivity , and will have mercy on you, and gather you again out of all the nations , into which he scattered you before.
text_la: reducet Dominus Deus tuus captivitatem tuam, ac miserebitur tui, et rursum congregabit te de cunctis populis, in quos te ante dispersit.
text_pt: Então o Senhor teu Deus te fará voltar do teu cativeiro, e se compadecerá de ti, e tornará a ajuntar-te dentre todas as nações entre as quais te espalhou o Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἰάσεται κύριος τὰς ἁμαρτίας σου καὶ ἐλεήσει σε καὶ πάλιν συνάξει σε ἐκ πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν εἰς οὓς διεσκόρπισέν σε κύριος ἐκεῖ

text_en: If you be driven as far as the poles of heaven , the Lord your God will fetch you back from hence,
text_la: Si ad cardines cæli fueris dissipatus, inde te retrahet Dominus Deus tuus,
text_pt: Ainda que os teus desterrados estejam na extremidade do céu, desde ali te ajuntará o Senhor teu Deus, e te tomará dali;
text_el: ἐὰν ᾖ ἡ διασπορά σου ἀπ' ἄκρου τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἕως ἄκρου τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐκεῖθεν συνάξει σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου καὶ ἐκεῖθεν λήμψεταί σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου

text_en: and will take you to himself, and bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you shall possess it: and blessing you, he will make you more numerous than were your fathers.
text_la: et assumet, atque introducet in terram, quam possederunt patres tui, et obtinebis eam : et benedicens tibi, majoris numeri te esse faciat quam fuerunt patres tui.
text_pt: E o Senhor teu Deus te trará à terra que teus pais possuíram, e a possuirás; e te fará bem, e te multiplicará mais do que a teus pais.
text_el: καὶ εἰσάξει σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ἐκληρονόμησαν οἱ πατέρες σου καὶ κληρονομήσεις αὐτήν καὶ εὖ σε ποιήσει καὶ πλεοναστόν σε ποιήσει ὑπὲρ τοὺς πατέρας σου

text_en: The Lord your God will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your seed: that you may love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul , that you may live.
text_la: Circumcidet Dominus Deus tuus cor tuum, et cor seminis tui, ut diligas Dominum Deum tuum in toto corde tuo, et in tota anima tua, ut possis vivere.
text_pt: E o Senhor teu Deus circuncidará o teu coração, e o coração de tua descendência, para amares ao Senhor teu Deus com todo o coração, e com toda a tua alma, para que vivas.
text_el: καὶ περικαθαριεῖ κύριος τὴν καρδίαν σου καὶ τὴν καρδίαν τοῦ σπέρματός σου ἀγαπᾶν κύριον τὸν θεόν σου ἐξ ὅλης τῆς καρδίας σου καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς ψυχῆς σου ἵνα ζῇς σύ

text_en: And he will turn all these curses upon your enemies, and upon them that hate and persecute you.
text_la: Omnes autem maledictiones has convertet super inimicos tuos, et eos qui oderunt te et persequuntur.
text_pt: E o Senhor teu Deus porá todas estas maldições sobre os teus inimigos, e sobre os que te odiarem, que te perseguirem.
text_el: καὶ δώσει κύριος ὁ θεός σου τὰς ἀρὰς ταύτας ἐπὶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς μισοῦντάς σε οἳ ἐδίωξάν σε

text_en: But you shall return, and hear the voice of the Lord your God , and shall do all the commandments which I command you this day:
text_la: Tu autem reverteris, et audies vocem Domini Dei tui, faciesque universa mandata quæ ego præcipio tibi hodie:
text_pt: Converter-te-ás, pois, e darás ouvidos à voz do Senhor; cumprirás todos os seus mandamentos que hoje te ordeno.
text_el: καὶ σὺ ἐπιστραφήσῃ καὶ εἰσακούσῃ τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου καὶ ποιήσεις τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ὅσας ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον

text_en: And the Lord your God will make you abound in all the works of your hands, in the fruit of your womb, and in the fruit of your cattle, in the fruitfulness of your land, and in the plenty of all things. For the Lord will return to rejoice over you in all good things, as he rejoiced in your fathers:
