text_la: et abundare te faciet Dominus Deus tuus in cunctis operibus manuum tuarum, in sobole uteri tui, et in fructu jumentorum tuorum, in ubertate terræ tuæ, et in rerum omnium largitate. Revertetur enim Dominus, ut gaudeat super te in omnibus bonis, sicut gavisus est in patribus tuis:
text_pt: E o Senhor teu Deus te fará prosperar em toda a obra das tuas mãos, no fruto do teu ventre, e no fruto dos teus animais, e no fruto da tua terra para o teu bem; porquanto o Senhor tornará a alegrar-se em ti para te fazer bem, como se alegrou em teus pais,
text_el: καὶ πολυωρήσει σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐν παντὶ ἔργῳ τῶν χειρῶν σου ἐν τοῖς ἐκγόνοις τῆς κοιλίας σου καὶ ἐν τοῖς γενήμασιν τῆς γῆς σου καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἐκγόνοις τῶν κτηνῶν σου ὅτι ἐπιστρέψει κύριος ὁ θεός σου εὐφρανθῆναι ἐπὶ σὲ εἰς ἀγαθά καθότι ηὐφράνθη ἐπὶ τοῖς πατράσιν σου

text_en: Yet so if you hear the voice of the Lord your God , and keep his precepts and ceremonies , which are written in this law : and return to the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul .
text_la: si tamen audieris vocem Domini Dei tui, et custodieris præcepta ejus et cæremonias, quæ in hac lege conscripta sunt : et revertaris ad Dominum Deum tuum in toto corde tuo, et in tota anima tua.
text_pt: Quando deres ouvidos à voz do Senhor teu Deus, guardando os seus mandamentos e os seus estatutos, escritos neste livro da lei, quando te converteres ao Senhor teu Deus com todo o teu coração, e com toda a tua alma.
text_el: ἐὰν εἰσακούσῃς τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου φυλάσσεσθαι καὶ ποιεῖν πάσας τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰς κρίσεις αὐτοῦ τὰς γεγραμμένας ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τοῦ νόμου τούτου ἐὰν ἐπιστραφῇς ἐπὶ κύριον τὸν θεόν σου ἐξ ὅλης τῆς καρδίας σου καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς ψυχῆς σου

text_en: This commandment , that I command you this day is not above you, nor far off from you:
text_la: Mandatum hoc, quod ego præcipio tibi hodie, non supra te est, neque procul positum,
text_pt: Porque este mandamento, que hoje te ordeno, não te é encoberto, e tampouco está longe de ti.
text_el: ὅτι ἡ ἐντολὴ αὕτη ἣν ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον οὐχ ὑπέρογκός ἐστιν οὐδὲ μακρὰν ἀπὸ σοῦ

text_en: Nor is it in heaven , that you should say: Which of us can go up to heaven to bring it unto us, and we may hear and fulfil it in work?
text_la: nec in cælo situm, ut possis dicere : Quis nostrum valet ad cælum ascendere, ut deferat illud ad nos, et audiamus atque opere compleamus?
text_pt: Não está nos céus, para dizeres: Quem subirá por nós aos céus, que no-lo traga, e no-lo faça ouvir, para que o cumpramos?
text_el: οὐκ ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ἄνω ἐστὶν λέγων τίς ἀναβήσεται ἡμῖν εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ λήμψεται αὐτὴν ἡμῖν καὶ ἀκούσαντες αὐτὴν ποιήσομεν

text_en: Nor is it beyond the sea: that you may excuse yourself, and say: Which of us can cross the sea, and bring it unto us: that we may hear, and do that which is commanded?
text_la: neque trans mare positum : ut causeris, et dicas : Quis ex nobis poterit transfretare mare, et illud ad nos usque deferre, ut possimus audire et facere quod præceptum est?
text_pt: Nem tampouco está além do mar, para dizeres: Quem passará por nós além do mar, para que no-lo traga, e no-lo faça ouvir, para que o cumpramos?
text_el: οὐδὲ πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης ἐστὶν λέγων τίς διαπεράσει ἡμῖν εἰς τὸ πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ λήμψεται ἡμῖν αὐτήν καὶ ἀκουστὴν ἡμῖν ποιήσει αὐτήν καὶ ποιήσομεν

text_en: But the word is very near unto you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.
text_la: sed juxta te est sermo valde, in ore tuo, et in corde tuo, ut facias illum.
text_pt: Porque esta palavra está mui perto de ti, na tua boca, e no teu coração, para a cumprires.
text_el: ἔστιν σου ἐγγὺς τὸ ῥῆμα σφόδρα ἐν τῷ στόματί σου καὶ ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ σου καὶ ἐν ταῖς χερσίν σου αὐτὸ ποιεῖν

text_en: Consider that I have set before you this day life and good , and on the other hand death and evil :
text_la: Considera quod hodie proposuerim in conspectu tuo, vitam et bonum, et e contrario mortem et malum:
text_pt: Vês aqui, hoje te tenho proposto a vida e o bem, e a morte e o mal;
text_el: ἰδοὺ δέδωκα πρὸ προσώπου σου σήμερον τὴν ζωὴν καὶ τὸν θάνατον τὸ ἀγαθὸν καὶ τὸ κακόν

text_en: That you may love the Lord your God , and walk in his ways, and keep his commandments and ceremonies and judgments, and bless you in the land, which you shall go in to possess.
text_la: ut diligas Dominum Deum tuum, et ambules in viis ejus, et custodias mandata illius ac cæremonias atque judicia : et vivas, atque multiplicet te, benedicatque tibi in terra, ad quam ingredieris possidendam.
text_pt: Porquanto te ordeno hoje que ames ao Senhor teu Deus, que andes nos seus caminhos, e que guardes os seus mandamentos, e os seus estatutos, e os seus juízos, para que vivas, e te multipliques, e o Senhor teu Deus te abençoe na terra a qual entras a possuir.
text_el: ἐὰν εἰσακούσῃς τὰς ἐντολὰς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου ἃς ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον ἀγαπᾶν κύριον τὸν θεόν σου πορεύεσθαι ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ φυλάσσεσθαι τὰ δικαιώματα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰς κρίσεις αὐτοῦ καὶ ζήσεσθε καὶ πολλοὶ ἔσεσθε καὶ εὐλογήσει σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ εἰς ἣν εἰσπορεύῃ ἐκεῖ κληρονομῆσαι αὐτήν

text_en: But if your heart be turned away, so that you will not hear, and being deceived with error you adore strange gods , and serve them:
text_la: Si autem aversum fuerit cor tuum, et audire nolueris, atque errore deceptus adoraveris deos alienos, et servieris eis:
text_pt: Porém se o teu coração se desviar, e não quiseres dar ouvidos, e fores seduzido para te inclinares a outros deuses, e os servires,
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν μεταστῇ ἡ καρδία σου καὶ μὴ εἰσακούσῃς καὶ πλανηθεὶς προσκυνήσῃς θεοῖς ἑτέροις καὶ λατρεύσῃς αὐτοῖς

text_en: I foretell you this day that you shall perish, and shall remain but a short time in the land, to which you shall pass over the Jordan , and shall go in to possess it.
text_la: prædico tibi hodie quod pereas, et parvo tempore moreris in terra, ad quam, Jordane transmisso, ingredieris possidendam.
text_pt: Então eu vos declaro hoje que, certamente, perecereis; não prolongareis os dias na terra a que vais, passando o Jordão, para que, entrando nela, a possuas;
text_el: ἀναγγέλλω σοι σήμερον ὅτι ἀπωλείᾳ ἀπολεῖσθε καὶ οὐ μὴ πολυήμεροι γένησθε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἧς κύριος ὁ θεός σου δίδωσίν σοι εἰς ἣν ὑμεῖς διαβαίνετε τὸν Ιορδάνην ἐκεῖ κληρονομῆσαι αὐτήν

text_en: I call heaven and earth to witness this day, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing . Choose therefore life, that both you and your seed may live:
text_la: Testes invoco hodie cælum et terram, quod proposuerim vobis vitam et mortem, benedictionem et maledictionem. Elige ergo vitam, ut et tu vivas, et semen tuum:
text_pt: Os céus e a terra tomo hoje por testemunhas contra vós, de que te tenho proposto a vida e a morte, a bênção e a maldição; escolhe pois a vida, para que vivas, tu e a tua descendência,
text_el: διαμαρτύρομαι ὑμῖν σήμερον τόν τε οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν τὴν ζωὴν καὶ τὸν θάνατον δέδωκα πρὸ προσώπου ὑμῶν τὴν εὐλογίαν καὶ τὴν κατάραν ἔκλεξαι τὴν ζωήν ἵνα ζῇς σὺ καὶ τὸ σπέρμα σου

text_en: And that you may love the Lord your God , and obey his voice, and adhere to him (for he is your life, and the length of your days), that you may dwell in the land, for which the Lord swore to your fathers Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob that he would give it them.
text_la: et diligas Dominum Deum tuum, atque obedias voci ejus, et illi adhæreas (ipse est enim vita tua, et longitudo dierum tuorum), ut habites in terra, pro qua juravit Dominus patribus tuis, Abraham, Isaac, et Jacob, ut daret eam illis.
text_pt: Amando ao Senhor teu Deus, dando ouvidos à sua voz, e achegando-te a ele; pois ele é a tua vida, e o prolongamento dos teus dias; para que fiques na terra que o Senhor jurou a teus pais, a Abraão, a Isaque, e a Jacó, que lhes havia de dar.
text_el: ἀγαπᾶν κύριον τὸν θεόν σου εἰσακούειν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔχεσθαι αὐτοῦ ὅτι τοῦτο ἡ ζωή σου καὶ ἡ μακρότης τῶν ἡμερῶν σου κατοικεῖν σε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἧς ὤμοσεν κύριος τοῖς πατράσιν σου Αβρααμ καὶ Ισαακ καὶ Ιακωβ δοῦναι αὐτοῖς

text_en: And Moses went, and spoke all these words to all Israel ,
text_la: Abiit itaque Moyses, et locutus est omnia verba hæc ad universum Israël,
text_pt: Depois foi Moisés, e falou estas palavras a todo o Israel,
text_el: καὶ συνετέλεσεν Μωυσῆς λαλῶν πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους πρὸς πάντας υἱοὺς Ισραηλ

text_en: and he said to them: I am this day a hundred and twenty years old, I can no longer go out and come in, especially as the Lord also has said to me: You shall not pass over this Jordan .
text_la: et dixit ad eos : Centum viginti annorum sum hodie; non possum ultra egredi et ingredi, præsertim cum et Dominus dixerit mihi : Non transibis Jordanem istum.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Da idade de cento e vinte anos sou eu hoje; já não poderei mais sair e entrar; além disto o Senhor me disse: Não passarás o Jordão.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς ἑκατὸν καὶ εἴκοσι ἐτῶν ἐγώ εἰμι σήμερον οὐ δυνήσομαι ἔτι εἰσπορεύεσθαι καὶ ἐκπορεύεσθαι κύριος δὲ εἶπεν πρός με οὐ διαβήσῃ τὸν Ιορδάνην τοῦτον

text_en: The Lord your God then will pass over before you: he will destroy all these nations in your sight, and you shall possess them: and this Joshua shall go over before you, as the Lord has spoken.
text_la: Dominus ergo Deus tuus transibit ante te : ipse delebit omnes gentes has in conspectu tuo, et possidebis eas : et Josue iste transibit ante te, sicut locutus est Dominus.
text_pt: O Senhor teu Deus passará adiante de ti; ele destruirá estas nações de diante de ti, para que as possuas; Josué passará adiante de ti, como o Senhor tem falado.
text_el: κύριος ὁ θεός σου ὁ προπορευόμενος πρὸ προσώπου σου αὐτὸς ἐξολεθρεύσει τὰ ἔθνη ταῦτα ἀπὸ προσώπου σου καὶ κατακληρονομήσεις αὐτούς καὶ Ἰησοῦς ὁ προπορευόμενος πρὸ προσώπου σου καθὰ ἐλάλησεν κύριος

text_en: And the Lord shall do to them as he did to Sehon and Og the kings of the Amorrhites , and to their land, and shall destroy them.
text_la: Facietque Dominus eis sicut fecit Sehon et Og regibus Amorrhæorum, et terræ eorum, delebitque eos.
text_pt: E o Senhor lhes fará como fez a Siom e a Ogue, reis dos amorreus, e à sua terra, os quais destruiu.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσει κύριος αὐτοῖς καθὰ ἐποίησεν Σηων καὶ Ωγ τοῖς δυσὶ βασιλεῦσιν τῶν Αμορραίων οἳ ἦσαν πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου καὶ τῇ γῇ αὐτῶν καθότι ἐξωλέθρευσεν αὐτούς

text_en: Therefore when the Lord shall have delivered these also to you, you shall do in like manner to them as I have commanded you.
text_la: Cum ergo et hos tradiderit vobis, similiter facietis eis, sicut præcepi vobis.
text_pt: Quando, pois, o Senhor vo-los der diante de vós, então com eles fareis conforme a todo o mandamento que vos tenho ordenado.
text_el: καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς κύριος ὑμῖν καὶ ποιήσετε αὐτοῖς καθότι ἐνετειλάμην ὑμῖν

text_en: Do manfully and be of good heart: fear not, nor be dismayed at their sight: for the Lord your God he himself is your leader, and will not leave you nor forsake you.
text_la: Viriliter agite, et confortamini : nolite timere, nec paveatis ad conspectum eorum : quia Dominus Deus tuus ipse est ductor tuus, et non dimittet, nec derelinquet te.
text_pt: Esforçai-vos, e animai-vos; não temais, nem vos espanteis diante deles; porque o Senhor teu Deus é o que vai contigo; não te deixará nem te desamparará.
text_el: ἀνδρίζου καὶ ἴσχυε μὴ φοβοῦ μηδὲ δειλία μηδὲ πτοηθῇς ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν ὅτι κύριος ὁ θεός σου ὁ προπορευόμενος μεθ' ὑμῶν ἐν ὑμῖν οὐ μή σε ἀνῇ οὔτε μή σε ἐγκαταλίπῃ

text_en: And Moses called Joshua , and said to him before all Israel : Take courage , and be valiant : for you shall bring this people into the land which the Lord swore he would give to their fathers, and you shall divide it by lot.
text_la: Vocavitque Moyses Josue, et dixit ei coram omni Israël : Confortare, et esto robustus : tu enim introduces populum istum in terram, quam daturum se patribus eorum juravit Dominus, et tu eam sorte divides.
text_pt: E chamou Moisés a Josué, e lhe disse aos olhos de todo o Israel: Esforça-te e anima-te; porque com este povo entrarás na terra que o Senhor jurou a teus pais lhes dar; e tu os farás herdá-la.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Μωυσῆς Ἰησοῦν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ἔναντι παντὸς Ισραηλ ἀνδρίζου καὶ ἴσχυε σὺ γὰρ εἰσελεύσῃ πρὸ προσώπου τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ὤμοσεν κύριος τοῖς πατράσιν ἡμῶν δοῦναι αὐτοῖς καὶ σὺ κατακληρονομήσεις αὐτὴν αὐτοῖς

text_en: And the Lord who is your leader, he himself will be with you: he will not leave you, nor forsake you: fear not, neither be dismayed.
text_la: Et Dominus qui ductor est vester, ipse erit tecum : non dimittet, nec derelinquet te : noli timere, nec paveas.
text_pt: O Senhor, pois, é aquele que vai adiante de ti; ele será contigo, não te deixará, nem te desamparará; não temas, nem te espantes.
text_el: καὶ κύριος ὁ συμπορευόμενος μετὰ σοῦ οὐκ ἀνήσει σε οὐδὲ μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃ σε μὴ φοβοῦ μηδὲ δειλία

text_en: And Moses wrote this law , and delivered it to the priests the sons of Levi , who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord , and to all the ancients of Israel .
text_la: Scripsit itaque Moyses legem hanc, et tradidit eam sacerdotibus filiis Levi, qui portabant arcam fœderis Domini, et cunctis senioribus Israël.
text_pt: E Moisés escreveu esta lei, e a deu aos sacerdotes, filhos de Levi, que levavam a arca da aliança do Senhor, e a todos os anciãos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἔγραψεν Μωυσῆς τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ νόμου τούτου εἰς βιβλίον καὶ ἔδωκεν τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν τοῖς υἱοῖς Λευι τοῖς αἴρουσιν τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου καὶ τοῖς πρεσβυτέροις τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And he commanded them, saying: After seven years, in the year of remission, in the feast of tabernacles ,
text_la: Præcepitque eis, dicens : Post septem annos, anno remissionis, in solemnitate tabernaculorum,
text_pt: E ordenou-lhes Moisés, dizendo: Ao fim de cada sete anos, no tempo determinado do ano da remissão, na festa dos tabernáculos,
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο αὐτοῖς Μωυσῆς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ λέγων μετὰ ἑπτὰ ἔτη ἐν καιρῷ ἐνιαυτοῦ ἀφέσεως ἐν ἑορτῇ σκηνοπηγίας

text_en: when all Israel come together, to appear in the sight of the Lord your God in the place which the Lord shall choose, you shall read the words of this law before all Israel , in their hearing.
text_la: convenientibus cunctis ex Israël, ut appareant in conspectu Domini Dei tui in loco quem elegerit Dominus, leges verba legis hujus coram omni Israël, audientibus eis,
text_pt: Quando todo o Israel vier a comparecer perante o Senhor teu Deus, no lugar que ele escolher, lerás esta lei diante de todo o Israel aos seus ouvidos.
text_el: ἐν τῷ συμπορεύεσθαι πάντα Ισραηλ ὀφθῆναι ἐνώπιον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου ἐν τῷ τόπῳ ᾧ ἂν ἐκλέξηται κύριος ἀναγνώσεσθε τὸν νόμον τοῦτον ἐναντίον παντὸς Ισραηλ εἰς τὰ ὦτα αὐτῶν

text_en: And the people being all assembled together, both men and women , children and strangers, that are within your gates: that hearing they may learn, and fear the Lord your God , and keep, and fulfil all the words of this law :
text_la: et in unum omni populo congregato, tam viris quam mulieribus, parvulis, et advenis, qui sunt intra portas tuas : ut audientes discant, et timeant Dominum Deum vestrum, et custodiant, impleantque omnes sermones legis hujus.
text_pt: Ajunta o povo, os homens e as mulheres, os meninos e os estrangeiros que estão dentro das tuas portas, para que ouçam e aprendam e temam ao Senhor vosso Deus, e tenham cuidado de fazer todas as palavras desta lei;
text_el: ἐκκλησιάσας τὸν λαόν τοὺς ἄνδρας καὶ τὰς γυναῖκας καὶ τὰ ἔκγονα καὶ τὸν προσήλυτον τὸν ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν ὑμῶν ἵνα ἀκούσωσιν καὶ ἵνα μάθωσιν φοβεῖσθαι κύριον τὸν θεὸν ὑμῶν καὶ ἀκούσονται ποιεῖν πάντας τοὺς λόγους τοῦ νόμου τούτου

text_en: That their children also, who now are ignorant , may hear, and fear the Lord their God , all the days that they live in the land whither you are going over the Jordan to possess it.
text_la: Filii quoque eorum qui nunc ignorant, ut audire possint, et timeant Dominum Deum suum cunctis diebus quibus versantur in terra, ad quam vos, Jordane transmisso, pergitis obtinendam.
text_pt: E que seus filhos, que não a souberem, ouçam e aprendam a temer ao Senhor vosso Deus, todos os dias que viverdes sobre a terra a qual ides, passando o Jordão, para a possuir.
text_el: καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν οἳ οὐκ οἴδασιν ἀκούσονται καὶ μαθήσονται φοβεῖσθαι κύριον τὸν θεὸν ὑμῶν πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ὅσας αὐτοὶ ζῶσιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς εἰς ἣν ὑμεῖς διαβαίνετε τὸν Ιορδάνην ἐκεῖ κληρονομῆσαι αὐτήν

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Behold the days of your death are near: call Joshua , and stand in the tabernacle of the testimony , that I may give him a charge. So Moses and Joshua went and stood in the tabernacle of the testimony :
text_la: Et ait Dominus ad Moysen : Ecce prope sunt dies mortis tuæ : voca Josue, et state in tabernaculo testimonii, ut præcipiam ei. Abierunt ergo Moyses et Josue, et steterunt in tabernaculo testimonii:
text_pt: E disse o Senhor a Moisés: Eis que os teus dias são chegados, para que morras; chama a Josué, e apresentai-vos na tenda da congregação, para que eu lhe dê ordens. Assim foram Moisés e Josué, e se apresentaram na tenda da congregação.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἰδοὺ ἠγγίκασιν αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ θανάτου σου κάλεσον Ἰησοῦν καὶ στῆτε παρὰ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ ἐντελοῦμαι αὐτῷ καὶ ἐπορεύθη Μωυσῆς καὶ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ ἔστησαν παρὰ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: And the Lord appeared there in the pillar of a cloud , which stood in the entry of the tabernacle .
text_la: apparuitque Dominus ibi in columna nubis, quæ stetit in introitu tabernaculi.
text_pt: Então o Senhor apareceu na tenda, na coluna de nuvem; e a coluna de nuvem estava sobre a porta da tenda.
text_el: καὶ κατέβη κύριος ἐν νεφέλῃ καὶ ἔστη παρὰ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ ἔστη ὁ στῦλος τῆς νεφέλης παρὰ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Behold you shall sleep with your fathers, and this people rising up will go a fornicating after strange gods in the land, to which it goes in to dwell: there will they forsake me, and will make void the covenant, which I have made with them,
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen : Ecce tu dormies cum patribus tuis, et populus iste consurgens fornicabitur post deos alienos in terra, ad quam ingreditur ut habitet in ea : ibi derelinquet me, et irritum faciet fœdus, quod pepigi cum eo.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor a Moisés: Eis que dormirás com teus pais; e este povo se levantará, e prostituir-se-á indo após os deuses estranhos na terra, para cujo meio vai, e me deixará, e anulará a minha aliança que tenho feito com ele.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἰδοὺ σὺ κοιμᾷ μετὰ τῶν πατέρων σου καὶ ἀναστὰς ὁ λαὸς οὗτος ἐκπορνεύσει ὀπίσω θεῶν ἀλλοτρίων τῆς γῆς εἰς ἣν οὗτος εἰσπορεύεται ἐκεῖ εἰς αὐτήν καὶ ἐγκαταλείψουσίν με καὶ διασκεδάσουσιν τὴν διαθήκην μου ἣν διεθέμην αὐτοῖς

text_en: and my wrath shall be kindled against them in that day: and I will forsake them, and will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured: all evils and afflictions shall find them, so that they shall say in that day: In truth it is because God is not with me, that these evils have found me.
text_la: Et irascetur furor meus contra eum in die illo : et derelinquam eum, et abscondam faciem meam ab eo, et erit in devorationem : invenient eum omnia mala et afflictiones, ita ut dicat in illo die : Vere quia non est Deus mecum, invenerunt me hæc mala.
text_pt: Assim se acenderá a minha ira naquele dia contra ele, e desampará-lo-ei, e esconderei o meu rosto dele, para que seja devorado; e tantos males e angústias o alcançarão, que dirá naquele dia: Não me alcançaram estes males, porque o meu Deus não está no meio de mim?
text_el: καὶ ὀργισθήσομαι θυμῷ εἰς αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καὶ καταλείψω αὐτοὺς καὶ ἀποστρέψω τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἀπ' αὐτῶν καὶ ἔσται κατάβρωμα καὶ εὑρήσουσιν αὐτὸν κακὰ πολλὰ καὶ θλίψεις καὶ ἐρεῖ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ διότι οὐκ ἔστιν κύριος ὁ θεός μου ἐν ἐμοί εὕροσάν με τὰ κακὰ ταῦτα

text_en: But I will hide, and cover my face in that day, for all the evils which they have done, because they have followed strange gods .
text_la: Ego autem abscondam, et celabo faciem meam in die illo propter omnia mala, quæ fecit, quia secutus est deos alienos.
text_pt: Esconderei, pois, totalmente o meu rosto naquele dia, por todo o mal que tiver feito, por se haverem tornado a outros deuses.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ἀποστροφῇ ἀποστρέψω τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἀπ' αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ διὰ πάσας τὰς κακίας ἃς ἐποίησαν ὅτι ἐπέστρεψαν ἐπὶ θεοὺς ἀλλοτρίους

text_en: Now therefore write you this canticle , and teach the children of Israel : that they may know it by heart, and sing it by mouth, and this song may be unto me for a testimony among the children of Israel .
text_la: Nunc itaque scribite vobis canticum istud, et docete filios Israël : ut memoriter teneant, et ore decantent, et sit mihi carmen istud pro testimonio inter filios Israël.
text_pt: Agora, pois, escrevei-vos este cântico, e ensinai-o aos filhos de Israel; ponde-o na sua boca, para que este cântico me seja por testemunha contra os filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ νῦν γράψατε τὰ ῥήματα τῆς ᾠδῆς ταύτης καὶ διδάξετε αὐτὴν τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐμβαλεῖτε αὐτὴν εἰς τὸ στόμα αὐτῶν ἵνα γένηταί μοι ἡ ᾠδὴ αὕτη εἰς μαρτύριον ἐν υἱοῖς Ισραηλ

text_en: For I will bring them into the land, for which I swore to their fathers, that flows with milk and honey. And when they have eaten, and are full and fat, they will turn away after strange gods , and will serve them: and will despise me, and make void my covenant.
text_la: Introducam enim eum in terram, pro qua juravi patribus ejus, lacte et melle manantem. Cumque comederint, et saturati, crassique fuerint, avertentur ad deos alienos, et servient eis : detrahentque mihi, et irritum facient pactum meum.
text_pt: Porque introduzirei o meu povo na terra que jurei a seus pais, que mana leite e mel; e comerá, e se fartará, e se engordará; então se tornará a outros deuses, e os servirá, e me irritarão, e anularão a minha aliança.
text_el: εἰσάξω γὰρ αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν γῆν τὴν ἀγαθήν ἣν ὤμοσα τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν δοῦναι αὐτοῖς γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι καὶ φάγονται καὶ ἐμπλησθέντες κορήσουσιν καὶ ἐπιστραφήσονται ἐπὶ θεοὺς ἀλλοτρίους καὶ λατρεύσουσιν αὐτοῖς καὶ παροξυνοῦσίν με καὶ διασκεδάσουσιν τὴν διαθήκην μου

text_en: And after many evils and afflictions shall have come upon them, this canticle shall answer them for a testimony, which no oblivion shall take away out of the mouth of their seed. For I know their thoughts, and what they are about to do this day, before that I bring them into the land which I have promised them.
text_la: Postquam invenerint eum mala multa et afflictiones, respondebit ei canticum istud pro testimonio, quod nulla delebit oblivio ex ore seminis sui. Scio enim cogitationes ejus, quæ facturus sit hodie, antequam introducam eum in terram, quam ei pollicitus sum.
text_pt: E será que, quando o alcançarem muitos males e angústias, então este cântico responderá contra ele por testemunha, pois não será esquecido da boca de sua descendência; porquanto conheço a sua imaginação, o que ele faz hoje, antes que o introduza na terra que tenho jurado.
text_el: καὶ ἀντικαταστήσεται ἡ ᾠδὴ αὕτη κατὰ πρόσωπον μαρτυροῦσα οὐ γὰρ μὴ ἐπιλησθῇ ἀπὸ στόματος αὐτῶν καὶ ἀπὸ στόματος τοῦ σπέρματος αὐτῶν ἐγὼ γὰρ οἶδα τὴν πονηρίαν αὐτῶν ὅσα ποιοῦσιν ὧδε σήμερον πρὸ τοῦ εἰσαγαγεῖν με αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν γῆν τὴν ἀγαθήν ἣν ὤμοσα τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν

text_en: Moses therefore wrote the canticle , and taught it to the children of Israel .
text_la: Scripsit ergo Moyses canticum, et docuit filios Israël.
text_pt: Assim Moisés escreveu este cântico naquele dia, e o ensinou aos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἔγραψεν Μωυσῆς τὴν ᾠδὴν ταύτην ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ καὶ ἐδίδαξεν αὐτὴν τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ

text_en: And the Lord commanded Joshua the son of Nun , and said: Take courage , and be valiant : for you shall bring the children of Israel into the land which I have promised , and I will be with you.
text_la: Præcepitque Dominus Josue filio Nun, et ait : Confortare, et esto robustus : tu enim introduces filios Israël in terram, quam pollicitus sum, et ego ero tecum.
text_pt: E ordenou a Josué, filho de Num, e disse: Esforça-te e anima-te; porque tu introduzirás os filhos de Israel na terra que lhes jurei; e eu serei contigo.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο Μωυσῆς Ἰησοῖ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ἀνδρίζου καὶ ἴσχυε σὺ γὰρ εἰσάξεις τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ὤμοσεν κύριος αὐτοῖς καὶ αὐτὸς ἔσται μετὰ σοῦ

text_en: Therefore after Moses had wrote the words of this law in a volume, and finished it:
text_la: Postquam ergo scripsit Moyses verba legis hujus in volumine, atque complevit,
text_pt: E aconteceu que, acabando Moisés de escrever num livro, todas as palavras desta lei,
text_el: ἡνίκα δὲ συνετέλεσεν Μωυσῆς γράφων πάντας τοὺς λόγους τοῦ νόμου τούτου εἰς βιβλίον ἕως εἰς τέλος

text_en: He commanded the Levites , who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord , saying:
text_la: præcepit Levitis, qui portabant arcam fœderis Domini, dicens:
text_pt: Deu ordem aos levitas, que levavam a arca da aliança do Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο τοῖς Λευίταις τοῖς αἴρουσιν τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου λέγων

text_en: Take this book, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God : that it may be there for a testimony against you.
text_la: Tollite librum istum, et ponite eum in latere arcæ fœderis Domini Dei vestri : ut sit ibi contra te in testimonium.
text_pt: Tomai este livro da lei, e ponde-o ao lado da arca da aliança do Senhor vosso Deus, para que ali esteja por testemunha contra ti.
text_el: λαβόντες τὸ βιβλίον τοῦ νόμου τούτου θήσετε αὐτὸ ἐκ πλαγίων τῆς κιβωτοῦ τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν καὶ ἔσται ἐκεῖ ἐν σοὶ εἰς μαρτύριον

text_en: For I know your obstinacy, and your most stiff neck. While I am yet living, and going in with you, you have always been rebellious against the Lord : how much more when I shall be dead?
text_la: Ego enim scio contentionem tuam, et cervicem tuam durissimam. Adhuc vivente me et ingrediente vobiscum, semper contentiose egistis contra Dominum : quanto magis cum mortuus fuero?
text_pt: Porque conheço a tua rebelião e a tua dura cerviz; eis que, vivendo eu ainda hoje convosco, rebeldes fostes contra o Senhor; e quanto mais depois da minha morte?
text_el: ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐπίσταμαι τὸν ἐρεθισμόν σου καὶ τὸν τράχηλόν σου τὸν σκληρόν ἔτι γὰρ ἐμοῦ ζῶντος μεθ' ὑμῶν σήμερον παραπικραίνοντες ἦτε τὰ πρὸς τὸν θεόν πῶς οὐχὶ καὶ ἔσχατον τοῦ θανάτου μου

text_en: Gather unto me all the ancients of your tribes , and your doctors, and I will speak these words in their hearing, and will call heaven and earth to witness against them.
text_la: Congregate ad me omnes majores natu per tribus vestras, atque doctores, et loquar audientibus eis sermones istos, et invocabo contra eos cælum et terram.
text_pt: Ajuntai perante mim todos os anciãos das vossas tribos, e vossos oficiais, e aos seus ouvidos falarei estas palavras, e contra eles por testemunhas tomarei o céu e a terra.
text_el: ἐκκλησιάσατε πρός με τοὺς φυλάρχους ὑμῶν καὶ τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους ὑμῶν καὶ τοὺς κριτὰς ὑμῶν καὶ τοὺς γραμματοεισαγωγεῖς ὑμῶν ἵνα λαλήσω εἰς τὰ ὦτα αὐτῶν πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους καὶ διαμαρτύρωμαι αὐτοῖς τόν τε οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: For I know that, after my death, you will do wickedly , and will quickly turn aside form the way that I have commanded you: and evils shall come upon you in the latter times, when you shall do evil in the sight of the Lord , to provoke him by the works of your hands.
text_la: Novi enim quod post mortem meam inique agetis, et declinabitis cito de via, quam præcepi vobis : et occurrent vobis mala in extremo tempore, quando feceritis malum in conspectu Domini, ut irritetis eum per opera manuum vestrarum.
text_pt: Porque eu sei que depois da minha morte certamente vos corrompereis, e vos desviareis do caminho que vos ordenei; então este mal vos alcançará nos últimos dias, quando fizerdes mal aos olhos do Senhor, para o provocar à ira com a obra das vossas mãos.
text_el: οἶδα γὰρ ὅτι ἔσχατον τῆς τελευτῆς μου ἀνομίᾳ ἀνομήσετε καὶ ἐκκλινεῖτε ἐκ τῆς ὁδοῦ ἧς ἐνετειλάμην ὑμῖν καὶ συναντήσεται ὑμῖν τὰ κακὰ ἔσχατον τῶν ἡμερῶν ὅτι ποιήσετε τὸ πονηρὸν ἐναντίον κυρίου παροργίσαι αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις τῶν χειρῶν ὑμῶν

text_en: Moses therefore spoke, in the hearing of the whole assembly of Israel , the words of this canticle , and finished it even to the end.
text_la: Locutus est ergo Moyses, audiente universo cœtu Israël, verba carminis hujus, et ad finem usque complevit.
text_pt: Então Moisés falou as palavras deste cântico aos ouvidos de toda a congregação de Israel, até se acabarem.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Μωυσῆς εἰς τὰ ὦτα πάσης ἐκκλησίας Ισραηλ τὰ ῥήματα τῆς ᾠδῆς ταύτης ἕως εἰς τέλος

text_en: Hear, O you heavens , the things I speak, let the earth give ear to the words of my mouth.
text_la: Audite, cæli, quæ loquor : audiat terra verba oris mei.
text_pt: Inclinai os ouvidos, ó céus, e falarei; e ouça a terra as palavras da minha boca.
text_el: πρόσεχε οὐρανέ καὶ λαλήσω καὶ ἀκουέτω γῆ ῥήματα ἐκ στόματός μου

text_en: Let my doctrine gather as the rain, let my speech distil as the dew, as a shower upon the herb, and as drops upon the grass.
text_la: Concrescat ut pluvia doctrina mea, fluat ut ros eloquium meum, quasi imber super herbam, et quasi stillæ super gramina.
text_pt: Goteje a minha doutrina como a chuva, destile a minha palavra como o orvalho, como chuvisco sobre a erva e como gotas de água sobre a relva.
text_el: προσδοκάσθω ὡς ὑετὸς τὸ ἀπόφθεγμά μου καὶ καταβήτω ὡς δρόσος τὰ ῥήματά μου ὡσεὶ ὄμβρος ἐπ' ἄγρωστιν καὶ ὡσεὶ νιφετὸς ἐπὶ χόρτον

text_en: Because I will invoke the name of the Lord : give magnificence to our God .
text_la: Quia nomen Domini invocabo : date magnificentiam Deo nostro.
text_pt: Porque apregoarei o nome do Senhor; engrandecei a nosso Deus.
text_el: ὅτι ὄνομα κυρίου ἐκάλεσα δότε μεγαλωσύνην τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν

text_en: The works of God are perfect, and all his ways are judgments: God is faithful and without any iniquity , he is just and right.
text_la: Dei perfecta sunt opera, et omnes viæ ejus judicia : Deus fidelis, et absque ulla iniquitate, justus et rectus.
text_pt: Ele é a Rocha, cuja obra é perfeita, porque todos os seus caminhos justos são; Deus é a verdade, e não há nele injustiça; justo e reto é.
text_el: θεός ἀληθινὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ ὁδοὶ αὐτοῦ κρίσεις θεὸς πιστός καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἀδικία δίκαιος καὶ ὅσιος κύριος

text_en: They have sinned against him, and are none of his children in their filth: they are a wicked and perverse generation .
text_la: Peccaverunt ei, et non filii ejus in sordibus : generatio prava atque perversa.
text_pt: Corromperam-se contra ele; não são seus filhos, mas a sua mancha; geração perversa e distorcida é.
text_el: ἡμάρτοσαν οὐκ αὐτῷ τέκνα μωμητά γενεὰ σκολιὰ καὶ διεστραμμένη

text_en: Is this the return you make to the Lord , O foolish and senseless people? Is not he your father, that has possessed you, and made you, and created you?
text_la: Hæccine reddis Domino, popule stulte et insipiens? numquid non ipse est pater tuus, qui possedit te, et fecit, et creavit te?
text_pt: Recompensais assim ao Senhor, povo louco e ignorante? Não é ele teu pai que te adquiriu, te fez e te estabeleceu?
text_el: ταῦτα κυρίῳ ἀνταποδίδοτε οὕτω λαὸς μωρὸς καὶ οὐχὶ σοφός οὐκ αὐτὸς οὗτός σου πατὴρ ἐκτήσατό σε καὶ ἐποίησέν σε καὶ ἔκτισέν σε

text_en: Remember the days of old, think upon every generation : ask your father, and he will declare to you: your elders and they will tell you.
text_la: Memento dierum antiquorum, cogita generationes singulas : interroga patrem tuum, et annuntiabit tibi : majores tuos, et dicent tibi.
text_pt: Lembra-te dos dias da antiguidade, atenta para os anos de muitas gerações: pergunta a teu pai, e ele te informará; aos teus anciãos, e eles te dirão.
text_el: μνήσθητε ἡμέρας αἰῶνος σύνετε ἔτη γενεᾶς γενεῶν ἐπερώτησον τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ σοι τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους σου καὶ ἐροῦσίν σοι

text_en: When the Most High divided the nations : when he separated the sons of Adam , he appointed the bounds of people according to the number of the children of Israel .
text_la: Quando dividebat Altissimus gentes, quando separabat filios Adam, constituit terminos populorum juxta numerum filiorum Israël.
text_pt: Quando o Altíssimo distribuía as heranças às nações, quando dividia os filhos de Adão uns dos outros, estabeleceu os termos dos povos, conforme o número dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: ὅτε διεμέριζεν ὁ ὕψιστος ἔθνη ὡς διέσπειρεν υἱοὺς Αδαμ ἔστησεν ὅρια ἐθνῶν κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ἀγγέλων θεοῦ

text_en: But the Lord's portion is his people: Jacob the lot of his inheritance.
text_la: Pars autem Domini, populus ejus : Jacob funiculus hæreditatis ejus.
text_pt: Porque a porção do Senhor é o seu povo; Jacó é a parte da sua herança.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη μερὶς κυρίου λαὸς αὐτοῦ Ιακωβ σχοίνισμα κληρονομίας αὐτοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: He found him in a desert land, in a place of horror, and of vast wilderness : he led him about, and taught him: and he kept him as the apple of his eye.
text_la: Invenit eum in terra deserta, in loco horroris, et vastæ solitudinis : circumduxit eum, et docuit : et custodivit quasi pupillam oculi sui.
text_pt: Achou-o numa terra deserta, e num ermo solitário cheio de uivos; cercou-o, instruiu-o, e guardou-o como a menina do seu olho.
text_el: αὐτάρκησεν αὐτὸν ἐν γῇ ἐρήμῳ ἐν δίψει καύματος ἐν ἀνύδρῳ ἐκύκλωσεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐπαίδευσεν αὐτὸν καὶ διεφύλαξεν αὐτὸν ὡς κόραν ὀφθαλμοῦ

text_en: As the eagle enticing her young to fly, and hovering over them, he spread his wings, and has taken him and carried him on his shoulders.
text_la: Sicut aquila provocans ad volandum pullos suos, et super eos volitans, expandit alas suas, et assumpsit eum, atque portavit in humeris suis.
text_pt: Como a águia desperta a sua ninhada, move-se sobre os seus filhos, estende as suas asas, toma-os, e os leva sobre as suas asas,
text_el: ὡς ἀετὸς σκεπάσαι νοσσιὰν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τοῖς νεοσσοῖς αὐτοῦ ἐπεπόθησεν διεὶς τὰς πτέρυγας αὐτοῦ ἐδέξατο αὐτοὺς καὶ ἀνέλαβεν αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ τῶν μεταφρένων αὐτοῦ

text_en: The Lord alone was his leader: and there was no strange god with him.
text_la: Dominus solus dux ejus fuit, et non erat cum eo deus alienus :
text_pt: Assim só o Senhor o guiou; e não havia com ele deus estranho.
text_el: κύριος μόνος ἦγεν αὐτούς καὶ οὐκ ἦν μετ' αὐτῶν θεὸς ἀλλότριος

text_en: He set him upon high land: that he might eat the fruits of the fields, that he might suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the hardest stone,
text_la: constituit eum super excelsam terram, ut comederet fructus agrorum : ut sugeret mel de petra, oleumque de saxo durissimo;
text_pt: Ele o fez cavalgar sobre as alturas da terra, e comer os frutos do campo, e o fez chupar mel da rocha e azeite da dura pederneira.
text_el: ἀνεβίβασεν αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ τὴν ἰσχὺν τῆς γῆς ἐψώμισεν αὐτοὺς γενήματα ἀγρῶν ἐθήλασαν μέλι ἐκ πέτρας καὶ ἔλαιον ἐκ στερεᾶς πέτρας

text_en: butter of the herd, and milk of the sheep with the fat of lambs, and of the rams of the breed of Basan: and goats with the marrow of wheat, and might drink the purest blood of the grape.
text_la: butyrum de armento, et lac de ovibus cum adipe agnorum, et arietum filiorum Basan : et hircos cum medulla tritici, et sanguinem uvæ biberet meracissimum.
text_pt: Manteiga de vacas, e leite de ovelhas, com a gordura dos cordeiros e dos carneiros que pastam em Basã, e dos bodes, com o mais escolhido trigo; e bebeste o sangue das uvas, o vinho puro.
text_el: βούτυρον βοῶν καὶ γάλα προβάτων μετὰ στέατος ἀρνῶν καὶ κριῶν υἱῶν ταύρων καὶ τράγων μετὰ στέατος νεφρῶν πυροῦ καὶ αἷμα σταφυλῆς ἔπιον οἶνον

text_en: The beloved grew fat, and kicked: he grew fat, and thick and gross, he forsook God who made him, and departed from God his saviour.
text_la: Incrassatus est dilectus, et recalcitravit : incrassatus, impinguatus, dilatatus, dereliquit Deum factorem suum, et recessit a Deo salutari suo.
text_pt: E, engordando-se Jesurum, deu coices (engordaste-te, engrossaste-te, e de gordura te cobriste) e deixou a Deus, que o fez, e desprezou a Rocha da sua salvação.
text_el: καὶ ἔφαγεν Ιακωβ καὶ ἐνεπλήσθη καὶ ἀπελάκτισεν ὁ ἠγαπημένος ἐλιπάνθη ἐπαχύνθη ἐπλατύνθη καὶ ἐγκατέλιπεν θεὸν τὸν ποιήσαντα αὐτὸν καὶ ἀπέστη ἀπὸ θεοῦ σωτῆρος αὐτοῦ

text_en: They provoked him by strange gods , and stirred him up to anger , with their abominations.
text_la: Provocaverunt eum in diis alienis, et in abominationibus ad iracundiam concitaverunt.
text_pt: Com deuses estranhos o provocaram a zelos; com abominações o irritaram.
text_el: παρώξυνάν με ἐπ' ἀλλοτρίοις ἐν βδελύγμασιν αὐτῶν ἐξεπίκρανάν με

text_en: They sacrificed to devils and not to God : to gods whom they knew not: that were newly come up, whom their fathers worshipped not.
text_la: Immolaverunt dæmoniis et non Deo, diis quos ignorabant : novi recentesque venerunt, quos non coluerunt patres eorum :
text_pt: Sacrifícios ofereceram aos demônios, não a Deus; aos deuses que não conheceram, novos deuses que vieram há pouco, aos quais não temeram vossos pais.
text_el: ἔθυσαν δαιμονίοις καὶ οὐ θεῷ θεοῖς οἷς οὐκ ᾔδεισαν καινοὶ πρόσφατοι ἥκασιν οὓς οὐκ ᾔδεισαν οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν

text_en: You have forsaken the God that begot you, and have forgotten the Lord that created you.
text_la: Deum qui te genuit dereliquisti, et oblitus es Domini creatoris tui.
text_pt: Esqueceste-te da Rocha que te gerou; e em esquecimento puseste o Deus que te formou;
text_el: θεὸν τὸν γεννήσαντά σε ἐγκατέλιπες καὶ ἐπελάθου θεοῦ τοῦ τρέφοντός σε

text_en: The Lord saw, and was moved to wrath : because his own sons and daughters provoked him.
text_la: Vidit Dominus, et ad iracundiam concitatus est : quia provocaverunt eum filii sui et filiæ.
text_pt: O que vendo o Senhor, os desprezou, por ter sido provocado à ira contra seus filhos e suas filhas;
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν κύριος καὶ ἐζήλωσεν καὶ παρωξύνθη δι' ὀργὴν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ θυγατέρων

text_en: And he said: I will hide my face from them, and will consider what their last end shall be: for it is a perverse generation , and unfaithful children.
text_la: Et ait : Abscondam faciem meam ab eis, et considerabo novissima eorum : generatio enim perversa est, et infideles filii.
text_pt: E disse: Esconderei o meu rosto deles, verei qual será o seu fim; porque são geração perversa, filhos em quem não há lealdade.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἀποστρέψω τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἀπ' αὐτῶν καὶ δείξω τί ἔσται αὐτοῖς ἐπ' ἐσχάτων ὅτι γενεὰ ἐξεστραμμένη ἐστίν υἱοί οἷς οὐκ ἔστιν πίστις ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: They have provoked me with that which was no god , and have angered me with their vanities: and I will provoke them with that which is no people, and will vex them with a foolish nation.
text_la: Ipsi me provocaverunt in eo qui non erat Deus, et irritaverunt in vanitatibus suis : et ego provocabo eos in eo qui non est populus, et in gente stulta irritabo illos.
text_pt: A zelos me provocaram com aquilo que não é Deus; com as suas vaidades me provocaram à ira: portanto eu os provocarei a zelos com o que não é povo; com nação louca os despertarei à ira.
text_el: αὐτοὶ παρεζήλωσάν με ἐπ' οὐ θεῷ παρώργισάν με ἐν τοῖς εἰδώλοις αὐτῶν κἀγὼ παραζηλώσω αὐτοὺς ἐπ' οὐκ ἔθνει ἐπ' ἔθνει ἀσυνέτῳ παροργιῶ αὐτούς

text_en: A fire is kindled in my wrath , and shall burn even to the lowest hell : and shall devour the earth with her increase, and shall burn the foundations of the mountains.
text_la: Ignis succensus est in furore meo, et ardebit usque ad inferni novissima : devorabitque terram cum germine suo, et montium fundamenta comburet.
text_pt: Porque um fogo se acendeu na minha ira, e arderá até ao mais profundo do inferno, e consumirá a terra com a sua colheita, e abrasará os fundamentos dos montes.
text_el: ὅτι πῦρ ἐκκέκαυται ἐκ τοῦ θυμοῦ μου καυθήσεται ἕως ᾅδου κάτω καταφάγεται γῆν καὶ τὰ γενήματα αὐτῆς φλέξει θεμέλια ὀρέων

text_en: I will heap evils upon them, and will spend my arrows among them.
text_la: Congregabo super eos mala, et sagittas meas complebo in eis.
text_pt: Males amontoarei sobre eles; as minhas setas esgotarei contra eles.
text_el: συνάξω εἰς αὐτοὺς κακὰ καὶ τὰ βέλη μου συντελέσω εἰς αὐτούς

text_en: They shall be consumed with famine, and birds shall devour them with a most bitter bite: I will send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the fury of creatures that trail upon the ground, and of serpents.
text_la: Consumentur fame, et devorabunt eos aves morsu amarissimo : dentes bestiarum immittam in eos, cum furore trahentium super terram, atque serpentium.
text_pt: Consumidos serão de fome, comidos pela febre ardente e de peste amarga; e contra eles enviarei dentes de feras, com ardente veneno de serpentes do pó.
text_el: τηκόμενοι λιμῷ καὶ βρώσει ὀρνέων καὶ ὀπισθότονος ἀνίατος ὀδόντας θηρίων ἀποστελῶ εἰς αὐτοὺς μετὰ θυμοῦ συρόντων ἐπὶ γῆς

text_en: Without, the sword shall lay them waste, and terror within, both the young man and the virgin , the sucking child with the man in years.
text_la: Foris vastabit eos gladius, et intus pavor, juvenem simul ac virginem, lactentem cum homine sene.
text_pt: Por fora devastará a espada, e por dentro o pavor; ao jovem, juntamente com a virgem, assim à criança de peito como ao homem encanecido.
text_el: ἔξωθεν ἀτεκνώσει αὐτοὺς μάχαιρα καὶ ἐκ τῶν ταμιείων φόβος νεανίσκος σὺν παρθένῳ θηλάζων μετὰ καθεστηκότος πρεσβύτου

text_en: I said: Where are they? I will make the memory of them to cease from among men .
text_la: Dixi : Ubinam sunt? cessare faciam ex hominibus memoriam eorum.
text_pt: Eu disse: Por todos os cantos os espalharei; farei cessar a sua memória dentre os homens,
text_el: εἶπα διασπερῶ αὐτούς παύσω δὴ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων τὸ μνημόσυνον αὐτῶν

text_en: But for the wrath of the enemies I have deferred it: lest perhaps their enemies might be proud , and should say: Our mighty hand, and not the Lord , has done all these things.
text_la: Sed propter iram inimicorum distuli : ne forte superbirent hostes eorum, et dicerent : Manus nostra excelsa, et non Dominus, fecit hæc omnia.
text_pt: Se eu não receasse a ira do inimigo, para que os seus adversários não se iludam, e para que não digam: A nossa mão está exaltada; o Senhor não fez tudo isto.
text_el: εἰ μὴ δι' ὀργὴν ἐχθρῶν ἵνα μὴ μακροχρονίσωσιν καὶ ἵνα μὴ συνεπιθῶνται οἱ ὑπεναντίοι μὴ εἴπωσιν ἡ χεὶρ ἡμῶν ἡ ὑψηλὴ καὶ οὐχὶ κύριος ἐποίησεν ταῦτα πάντα

text_en: They are a nation without counsel, and without wisdom.
text_la: Gens absque consilio est, et sine prudentia.
text_pt: Porque são gente falta de conselhos, e neles não há entendimento.
text_el: ὅτι ἔθνος ἀπολωλεκὸς βουλήν ἐστιν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐπιστήμη

text_en: O that they would be wise and would understand, and would provide for their last end.
text_la: Utinam saperent, et intelligerent, ac novissima providerent.
text_pt: Quem dera eles fossem sábios! Que isto entendessem, e atentassem para o seu fim!
text_el: οὐκ ἐφρόνησαν συνιέναι ταῦτα καταδεξάσθωσαν εἰς τὸν ἐπιόντα χρόνον

text_en: How should one pursue after a thousand, and two chase ten thousand? Was it not, because their God had sold them, and the Lord had shut them up?
text_la: Quomodo persequatur unus mille, et duo fugent decem millia? nonne ideo, quia Deus suus vendidit eos, et Dominus conclusit illos?
text_pt: Como poderia ser que um só perseguisse mil, e dois fizessem fugir dez mil, se a sua Rocha os não vendera, e o Senhor os não entregara?
text_el: πῶς διώξεται εἷς χιλίους καὶ δύο μετακινήσουσιν μυριάδας εἰ μὴ ὁ θεὸς ἀπέδοτο αὐτοὺς καὶ κύριος παρέδωκεν αὐτούς

text_en: For our God is not as their gods : our enemies themselves are judges.
text_la: Non enim est Deus noster ut dii eorum : et inimici nostri sunt judices.
text_pt: Porque a sua rocha não é como a nossa Rocha, sendo até os nossos inimigos juízes disto.
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ὡς ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν οἱ θεοὶ αὐτῶν οἱ δὲ ἐχθροὶ ἡμῶν ἀνόητοι

text_en: Their vines are of the vineyard of Sodom , and of the suburbs of Gomorrha : their grapes are grapes of gall, and their clusters most bitter.
text_la: De vinea Sodomorum, vinea eorum, et de suburbanis Gomorrhæ : uva eorum, uva fellis, et botri amarissimi.
text_pt: Porque a sua vinha é a vinha de Sodoma e dos campos de Gomorra; as suas uvas são uvas venenosas, cachos amargos têm.
text_el: ἐκ γὰρ ἀμπέλου Σοδομων ἡ ἄμπελος αὐτῶν καὶ ἡ κληματὶς αὐτῶν ἐκ Γομορρας ἡ σταφυλὴ αὐτῶν σταφυλὴ χολῆς βότρυς πικρίας αὐτοῖς

text_en: Their wine is the gall of dragons, and the venom of asps, which is incurable.
text_la: Fel draconum vinum eorum, et venenum aspidum insanabile.
text_pt: O seu vinho é ardente veneno de serpentes, e peçonha cruel de víboras.
text_el: θυμὸς δρακόντων ὁ οἶνος αὐτῶν καὶ θυμὸς ἀσπίδων ἀνίατος

text_en: Are not these things stored up with me, and sealed up in my treasures?
text_la: Nonne hæc condita sunt apud me, et signata in thesauris meis?
text_pt: Não está isto guardado comigo? Selado nos meus tesouros?
text_el: οὐκ ἰδοὺ ταῦτα συνῆκται παρ' ἐμοὶ καὶ ἐσφράγισται ἐν τοῖς θησαυροῖς μου

text_en: Revenge is mine, and I will repay them in due time, that their foot may slide: the day of destruction is at hand, and the time makes haste to come.
text_la: Mea est ultio, et ego retribuam in tempore, ut labatur pes eorum : juxta est dies perditionis, et adesse festinant tempora.
text_pt: Minha é a vingança e a recompensa, ao tempo que resvalar o seu pé; porque o dia da sua ruína está próximo, e as coisas que lhes hão de suceder, se apressam a chegar.
text_el: ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἐκδικήσεως ἀνταποδώσω ἐν καιρῷ ὅταν σφαλῇ ὁ ποὺς αὐτῶν ὅτι ἐγγὺς ἡμέρα ἀπωλείας αὐτῶν καὶ πάρεστιν ἕτοιμα ὑμῖν

text_en: The Lord will judge his people, and will have mercy on his servants: he shall see that their hand is weakened, and that they who were shut up have also failed, and they that remained are consumed.
text_la: Judicabit Dominus populum suum, et in servis suis miserebitur : videbit quod infirmata sit manus, et clausi quoque defecerunt, residuique consumpti sunt.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor fará justiça ao seu povo, e se compadecerá de seus servos; quando vir que o poder deles se foi, e não há preso nem desamparado.
text_el: ὅτι κρινεῖ κύριος τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ παρακληθήσεται εἶδεν γὰρ παραλελυμένους αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐκλελοιπότας ἐν ἐπαγωγῇ καὶ παρειμένους

text_en: And he shall say: Where are their gods , in whom they trusted?
text_la: Et dicet : Ubi sunt dii eorum, in quibus habebant fiduciam?
text_pt: Então dirá: Onde estão os seus deuses? A rocha em quem confiavam,
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος ποῦ εἰσιν οἱ θεοὶ αὐτῶν ἐφ' οἷς ἐπεποίθεισαν ἐπ' αὐτοῖς

text_en: Of whose victims they ate the fat, and drank the wine of their drink offerings : let them arise and help you, and protect you in your distress.
text_la: de quorum victimis comedebant adipes, et bibebant vinum libaminum : surgant, et opitulentur vobis, et in necessitate vos protegant.
text_pt: De cujos sacrifícios comiam a gordura, e de cujas libações bebiam o vinho? Levantem-se, e vos ajudem, para que haja para vós esconderijo.
text_el: ὧν τὸ στέαρ τῶν θυσιῶν αὐτῶν ἠσθίετε καὶ ἐπίνετε τὸν οἶνον τῶν σπονδῶν αὐτῶν ἀναστήτωσαν καὶ βοηθησάτωσαν ὑμῖν καὶ γενηθήτωσαν ὑμῖν σκεπασταί

text_en: See that I alone am, and there is no other God besides me: I will kill and I will make to live: I will strike, and I will heal, and there is none that can deliver out of my hand.
text_la: Videte quod ego sim solus, et non sit alius deus præter me : ego occidam, et ego vivere faciam : percutiam, et ego sanabo, et non est qui de manu mea possit eruere.
text_pt: Vede agora que eu, eu o sou, e mais nenhum deus há além de mim; eu mato, e eu faço viver; eu firo, e eu saro, e ninguém há que escape da minha mão.
text_el: ἴδετε ἴδετε ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν θεὸς πλὴν ἐμοῦ ἐγὼ ἀποκτενῶ καὶ ζῆν ποιήσω πατάξω κἀγὼ ἰάσομαι καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὃς ἐξελεῖται ἐκ τῶν χειρῶν μου

text_en: I will lift up my hand to heaven , and I will say: I live for ever.
text_la: Levabo ad cælum manum meam, et dicam : Vivo ego in æternum.
text_pt: Porque levantarei a minha mão aos céus, e direi: Eu vivo para sempre.
text_el: ὅτι ἀρῶ εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν τὴν χεῖρά μου καὶ ὀμοῦμαι τῇ δεξιᾷ μου καὶ ἐρῶ ζῶ ἐγὼ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: If I shall whet my sword as the lightning, and my hand take hold on judgment: I will render vengeance to my enemies, and repay them that hate me.
text_la: Si acuero ut fulgur gladium meum, et arripuerit judicium manus mea : reddam ultionem hostibus meis, et his qui oderunt me retribuam.
text_pt: Se eu afiar a minha espada reluzente, e se a minha mão travar o juízo, retribuirei a vingança sobre os meus adversários, e recompensarei aos que me odeiam.
text_el: ὅτι παροξυνῶ ὡς ἀστραπὴν τὴν μάχαιράν μου καὶ ἀνθέξεται κρίματος ἡ χείρ μου καὶ ἀνταποδώσω δίκην τοῖς ἐχθροῖς καὶ τοῖς μισοῦσίν με ἀνταποδώσω

text_en: I will make my arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh, of the blood of the slain and of the captivity , of the bare head of the enemies.
text_la: Inebriabo sagittas meas sanguine, et gladius meus devorabit carnes; de cruore occisorum, et de captivitate, nudati inimicorum capitis.
text_pt: Embriagarei as minhas setas de sangue, e a minha espada comerá carne; do sangue dos mortos e dos prisioneiros, desde a cabeça, haverá vinganças do inimigo.
text_el: μεθύσω τὰ βέλη μου ἀφ' αἵματος καὶ ἡ μάχαιρά μου καταφάγεται κρέα ἀφ' αἵματος τραυματιῶν καὶ αἰχμαλωσίας ἀπὸ κεφαλῆς ἀρχόντων ἐχθρῶν

text_en: Praise his people, you nations, for he will revenge the blood of his servants: and will render vengeance to their enemies, and he will be merciful to the land of his people.
text_la: Laudate, gentes, populum ejus, quia sanguinem servorum suorum ulciscetur : et vindictam retribuet in hostes eorum, et propitius erit terræ populi sui.
text_pt: Jubilai, ó nações, o seu povo, porque ele vingará o sangue dos seus servos, e sobre os seus adversários retribuirá a vingança, e terá misericórdia da sua terra e do seu povo.
text_el: εὐφράνθητε οὐρανοί ἅμα αὐτῷ καὶ προσκυνησάτωσαν αὐτῷ πάντες υἱοὶ θεοῦ εὐφράνθητε ἔθνη μετὰ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐνισχυσάτωσαν αὐτῷ πάντες ἄγγελοι θεοῦ ὅτι τὸ αἷμα τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ ἐκδικᾶται καὶ ἐκδικήσει καὶ ἀνταποδώσει δίκην τοῖς ἐχθροῖς καὶ τοῖς μισοῦσιν ἀνταποδώσει καὶ ἐκκαθαριεῖ κύριος τὴν γῆν τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: So Moses came and spoke all the words of this canticle in the ears of the people, and Joshua the son of Nun .
text_la: Venit ergo Moyses, et locutus est omnia verba cantici hujus in auribus populi, ipse et Josue filius Nun.
text_pt: E veio Moisés, e falou todas as palavras deste cântico aos ouvidos do povo, ele e Josué, filho de Num.
text_el: καὶ ἔγραψεν Μωυσῆς τὴν ᾠδὴν ταύτην ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ καὶ ἐδίδαξεν αὐτὴν τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Μωυσῆς καὶ ἐλάλησεν πάντας τοὺς λόγους τοῦ νόμου τούτου εἰς τὰ ὦτα τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτὸς καὶ Ἰησοῦς ὁ τοῦ Ναυη

text_en: And he ended all these words, speaking to all Israel .
text_la: Complevitque omnes sermones istos, loquens ad universum Israël,
text_pt: E, acabando Moisés de falar todas estas palavras a todo o Israel,
text_el: καὶ συνετέλεσεν Μωυσῆς λαλῶν παντὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: And he said to them: Set your hearts on all the words, which I testify to you this day: which you shall command your children to observe and to do, and to fulfil all that is written in this law :
text_la: et dixit ad eos : Ponite corda vestra in omnia verba, quæ ego testificor vobis hodie : ut mandetis ea filiis vestris custodire et facere, et implere universa quæ scripta sunt legis hujus:
text_pt: Disse-lhes: Aplicai o vosso coração a todas as palavras que hoje testifico entre vós, para que as recomendeis a vossos filhos, para que tenham cuidado de cumprir todas as palavras desta lei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς προσέχετε τῇ καρδίᾳ ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους οὓς ἐγὼ διαμαρτύρομαι ὑμῖν σήμερον ἃ ἐντελεῖσθε τοῖς υἱοῖς ὑμῶν φυλάσσειν καὶ ποιεῖν πάντας τοὺς λόγους τοῦ νόμου τούτου

text_en: For they are not commanded you in vain, but that every one should live in them, and that doing them you may continue a long time in the land whither you are going over the Jordan to possess it.
text_la: quia non incassum præcepta sunt vobis, sed ut singuli in eis viverent : quæ facientes longo perseveretis tempore in terra, ad quam, Jordane transmisso, ingredimini possidendam.
text_pt: Porque esta palavra não vos é vã, antes é a vossa vida; e por esta mesma palavra prolongareis os dias na terra a qual, passando o Jordão, ides a possuir.
text_el: ὅτι οὐχὶ λόγος κενὸς οὗτος ὑμῖν ὅτι αὕτη ἡ ζωὴ ὑμῶν καὶ ἕνεκεν τοῦ λόγου τούτου μακροημερεύσετε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς εἰς ἣν ὑμεῖς διαβαίνετε τὸν Ιορδάνην ἐκεῖ κληρονομῆσαι αὐτήν

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses the same day, saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen in eadem die, dicens:
text_pt: Depois falou o Senhor a Moisés, naquele mesmo dia, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ λέγων

text_en: Go up into this mountain Abarim , (that is to say, of passages), unto mount Nebo , which is in the land of Moab over against Jericho : and see the land of Chanaan , which I will deliver to the children of Israel to possess, and die thou in the mountain.
text_la: Ascende in montem istum Abarim, id est, transitum, in montem Nebo, qui est in terra Moab contra Jericho : et vide terram Chanaan, quam ego tradam filiis Israël obtinendam, et morere in monte.
text_pt: Sobe ao monte de Abarim, ao monte Nebo, que está na terra de Moabe, defronte de Jericó, e vê a terra de Canaã, que darei aos filhos de Israel por possessão.
text_el: ἀνάβηθι εἰς τὸ ὄρος τὸ Αβαριν τοῦτο ὄρος Ναβαυ ὅ ἐστιν ἐν γῇ Μωαβ κατὰ πρόσωπον Ιεριχω καὶ ἰδὲ τὴν γῆν Χανααν ἣν ἐγὼ δίδωμι τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ εἰς κατάσχεσιν

text_en: When you have gone up into it you shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered to his people :
text_la: Quem conscendens jungeris populis tuis, sicut mortuus est Aaron frater tuus in monte Hor, et appositus populis suis:
text_pt: E morre no monte ao qual subirás; e recolhe-te ao teu povo, como Arão teu irmão morreu no monte Hor, e se recolheu ao seu povo.
text_el: καὶ τελεύτα ἐν τῷ ὄρει εἰς ὃ ἀναβαίνεις ἐκεῖ καὶ προστέθητι πρὸς τὸν λαόν σου ὃν τρόπον ἀπέθανεν Ααρων ὁ ἀδελφός σου ἐν Ωρ τῷ ὄρει καὶ προσετέθη πρὸς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Because you trespassed against me in the midst of the children of Israel , at the waters of contradiction, in Cades of the desert of Sin: and you did not sanctify me among the children of Israel .
text_la: quia prævaricati estis contra me in medio filiorum Israël ad aquas contradictionis in Cades deserti Sin: et non sanctificastis me inter filios Israël.
text_pt: Porquanto transgredistes contra mim no meio dos filhos de Israel, às águas de Meribá de Cades, no deserto de Zim; pois não me santificastes no meio dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: διότι ἠπειθήσατε τῷ ῥήματί μου ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ἐπὶ τοῦ ὕδατος ἀντιλογίας Καδης ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Σιν διότι οὐχ ἡγιάσατέ με ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ

text_en: You shall see the land before you, which I will give to the children of Israel , but you shall not enter into it.
text_la: E contra videbis terram, et non ingredieris in eam, quam ego dabo filiis Israël.
text_pt: Pelo que verás a terra diante de ti, porém não entrarás nela, na terra que darei aos filhos de Israel.
text_el: ὅτι ἀπέναντι ὄψῃ τὴν γῆν καὶ ἐκεῖ οὐκ εἰσελεύσῃ

text_en: This is the blessing , wherewith the man of God , Moses , blessed the children of Israel , before his death.
text_la: Hæc est benedictio, qua benedixit Moyses, homo Dei, filiis Israël ante mortem suam.
text_pt: Esta, porém, é a bênção com que Moisés, homem de Deus, abençoou os filhos de Israel antes da sua morte.
text_el: καὶ αὕτη ἡ εὐλογία ἣν εὐλόγησεν Μωυσῆς ἄνθρωπος τοῦ θεοῦ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ πρὸ τῆς τελευτῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he said: The Lord came from Sinai , and from Seir he rose up to us: he has appeared from mount Pharan, and with him thousands of saints . In his right hand a fiery law .
text_la: Et ait : Dominus de Sinai venit, et de Seir ortus est nobis : apparuit de monte Pharan, et cum eo sanctorum millia. In dextera ejus ignea lex.
text_pt: Disse pois: O Senhor veio de Sinai, e lhes subiu de Seir; resplandeceu desde o monte Parã, e veio com dez milhares de santos; à sua direita havia para eles o fogo da lei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος ἐκ Σινα ἥκει καὶ ἐπέφανεν ἐκ Σηιρ ἡμῖν καὶ κατέσπευσεν ἐξ ὄρους Φαραν σὺν μυριάσιν Καδης ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ ἄγγελοι μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: He has loved the people, all the saints are in his hand: and they that approach to his feet, shall receive of his doctrine.
text_la: Dilexit populos, omnes sancti in manu illius sunt : et qui appropinquant pedibus ejus, accipient de doctrina illius.
text_pt: Na verdade ama os povos; todos os seus santos estão na sua mão; postos serão no meio, entre os teus pés, e cada um receberá das tuas palavras.
text_el: καὶ ἐφείσατο τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντες οἱ ἡγιασμένοι ὑπὸ τὰς χεῖράς σου καὶ οὗτοι ὑπὸ σέ εἰσιν καὶ ἐδέξατο ἀπὸ τῶν λόγων αὐτοῦ

text_en: Moses commanded us a law , the inheritance of the multitude of Jacob .
text_la: Legem præcepit nobis Moyses, hæreditatem multitudinis Jacob.
text_pt: Moisés nos deu a lei, como herança da congregação de Jacó.
text_el: νόμον ὃν ἐνετείλατο ἡμῖν Μωυσῆς κληρονομίαν συναγωγαῖς Ιακωβ

text_en: He shall be king with the most right, the princes of the people, being assembled with the tribes of Israel .
text_la: Erit apud rectissimum rex, congregatis principibus populi cum tribubus Israël.
text_pt: E foi rei em Jesurum, quando se congregaram os cabeças do povo com as tribos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῷ ἠγαπημένῳ ἄρχων συναχθέντων ἀρχόντων λαῶν ἅμα φυλαῖς Ισραηλ

text_en: Let Ruben live, and not die, and be he small in number.
text_la: Vivat Ruben, et non moriatur, et sit parvus in numero.
text_pt: Viva Rúben, e não morra, e que os seus homens não sejam poucos.
text_el: ζήτω Ρουβην καὶ μὴ ἀποθανέτω καὶ ἔστω πολὺς ἐν ἀριθμῷ

text_en: This is the blessing of Juda . Hear, O Lord , the voice of Juda , and bring him in unto his people: his hands shall fight for him, and he shall be his helper against his enemies.
text_la: Hæc est Judæ benedictio : Audi, Domine, vocem Judæ, et ad populum suum introduc eum : manus ejus pugnabunt pro eo, et adjutor illius contra adversarios ejus erit.
text_pt: E isto é o que disse de Judá: Ouve, ó Senhor, a voz de Judá, e introduze-o no seu povo; as suas mãos lhe bastem, e tu lhe sejas em ajuda contra os seus inimigos.
text_el: καὶ αὕτη Ιουδα εἰσάκουσον κύριε φωνῆς Ιουδα καὶ εἰς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ εἰσέλθοισαν αἱ χεῖρες αὐτοῦ διακρινοῦσιν αὐτῷ καὶ βοηθὸς ἐκ τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτοῦ ἔσῃ

text_en: To Levi also he said: Your perfection , and your doctrine be to your holy man , whom you have proved in the temptation, and judged at the waters of contradiction:
text_la: Levi quoque ait : Perfectio tua, et doctrina tua viro sancto tuo, quem probasti in tentatione, et judicasti ad aquas contradictionis.
text_pt: E de Levi disse: Teu Tumim e teu Urim são para o teu amado, que tu provaste em Massá, com quem contendeste junto às águas de Meribá.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Λευι εἶπεν δότε Λευι δήλους αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀλήθειαν αὐτοῦ τῷ ἀνδρὶ τῷ ὁσίῳ ὃν ἐπείρασαν αὐτὸν ἐν πείρᾳ ἐλοιδόρησαν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ ὕδατος ἀντιλογίας

text_en: Who has said to his father, and to his mother: I do not know you; and to his brethren: I know you not: and their own children they have not known. These have kept your word, and observed your covenant,
text_la: Qui dixit patri suo et matri suæ : Nescio vos : et fratribus suis : Ignoro vos : et nescierunt filios suos. Hi custodierunt eloquium tuum, et pactum tuum servaverunt.
text_pt: Aquele que disse a seu pai, e à sua mãe: Nunca os vi; e não conheceu a seus irmãos, e não estimou a seus filhos; pois guardaram a tua palavra e observaram a tua aliança.
text_el: ὁ λέγων τῷ πατρὶ καὶ τῇ μητρί οὐχ ἑόρακά σε καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐπέγνω καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ ἀπέγνω ἐφύλαξεν τὰ λόγιά σου καὶ τὴν διαθήκην σου διετήρησεν

text_en: your judgments, O Jacob , and your law , O Israel : they shall put incense in your wrath and holocaust upon your altar .
text_la: Judicia tua, o Jacob, et legem tuam, o Israël : ponent thymiama in furore tuo, et holocaustum super altare tuum.
text_pt: Ensinaram os teus juízos a Jacó, e a tua lei a Israel; puseram incenso no teu nariz, e o holocausto sobre o teu altar.
text_el: δηλώσουσιν τὰ δικαιώματά σου τῷ Ιακωβ καὶ τὸν νόμον σου τῷ Ισραηλ ἐπιθήσουσιν θυμίαμα ἐν ὀργῇ σου διὰ παντὸς ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριόν σου

text_en: Bless , O Lord , his strength, and receive the works of his hands. Strike the backs of his enemies, and let not them that hate him rise.
text_la: Benedic, Domine, fortitudini ejus : et opera manuum illius suscipe. Percute dorsa inimicorum ejus : et qui oderunt eum, non consurgant.
text_pt: Abençoa o seu poder, ó Senhor, e aceita a obra das suas mãos; fere os lombos dos que se levantam contra ele e o odeiam, para que nunca mais se levantem.
text_el: εὐλόγησον κύριε τὴν ἰσχὺν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν αὐτοῦ δέξαι κάταξον ὀσφὺν ἐχθρῶν ἐπανεστηκότων αὐτῷ καὶ οἱ μισοῦντες αὐτὸν μὴ ἀναστήτωσαν

text_en: And to Benjamin he said: The best beloved of the Lord shall dwell confidently in him: as in a bride chamber shall he abide all the day long, and between his shoulders shall be rest.
text_la: Et Benjamin ait : Amantissimus Domini habitabit confidenter in eo : quasi in thalamo tota die morabitur, et inter humeros illius requiescet.
text_pt: E de Benjamim disse: O amado do Senhor habitará seguro com ele; todo o dia o cobrirá, e morará entre os seus ombros.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Βενιαμιν εἶπεν ἠγαπημένος ὑπὸ κυρίου κατασκηνώσει πεποιθώς καὶ ὁ θεὸς σκιάζει ἐπ' αὐτῷ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ὤμων αὐτοῦ κατέπαυσεν

text_en: To Joseph also he said: Of the blessing of the Lord be his land, of the fruits of heaven , and of the dew, and of the deep that lies beneath.
text_la: Joseph quoque ait : De benedictione Domini terra ejus, de pomis cæli, et rore, atque abysso subjacente.
text_pt: E de José disse: Bendita do Senhor seja a sua terra, com o mais excelente dos céus, com o orvalho e com o abismo que jaz abaixo.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Ιωσηφ εἶπεν ἀπ' εὐλογίας κυρίου ἡ γῆ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ ὡρῶν οὐρανοῦ καὶ δρόσου καὶ ἀπὸ ἀβύσσων πηγῶν κάτωθεν

text_en: Of the fruits brought forth by the sun and by the moon.
text_la: De pomis fructuum solis ac lunæ,
text_pt: E com os mais excelentes frutos do sol, e com as mais excelentes produções das luas,
text_el: καὶ καθ' ὥραν γενημάτων ἡλίου τροπῶν καὶ ἀπὸ συνόδων μηνῶν

text_en: Of the tops of the ancient mountains, of the fruits of the everlasting hills:
text_la: de vertice antiquorum montium, de pomis collium æternorum :
text_pt: E com o mais excelente dos montes antigos, e com o mais excelente dos outeiros eternos.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ κορυφῆς ὀρέων ἀρχῆς καὶ ἀπὸ κορυφῆς βουνῶν ἀενάων

text_en: And of the fruits of the earth, and of the fullness thereof. The blessing of him that appeared in the bush, come upon the head of Joseph , and upon the crown of the Nazarite among his brethren.
text_la: et de frugibus terræ, et de plenitudine ejus. Benedictio illius qui apparuit in rubo, veniat super caput Joseph, et super verticem nazaræi inter fratres suos.
text_pt: E com o mais excelente da terra, e da sua plenitude, e com a benevolência daquele que habitava na sarça, venha sobre a cabeça de José, e sobre o alto da cabeça daquele que foi separado de seus irmãos.
text_el: καὶ καθ' ὥραν γῆς πληρώσεως καὶ τὰ δεκτὰ τῷ ὀφθέντι ἐν τῷ βάτῳ ἔλθοισαν ἐπὶ κεφαλὴν Ιωσηφ καὶ ἐπὶ κορυφῆς δοξασθεὶς ἐν ἀδελφοῖς

text_en: His beauty as of the firstling of a bullock, his horns as the horns of a rhinoceros: with them shall he push the nations even to the ends of the earth. These are the multitudes of Ephraim and these the thousands of Manasses .
text_la: Quasi primogeniti tauri pulchritudo ejus, cornua rhinocerotis cornua illius : in ipsis ventilabit gentes usque ad terminos terræ. Hæ sunt multitudines Ephraim : et hæc millia Manasse.
text_pt: Ele tem a glória do primogênito do seu touro, e os seus chifres são chifres de boi selvagem; com eles rechaçará todos os povos até às extremidades da terra; estes pois são os dez milhares de Efraim, e estes são os milhares de Manassés.
text_el: πρωτότοκος ταύρου τὸ κάλλος αὐτοῦ κέρατα μονοκέρωτος τὰ κέρατα αὐτοῦ ἐν αὐτοῖς ἔθνη κερατιεῖ ἅμα ἕως ἐπ' ἄκρου γῆς αὗται μυριάδες Εφραιμ καὶ αὗται χιλιάδες Μανασση

text_en: And to Zabulon he said: Rejoice, O Zabulon , in your going out; and Issachar in your tabernacles.
text_la: Et Zabulon ait : Lætare, Zabulon, in exitu tuo, et Issachar in tabernaculis tuis.
text_pt: E de Zebulom disse: Zebulom, alegra-te nas tuas saídas; e tu, Issacar, nas tuas tendas.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Ζαβουλων εἶπεν εὐφράνθητι Ζαβουλων ἐν ἐξοδίᾳ σου καί Ισσαχαρ ἐν τοῖς σκηνώμασιν αὐτοῦ

text_en: They shall call the people to the mountain: there shall they sacrifice the victims of justice . Who shall suck as milk the abundance of the sea, and the hidden treasures of the sands.
text_la: Populos vocabunt ad montem : ibi immolabunt victimas justitiæ. Qui inundationem maris quasi lac sugent, et thesauros absconditos arenarum.
text_pt: Eles chamarão os povos ao monte; ali apresentarão ofertas de justiça, porque chuparão a abundância dos mares e os tesouros escondidos da areia.
text_el: ἔθνη ἐξολεθρεύσουσιν καὶ ἐπικαλέσεσθε ἐκεῖ καὶ θύσετε θυσίαν δικαιοσύνης ὅτι πλοῦτος θαλάσσης θηλάσει σε καὶ ἐμπόρια παράλιον κατοικούντων

text_en: And to Gad he said: Blessed be Gad in his breadth: he has rested as a lion, and has seized upon the arm and the top of the head.
text_la: Et Gad ait : Benedictus in latitudine Gad : quasi leo requievit, cepitque brachium et verticem.
text_pt: E de Gade disse: Bendito aquele que faz dilatar a Gade; habita como a leoa, e despedaça o braço e o alto da cabeça.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Γαδ εἶπεν εὐλογημένος ἐμπλατύνων Γαδ ὡς λέων ἀνεπαύσατο συντρίψας βραχίονα καὶ ἄρχοντα

text_en: And he saw his pre-eminence, that in his portion the teacher was laid up: who was with the princes of the people, and did the justices of the Lord , and his judgment with Israel .
text_la: Et vidit principatum suum, quod in parte sua doctor esset repositus : qui fuit cum principibus populi, et fecit justitias Domini, et judicium suum cum Israël.
text_pt: E se proveu da melhor parte, porquanto ali estava escondida a porção do legislador; por isso veio com os chefes do povo, executou a justiça do Senhor e os seus juízos para com Israel.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν ἀπαρχὴν αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐκεῖ ἐμερίσθη γῆ ἀρχόντων συνηγμένων ἅμα ἀρχηγοῖς λαῶν δικαιοσύνην κύριος ἐποίησεν καὶ κρίσιν αὐτοῦ μετὰ Ισραηλ

text_en: To Dan also he said: Dan is a young lion, he shall flow plentifully from Basan.
text_la: Dan quoque ait : Dan catulus leonis, fluet largiter de Basan.
text_pt: E de Dã disse: Dã é cria de leão; que salta de Basã.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Δαν εἶπεν Δαν σκύμνος λέοντος καὶ ἐκπηδήσεται ἐκ τοῦ Βασαν

text_en: And to Nephtali he said: Nephtali shall enjoy abundance, and shall be full of the blessings of the Lord : he shall possess the sea and the south.
text_la: Et Nephthali dixit : Nephthali abundantia perfruetur, et plenus erit benedictionibus Domini : mare et meridiem possidebit.
text_pt: E de Naftali disse: Farta-te, ó Naftali, da benevolência, e enche-te da bênção do Senhor; possui o ocidente e o sul.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Νεφθαλι εἶπεν Νεφθαλι πλησμονὴ δεκτῶν καὶ ἐμπλησθήτω εὐλογίαν παρὰ κυρίου θάλασσαν καὶ λίβα κληρονομήσει

text_en: To Aser also he said: Let Aser be blessed with children, let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.
text_la: Aser quoque ait : Benedictus in filiis Aser, sit placens fratribus suis, et tingat in oleo pedem suum :
text_pt: E de Aser disse: Bendito seja Aser com seus filhos; agrade a seus irmãos, e banhe em azeite o seu pé.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Ασηρ εἶπεν εὐλογητὸς ἀπὸ τέκνων Ασηρ καὶ ἔσται δεκτὸς τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτοῦ βάψει ἐν ἐλαίῳ τὸν πόδα αὐτοῦ

text_en: His shoe shall be iron and brass. As the days of your youth, so also shall your old age be.
text_la: ferrum et æs calceamentum ejus. Sicut dies juventutis tuæ, ita et senectus tua.
text_pt: Seja de ferro e de metal o teu calçado; e a tua força seja como os teus dias.
text_el: σίδηρος καὶ χαλκὸς τὸ ὑπόδημα αὐτοῦ ἔσται καὶ ὡς αἱ ἡμέραι σου ἡ ἰσχύς σου

text_en: There is no other god like the God of the rightest: he that is mounted upon the heaven is your helper. By his magnificence the clouds run hither and thither.
text_la: Non est deus alius ut Deus rectissimi, ascensor cæli, auxiliator tuus. Magnificentia ejus discurrunt nubes,
text_pt: Não há outro, ó Jesurum, semelhante a Deus, que cavalga sobre os céus para a tua ajuda, e com a sua majestade sobre as mais altas nuvens.
text_el: οὐκ ἔστιν ὥσπερ ὁ θεὸς τοῦ ἠγαπημένου ὁ ἐπιβαίνων ἐπὶ τὸν οὐρανὸν βοηθός σου καὶ ὁ μεγαλοπρεπὴς τοῦ στερεώματος

text_en: His dwelling is above, and underneath are the everlasting arms: he shall cast out the enemy from before you, and shall say: Be brought to nought.
text_la: habitaculum ejus sursum, et subter brachia sempiterna ejiciet a facie tua inimicum, dicetque : Conterere.
text_pt: O Deus eterno é a tua habitação, e por baixo estão os braços eternos; e ele lançará o inimigo de diante de ti, e dirá: Destrói-o.
text_el: καὶ σκέπασις θεοῦ ἀρχῆς καὶ ὑπὸ ἰσχὺν βραχιόνων ἀενάων καὶ ἐκβαλεῖ ἀπὸ προσώπου σου ἐχθρὸν λέγων ἀπόλοιο

text_en: Israel shall dwell in safety, and alone. The eye of Jacob in a land of corn and wine, and the heavens shall be misty with dew.
text_la: Habitabit Israël confidenter, et solus. Oculus Jacob in terra frumenti et vini, cælique caligabunt rore.
text_pt: Israel, pois, habitará só, seguro, na terra da fonte de Jacó, na terra de grão e de mosto; e os seus céus gotejarão orvalho.
text_el: καὶ κατασκηνώσει Ισραηλ πεποιθὼς μόνος ἐπὶ γῆς Ιακωβ ἐπὶ σίτῳ καὶ οἴνῳ καὶ ὁ οὐρανὸς αὐτῷ συννεφὴς δρόσῳ

text_en: Blessed are you, Israel : who is like to you, O people, that are saved by the Lord ? The shield of your help, and the sword of your glory : your enemies shall deny you, and you shall tread upon their necks.
text_la: Beatus es tu, Israël : quis similis tui, popule, qui salvaris in Domino? Scutum auxilii tui, et gladius gloriæ tuæ : negabunt te inimici tui, et tu eorum colla calcabis.
text_pt: Bem-aventurado tu, ó Israel! Quem é como tu? Um povo salvo pelo Senhor, o escudo do teu socorro, e a espada da tua majestade; por isso os teus inimigos te serão sujeitos, e tu pisarás sobre as suas alturas.
text_el: μακάριος σύ Ισραηλ τίς ὅμοιός σοι λαὸς σῳζόμενος ὑπὸ κυρίου ὑπερασπιεῖ ὁ βοηθός σου καὶ ἡ μάχαιρα καύχημά σου καὶ ψεύσονταί σε οἱ ἐχθροί σου καὶ σὺ ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλον αὐτῶν ἐπιβήσῃ

text_en: Then Moses went up from the plains of Moab upon mount Nebo , to the top of Phasga over against Jericho : and the Lord showed him all the land of Galaad as far as Dan .
text_la: Ascendit ergo Moyses de campestribus Moab super montem Nebo, in verticem Phasga contra Jericho : ostenditque ei Dominus omnem terram Galaad usque Dan,
text_pt: Então subiu Moisés das campinas de Moabe ao monte Nebo, ao cume de Pisga, que está em frente a Jericó e o SENHOR mostrou-lhe toda a terra desde Gileade até Dã;
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη Μωυσῆς ἀπὸ Αραβωθ Μωαβ ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος Ναβαυ ἐπὶ κορυφὴν Φασγα ἥ ἐστιν ἐπὶ προσώπου Ιεριχω καὶ ἔδειξεν αὐτῷ κύριος πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν Γαλααδ ἕως Δαν

text_en: And all Nephtali , and the land of Ephraim and Manasses , and all the land of Juda unto the furthermost sea,
text_la: et universum Nephthali, terramque Ephraim et Manasse, et omnem terram Juda usque ad mare novissimum,
text_pt: E todo Naftali, e a terra de Efraim, e Manassés e toda a terra de Judá, até ao mar ocidental;
text_el: καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν Νεφθαλι καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν Εφραιμ καὶ Μανασση καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν Ιουδα ἕως τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς ἐσχάτης

text_en: and the south part, and the breadth of the plain of Jericho the city of palm trees as far as Segor .
text_la: et australem partem, et latitudinem campi Jericho civitatis palmarum usque Segor.
text_pt: E o sul, e a campina do vale de Jericó, a cidade das palmeiras, até Zoar.
text_el: καὶ τὴν ἔρημον καὶ τὰ περίχωρα Ιεριχω πόλιν φοινίκων ἕως Σηγωρ

text_en: And the Lord said to him: This is the land, for which I swore to Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob , saying: I will give it to your seed. You have seen it with your eyes, and shall not pass over to it.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad eum : Hæc est terra, pro qua juravi Abraham, Isaac, et Jacob, dicens : Semini tuo dabo eam. Vidisti eam oculis tuis, et non transibis ad illam.
text_pt: E disse-lhe o Senhor: Esta é a terra que jurei a Abraão, Isaque, e Jacó, dizendo: À tua descendência a darei; eu te faço vê-la com os teus olhos, porém lá não passarás.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν αὕτη ἡ γῆ ἣν ὤμοσα Αβρααμ καὶ Ισαακ καὶ Ιακωβ λέγων τῷ σπέρματι ὑμῶν δώσω αὐτήν καὶ ἔδειξα αὐτὴν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς σου καὶ ἐκεῖ οὐκ εἰσελεύσῃ

text_en: And Moses the servant of the Lord died there, in the land of Moab , by the commandment of the Lord :
text_la: Mortuusque est ibi Moyses servus Domini, in terra Moab, jubente Domino:
text_pt: Assim morreu ali Moisés, servo do Senhor, na terra de Moabe, conforme a palavra do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐτελεύτησεν Μωυσῆς οἰκέτης κυρίου ἐν γῇ Μωαβ διὰ ῥήματος κυρίου

text_en: And he buried him in the valley of the land of Moab over against Phogor: and no man has known of his sepulchre until this present day.
text_la: et sepelivit eum in valle terræ Moab contra Phogor : et non cognovit homo sepulchrum ejus usque in præsentem diem.
text_pt: E o sepultou num vale, na terra de Moabe, em frente de Bete-Peor; e ninguém soube até hoje o lugar da sua sepultura.
text_el: καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτὸν ἐν Γαι ἐν γῇ Μωαβ ἐγγὺς οἴκου Φογωρ καὶ οὐκ οἶδεν οὐδεὶς τὴν ταφὴν αὐτοῦ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, neither were his teeth moved.
text_la: Moyses centum et viginti annorum erat quando mortuus est : non caligavit oculus ejus, nec dentes illius moti sunt.
text_pt: Era Moisés da idade de cento e vinte anos quando morreu; os seus olhos nunca se escureceram, nem perdeu o seu vigor.
text_el: Μωυσῆς δὲ ἦν ἑκατὸν καὶ εἴκοσι ἐτῶν ἐν τῷ τελευτᾶν αὐτόν οὐκ ἠμαυρώθησαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ οὐδὲ ἐφθάρησαν τὰ χελύνια αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the children of Israel mourned for him in the plains of Moab thirty days: and the days of their mourning in which they mourned Moses were ended.
text_la: Fleveruntque eum filii Israël in campestribus Moab triginta diebus : et completi sunt dies planctus lugentium Moysen.
text_pt: E os filhos de Israel prantearam a Moisés trinta dias, nas campinas de Moabe; e os dias do pranto no luto de Moisés se cumpriram.
text_el: καὶ ἔκλαυσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τὸν Μωυσῆν ἐν Αραβωθ Μωαβ ἐπὶ τοῦ Ιορδάνου κατὰ Ιεριχω τριάκοντα ἡμέρας καὶ συνετελέσθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι πένθους κλαυθμοῦ Μωυσῆ

text_en: And Joshua the son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom, because Moses had laid his hands upon him. And the children of Israel obeyed him, and did as the Lord commanded Moses .
text_la: Josue vero filius Nun repletus est spiritu sapientiæ, quia Moyses posuit super eum manus suas. Et obedierunt ei filii Israël, feceruntque sicut præcepit Dominus Moysi.
text_pt: E Josué, filho de Num, foi cheio do espírito de sabedoria, porquanto Moisés tinha posto sobre ele as suas mãos; assim os filhos de Israel lhe deram ouvidos, e fizeram como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.
text_el: καὶ Ἰησοῦς υἱὸς Ναυη ἐνεπλήσθη πνεύματος συνέσεως ἐπέθηκεν γὰρ Μωυσῆς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ ἐπ' αὐτόν καὶ εἰσήκουσαν αὐτοῦ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καὶ ἐποίησαν καθότι ἐνετείλατο κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: And there arose no more a prophet in Israel like unto Moses , whom the Lord knew face to face,
text_la: Et non surrexit ultra propheta in Israël sicut Moyses, quem nosset Dominus facie ad faciem,
text_pt: E nunca mais se levantou em Israel profeta algum como Moisés, a quem o Senhor conhecera face a face;
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἀνέστη ἔτι προφήτης ἐν Ισραηλ ὡς Μωυσῆς ὃν ἔγνω κύριος αὐτὸν πρόσωπον κατὰ πρόσωπον

text_en: in all the signs and wonders , which he sent by him, to do in the land of Egypt to Pharao , and to all his servants, and to his whole land,
text_la: in omnibus signis atque portentis, quæ misit per eum, ut faceret in terra Ægypti Pharaoni, et omnibus servis ejus, universæque terræ illius,
text_pt: Nem semelhante em todos os sinais e maravilhas, que o Senhor o enviou para fazer na terra do Egito, a Faraó, e a todos os seus servos, e a toda a sua terra.
text_el: ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς σημείοις καὶ τέρασιν ὃν ἀπέστειλεν αὐτὸν κύριος ποιῆσαι αὐτὰ ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ Φαραω καὶ τοῖς θεράπουσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ πάσῃ τῇ γῇ αὐτοῦ

text_en: and all the mighty hand, and great miracles , which Moses did before all Israel .
text_la: et cunctam manum robustam, magnaque mirabilia, quæ fecit Moyses coram universo Israël.
text_pt: E em toda a mão forte, e em todo o grande espanto, que praticou Moisés aos olhos de todo o Israel.
text_el: τὰ θαυμάσια τὰ μεγάλα καὶ τὴν χεῖρα τὴν κραταιάν ἃ ἐποίησεν Μωυσῆς ἔναντι παντὸς Ισραηλ
